text:
Yeh Surah sab se aakhir Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utri hai Bukhari Sharif mein hai sab se aakhir (Ayat Yasfatunaka ilakh,) utri aur sab se aakhri Surah Surah-e-Bara'at utri hai. Is ke shuru mein Bismillah na hone ki wajah yeh hai ke Sahaba ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki iqtada kar ke ise Quran mein likha nahin tha. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne Hazrat Usman se poocha ke aakhir kya wajah hai aap ne Surah-e-Anfal ko jo Masani mein se hai aur Surah-e-Bara'at ko jo Mi'een mein se hai mila diya aur in ke darmiyan Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim nahin likhi aur pehle ki saat lambi Suraton mein inhein rakhein? Aap ne jawab diya ke basa auqat Huzoor Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ek saath kai Suratein utarti thin. Jab Ayat utarti aap wahi ke likhne walon mein se kisi ko bula kar farma dete ke is Ayat ko falan Surah mein likh do jis mein yeh yeh zikr hai. Surah-e-Anfal Madinah Sharif mein sab se pehle nazil hui aur Surah-e-Bara'at sab se aakhir mein utri thi bayanat dono ke milte julte thay mujhe darr laga ke kahin yeh bhi isi mein se na ho Huzoor (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka intiqal ho gaya aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se nahin farmaya ke yeh is mein se hai is liye mein ne dono Suratein muttasil likhin aur inke darmiyan Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim nahin likhin aur saat pehli lambi Suraton mein inhein rakha. Is Surah ka ibtidai hissa is waqt utra jab aap Ghazwa-e-Tabook se wapas aa rahe thay. Hajj ka zamana tha Mushrikeen apni aadat ke mutabiq Hajj mein aakar Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf nange ho kar kiya karte thay. Aap ne in mein khala mala hona napasand farma kar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko Hajj ka Imam bana kar is saal Makkah Sharif rawana farmaya ke Musalmanon ko Ahkam-e-Hajj sikhayein aur Mushrikon mein elan kar dein ke woh ayinda saal se Hajj ko na aayein aur Surah-e-Bara'at ka bhi aam logon mein elan kar dein. Aap ke peeche phir Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko bheja ke aap ka paigham bahaisiyat aap ke nazdiki qarabati-dari ke aap bhi pahuncha dein jaise ke is ka tafseeli bayan aa raha hai. Insha'Allah. Pas farman hai ke yeh be-ta'alluq hai. Aur Allah aur is ke Rasool ki taraf se baaz to kehte hain yeh elan is ahd-o-paiman ke mutalliq pehchan se koi waqt muayyan na tha ya jin se ahd chaar mah se kam ka tha lekin jin ka lamba ahd tha woh badastoor baqi raha. Jaise farman hai ke (Fa-atimmū ilaihim 'ahdahum ilā muddatihim, innallāha yuhibbul-muttaqīn) (At-Taubah: 4) in ki muddat poori hone tak tum in se in ka ahd nibhao. Hadith Sharif mein bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya hum se jin ka ahd-o-paiman hai hum is par muqarrara waqt tak pabandi se qaim hain go is bare mein aur aqwal bhi hain lekin sab se accha aur sab se qawi qaul yehi hai. Ibn Abbas farmate hain ke jin logon se ahd ho chuka tha in ke liye chaar mah ki had-bandi Allah Ta'ala ne muqarrar ki aur jin se ahd na tha in ke liye hurmat wale mahinon ke guzar jaane ki ahd-bandi muqarrar kar di yani das Zil-Hijjah se Muharram-ul-Haram tak ke pachaas din.

Is muddat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un se jang karne ki ijazat de di gayi hai jab tak woh Islam qabool na karlein. Aur jin se ahad hai woh das Zil-Hijjah ke elaan ke din se le kar bees Rabi-ul-Aakhir tak apni tayyari karlein phir agar chahein muqable par aa-jayein yeh waqia san 9 Hijri ka hai. Aap ne Hazrat Abu Bakr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko Ameer-e-Hajj muqarrar kar ke bheja tha aur Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko tees ya chalis aayatein Quran ki is Surah ki de kar bheja ke aap chaar maah ki muddat ka elaan kar dein. Aap ne un ke deron mein gharon mein manzilon mein ja ja kar yeh aayatein unhein suna dein aur saath hi Sarkar-e-Nabuwat ka yeh hukm bhi suna diya ke is saal ke baad Hajj ke liye koi mushrik na aaye aur Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf koi nanga shakhs na kare. Qabila Khuza'ah, Qabila Mudlaj aur doosre sab qabail ke liye bhi yehi elaan tha. Tabook se aakar aap ne Hajj ka irada kiya tha lekin mushrikon ka wahan aana un ka nange ho kar wahan ka tawaf karna Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko napasand tha is liye Hajj na kiya aur is saal Hazrat Abu Bakr (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko aur Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko bheja unhon ne Zil-Majaz ke bazaron mein aur har gali kooche aur har har padao aur maidan mein elaan kiya ke chaar mahine tak ki toh shirk aur mushrik ko mohlat hai is ke baad hamari Islami talwarein apna jauhar dikhayengi bees din Zil-Hijjah ke, Muharram poora, Safar poora aur Rabi-ul-Awwal poora aur das din Rabi-ul-Aakhir ke. Zuhri kehte hain Shawwal Muharram tak ki dheel thi lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Aur samajh se bhi bala-tar hai ke hukm pahunchne se pehle hi muddat shumari kaise ho sakti hai?

Hajj-e-Akbar ke din ilan Allah Ta'ala aur uske Rasool ﷺ ki taraf se aam ilan hai aur hai bhi bare Hajj ke din. Yaani Eid-e-Qurban ko jo Hajj ke tamam dinon se bara aur afzal din hai ke Allah aur uska Rasool ﷺ mushrikon se bari-uz-zimma, bezar aur alag hai. Agar ab bhi tum gumrahi aur shirk-o-burai chor do toh yeh tumhare haq mein behtar hai, tauba karlo, naik ban jao, Islam qubool karlo, shirk-o-kufr chor do aur agar tum ne na mana, apni zalalat par qayam rahe toh tum na ab Allah ke qabze se baahar ho na آئندہ kisi waqt Allah ko daba sakte ho. Woh tum par qadir hai, tumhari chotiyan uske haath mein hain, woh kafiron ko duniya mein bhi saza karega aur aakhirat mein bhi azab karega.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H (Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain ke mujhe Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.H ne qurbani wale din un logon mein jo ilan ke liye bheje gaye thay, bheja. Hum ne munadi kardi ke is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj ko na aaye aur Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf koi shakhs nanga ho kar na kare. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali ko bheja ke Surah Bara'at ka ilan kardein, pas aap ne bhi Mina mein hamare sath Eid ke din unhi ahkaam ki munadi ki. 

Hajj-e-Akbar ka din Baqra Eid ka din hai, kyunke log Hajj-e-Asghar bola karte thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.H ke ilan ke baad Hijjatul Wida mein ek bhi mushrik Hajj ko nahi aaya tha. Hunain ke zamane mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Ji'rana se umre ka ehram bandha tha, phir us saal Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.H ko Ameer-e-Hajj bana kar bheja aur aap ne Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H ko munadi ke liye rawana farmaya, phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali R.H ko bheja ke Bara'at ka ilan kardein. Ameer-e-Hajj Hazrat Ali R.H ke aane ke baad bhi Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.H hi rahe R.H. Lekin is riwayat mein gharabat hai, umra Ji'rana wale saal Ameer-e-Hajj Hazrat Ittab bin Asid thay, Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.H toh san 9 Hijri mein Ameer-e-Hajj thay.

Musnad ki riwayat mein hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira farmate hain, is saal Hazrat Ali R.H ke sath main tha, hum ne pukar pukar kar munadi kardi ke jannat mein sirf imandar hi jayenge, Baitullah ka tawaf a آئندہ se koi shakhs oryani ki halat mein nahi kar sakega. Jin ke sath hamare ahd-o-paiman hain, unki muddat aaj se chaar mah ki hai, is muddat ke guzar jaane ke baad Allah aur uska Rasool ﷺ mushrikon se bari-uz-zimma hain, is saal ke baad kisi kafir ko Baitullah ke Hajj ki ijazat nahi. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H farmate hain, yeh munadi karte karte mera gala par gaya. Hazrat Ali ki aawaz baith jaane ke baad maine munadi shuru kardi thi. 

Ek riwayat mein hai, jis se ahd hai, uski muddat wahi hai. Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain, mujhe toh dar hai ke yeh jumla kisi rawi ke wahm ki wajah se na ho, kyunke muddat ke bare mein iske khilaf bahut si riwayatein hain.

Musnad mein hai ke Bara'at ka ailan karne ko Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.H ko bheja woh Zul-Hulaifa pohanche honge jo Aap ne farmaya ke yeh ailan toh ya main khud karunga ya mere Ahl-e-Bait mein se koi shakhs karega phir Aap ne Hazrat Ali ko bheja. Hazrat Ali farmate hain Surah Bara'at ki das aayetein jab utareen Aap ne Hazrat Abu Bakr ko bula kar farmaya inhein le jao aur Ahl-e-Makkah ko sunao, phir mujhe yaad farmaya aur irshad hua ke tum jao Abu Bakr Siddique R.H se tum milo jahan woh milen un se kitab le lena aur Makkah walon ke paas ja kar inhein parh sunana. Main chala, Juhfa mein ja kar mulaqat hui, main ne un se kitab le li, Aap wapas lotay aur Huzoor ﷺ se poosha ke kya mere bare mein koi aayetein nazil hui hain? Aap ne farmaya nahin, Jibraeel A.S mere paas aaye aur farmaya ke ya toh yeh paigham khud Aap pohanchayein ya aur koi shakhs jo Aap mein se ho. Is sanad mein da'af hai aur is se yeh murad bhi nahin Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.H us waqt lot aaye nahin balki Aap ne apni sardari mein woh Hajj karaya, Hajj se farigh ho kar phir wapas aaye jaise ke aur riwayaton mein sarahatan marwi hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ali R.H se jab Huzoor ﷺ ne is paigham rasani ka zikr kiya toh Hazrat Ali R.H ne uzr paish kiya ke main umar ke lihaz se aur taqreer ke lihaz se apne mein kami pata hoon, Aap ne farmaya lekin zarurat is ki hai ke ise ya toh main aap pohanchaun ya toh pohanchaye. Hazrat Ali R.H ne kaha agar yahi hai toh lijiye main jata hoon, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jao Allah teri zuban ko sabit rakhe aur tere dil ko hidayat de, phir apna hath un ke munh par rakha.

Logon ne Hazrat Ali se poosha ke Hajj ke moqe par Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.H ke sath Aap ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ne kya baat pohanchane bheja tha? Aap ne wahi ooper wali charon baatein bayan farmayeen. Musnad wagairah mein yeh riwayat kisi tareeq se aayi hai is mein lafz yeh hain ke jin se muaahida hai woh jis muddat tak hai usi tak rahega.

Aur hadith mein hai ke Aap se logon ne kaha ke Aap Hajj mein Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.H ko bhej chuke hain kash ke yeh paigham bhi inhein pohncha dete. Aap ne toh Hajj ka intezam kiya aur Eid wale din Hazrat Ali R.H ne logon ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ke yeh ahkaam pohnchaye. Phir yeh dono Aap ke paas aaye, pas mushrikeen mein se jin se aam ahad tha un ke liye toh chaar mah ki muddat ho gayi, baqi jis se jitna ahad tha woh badastoor raha.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Abu Bakr Siddique ko toh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Ameer-e-Hajj bana kar bheja tha aur mujhe un ke paas chaalees aayetein Surah Bara'at ki de kar bheja tha, Aap ne Arafat ke maidan mein Arafa ke din logon ko khutba diya, phir Hazrat Ali R.H se farmaya uthiye aur Sarkar-e-Risalat Maab ka paigham logon ko suna dijiye. Pas Hazrat Ali R.H ne khare ho kar in chaalees aayeton ki tilawat farmayi.

Phir laut kar Mina mein aa kar Jamrah par kankariyan phenkein, oont nahr kiya, sar mundwaya, phir mujhe maloom hua ke sab haaji is khutbe ke waqt maujood thay, is liye maine deron mein aur khemon mein aur padaao mein ja ja kar munadi shuru kardi. Mera khayal hai ke shayad is wajah se logon ko yeh guman ho gaya, yeh dasween tarikh ka zikr hai, halanki asl paigham nauween ko Arafah ke din pahuncha diya gaya tha.

Abu Ishaq kehte hain maine Abu Juhaifah se poocha ke Hajj-e-Akbar ka konsa din hai? Aap ne farmaya Arafah ka din. Maine kaha yeh aap apni taraf se farma rahe hain ya Sahaba (R.A) se suna hua? Farmaya sab kuch yahi hai. Ata bhi yahi farmate hain, Hazrat Umar (R.A) bhi yahi farma kar farmate hain, pas is din koi roza na rakhe.

Rawi kehta hai maine apne baap ke baad Hajj kiya, Madine pahuncha aur poocha ke yahan aaj kal sab se afzal koun hain? Logon ne kaha Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib hain (R.A). Main aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke maine Madine walon se poocha ke yahan aaj kal sab se afzal koun hain? To unhon ne aap ka naam liya to main aap ke paas aaya hoon, yeh farmaiye ke Arafah ke din ke rozay ke bare mein aap kya farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya main tumhein apne se aik so darjay behtareen shakhs ko bataoon, woh Amr bin Umar hain, woh is rozay se mana farmate thay aur usi din ko Hajj-e-Akbar farmate thay. (Ibn Abi Hatim waghaira). Aur bhi bohat se buzurgon ne yahi farmaya hai ke Hajj-e-Akbar se murad Arafah ka din hai. Aik mursal hadith mein bhi hai, Aap ne apne Arafah ke khutbe mein farmaya, yahi Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai.

Doosra qaul yeh hai ke is se murad Baqra Eid ka din hai. Hazrat Ali yahi farmate hain. Aik martaba Hazrat Ali Baqra Eid walay din apne safaid khuchar par sawar ja rahe thay ke aik shakhs ne un ki lagam thaam li aur yahi poocha, Aap ne farmaya Hajj-e-Akbar ka din aaj hi ka din hai, lagam chhod de. Abdullah bin Abi Aufa ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Hazrat Mughirah bin Shubah ne apne Eid ke khutbe mein farmaya aaj hi ka din Yaum-ul-Azha hai, aaj hi ka din Yaum-un-Nahr hai, aaj hi ka din Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai. Ibn Abbas se bhi yahi marwi hai aur bhi bohat se log usi taraf gaye hain ke Hajj-e-Akbar Baqra Eid ka din hai. Imam Ibn Jareer ka pasandeeda qaul bhi yahi hai.

Sahih Bukhari ke hawalay se pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) se munadi karne walon ko Mina mein Eid ke din bheja tha. Ibn Jareer mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hijjat-ul-Wida mein jamron ke paas dasween tarikh Dhul-Hijjah ko thahray aur farmaya yeh din Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ki oontni surkh rang ki thi, Aap ne logon se poocha ke jaante bhi ho? Aaj kya din hai? Logon ne kaha qurbani ka din hai. Aap ne farmaya sach hai, yahi din Hajj-e-Akbar ka hai.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap oontni par sawar thay, log is ki nakeel thame hue thay. Aap ne Sahaba (R.A) se poocha ke yeh konsa din hai jaante ho? Hum is khayal se khamosh ho gaye ke shayad Aap is ka koi aur hi naam batayein. Aap ne farmaya yeh Hajj-e-Akbar ka din nahi?

Aur riwayat mein hai ke logon ne aap ke sawal par jawab diya ke yeh Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai. Saeed bin Musayyib farmate hain ke Eid ke baad ka din hai. Mujahid kehte hain Hajj ke sab dinon ka yahi naam hai. Sufyan bhi yahi kehte hain ke jaise Yaum-e-Jamal, Yaum-e-Siffeen in ladaiyon ke tamam dinon ka naam hai, waise hi yeh bhi hai. Hasan Basri se jab yeh sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya tumhein is se kya hasil, yeh toh us saal tha jis saal Hajj ke ameer Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A the. Ibn Sireen isi sawal ke jawab mein farmate hain yahi woh din tha jis mein Rasulullah ﷺ ka aur aam logon ka Hajj hua.

Ehad-nama ki Shart

Pehle jo hadeethein bayaan ho chuki hain un ka aur is ayat ka mazmoon aik hi hai. Is se saaf ho gaya ke jin mein mutlaqan ahd-o-paiman hue thay unhein toh chaar mah ki mohlat di gayi ke is mein woh apna jo chahein kar lein aur jin se kisi muddat tak ahd-paiman ho chuke hain woh sab ahd sabit hain bashart-e-keh woh log muahade ki shara-it par qaim rahein, na musalman ko khud koi eza pahunchayein na un ke dushmanon ki kumak aur imdad karein. Allah Ta'ala apne wadon ke poore logon se mohabbat rakhta hai.

Jihad aur Hurmat Waley Mahiney

Hurmat waley mahino se murad yahan woh chaar mahiney hain jin ka zikr (Inna 'iddatas-shuhori 'indallahi isna 'ashara shahran fi kitabillah yauma khalaqas-samawati wal-arda minha arba'atun hurumun zalikad-dinul-qayyimu fa la tazlimu fihinna anfusakum wa qatilul-mushrikina kaffatan kama yuqatilunakum kaffatan wa'lamu annallaha ma'al-muttaqin) (At-Taubah: 36) mein hai, pas un ke haq mein akhri hurmat wala mahina Muharram-ul-Haram ka hai. Ibn Abbas aur Zahhak se bhi yahi marwi hai, lekin is mein zara tamammul hai, balkah murad is se yahan woh chaar mahiney hain jin mein mushrikin ko panah mili thi ke un ke baad tum se larki hai. Chunancha khud isi surat mein is ka bayan aur ayat mein aa raha hai. Farmata hai in chaar mah ke baad mushrikon se jang karo, unhein qatal karo, unhein giraftar karo, jahan bhi pao. Pas yeh aam hai, lekin mashhoor yeh hai ke yeh khas hai, haram mein larki nahi hosakti, jaise farman hai (Waqtuluhum haisu saqiftumuhum wa akhrijuhum min haisu akhrajukum wal-fitnatu ashaddu minal-qatl, wa la tuqatiluhum 'indal-masjidil-harami hatta yuqatilukum fih, fa in qatalukum faqtuluhum, zalika jaza'ul-kafirin) (Al-Baqarah: 191) yani Masjid-e-Haram ke paas un se na laro jab tak ke woh apni taraf se larki ki ibtida na karein. Agar yeh wahan tum se larein toh phir tumhein bhi un se larki karne ki ijazat hai. Chaho qatal karo, chaho qaid karlo, un ke qilon ka mahasra karo, un ke liye har ghati mein baith kar taak lagao, unhein zad par la kar maro. Yani yahi nahi ke mil jayen toh jharap hojaye, khud charh kar jao. Un ki rahein band karo aur unhein majboor kardo ke ya toh Islam layen ya larein. Is liye farmaya ke agar woh tauba karlein, paband-e-namaz hojayen, zakat dene ke mani'on se jihad karne ki isi jaisi ayaton se Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ne daleel li thi ke larki is shart par haram hai ke Islam mein dakhil hojayen aur Islam ke wajibat baja layen. Is ayat mein arkan-e-Islam ko tarteeb-war bayan farmaya hai, a'la phir adna, pas shahadat ke baad sab se bara rukn-e-Islam namaz hai jo Allah Azzawajal ka haq hai. Namaz ke baad zakat hai jis ka nafa faqiron, miskinon, mohtajon ko pohanchta hai aur makhlooq ka zabardast haq jo insan ke zimme hai ada hojata hai. Yahi wajah hai ke aksar namaz ke sath hi zakat ka zikr Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Mujhe hukm kiya gaya hai ke logon se jihad jari rakho, jab tak ke woh yeh gawahi na dein ke koi mabood bajuz Allah ke nahi hai aur yeh ke Muhammad ﷺ Rasulullah hain aur namazon ko qaim karein aur zakat dein.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmaate hain ke tumhein namazon ke qaim karne aur zakat dene ka hukum kiya gaya hai jo zakat na de uski namaz bhi nahi. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmaate hain Allah Ta'ala hargiz kisi ki namaz qabul nahi farmaata jab tak woh zakat ada na kare. Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A par raham farmaaye aap ki fiqh sabse badhi hui thi. Jo aap ne zakat ke munkeron se jihad kiya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmaate hain mujhe logon se jihad ka hukum diya gaya hai. Jab tak ke woh yeh gawahi na dein ke bajuz Allah Ta'ala barhaq ke aur koi laayiq-e-ibadat nahi aur Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke Rasul hain. Jab woh in dono baaton ka ikraar kar lein, hamare qibla ki taraf munh kar lein, hamara zabeeha khane lagein, hum jaisi namazein padhne lagein to hum par unke khoon unke maal haram hain magar ahkaam-e-haq ke taht unhein woh haq hasil hai jo aur musalmanon ka hai aur unke zimme har woh cheez hai jo aur musalmanon ke zimme hai yeh riwayat Bukhari Sharif mein aur sunan mein bhi hai siwaye Ibn Majah ke. Ibn Jareer mein hai Rasul Maqbool ﷺ farmaate hain jo duniya se is haal mein jaaye ke Allah Ta'ala akele ki khalis ibadat karta ho aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na karta ho to woh is haal mein jaayega ke Allah usse khush hoga. Hazrat Anas R.A farmaate hain yahi Allah ka deen hai isi ko tamam paighambar (Alaihimas Salam) laaye the aur apne Rab ki taraf se apni apni ummaton ko pahunchaya tha isse pehle ke baatein phail jaaein aur khwahishein idhar udhar lag jaaein iski sachai ki shahadat Allah ki aakhri wahi mein maujud hai Allah Ta'ala farmaata hai (Fa in taabu wa aqam-us-salata wa aatw-uz-zakata fa ikhwanukum fid-deeni wa nufassil-ul-aayati li-qawmin ya'lamoon 9. (At-Tawbah: 11) Pas tauba yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala wahid barhaq hai pas tauba yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala wahid barhaq ke siwa auron ki ibadat se dast-bardar ho jaaein namaz aur zakat ke paband ho jaaein aur aayat mein hai ke in teenon kaamo ke baad woh tumhare deeni baradar hain. Dahhak farmaate hain yeh talwar ki aayat hai isne un tamam ahd-o-paiman ko chaak kar diya, jo mushrikon se the. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai ke Bara'at ke nazil hone par chaar mahine guzar jaane ke baad koi ahd-o-zimma baaki nahi raha. Pehli shartein barabari ke sath tod di gayein. Ab Islam aur jihad baaki reh gaya, Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A farmaate hain Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko chaar talwaron ke sath bheja ek to mushrikeen-e-Arab mein farmaata hai (Fa-qtul-ul-mushrikeena haithu wajadtumuhum wa khuzuhum wa ahsuruhum wa-q'udoo lahum kulla marsadin fa in taabu wa aqam-us-salata wa aatw-uz-zakata fa khalloo sabeelahum inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun 9. (At-Tawbah: 5) Mushrikon ko jahan paao qatal karo. Yeh riwayat isi tarah mukhtasaran hai.

Mera khayal hai ke dusri talwar Ahl-e-Kitab mein farmata hai (Qatilul-lazi la yu'minuna billahi wa la bil-yau-mil-akhiri wa la yuharrimuna ma harramallahu wa rasuluhu wa la yadinuna dinal-haqqa minal-lazi utul-kitaba hatta yu'tul-jizyata 'an yadin wa hum saghirun) (At-Taubah: 29) Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala par, qayamat ke din par iman na lane walon aur Allah Rasul ke haram kardah ko haram na manne walon aur Allah ke sachche deen ko qubool karne walon se jo Ahl-e-Kitab hain jihad karo tawaqtike woh zillat ke sath jizya dena qubool kar lein. Teesri talwar munafiqon mein farman hai (Ya ayyuhan-nabiyyu jahidil-kuffara wal-munafiqi-na wagluz 'alaihim wa ma'wuhum jahannamu wa bi'sal-masir) (At-Taubah: 73) Aye Nabi! Kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad karo. Chauthi talwar baghiyon mein irshad hai (Wa in ta'ifatani minal-mu'minina q-tatalu fa aslihu bainahuma fa in baghat ihdahuma 'alal-ukhra fa qatilul-lati tabgi hatta tafi'a ila amril-lahi fa in fa'at fa aslihu bainahuma bil-'adli wa aqsitu innal-laha yuhibbul-muqsitin) (Al-Hujurat: 9) Agar Musalmanon ki do jamaton mein larai ho jaye to un mein sulh kara do, phir bhi agar koi jamat dusri ko dabati chali jaye to un baghiyon se tum laro jab tak ke woh palat kar Allah ke hukm ki mat-hati mein na a jaye. Dahhak aur Suddi ka qaul hai ke yeh ayat talwar (Fa iza laqi-tumul-lazi kafaru fa darbar-riqabi hatta iza as-khantumu-hum fa shuddul-wasoqa fa imma mannam ba'du wa imma fida'an hatta tada'al-harbu auzaruha zalika wa lau yasahul-lahu lantasara minhum wa lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi ba'din wal-lazi qutilu fi sabilillahi fa lan yudilla a'malahum) (Muhammad: 4) se mansukh hai ya'ni bator ehsan ke ya fidya le kar kafir qaidhiyon ko chhor do. Qatadah is ke bar-aks kehte hain pichli ayat pehli se mansukh hai.))

Aman maangne walon ko aman do, munafiqon ki gardan maar do. Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukum farmata hai ke jin kafiron se aap ko jihad ka hukum diya gaya hai, un mein se agar koi aap se aman talab kare toh aap us ki khwahish poori kar dein, usay aman dein, yahan tak ke woh Quran-e-Kareem sun le, aap ki baatein sun le, deen ki taleem maloom kar le, hujjat-e-Rabbani poori ho jaye. Phir apne aman mein hi usay us ke watan pohncha do, be-khofi ke sath yeh apne aman ki jagah pohnch jaye, mumkin hai ke soch samajh kar haq ko qubool kar le. Yeh is liye hai ke yeh be-ilm log hain, inhein deeni maloomat baham pohnchao, Allah ki dawat us ke bandon ke kanon tak pohncha do. 

Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke jo tere paas deeni baatein sunne samajhne ke liye aaye, khwah woh koi hi kyun na ho, woh aman mein hai yahan tak ke Kalamullah sune, phir jahan se aaya hai wahan ba-aman pohnch jaye. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ un logon ko jo deen samajhne aur Allah ki taraf se laye hue paigham ko sunne ke liye aate, inhein aman de diya karte thay. Hudaibiyah wale saal bhi Quraysh ke jitne qasid aaye yahan unhein koi khatra na tha. Urwah bin Masood, Mukarrib bin Hafsah, Suhail bin Amr waghera yakke baad deegare aate rahe. Yahan aakar unhein woh shaan nazar aayi jo Qaisar-o-Kisra ke darbar mein bhi na thi, yahi unhon ne apni qaum se kaha, pas yeh rawiya bhi bohat se logon ki hidayat ka zariya ban gaya. 

Musailmah Kazzab mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ka qasid jab Huzoor ﷺ ki bargah mein pohncha, aap ne us se poocha ke kya tum Musailmah ki risalat ke qayl ho? Us ne kaha haan, aap ne farmaya agar qasidon ka qatal mere nazdeek najayaz na hota toh main teri gardan uda deta. Aakhir yeh shakhs Hazrat Ibn Masood Kufi ki imarat ke zamane mein qatal kar diya gaya, isay Ibn-e-An-Nuwahah kaha jata tha. Aap ko jab maloom hua ke yeh Musailmah ka manne wala hai toh aap ne bulwaya aur farmaya ab tu qasid nahi hai, ab teri gardan marne se koi amr mani' nahi, chunancha isay qatal kar diya gaya, Allah ki laanat us par ho. 

Al-Gharaz Dar-ul-Harb se jo qasid aaye ya tajir aaye ya sulah ka talib aaye ya aapas mein islah ke irade se aaye ya jaziya lekar hazir ho, Imam ya naib-e-Imam ne ise aman-o-aman de diya ho toh jab tak woh Dar-ul-Islam mein rahe ya apne watan na pohnch jaye, ise qatal karna haram hai. Ulama kehte hain aise shakhs ko Dar-ul-Islam mein saal bhar tak na rehne diya jaye. Zyada se zyada chaar maah tak woh yahan thehar sakta hai, phir chaar maah se zyada aur saal bhar ke andar do qoul hain Imam Shafi'i waghera ulama ke hain, Rahimahumullah Ta'ala.

Pabandi-e-Ahd ki Shara'it

Upar wale hukm ki hikmat bayan ho rahi hai ke chaar mah ki mohlat dene par ldai ki ijazat dene ki wajah se hai ke woh apne shirk-o-kufr ko chhorne aur apne ahd-o-paiman par qaim rehne wale hi nahi. Haan Sulh-e-Hudaibiyah jab tak unki taraf se na tute tum bhi na todna. Yeh sulh das saal ke liye hui thi. Mah-e-Zul-Qa'dah san 6 hijri se Huzoor ﷺ ne is muahide ko nibhaya yahan tak ke Quraysh ki taraf se muahida toda gaya, unke halif Banu Bakr ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ke halif Khuza'ah par chadahi ki balki Haram mein bhi unhe qatal kiya, is bina par Ramadan Sharif 8 hijri mein Huzoor ﷺ ne un par chadahi ki. Rabb-ul-Alamin ne Makkah aap ke hathon fath karaya aur unhe aap ke bas kardiya. Walillahil Hamdu wal-Minnah. Lekin aap ne bawajood ghalbah aur qudrat ke un mein se jinhon ne Islam qubool kiya sab ko azad kardiya, inhi logon ko Tulaqa' kehte hain. Yeh taqreeban do hazar the jo kufr par phir bhi baqi rahe aur idhar udhar hogaye. Rahmat-ul-Lil-Alamin ne sab ko aam panah de di aur unhe Makkah Sharif mein aane aur yahan apne makanon mein rehne ki ijazat marhamat farmai ke chaar mah tak woh jahan chahein aa ja sakte hain, inhi mein Safwan bin Umayyah aur Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl waghera the, phir Allah ne unki rehbari ki aur unhe Islam naseeb farmaya. Allah Ta'ala apne har andaze ke karne mein aur har kaam ke karne mein tareefon wala hi hai.

Kafaron ki dushmani. Allah Ta'ala kafaron ke makr-o-fareeb aur un ki dili adawat se musalmanon ko aagah karta hai taake woh un ki dosti apne dil mein na rakhein na un ke qaul-o-qarar par mutmain rahein, un ka kufr-o-shirk unhein waadon ki pabandi par rehne nahi deta. Yeh toh waqt ke muntazir hain, un ka bas chale toh yeh toh tumhein kachcha chaba dalein, na qarabat-dari ko dekhein na waadon ki pasdari karein. Un se jo ho sake woh تکلیف (takleef) tum par todein aur khush hon. Aal ke maane qarabat-dari ke hain. Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi yahi marwi hai aur Hazrat Hassan R.H ke sher mein bhi yahi maane kiye gaye hain ke woh apne ghalbe ke waqt Allah ka bhi lihaaz na karenge na kisi aur ka. Yahi lafz Aal, Il ban kar Jibreel, Mikaeel aur Israfeel mein aaya hai yaani is ka maane Allah hai lekin pehla qaul hi zahir aur mashhoour hai aur aksar mufassireen ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Mujahid kehte hain murad ahad hai, Qatadah ka qaul hai murad qasam hai.

Jihad hi rah-e-islah hai. Mushrikon ki mazammat ke sath hi Musalmanon ko targheeb-e-jihad di ja rahi hai ke in kafiron ne dunya-e-khasees ko akhirat-e-nafees ke badle pasand kar liya hai. Khud rah-e-Rabb se hat kar Mominon ko bhi iman se rok rahe hain, in ke a'maal bahut hi bad hain. Yeh to Mominon ko nuqsan pahunchane ke hi darpay hain, na unhein rishtedari ka khayal na muahide ka paas. Hai jo dunya ko is haal mein chhore ke Allah ki ibadatein khuloos ke sath kar raha ho, us ke sath kisi ko shareek na banata ho, namaz-o-zakat ka paband ho to Allah us se khush ho kar milega. Yehi Allah ka woh deen hai jise Ambiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) late rahe aur isi ki tableegh Allah ki taraf se woh karte rahe. Is se pehle ke baatein phail jayein aur khwahishein barh jayein, is ki tasdeeq Kitabullah mein maujood hai ke agar woh tauba kar lein yaani buton ko aur but-parasti ko chhor dein aur namazi aur zakati ban jayein to tum un ke raste chhor do. Aur ayat mein hai ke phir to yeh tumhare deeni bhai hain. Imam Bazzar (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke mere khayal se to marfoo' hadith wahin par khatam hai ke Allah us se razamand ho kar milega, is ke baad ka kalam rawi-e-hadith Rabi' bin Anas (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Wa'da Khilaf Qaum Ko Dandan-Shikan Jawab Do

Agar yeh mushrik apni qasmon ko tod kar wa'da khilafi aur ahad shikani karein aur tumhare deen par e'tiraz karne lagein to tum un ke kufr ke saron ko tod marod do. Isi liye ulema ne kaha hai ke jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gaaliyan de, deen mein aib joi kare, is ka zikr ihanat ke saath kare usay qatl kar diya jaye. Un ki qasmein mahz be-e'tibar hain. Yehi tariqa un ke kufr-o-inaad se rokne ka hai. Abu Jahl, Utbah, Shaibah, Umayyah waghairah yeh sab sardaran-e-kufr the. Ek khariji ne Hazrat Sa'd bin Waqqas ko kaha ke yeh kufr ke peshwaon mein se ek hai, aap ne farmaya tu jhoota hai main to un mein se hoon jinhon ne kufr ke peshwaon ko qatl kiya tha. Hazrat Huzaifah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain, is aayat wale is ke baad qatl nahin kiye gaye. Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Sahih yeh hai ke aayat aam hai go sabab-e-nuzool ke e'tibar se is se murad mushrikeen-e-Quraish hain lekin hukman yeh unhein aur sab ko shamil hai wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Sham ki taraf lashkar bheja to un se farmaya ke tumhein un mein kuchh log aise milein ge jin ki chandhiya mundi hui hogi to tum is shaitani baithak ko talwar se do tukde kar dena Wallah un mein se ek ka qatl doosre sattar logon ke qatl se bhi mujhe zyada pasand hai is liye ke farman-e-Ilahi hai kufr ke imamon ko qatl karo (Ibn Abi Hatim).

Zalim metodología... Zaalimon ko un ke kayfar-e-kirdar ko pohanchao. Musalmanon ko poori tarah jihad par amada karne ke liye farma raha hai yeh wada shikan kasmein todne wale kuffar wahi hain jinhon ne Rasool ﷺ ko jala-watan karne ki poori thaan li thi, chahte the ke qaid karlein ya qatal kar daalan ya dais nikala de dein, un ke makr se Allah ka makr kahin behtar tha. Sirf iman ki bina par dushmani kar ke Paighambar ﷺ ko aur mominon ko watan se kharij karte rahe, bhad bhada kar uth khade hote the taake tujhe Makkah Sharif se nikaal dein. Burai ki ibtida bhi unhi ki taraf se hai, Badr ke din lashkar le kar nikle halanki maloom ho chuka tha ke qafila bach kar nikal gaya hai lekin taham ghuroor-o-fakhar se Allah ke lashkar ko shikast dene ke irade se musalmanon se saf-ara ho gaye jaise ke poora waqia is se pehle bayan ho chuka hai.

Unhon ne ahd-shakni ki aur apne halifon ke sath mil kar Rasoolullah ke halifon se jang ki. Bani Bakr ki Khuza'ah ke khilaf madad ki, is khilaf-e-wada ki wajah se Huzoor ﷺ ne un par lashkar-kashi ki, un ki khoob sarkobi ki aur Makkah fath kar liya, falhamdulillah.

Farmata hai ke tum un najis logon se khauf khate ho? Agar tum momin ho to tumhare dil mein bajuz Allah ke kisi ka khauf nahi hona chahiye, wahi is laiq hai ke is se imandar darte rahein. Doosri ayat mein hai: Un se na daro sirf mujh se hi daro. Mera ghalba, meri saltanat, meri saza, meri qudrat, meri malkiyat, beshak is qabil hai ke har waqt har dil meri haibat se larzta rahe, tamam kaam mere hath mein hain jo chahon kar sakta hoon aur kar guzarta hoon. Meri mansha ke baghair kuch bhi nahi ho sakta.

Musalmanon par jihad ki farziyat ka raaz bayan ho raha hai ke Allah qadir tha jo azab chahta un par bhej deta lekin is ki mansha yeh hai ke tumhare hathon unhein saza de, un ki barbadi tum khud karo, tumhare dil ki khud bharas nikal jaye aur tumhein rahat-o-aram, shadmani-o-kamrani hasil ho. Yeh baat kuch unhi ke sath makhsoos na thi balke tamam mominon ke liye bhi hai, khususan Khuza'ah ka qabila jin par khilaf-e-ahd Quraysh apne halifon mein mil kar chadh daude, un ke dil usi

Burai ki ibtida bhi unhi ki taraf se hai, Badr ke din lashkar le kar nikle halanki maloom ho chuka tha ke qafila bach kar nikal gaya hai lekin taham ghuroor-o-fakhar se Allah ke lashkar ko shikast dene ke irade se musalmanon se saf-ara ho gaye jaise ke poora waqia is se pehle bayan ho chuka hai.

Unhon ne ahd-shakni ki aur apne halifon ke sath mil kar Rasoolullah ke halifon se jang ki. Bani Bakr ki Khuza'ah ke khilaf madad ki, is khilaf-e-wada ki wajah se Huzoor ﷺ ne un par lashkar-kashi ki, un ki khoob sarkobi ki aur Makkah fath kar liya, falhamdulillah.

Farmata hai ke tum un najis logon se khauf khate ho? Agar tum momin ho to tumhare dil mein bajuz Allah ke kisi ka khauf nahi hona chahiye, wahi is laiq hai ke is se imandar darte rahein. Doosri ayat mein hai: Un se na daro sirf mujh se hi daro. Mera ghalba, meri saltanat, meri saza, meri qudrat, meri malkiyat, beshak is qabil hai ke har waqt har dil meri haibat se larzta rahe, tamam kaam mere hath mein hain jo chahon kar sakta hoon aur kar guzarta hoon. Meri mansha ke baghair kuch bhi nahi ho sakta.

Musalmaan bhi aazmaye jayenge, yeh namumkin hai ke imtighaan baghair musalmaan bhi chhod diye jayenge. Sachhe aur jhoothe musalmaan ko zahir kar dena zaroori hai. Walijah ke maana bhedi aur dakhil dene wale ke hain. Pas sachhe woh hain jo jihad mein aage badh kar hissa lein aur zahir-o-batin mein Allah-o-Rasool ki khair-khwahi aur himayat karein. Ek qisam ka bayaan doosri qisam ko zahir kar deta tha, is liye doosri qisam ke logon ka bayaan chhod diya. Aisi ibaratein shairon ke sheron mein bhi hain. Ek jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai ke kya logon ne yeh guman kar rakha hai ke woh sirf yeh kehne se chhod diye jayenge ke hum iman laye aur un ki aazmaish hogi hi nahi? Halaanki agle momino ki bhi hum ne aazmaish ki. Yaad rakho, Allah sachhe jhootho ko zaroor alag alag kar dega. Aur aayat mein isi mazmoon ko (am hasibtum an tadkhulul jannata) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 214) ke lafzon se bayaan farmaya hai. Aur aayat mein hai: (ma kanal lahu liyazaral mo'minina 'ala ma antum 'alaihi hatta yamizal khabitha minat tayyib, wa ma kanal lahu liyutli'akum 'alal ghaibi wa lakinnal laha yajtabi min rusulihi man yashao fa aminu billahi wa rusulihi, wa in tu'minu wa tattaqu fa lakum ajrun azeem) (Surah Ali 'Imran: 179). Allah aisa nahi ke tum momino ko tumhari halat par hi chhod de aur imtighaan kar ke yeh na maloom kar le ke khabees kaun hai aur tayyib kaun hai? Pas jihad ke mashroo' karne mein ek hikmat yeh bhi hai ke khare khote ki tameez ho jati hai, go Allah Ta'ala har cheez se waqif hai. Jo hoga woh bhi use maloom hai aur jo nahi hua woh jab hoga, tab kis tarah hoga yeh bhi woh jaanta hai. Cheez ke hone se pehle hi use is ka ilm hasil hai aur har cheez ki har halat se woh waqif hai, lekin woh chahta hai ke duniya par bhi khara khota aur sacha jhootha zahir kar de. Us ke siva koi mabood nahi, na us ke siva koi parwardigar hai, na us ki qaza-o-qadr aur irade ko koi badal sakta hai.

Mushrikon ko Allah ke ghar se kya talluq? Yaani Allah ke sath sharik karne walon ko Allah ki masjidon (ki tameer) karne wale banana laayiq hi nahi yeh mushrik hain Baitullah se unhein kya talluq? Masajid ko masjid bhi parha gaya hai pas murad Masjid Haram hai jo ro-e-zameen ki masjidon se ashraf hai jo awal din se sirf Allah ki ibadat ke liye banayi gayi hai jis ki buniyadein Khalilullah ne rakhi thien aur yeh log mushrik hain haal o qaal dono aitbar se tum nasrani se poocho woh saf kahega main nasrani hoon, yahood se poocho woh apni yahoodiyat ka iqrar karenge, sabi se poocho woh bhi apna sabi hona apni zuban se kahega, mushrik bhi apne mushrik hone ke liye iqrari hain un ke is shirk ki wajah se un ke amaal akaarat hochuke hain aur yeh hamesha ke liye naari hain. Yeh to Masjid Haram se aur Allah ki rah rokte hi hain yeh go kahin lekin darasal yeh Allah ke auliya nahi auliya Allah to woh hain jo muttaqi hon lekin aksar log ilm se kore aur khali hote hain. Haan Baitullah ki abadi momino ke hathon hoti hai pas jis ke hath se masjidon ki abadi ho us ke iman ka Quran gawah hai. Musnad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab tum kisi ko masjid mein aane jaane ki aadat wala dekho to us ke iman ki shahadat do phir aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farmayi aur hadith mein hai masjidon ke abad karne wale Allah wale hain aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala in masjid walon par nazrein daal kar apne azab poori qaum par se hata leta hai. Aur hadith mein hai Allah Azzawajal farmata hai mujhe apni izzat aur apne jalal ki qasam ke main zameen walon ko azab karna chahta hoon lekin apne gharon ke abad karne walon aur apni rah mein aapas mein mohabbat rakhne walon aur subh sehari ke waqt istighfar karne walon par nazrein daal kar apne azab hata leta hai. Ibn Asakir mein hai ke shaitan insan ka bhediya hai jaise bakriyon ka bhediya hota hai ke woh alag thalag padi hui idhar udhar ki bikhri bakri ko pakad kar le jata hai pas tum phoot aur ikhtilaf se bacho jamaat ko aur awam ko aur masjidon ko lazim pakde raho. Ashab-e-Rasool ﷺ ka bayan hai ke masjidin is zameen par Allah ka ghar hain jo in mein dakhil ho Allah ka un par haq hai ke woh masajid ka ahteram karein. Ibn Abbas farmate hain jo namaz ki azan sun kar phir bhi masjid mein aakar ba-jamat namaz na padhe us ki namaz nahi hoti woh Allah ka na-farman hai ke masjidon ki abadi karne wale Allah ke aur qayamat ke manne wale hi hote hain. Phir farmaya namazi badni ibadat namaz ke paband hote hain aur mali ibadat zakat ke bhi ada karne wale hote hain un ki bhalai apne liye bhi hoti hai aur phir aam makhlooq ke liye bhi hoti hai un ke dil Allah ke siva aur kisi se darte nahi yahi rah-yafta log hain. Mowahid iman dar Quran o Hadith ke mateh-e-tur panchfon namazon ke paband sirf Allah ka khouf khane wale us ke siva dusre ki bandagi na karne wale hi rah-yafta aur kamyab aur ba-maqsad hain.

Yeh yaad rahe ke ba-qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) Quran-e-Kareem mein jahan bhi lafz "Asa" aata hai, woh yaqeen ke ma'ani mein hai, umeed ke ma'ani mein nahi. Maslan farman hai: (Aysa an yab'athaka rabbuka maqaman mahmuda). Toh maqaman mahmuda mein pahunchana yaqeeni, Huzoor ﷺ ka shafi'-e-mahshar banna yaqeeni cheez hai, jis mein koi shak-o-shubha nahi. Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain: "Asa" Kalamullah mein haq aur yaqeen ke liye aata hai.

Sab se buri ibaadat Allah ki raah mein jihad hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke kafiron ka qool tha ke Baitullah ki khidmat aur haajiyon ko paani pilane ki saadat iman o jihad se behtar hai, hum chunke yeh dono khidmaten anjaam de rahe hain is liye hum se behtar koi nahi. Allah ne un ke fakr o ghuroor aur haq se takabbur aur munh pherne ko benaqab kiya ke meri aayaton ki tumhare saamne tilaawat hote hue tum un se be-parwahi se munh mod kar apni baat-cheet mein mashghool rehte ho. Pas tumhara gumaan be-ja, tumhara ghuroor ghalat, tumhara fakr na-munaasib hai. Yun bhi Allah ke sath iman aur is ki raah mein jihad bahut badi cheez hai lekin tumhare muqable mein to woh aur bhi badi cheez hai kyunke tumhari to koi neki ho bhi to use shirk ka keeda kha jata hai. Pas farmata hai ke yeh dono giroh barabar ke bhi nahi. Yeh apne tain abaadi karne wala kehte the, Allah ne un ka naam zaalim rakha, un ki Allah ke ghar ki khidmat bekaar kar di gayi. Kehte hain ke Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne apni qaid ke zamane mein kaha tha ke tum agar islam o jihad mein the to hum bhi Allah ke ghar ki khidmat aur haajiyon ko aaram pahunchane mein the, is par yeh aayat utri ke shirk ke waqt ki neki bekaar hai. Sahaba ne jab un se pur-le-de shuru ki to Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne kaha tha ke hum Masjid-e-Haram ke mutawalli the, hum ghulamon ko azaad karte the, hum Baitullah ko ghilaaf chadhaate the, hum haajiyon ko paani pilaate the, is par yeh aayat utri. Marwi hai ke yeh guftgoo Hazrat Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) mein hui thi. Marwi hai ke Talha bin Shaiba, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib, Ali bin Abi Talib baithe baithe apni apni buzurgiyan bayaan karne lage, Usman (R.A) ne kaha main Baitullah ka kunji bardaar hoon, agar main chahun wahan raat guzaar sakta hoon. Abbas (R.A) ne kaha main Zamzam ka paani pilane wala hoon aur is ka nigehbaan hoon, agar chahun to masjid mein saari raat reh sakta hoon. Ali (R.A) ne kaha main nahi jaanta ke tum dono sahib kya keh rahe ho? Main ne logon se chhe maah pehle qibla ki taraf namaz padhi hai, main mujahid hoon aur is par yeh aayat poori utri. Abbas (R.A) ne apna dar zahir kiya ke kahin main chaah-e-zamzam ke paani pilane ke ohde se na hata diya jaun. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya nahi tum apne is mansab par qayam raho, tumhare liye is mein bhalai hai.

Is ayat ki tafsir mein ek marfu hadith warid hui hai jis ka zikr bhi yahan zaruri hai. Hazrat Numan bin Bashir (R.A) kehte hain ke ek shakhs ne kaha: Islam ke baad agar main koi amal na karun toh mujhe parwah nahi, bujz is ke ke main hajiyon ko pani pilaun. Dusray ne isi tarah masjid haram ki abadi ko kaha, teesray ne isi tarah rah-e-Rab ke jihad ko kaha. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne unhein dant diya aur farmaya: Minbar-e-Rasool-ullah ke paas awazein buland na karo, yeh waqia jumma ke din ka hai. Jumma ke baad hum sab An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas hazir hue aur aap se pucha toh Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil farma di. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne wada kiya tha ke namaz-e-jumma ke baad main aap ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh baat daryaft kar lun ga.

Marwi hai ke Talha bin Shaiba, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib, Ali bin Abi Talib baithe baithe apni apni buzurgiyan bayaan karne lage, Usman (R.A) ne kaha main Baitullah ka kunji bardaar hoon, agar main chahun wahan raat guzaar sakta hoon. Abbas (R.A) ne kaha main Zamzam ka paani pilane wala hoon aur is ka nigehbaan hoon, agar chahun to masjid mein saari raat reh sakta hoon. Ali (R.A) ne kaha main nahi jaanta ke tum dono sahib kya keh rahe ho? Main ne logon se chhe maah pehle qibla ki taraf namaz padhi hai, main mujahid hoon aur is par yeh aayat poori utri. Abbas (R.A) ne apna dar zahir kiya ke kahin main chaah-e-zamzam ke paani pilane ke ohde se na hata diya jaun. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya nahi tum apne is mansab par qayam raho, tumhare liye is mein bhalai hai.

Is ayat ki tafsir mein ek marfu hadith warid hui hai jis ka zikr bhi yahan zaruri hai. Hazrat Numan bin Bashir (R.A) kehte hain ke ek shakhs ne kaha: Islam ke baad agar main koi amal na karun toh mujhe parwah nahi, bujz is ke ke main hajiyon ko pani pilaun. Dusray ne isi tarah masjid haram ki abadi ko kaha, teesray ne isi tarah rah-e-Rab ke jihad ko kaha. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne unhein dant diya aur farmaya: Minbar-e-Rasool-ullah ke paas awazein buland na karo, yeh waqia jumma ke din ka hai. Jumma ke baad hum sab An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas hazir hue aur aap se pucha toh Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil farma di. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne wada kiya tha ke namaz-e-jumma ke baad main aap ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh baat daryaft kar lun ga.

Sab se buri ibaadat Allah ki raah mein jihad hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke kafiron ka qool tha ke Baitullah ki khidmat aur haajiyon ko paani pilane ki saadat iman o jihad se behtar hai, hum chunke yeh dono khidmaten anjaam de rahe hain is liye hum se behtar koi nahi. Allah ne un ke fakr o ghuroor aur haq se takabbur aur munh pherne ko benaqab kiya ke meri aayaton ki tumhare saamne tilaawat hote hue tum un se be-parwahi se munh mod kar apni baat-cheet mein mashghool rehte ho. Pas tumhara gumaan be-ja, tumhara ghuroor ghalat, tumhara fakr na-munaasib hai. Yun bhi Allah ke sath iman aur is ki raah mein jihad bahut badi cheez hai lekin tumhare muqable mein to woh aur bhi badi cheez hai kyunke tumhari to koi neki ho bhi to use shirk ka keeda kha jata hai. Pas farmata hai ke yeh dono giroh barabar ke bhi nahi. Yeh apne tain abaadi karne wala kehte the, Allah ne un ka naam zaalim rakha, un ki Allah ke ghar ki khidmat bekaar kar di gayi. Kehte hain ke Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne apni qaid ke zamane mein kaha tha ke tum agar islam o jihad mein the to hum bhi Allah ke ghar ki khidmat aur haajiyon ko aaram pahunchane mein the, is par yeh aayat utri ke shirk ke waqt ki neki bekaar hai. Tark-e-Mawalat-o-Mawaddat ka Hukm
Allah Ta'ala kafiron se tark-e-mawalat ka hukm deta hai, un ki dostiyon se rokta hai, go woh maan baap hon ya bhai hon. Bashartike woh kufr ko Islam par tarjeeh dein. Aur aayat mein hai: (La tajidu qawman yu'minuna billahi wal-yawmil-akhiri...) Allah par aur qayamat par iman laane walon ko to hargiz Allah aur Rasool ke dushmanon se dosti karne wala nahi payega, go woh un ke baap hon, bete hon, ya bhai hon, ya rishtedaar hon. Yahi log hain jin ke dilon mein iman rakh diya gaya hai aur apni khas rooh se un ki taaeed farmai hai. Unhein nehron wali jannat mein pohnchayega.

Bayhaqi mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ke baap ne Badar wale din un ke saamne apne buton ki tareefein shuru keen. Aap ne use harchand rokna chaha lekin woh barhta hi chala gaya. Baap beton mein jang shuru ho gayi, aap ne apne baap ko qatl kar diya. Is par aayat "La tajidu..." nazil hui.

Phir aisa karne walon ko darata hai aur farmata hai ke agar woh rishtedaar, apne hasil kiye hue maal aur mande ho jaane ki dahshat ki tijartein aur pasandeeda makanat agar tumhein Allah aur Rasool se aur jihad se bhi zyada marghoub hain, toh tumhein Allah ke azaab ke bardasht ke liye tayyar rehna chahiye. Aise badkaron ko Allah bhi rasta nahi dikhata.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sahaba ke sath ja rahe the, Hazrat Umar ka hath Aap (ﷺ) ke hath mein tha. Hazrat Umar kehne lage, "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap mujhe har cheez se zyada azeez hain bajuz meri apni jaan ke." Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein mera nafs hai, tum mein se koi momin na hoga jab tak ke woh mujhe apni jaan se bhi zyada azeez na rakh le." Hazrat Umar ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam! Ab aap ki mohabbat mujhe apni jaan se bhi zyada hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Aye Umar! (Tu momin ho gaya)." (Bukhari Sharif)

Sahih hadis mein Aap ka farman sabit hai ke: "Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, tum mein se koi imandar na hoga jab tak main use us ke maan baap, aulaad aur duniya ke kul logon se zyada azeez na ho jaon."

Musnad Ahmad aur Abu Dawood mein hai, Aap farmate hain: "Jab tum 'Inah ki khareedo-farokht karne lago ge aur gaye bael ki damein tham lo ge aur jihad chor do ge, toh Allah Ta'ala tum par zillat مسلط (musallat) karega, woh us waqt tak door na hogi jab tak ke tum apne deen ki taraf na laut aao."

Nasrat-e-Ilahi ka zikr
Mujahid kehte hain Bara'at ki yeh pehli ayat hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala apne bohot bara ehsan mominon par zikr farma raha hai ki us ne apne Nabi ﷺ ke sathiyon ki aap imdad farmai unhein dushmanon par ghalib kar diya aur ek jagah nahi har jagah us ki madad shamil-e-haal rahi isi waja se fateh-o-zafar ne kabhi ham-rikabi na chori. Yeh sirf ta'eed-e-rabbani thi na ke maal-o-asbab aur hathiyar ki faravani aur na tadad ki ziyadati. Yaad kar lo Hunain wale din tumhe zara apni tadad ki kasrat par naaz ho gaya toh kya haal hua? Peeth dikha kar bhag nikle the, maudood-e-chand hi Allah ke Paigambar ﷺ ke sath thahre usi waqt Allah ki madad nazil hui us ne dilon mein taskeen daal di yeh is liye ke tumhe maloom ho jaye ke madad usi Allah ki taraf se hai, us ki madad se choti choti jamaton ne bare bare grohon ke munh pher diye hain. Allah ki imdad sabr karne walon ke sath hoti hai. Yeh waqia hum anqareeb tafseel-war bayan karein, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. 
Musnad ki hadith mein hai behtareen sathi chaar hain aur behtareen chota lashkar chaar sau ka hai aur behtareen bara lashkar chaar hazar ka hai aur barah hazar ki tadad toh apni kami ke baais kabhi maghloob nahi ho sakti. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai Imam Tirmidhi ؒ ise Hasan Ghareeb batlate hain. Yeh riwayat siwaye ek rawi ke baaki sab rawiyon ne Mursal bayan ki hai. Ibn Majah aur Baihaqi mein bhi yeh riwayat isi tarah marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. 
San 8 Hijri mein Fateh Makkah ke baad mah-e-Shawwal mein Jang-e-Hunain hui thi. Jab Huzoor ﷺ Fateh Makkah se farigh hue aur ibtedai umoor sab anjam de chuke aur عموماً (umuman) Makki hazrat Musalman ho chuke aur unhein aap azad bhi kar chuke toh aap ko khabar mili ke qabeela Hawazin jama hua hai aur aap se jang karne par amada hai. Un ka sardar Malik bin Auf Nasri hai. Thaqeef ka sara qabeela un ke sath hai isi tarah Banu Jashm, Banu Sa'd bin Bakr bhi hain aur Banu Hilal ke kuch log bhi hain aur kuch log Banu Amr bin Amir ke aur Aun bin Amir ke bhi hain yeh sab log ma'a apni aurton aur bachon aur gharelu maal ke maidan mein nikal khare hue hain. Yahan tak ke apni bakriyon aur unton ko bhi unhon ne sath hi rakha hai toh aap ne us lashkar ko le kar jo ab aap ke sath Muhajireen aur Ansar waghaira ka tha un ke muqabale ke liye chale taqreeban do hazar nau-muslim Makki bhi aap ke sath ho liye. Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan ki wadi mein dono lashkar mil gaye us jagah ka naam Hunain tha subah saw

Lekin Rasulullah ﷺ un ki taraf barhe aap us waqt safed khachar par sawar thay, Hazrat Abbas ؓ aap ke janwar ki dayin jaanib se nakeel thame huwe thay aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bayin taraf se nakeel pakre huwe thay. Janwar ki tezi ko yeh log rok rahe thay, aap ba-aawaz-e-buland apne tayin pohncha rahe thay, Musalmanon ko wapsi ka hukm farma rahe thay aur nida karte jaate thay ke Allah ke bando kahan chale, meri taraf aao. Main Allah ka sachcha Rasul hoon, main Nabi hoon, jhoota nahi hoon. Main aulaad-e-Abdul Muttalib mein se hoon. Aap ke sath us waqt sirf assi ya sau ke qareeb Sahaba ؓ reh gaye thay. 

Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ, Hazrat Umar ؓ, Hazrat Abbas ؓ, Hazrat Ali ؓ, Hazrat Fazl bin Abbas ؓ, Hazrat Abu Sufyan bin Haris ؓ, Hazrat Aiman bin Umme Aiman, Hazrat Usama bin Zaid waghera aap ﷺ ke sath hi thay. Phir aap ne apne chacha Hazrat Abbas (jo bohat buland aawaz wale thay) ko hukm diya ke darakht ke neechye bai'at karne wale mere sahabiyon ko aawaz do ke woh nah bhagein. Pas aap ne yeh keh kar: "Aey babool ke darakht tale bai'at karne walo! Aey Surah Baqarah ke hamalo!" Pas yeh aawaz un ke kaano mein pohnchti thi ke unhon ne har taraf se "Labbaik Labbaik" kehna shuru kiya aur aawaz ki jaanib lapak pare aur usi waqt laut kar aap ke aas-paas aakar khare ho gaye, yahan tak ke agar kisi ka oont ur gaya to us ne apni zirah pehn li, oont par se kood gaya aur paidal sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir ho gaya. 

Jab kuch jamaat aap ke ird-gird jama ho gayi, aap ne Allah se dua mangni shuru ki ke: "Bari Ilahi, jo wada tera mere sath hai use poora farma." Phir aap ne zameen se mitti ki ek mutthi bhar li aur use kafiron ki taraf phenka jis se un ki aankhon aur un ka munh bhar gaya, woh larhai ke qabil nah rahe. Idhar Musalmanon ne un par dhawa bol diya, un ke qadam ukhad gaye, bhag nikle. Musalmanon ne un ka peecha kiya aur Musalmanon ki baqi fauj Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pohnchi, itni dair mein to unhon ne kuffar ko qaid kar ke Huzoor ﷺ ke samne dher kar diya. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdul Rahman Fehri (jin ka naam Yazeed bin Asid hai ya Yazeed bin Anees hai aur Kurz bhi kaha gaya hai) farmate hain ke main is ma'rake mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke sath

Aap ne farmaya meri sawari tayyar karo usi waqt unhon ne zain nikali jis ke donon palay khajoor ki rassi ke thay jis mein koi fakhr-o-ghuroor ki cheez na thi jab kas chuke to Huzoor ﷺ sawar hue hum ne saf bandi kar li sham aur raat usi tarah guzri phir donon lashkaroon ki mud-bheed ho gayi to musalman bhag khare hue jaise Quran ne farmaya hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne aawaz di ke Aie Allah ke bando main Allah ka banda aur Rasool hoon, Aie Muhajireen main Allah ka banda aur Rasool hoon, phir apne ghore se utar pare mitti ki aik muthi bhar li aur yeh farma kar un ke chehre bigar jayen kafiron ki taraf phenk di, usi se Allah ne unhein shikast de di. In mushrikon ka bayan hai ke hum mein se aik bhi aisa na tha jis ki aankhon aur munh mein yeh mitti na aayi ho, usi waqt hamein aisa maloom hone laga ke goya zameen-o-asman ke darmiyan loha kisi lohe ke tasht par baj raha hai.

Aik riwayat mein hai ke bhage hue musalman jab aik so aap ke paas wapas pahunch gaye aap ne usi waqt hamla ka hukm de diya, awal to munadi Ansar ki thi phir Khazraj hi par reh gayi, yeh qabila larai ke waqt bara hi sabir tha. Aap ﷺ ne apni sawari par se maidan-e-jung ka nazara dekha aur farmaya ab larai garma-garmi se ho rahi hai. Is mein hai ke Allah ne jis kafir ko chaha qatal kara diya, jise chaha qaid kara diya aur un ke maal aur auladein apne Nabi ko fai mein dila dein. 

Hadhrat Bara bin Azib ؓ se kisi ne kaha Aie Abu Amarah kya tum log Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas se Hunain wale din bhag nikle thay? Aap ne farmaya lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ ka qadam peechhe na hata tha, baat yeh hai ke qabila Hawazan ke log teer andazi ke fann ke ustad thay, Allah ke fazl se hum ne unhein pehle hi hamle mein shikast de di lekin jab log maal-e-ghanimat par jhuk pare unhon ne mauqa dekh kar phir jo poori maharat ke sath teeron ki baarish barsai to yahan bhagdar mach gayi. 

SubhanAllah! Rasool Allah ﷺ ki kamil shujaat aur poori bahaduri ka yeh mauqa tha. Lashkar bhag nikla hai is waqt aap kisi taiz sawari par nahi jo bhagne daudne mein kaam aaye balki khachar par sawar hain aur mushrikon ki taraf barh rahe hain aur apne tain chhupate nahi balki apna naam apni zuban se pukar pukar kar bata rahe hain ke na pehchanne wale bhi pehchan lein. Khyal farmaiyye ke kis qadar zat-e-wahid par aap ka tawakkul hai aur kitna kamil yaqeen hai aap ko Allah ki madad par. Jante hain ke Allah Ta'ala Amr-e-Risalat ko poora kar ke hi rahega aur aap ke deen ko dunya ke aur deenon par ghalib kar ke hi rahega, fasalawatullahi wa salamuhu abadan abada. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi par aur musalmano ke upar sakeenat nazil farmata hai aur apne farishton ka lashkar bhejta hai jinhein koi na dekhta tha.

Aik mushrik ka bayan hai ke Hunain walay din jab hum musalmanon se larne lage aik bakri ka doodh nikala jaye itni der bhi hum ne unhe apne samne jamne nahi diya foran bhag khare hue aur hum ne unka taaqub shuru kiya yahan tak ke hamein aik sahib safed khachar par sawar nazar pare hum ne dekha yeh ke khubsurat noorani chehre wale kuch log unke ird gird hain unki zuban se nikla ke tumhare chehre bigar jayen wapas laut jao bas yeh kehna tha ke hamein shikast ho gayi yahan tak ke musalman hamare kandhon par sawar ho gaye Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain main bhi us lashkar mein tha Aap ke sath sirf assi Muhajir o Ansar reh gaye the hum ne peeth nahi dikhayi thi hum par Allah ne itminan o sukun nazil farma diya tha. Huzoor ﷺ apne safed khachar par sawar dushmanon ki taraf barh rahe the janwar ne thokar khayi Aap zain par se niche ki taraf jhuk gaye maine awaz di ke Huzoor ﷺ unche ho jayiye Allah Aap ko uncha hi rakhe Aap ne farmaya aik muthi mitti ki to bhar do maine bhar di Aap ne kafiron ki taraf phenki jis se unki aankhein bhar gayin phir farmaya Muhajir o Ansar kahan hain maine kaha yehin hain farmaya nahi awaz do mera awaz dena tha ke woh talwarein sonte hue lapak lapak kar aage ab to mushrikeen ki kuch na chali aur woh bhag khare hue. Baihaqi ki aik riwayat mein hai Shaibah bin Usman kehte hain ke Hunain ke din jabke maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is halat mein dekha ke lashkar shikast kha kar bhag khara hua hai aur Aap ﷺ tanha reh gaye hain toh mujhe Badr walay din apne baap aur chacha ka mara jana yaad aya ke woh Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hamza R.A ke hathon mare gaye hain, maine apne ji mein kaha ke inke intiqam lene ka is se acha moqa aur kaun sa milega ? Ao paigambar ko qatal kar do is irade se main Aap ki dayin janib se barha lekin wahan maine Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ko paya safed chandi jaisi zirah pehne mustaid khare hain maine socha ke yeh chacha hain apne bhatije ki poori himayat karenge chalo bayin janib se ja kar apna kaam karun aur udhar se aya toh dekha Abu Sufiyan bin Harith bin Abdul Muttalib khare hain maine kaha inke bhi chacha ke larke bhai hain apne bhai ki zaroor himayat karenge phir main rukawat kaat kar peechhe ki taraf aya Aap ke kareeb pahunch gaya ab yahi baqi reh gaya tha ke talwar soont kar waar kar dun ke maine dekha ek aag ka kora bijli ki tarah chamak kar mujh par parna chahta hai maine aankhein band kar leen aur pichle paon peechhe ki taraf hata usi waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne meri janib iltifat kiya aur farmaya Shaibah mere paas aya, Allah iske shaitan ko door kar de. Ab maine aankh khol kar jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ki taraf dekha toh wallah Aap mujhe mere kanon aur aankhon se bhi zyada mehboob the Aap ne farmaya Shaibah ja kafiron se lar Shaibah ka bayan hai ke is jang mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sathiyon mein main bhi tha lekin main Islam ki wajah se ya Islam ki marifat ki bina par nahi nikla tha balki maine kaha wah yeh kaise ho sakta hai ?

ke Hawazin Quraish par ghalib aa jayen? Main aap ke paas hi khara hua tha toh main ne ablaq rang ke ghore dekh kar kaha ya Rasul Allah main toh ablaq rang ke ghore dekh raha hoon aap ne farmaya Shaiba woh toh siwa kafiron ke kisi ko nazar nahi aate. Phir aap ne mere seene par hath maar kar dua ki ya Allah Shaiba ko hidayat kar phir dobara se-bara yehi kiya aur yehi kaha wallah aap ka hath hatne se pehle hi sari dunya se zyada aap ki mohabbat main apne dil mein pane laga. Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'am R.A farmate hain main is ghazwe mein aap ke ham-rikab tha main ne dekha ki koi cheez aasman se utar rahi hai cheontiyon ki tarah us ne maidan gher liya aur usi waqt mushrikon ke qadam ukhad gaye wallah hamein koi shak nahi ki woh aasmani madad thi. Yazid bin Amir Sawabi apne kufr ke zamane mein Jang-e-Hunain mein kafiron ke sath tha baad mein yeh musalman ho gaye the un se jab daryaft kiya jata ki is mauqa par tumhare dilon ka raub-o-khauf se kya hal tha? Toh woh tasht mein kankariyan rakh kar baja kar kehte bas yehi aawaz hamein hamare dil se aa rahi thi be-tarah kaleja uchhal raha tha aur dil dahal raha tha. Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasul Allah ﷺ farmate hain mujhe raub se madad di gayi hai. Mujhe Jami' Al-Kalimat diye gaye hain Al-Gharz kuffar ko Allah ne yeh saza di aur yeh un ke kufr ka badla tha. Baaki Hawazin par Allah ne meherbani farmai unhein tauba naseeb hui musalman ho kar khidmat-e-makhdoom mein hazir hue us waqt aap fateh-mandi ke sath lautte hue Makkha Sharif Ji'ranah ke qareeb pahunch chuke the. Jang ko bees din ke qareeb guzar chuke the is liye aap ne farmaya ki ab tum do cheezon mein se ek pasand kar lo ya toh qaidi ya maal? Unhon ne qaidiyon ka wapas lena pasand kiya un qaidiyon ki chhoton baron ki mard aurat ki baligh nabaligh ki tadad chhe hazaar thi. Aap ne yeh sab unhein luta diye un ka maal ba-taur-e-ghaneemat ke musalmanon mein taqseem hua aur nau-muslim jo Makkha ke azad-karda the unhein bhi aap ne is maal mein se diya ki un ke dil Islam ki taraf poore mail ho jayen un mein se ek ek ko sau sau oont ata farmae. Nasrat-e-Ilahi ka zikr
Mujahid kehte hain Bara'at ki yeh pehli ayat hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala apne bohot bara ehsan mominon par zikr farma raha hai ki us ne apne Nabi ﷺ ke sathiyon ki aap imdad farmai unhein dushmanon par ghalib kar diya aur ek jagah nahi har jagah us ki madad shamil-e-haal rahi isi waja se fateh-o-zafar ne kabhi ham-rikabi na chori. Yeh sirf ta'eed-e-rabbani thi na ke maal-o-asbab aur hathiyar ki faravani aur na tadad ki ziyadati. Yaad kar lo Hunain wale din tumhe zara apni tadad ki kasrat par naaz ho gaya toh kya haal hua? Peeth dikha kar bhag nikle the, maudood-e-chand hi Allah ke Paigambar ﷺ ke sath thahre usi waqt Allah ki madad nazil hui us ne dilon mein taskeen daal di yeh is liye ke tumhe maloom ho jaye ke madad usi Allah ki taraf se hai, us ki madad se choti choti jamaton ne bare bare grohon ke munh pher diye hain. Allah ki imdad sabr karne walon ke sath hoti hai. Yeh waqia hum anqareeb tafseel-war bayan karein, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. 
Musnad ki hadith mein hai behtareen sathi chaar hain aur behtareen chota lashkar chaar sau ka hai aur behtareen bara lashkar chaar hazar ka hai aur barah hazar ki tadad toh apni kami ke baais kabhi maghloob nahi ho sakti. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai Imam Tirmidhi ؒ ise Hasan Ghareeb batlate hain. Yeh riwayat siwaye ek rawi ke baaki sab rawiyon ne Mursal bayan ki hai. Ibn Majah aur Baihaqi mein bhi yeh riwayat isi tarah marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. 
San 8 Hijri mein Fateh Makkah ke baad mah-e-Shawwal mein Jang-e-Hunain hui thi. Jab Huzoor ﷺ Fateh Makkah se farigh hue aur ibtedai umoor sab anjam de chuke aur عموماً (umuman) Makki hazrat Musalman ho chuke aur unhein aap azad bhi kar chuke toh aap ko khabar mili ke qabeela Hawazin jama hua hai aur aap se jang karne par amada hai. Un ka sardar Malik bin Auf Nasri hai. Thaqeef ka sara qabeela un ke sath hai isi tarah Banu Jashm, Banu Sa'd bin Bakr bhi hain aur Banu Hilal ke kuch log bhi hain aur kuch log Banu Amr bin Amir ke aur Aun bin Amir ke bhi hain yeh sab log ma'a apni aurton aur bachon aur gharelu maal ke maidan mein nikal khare hue hain. Yahan tak ke apni bakriyon aur unton ko bhi unhon ne sath hi rakha hai toh aap ne us lashkar ko le kar jo ab aap ke sath Muhajireen aur Ansar waghaira ka tha un ke muqabale ke liye chale taqreeban do hazar nau-muslim Makki bhi aap ke sath ho liye. Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan ki wadi mein dono lashkar mil gaye us jagah ka naam Hunain tha subah saw

Lekin Rasulullah ﷺ un ki taraf barhe aap us waqt safed khachar par sawar thay, Hazrat Abbas ؓ aap ke janwar ki dayin jaanib se nakeel thame huwe thay aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib bayin taraf se nakeel pakre huwe thay. Janwar ki tezi ko yeh log rok rahe thay, aap ba-aawaz-e-buland apne tayin pohncha rahe thay, Musalmanon ko wapsi ka hukm farma rahe thay aur nida karte jaate thay ke Allah ke bando kahan chale, meri taraf aao. Main Allah ka sachcha Rasul hoon, main Nabi hoon, jhoota nahi hoon. Main aulaad-e-Abdul Muttalib mein se hoon. Aap ke sath us waqt sirf assi ya sau ke qareeb Sahaba ؓ reh gaye thay. 

Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ, Hazrat Umar ؓ, Hazrat Abbas ؓ, Hazrat Ali ؓ, Hazrat Fazl bin Abbas ؓ, Hazrat Abu Sufyan bin Haris ؓ, Hazrat Aiman bin Umme Aiman, Hazrat Usama bin Zaid waghera aap ﷺ ke sath hi thay. Phir aap ne apne chacha Hazrat Abbas (jo bohat buland aawaz wale thay) ko hukm diya ke darakht ke neechye bai'at karne wale mere sahabiyon ko aawaz do ke woh nah bhagein. Pas aap ne yeh keh kar: "Aey babool ke darakht tale bai'at karne walo! Aey Surah Baqarah ke hamalo!" Pas yeh aawaz un ke kaano mein pohnchti thi ke unhon ne har taraf se "Labbaik Labbaik" kehna shuru kiya aur aawaz ki jaanib lapak pare aur usi waqt laut kar aap ke aas-paas aakar khare ho gaye, yahan tak ke agar kisi ka oont ur gaya to us ne apni zirah pehn li, oont par se kood gaya aur paidal sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir ho gaya. 

Jab kuch jamaat aap ke ird-gird jama ho gayi, aap ne Allah se dua mangni shuru ki ke: "Bari Ilahi, jo wada tera mere sath hai use poora farma." Phir aap ne zameen se mitti ki ek mutthi bhar li aur use kafiron ki taraf phenka jis se un ki aankhon aur un ka munh bhar gaya, woh larhai ke qabil nah rahe. Idhar Musalmanon ne un par dhawa bol diya, un ke qadam ukhad gaye, bhag nikle. Musalmanon ne un ka peecha kiya aur Musalmanon ki baqi fauj Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pohnchi, itni dair mein to unhon ne kuffar ko qaid kar ke Huzoor ﷺ ke samne dher kar diya. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdul Rahman Fehri (jin ka naam Yazeed bin Asid hai ya Yazeed bin Anees hai aur Kurz bhi kaha gaya hai) farmate hain ke main is ma'rake mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke sath

Aap ne farmaya meri sawari tayyar karo usi waqt unhon ne zain nikali jis ke donon palay khajoor ki rassi ke thay jis mein koi fakhr-o-ghuroor ki cheez na thi jab kas chuke to Huzoor ﷺ sawar hue hum ne saf bandi kar li sham aur raat usi tarah guzri phir donon lashkaroon ki mud-bheed ho gayi to musalman bhag khare hue jaise Quran ne farmaya hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne aawaz di ke Aie Allah ke bando main Allah ka banda aur Rasool hoon, Aie Muhajireen main Allah ka banda aur Rasool hoon, phir apne ghore se utar pare mitti ki aik muthi bhar li aur yeh farma kar un ke chehre bigar jayen kafiron ki taraf phenk di, usi se Allah ne unhein shikast de di. In mushrikon ka bayan hai ke hum mein se aik bhi aisa na tha jis ki aankhon aur munh mein yeh mitti na aayi ho, usi waqt hamein aisa maloom hone laga ke goya zameen-o-asman ke darmiyan loha kisi lohe ke tasht par baj raha hai.

Aik riwayat mein hai ke bhage hue musalman jab aik so aap ke paas wapas pahunch gaye aap ne usi waqt hamla ka hukm de diya, awal to munadi Ansar ki thi phir Khazraj hi par reh gayi, yeh qabila larai ke waqt bara hi sabir tha. Aap ﷺ ne apni sawari par se maidan-e-jung ka nazara dekha aur farmaya ab larai garma-garmi se ho rahi hai. Is mein hai ke Allah ne jis kafir ko chaha qatal kara diya, jise chaha qaid kara diya aur un ke maal aur auladein apne Nabi ko fai mein dila dein. 

Hadhrat Bara bin Azib ؓ se kisi ne kaha Aie Abu Amarah kya tum log Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas se Hunain wale din bhag nikle thay? Aap ne farmaya lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ ka qadam peechhe na hata tha, baat yeh hai ke qabila Hawazan ke log teer andazi ke fann ke ustad thay, Allah ke fazl se hum ne unhein pehle hi hamle mein shikast de di lekin jab log maal-e-ghanimat par jhuk pare unhon ne mauqa dekh kar phir jo poori maharat ke sath teeron ki baarish barsai to yahan bhagdar mach gayi. 

SubhanAllah! Rasool Allah ﷺ ki kamil shujaat aur poori bahaduri ka yeh mauqa tha. Lashkar bhag nikla hai is waqt aap kisi taiz sawari par nahi jo bhagne daudne mein kaam aaye balki khachar par sawar hain aur mushrikon ki taraf barh rahe hain aur apne tain chhupate nahi balki apna naam apni zuban se pukar pukar kar bata rahe hain ke na pehchanne wale bhi pehchan lein. Khyal farmaiyye ke kis qadar zat-e-wahid par aap ka tawakkul hai aur kitna kamil yaqeen hai aap ko Allah ki madad par. Jante hain ke Allah Ta'ala Amr-e-Risalat ko poora kar ke hi rahega aur aap ke deen ko dunya ke aur deenon par ghalib kar ke hi rahega, fasalawatullahi wa salamuhu abadan abada. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi par aur musalmano ke upar sakeenat nazil farmata hai aur apne farishton ka lashkar bhejta hai jinhein koi na dekhta tha.

Aik mushrik ka bayan hai ke Hunain walay din jab hum musalmanon se larne lage aik bakri ka doodh nikala jaye itni der bhi hum ne unhe apne samne jamne nahi diya foran bhag khare hue aur hum ne unka taaqub shuru kiya yahan tak ke hamein aik sahib safed khachar par sawar nazar pare hum ne dekha yeh ke khubsurat noorani chehre wale kuch log unke ird gird hain unki zuban se nikla ke tumhare chehre bigar jayen wapas laut jao bas yeh kehna tha ke hamein shikast ho gayi yahan tak ke musalman hamare kandhon par sawar ho gaye Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain main bhi us lashkar mein tha Aap ke sath sirf assi Muhajir o Ansar reh gaye the hum ne peeth nahi dikhayi thi hum par Allah ne itminan o sukun nazil farma diya tha. Huzoor ﷺ apne safed khachar par sawar dushmanon ki taraf barh rahe the janwar ne thokar khayi Aap zain par se niche ki taraf jhuk gaye maine awaz di ke Huzoor ﷺ unche ho jayiye Allah Aap ko uncha hi rakhe Aap ne farmaya aik muthi mitti ki to bhar do maine bhar di Aap ne kafiron ki taraf phenki jis se unki aankhein bhar gayin phir farmaya Muhajir o Ansar kahan hain maine kaha yehin hain farmaya nahi awaz do mera awaz dena tha ke woh talwarein sonte hue lapak lapak kar aage ab to mushrikeen ki kuch na chali aur woh bhag khare hue. Baihaqi ki aik riwayat mein hai Shaibah bin Usman kehte hain ke Hunain ke din jabke maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is halat mein dekha ke lashkar shikast kha kar bhag khara hua hai aur Aap ﷺ tanha reh gaye hain toh mujhe Badr walay din apne baap aur chacha ka mara jana yaad aya ke woh Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hamza R.A ke hathon mare gaye hain, maine apne ji mein kaha ke inke intiqam lene ka is se acha moqa aur kaun sa milega ? Ao paigambar ko qatal kar do is irade se main Aap ki dayin janib se barha lekin wahan maine Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ko paya safed chandi jaisi zirah pehne mustaid khare hain maine socha ke yeh chacha hain apne bhatije ki poori himayat karenge chalo bayin janib se ja kar apna kaam karun aur udhar se aya toh dekha Abu Sufiyan bin Harith bin Abdul Muttalib khare hain maine kaha inke bhi chacha ke larke bhai hain apne bhai ki zaroor himayat karenge phir main rukawat kaat kar peechhe ki taraf aya Aap ke kareeb pahunch gaya ab yahi baqi reh gaya tha ke talwar soont kar waar kar dun ke maine dekha ek aag ka kora bijli ki tarah chamak kar mujh par parna chahta hai maine aankhein band kar leen aur pichle paon peechhe ki taraf hata usi waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne meri janib iltifat kiya aur farmaya Shaibah mere paas aya, Allah iske shaitan ko door kar de. Ab maine aankh khol kar jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ki taraf dekha toh wallah Aap mujhe mere kanon aur aankhon se bhi zyada mehboob the Aap ne farmaya Shaibah ja kafiron se lar Shaibah ka bayan hai ke is jang mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sathiyon mein main bhi tha lekin main Islam ki wajah se ya Islam ki marifat ki bina par nahi nikla tha balki maine kaha wah yeh kaise ho sakta hai ?
