In mushrikon ka bayan hai ke hum mein se aik bhi aisa na tha jis ki aankhon aur munh mein yeh mitti na aayi ho, usi waqt hamein aisa maloom hone laga ke goya zameen-o-asman ke darmiyan loha kisi lohe ke tasht par baj raha hai.

Aik riwayat mein hai ke bhage hue musalman jab aik so aap ke paas wapas pahunch gaye aap ne usi waqt hamla ka hukm de diya, awal to munadi Ansar ki thi phir Khazraj hi par reh gayi, yeh qabila larai ke waqt bara hi sabir tha. Aap ﷺ ne apni sawari par se maidan-e-jung ka nazara dekha aur farmaya ab larai garma-garmi se ho rahi hai. Is mein hai ke Allah ne jis kafir ko chaha qatal kara diya, jise chaha qaid kara diya aur un ke maal aur auladein apne Nabi ko fai mein dila dein. 

Hadhrat Bara bin Azib ؓ se kisi ne kaha Aie Abu Amarah kya tum log Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas se Hunain wale din bhag nikle thay? Aap ne farmaya lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ ka qadam peechhe na hata tha, baat yeh hai ke qabila Hawazan ke log teer andazi ke fann ke ustad thay, Allah ke fazl se hum ne unhein pehle hi hamle mein shikast de di lekin jab log maal-e-ghanimat par jhuk pare unhon ne mauqa dekh kar phir jo poori maharat ke sath teeron ki baarish barsai to yahan bhagdar mach gayi. 

SubhanAllah! Rasool Allah ﷺ ki kamil shujaat aur poori bahaduri ka yeh mauqa tha. Lashkar bhag nikla hai is waqt aap kisi taiz sawari par nahi jo bhagne daudne mein kaam aaye balki khachar par sawar hain aur mushrikon ki taraf barh rahe hain aur apne tain chhupate nahi balki apna naam apni zuban se pukar pukar kar bata rahe hain ke na pehchanne wale bhi pehchan lein. Khyal farmaiyye ke kis qadar zat-e-wahid par aap ka tawakkul hai aur kitna kamil yaqeen hai aap ko Allah ki madad par. Jante hain ke Allah Ta'ala Amr-e-Risalat ko poora kar ke hi rahega aur aap ke deen ko dunya ke aur deenon par ghalib kar ke hi rahega, fasalawatullahi wa salamuhu abadan abada. 

Ab Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi par aur musalmano ke upar sakeenat nazil farmata hai aur apne farishton ka lashkar bhejta hai jinhein koi na dekhta tha.

Aik mushrik ka bayan hai ke Hunain walay din jab hum musalmanon se larne lage aik bakri ka doodh nikala jaye itni der bhi hum ne unhe apne samne jamne nahi diya foran bhag khare hue aur hum ne unka taaqub shuru kiya yahan tak ke hamein aik sahib safed khachar par sawar nazar pare hum ne dekha yeh ke khubsurat noorani chehre wale kuch log unke ird gird hain unki zuban se nikla ke tumhare chehre bigar jayen wapas laut jao bas yeh kehna tha ke hamein shikast ho gayi yahan tak ke musalman hamare kandhon par sawar ho gaye Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain main bhi us lashkar mein tha Aap ke sath sirf assi Muhajir o Ansar reh gaye the hum ne peeth nahi dikhayi thi hum par Allah ne itminan o sukun nazil farma diya tha. Huzoor ﷺ apne safed khachar par sawar dushmanon ki taraf barh rahe the janwar ne thokar khayi Aap zain par se niche ki taraf jhuk gaye maine awaz di ke Huzoor ﷺ unche ho jayiye Allah Aap ko uncha hi rakhe Aap ne farmaya aik muthi mitti ki to bhar do maine bhar di Aap ne kafiron ki taraf phenki jis se unki aankhein bhar gayin phir farmaya Muhajir o Ansar kahan hain maine kaha yehin hain farmaya nahi awaz do mera awaz dena tha ke woh talwarein sonte hue lapak lapak kar aage ab to mushrikeen ki kuch na chali aur woh bhag khare hue. Baihaqi ki aik riwayat mein hai Shaibah bin Usman kehte hain ke Hunain ke din jabke maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is halat mein dekha ke lashkar shikast kha kar bhag khara hua hai aur Aap ﷺ tanha reh gaye hain toh mujhe Badr walay din apne baap aur chacha ka mara jana yaad aya ke woh Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hamza R.A ke hathon mare gaye hain, maine apne ji mein kaha ke inke intiqam lene ka is se acha moqa aur kaun sa milega ? Ao paigambar ko qatal kar do is irade se main Aap ki dayin janib se barha lekin wahan maine Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ko paya safed chandi jaisi zirah pehne mustaid khare hain maine socha ke yeh chacha hain apne bhatije ki poori himayat karenge chalo bayin janib se ja kar apna kaam karun aur udhar se aya toh dekha Abu Sufiyan bin Harith bin Abdul Muttalib khare hain maine kaha inke bhi chacha ke larke bhai hain apne bhai ki zaroor himayat karenge phir main rukawat kaat kar peechhe ki taraf aya Aap ke kareeb pahunch gaya ab yahi baqi reh gaya tha ke talwar soont kar waar kar dun ke maine dekha ek aag ka kora bijli ki tarah chamak kar mujh par parna chahta hai maine aankhein band kar leen aur pichle paon peechhe ki taraf hata usi waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne meri janib iltifat kiya aur farmaya Shaibah mere paas aya, Allah iske shaitan ko door kar de. Ab maine aankh khol kar jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ki taraf dekha toh wallah Aap mujhe mere kanon aur aankhon se bhi zyada mehboob the Aap ne farmaya Shaibah ja kafiron se lar Shaibah ka bayan hai ke is jang mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sathiyon mein main bhi tha lekin main Islam ki wajah se ya Islam ki marifat ki bina par nahi nikla tha balki maine kaha wah yeh kaise ho sakta hai ?

ke Hawazin Quraish par ghalib aa jayen? Main aap ke paas hi khara hua tha toh main ne ablaq rang ke ghore dekh kar kaha ya Rasul Allah main toh ablaq rang ke ghore dekh raha hoon aap ne farmaya Shaiba woh toh siwa kafiron ke kisi ko nazar nahi aate. Phir aap ne mere seene par hath maar kar dua ki ya Allah Shaiba ko hidayat kar phir dobara se-bara yehi kiya aur yehi kaha wallah aap ka hath hatne se pehle hi sari dunya se zyada aap ki mohabbat main apne dil mein pane laga. Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'am R.A farmate hain main is ghazwe mein aap ke ham-rikab tha main ne dekha ki koi cheez aasman se utar rahi hai cheontiyon ki tarah us ne maidan gher liya aur usi waqt mushrikon ke qadam ukhad gaye wallah hamein koi shak nahi ki woh aasmani madad thi. Yazid bin Amir Sawabi apne kufr ke zamane mein Jang-e-Hunain mein kafiron ke sath tha baad mein yeh musalman ho gaye the un se jab daryaft kiya jata ki is mauqa par tumhare dilon ka raub-o-khauf se kya hal tha? Toh woh tasht mein kankariyan rakh kar baja kar kehte bas yehi aawaz hamein hamare dil se aa rahi thi be-tarah kaleja uchhal raha tha aur dil dahal raha tha. Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasul Allah ﷺ farmate hain mujhe raub se madad di gayi hai. Mujhe Jami' Al-Kalimat diye gaye hain Al-Gharz kuffar ko Allah ne yeh saza di aur yeh un ke kufr ka badla tha. Baaki Hawazin par Allah ne meherbani farmai unhein tauba naseeb hui musalman ho kar khidmat-e-makhdoom mein hazir hue us waqt aap fateh-mandi ke sath lautte hue Makkha Sharif Ji'ranah ke qareeb pahunch chuke the. Jang ko bees din ke qareeb guzar chuke the is liye aap ne farmaya ki ab tum do cheezon mein se ek pasand kar lo ya toh qaidi ya maal? Unhon ne qaidiyon ka wapas lena pasand kiya un qaidiyon ki chhoton baron ki mard aurat ki baligh nabaligh ki tadad chhe hazaar thi. Aap ne yeh sab unhein luta diye un ka maal ba-taur-e-ghaneemat ke musalmanon mein taqseem hua aur nau-muslim jo Makkha ke azad-karda the unhein bhi aap ne is maal mein se diya ki un ke dil Islam ki taraf poore mail ho jayen un mein se ek ek ko sau sau oont ata farmae. Malik bin Auf Nasri ko bhi aap ne sau oont diye aur usi ko is ki qaum ka sardar bana diya jaise ki woh tha usi ki tareef mein usi ne apne mashhoor qaseede mein kaha hai ki main ne to Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jaisa na kisi aur ko dekha na suna. Dene mein aur bakhshish-o-ata karne mein aur qasooron se dar-guzar karne mein dunya mein aap ka sani nahi aap kul qiyamat ke din hone wale tamam umoor se muttali farmate rehte hain yehi nahi shujaat aur bahaduri mein bhi aap be-misal hain maidan-e-

Mushrikeen ko hudood-e-haram se nikal do. Allah Ta'ala Ahkam-ul-Hakimeen apne pak deen wale, pakeezgi aur taharat wale musalman bandon ko hukum farmata hai ki woh deen ki ro se najis mushrikon ko Baitullah Sharif ke pas na aane dein. Yeh ayat san 9 hijri mein nazil hui, isi saal An-Hazrat Rasul-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali ؓ ko Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ ke sath bheja aur hukum diya ki majma-e-hajj mein ailan kar do ki is saal ke baad koi mushrik hajj ko na aaye aur koi nanga shakhs Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf na kare. Is shar'i hukum ko Allah Ta'ala Qadir-o-Qayyum ne yun hi pura kiya ke na wahan mushrikeen ko dakhla naseeb hua na kisi ne is ke baad uryani ki halat mein Allah ke ghar ka tawaf kiya. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah ghulam aur zimmi shakhs ko mustasna banate hain. Musnad ki hadith mein farman-e-Rasul Akram ﷺ hai ke hamari is masjid mein is ke baad siwaye mu'ahda wale aur tumhare ghulamon ke aur koi kafir na aaye. Lekin is marfoo' se zyada sahih sanad wali mawqoof riwayat hai. Khalifa-tul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ؒ ne farman jari kar diya tha ki Yahood-o-Nasrani ko musalmanon ki masjidoan mein na aane do, un ka yeh imtina'i hukum isi ayat ke taht tha. Hazrat Atta farmate hain ke haram sara is hukum mein misl-e-Masjid-e-Haram ke hai. Yeh ayat mushrikon ki najasat par bhi daleel-e-wasiq hai. Sahih hadith mein hai momin najis nahi hota. Baqi rahi yeh baat ke mushrikon ka badan aur zat bhi najis hai ya nahi? Pas jamhoor ka qaul to yeh hai ke najis nahi. Is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ne Ahl-e-Kitab ka zabeeha halal kiya hai. Baaz Zahiriya kehte hain ke mushrikon ke badan bhi napak hi hain. Hasan farmate hain jo un se musafaha kare woh hath dho dale. Is hukum par baaz logon ne kaha ke phir to hamari tijarat ka manda ho jayega, hamare bazar beroonaq ho jayenge aur bahut se faide jate rahenge. Is ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala Ghani-o-Hameed farmata hai ke tum is baat se na daro, Allah tumhe aur bahut si soorton se (rizq) dila dega, tumhe Ahl-e-Kitab se jiziya dilayega aur tumhe ghani kar dega, tumhari maslahaton ko tum se zyada Rab janta hai, is ka hukum, is ki maman'at kisi na kisi hikmat se hi hoti hai. Yeh tijarat itne faide ki nahi jitna faida woh tumhe jiziye se deta hai. In Ahl-e-Kitab se jo Allah, us ke Rasul ﷺ, aur qayamat ke munkar hain, jo kisi nabi ke sahih ma'ane mein pure muttaba' nahi balki apni khwahishon ke aur apne baron ki taqlid ke peeche pade hue hain; agar unhe apne nabi ﷺ par, apni shariyat par pura iman hota to woh hamare is nabi par bhi zaroor iman late. Un ki basharat to har nabi deta raha, un ki itba' ka hukum har nabi ne diya lekin bawajood is ke woh is Ashraf-ur-Rusul ke inkari hain, pas agle nabiyon ki shar'i se bhi darasal unhe koi door ka sarokar bhi nahi. Isi wajah se un nabiyon ka zabani iqrar un ke liye besood hai kyunki yeh Sayyid-ul-Anbiya, Afzal-ur-Rusul, Khatam-un-Nabiyyeen, Akmal-ul-Mursaleen se kufr karte hain, is liye un se bhi jihad karo.

Un se jihad ke hukm ki yeh pehli ayat hai, us waqt tak aas-paas ke mushrikeen se jang ho chuki thi, un mein se aksar tauheed ke jhande tale aa chuke the, Jazirat-ul-Arab mein Islam ne jagah kar li thi, ab Yahood-o-Nasara ki khabar lene aur unhein raah-e-haq dikhane ka hukm hua. Sunah 9 hijri mein yeh hukm utra aur Aap ﷺ ne رومiyon (Rumiyon) se jihad ki tayari ki, logon ko apne irade se muttala kiya, Madina ke ard-gard ke arabon ko amada kiya aur taqreeban tees hazaar ka lashkar le kar Rum ka rukh kiya. Bajuze munafiqeen ke yahan koi na roka siwaye baaz ke.

Musam sakht garam tha, phalon ka waqt tha, Rum se jihad ke liye Sham ke mulk ka door-daraz ka kathan safar tha. Tabook tak tashreef le gaye, wahan taqreeban bees roz qiyam farmaya, phir Allah se istikhara kar ke halaat ki tangi aur logon ki zaeefi ki wajah se wapas loote. Jaise ke anqareeb is ka waqia Insha'Allah Ta'ala bayan hoga.

 Isi ayat se istadlal kar ke baaz ne farmaya hai ke jizya sirf Ahl-e-Kitab se aur un jaison se hi liya jaye jaise majoos hain, chunancha Hajar ke majusiyon se An-Hazrat ﷺ ne jizya liya tha. Imam Shafi'i ka yahi mazhab hai aur mashhoor mazhab Imam Ahmad ka bhi yahi hai. Imam Abu Haneefa kehte hain sab ajmiyon se liya jaye khwah woh Ahl-e-Kitab hon khwah mushrik hon. Haan arab mein se sirf Ahl-e-Kitab se hi liya jaye. Imam Malik farmate hain ke jizye ka lena tamam kuffaar se jaise hai khwah woh kitabi hon ya majoosi hon ya but-parast waghera hon. In mazahib ke dalaail waghera ki tafseel ki yeh jagah nahi, Wallahu A'lam.

Pas farmata hai ke jab tak woh zillat-o-khwari ke sath apne hathon jizya na dein unhein na chhoro. Pas Ahl-e-Zimma ko musalmanon par izzat-o-tauqeer deni aur unhein ouj-o-tarraqi deni jaise nahi hai. Sahih Muslim mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Yahood-o-Nasara se salam ki ibtida na karo aur jab un se koi raste mein mil jaye toh use tangi par majboor karo. Yahi wajah thi jo Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne un se aisi hi shartein ki thin. 

Abdur Rahman bin Ghanm Ash'ari kehte hain: Main ne apne hath se ahd-nama likh kar Hazrat Umar R.A ko diya tha ke Ahl-e-Sham ke flan flan shahri logon ki taraf se yeh muahida hai Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A se ke jab aap ke lashkar hum par aayein hum ne aap se apni jaan, maal aur ahl-o-iyal ke liye aman talab ki, hum in sharton par woh aman hasil karte hain ke hum apne in shahron mein aur un ke aas-paas koi girja ghar aur khanqah nayi nahi banayeinge.

mandir aur na aise kisi kharabi wale makan ki islah karenge aur jo mit chuke hain unhi durust nahi karenge, unmein agar koi musalman musafir utarna chahe to rokenge nahi khwah din ho khwah raat ho hum unke darwaze rah-guzar aur musafiron ke liye kushadah rakhenge aur jo musalman aaye hum uski teen din tak mehmandari karenge, hum apne in makanon ya rihaishi makanon waghera mein kahin kisi jasus ko na chupayenge, musalmanon se koi dhoka fareb nahi karenge, apni aulad ko Quran na sikhayenge, shirk ka izhar na karenge na kisi ko shirk ki taraf bulayenge, hum mein se koi agar islam qubul karna chahe hum use hargiz na rokenge, musalmanon ki tauqir-o-izzat karenge, hamari jagah agar woh baithna chahein to hum uthkar unhe jagah de denge, hum musalmanon se kisi cheez mein barabari na karenge, na libas mein na jooti mein na mang nikalne mein, hum unki zubanein nahi bolenge, unki kuniyatein nahi rakhenge, zeen wale ghordon par sawariyan na karenge, talwarein na latkayenge na apne sath rakhenge. Angoothiyon par arabi naqsh nahi karayenge, sharab-faroshi nahi karenge, apne saron ke agle balon ko tarashwa denge aur jahan kahin honge zunar zarooratan dale rahenge, saleeb ka nishan apne garjon par zahir nahi karenge. Apni mazhabi kitabein musalmanon ki guzar-gahon aur bazaron mein zahir nahi karenge, garjon mein naqoos buland awaz se bajayenge na musalmanon ki mojoodgi mein ba-awaz buland apni mazhabi kitabein padhenge na apne mazhabi shaar ko raston par karenge, na apne murdon par oonchi awaz se haye-waye karenge na unke sath musalmanon ke raston mein aag lekar jayenge, musalmanon ke hisse mein aaye hue ghulam hum na lenge, musalmanon ki khair-khwahi zaroor karte rahenge, unke gharon mein jhankenge nahi. Jab yeh ahd-nama Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam ki khidmat mein pesh hua to aap ne ek shart aur bhi is mein badhw

Abdur Rahman bin Ghanm Ash'ari kehte hain: Main ne apne hath se ahd-nama likh kar Hazrat Umar R.A ko diya tha ke Ahl-e-Sham ke flan flan shahri logon ki taraf se yeh muahida hai Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A se ke jab aap ke lashkar hum par aayein hum ne aap se apni jaan, maal aur ahl-o-iyal ke liye aman talab ki, hum in sharton par woh aman hasil karte hain ke hum apne in shahron mein aur un ke aas-paas koi girja ghar aur khanqah nayi nahi banayeinge.

mandir aur na aise kisi kharabi wale makan ki islah karenge aur jo mit chuke hain unhi durust nahi karenge, unmein agar koi musalman musafir utarna chahe to rokenge nahi khwah din ho khwah raat ho hum unke darwaze rah-guzar aur musafiron ke liye kushadah rakhenge aur jo musalman aaye hum uski teen din tak mehmandari karenge, hum apne in makanon ya rihaishi makanon waghera mein kahin kisi jasus ko na chupayenge, musalmanon se koi dhoka fareb nahi karenge, apni aulad ko Quran na sikhayenge, shirk ka izhar na karenge na kisi ko shirk ki taraf bulayenge, hum mein se koi agar islam qubul karna chahe hum use hargiz na rokenge, musalmanon ki tauqir-o-izzat karenge, hamari jagah agar woh baithna chahein to hum uthkar unhe jagah de denge, hum musalmanon se kisi cheez mein barabari na karenge, na libas mein na jooti mein na mang nikalne mein, hum unki zubanein nahi bolenge, unki kuniyatein nahi rakhenge, zeen wale ghordon par sawariyan na karenge, talwarein na latkayenge na apne sath rakhenge. Angoothiyon par arabi naqsh nahi karayenge, sharab-faroshi nahi karenge, apne saron ke agle balon ko tarashwa denge aur jahan kahin honge zunar zarooratan dale rahenge, saleeb ka nishan apne garjon par zahir nahi karenge. Apni mazhabi kitabein musalmanon ki guzar-gahon aur bazaron mein zahir nahi karenge, garjon mein naqoos buland awaz se bajayenge na musalmanon ki mojoodgi mein ba-awaz buland apni mazhabi kitabein padhenge na apne mazhabi shaar ko raston par karenge, na apne murdon par oonchi awaz se haye-waye karenge na unke sath musalmanon ke raston mein aag lekar jayenge, musalmanon ke hisse mein aaye hue ghulam hum na lenge, musalmanon ki khair-khwahi zaroor karte rahenge, unke gharon mein jhankenge nahi. Jab yeh ahd-nama Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam ki khidmat mein pesh hua to aap ne ek shart aur bhi is mein badhw

Buzurg baray nahiin Allah Jallashanahu sab se bara hai. In tamam aayaton mein bhi Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal mominon ko mushrikon, kafiron, yahudiyon aur nasraniyon se jihad karne ki raghibat dilata hai. Farmata hai dekho woh Allah ki shaan mein kaisi gustakhiyan karte hain, yahud Uzair ko Allah ka beta batate hain, Allah us se paak aur bartar-o-buland hai ki us ki aulaad ho. In logon ko Hazrat Uzair ki nisbat jo weham hua, is ka qissa yeh hai ki jab amaaliqah Bani Israel par ghalib aa gaye, un ke ulama ko qatal kar diya, un ke raeeson ko qaid kar liya. Uzair (Alaihis Salam) ka ilm uth jaane aur ulama ke qatal ho jaane se aur Bani Israel ki tabahi se saqt ranjeeda hue. Ab jo rona shuru kiya toh aankhon se aansu na thamte thay, rote rote palkein bhi jhad gayin. Ek din isi tarah rote hue ek maidan se guzar hua, dekha ki ek aurat ek qabr ke paas baithi ro rahi hai aur keh rahi hai haye ab mere khane ka kya hoga? Mere kapron ka kya hoga? Aap us ke paas thehar gaye aur us se farmaya, is shakhs se pehle tujhe kaun khilata tha aur kaun pehnata tha? Us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala. Aap ne farmaya phir Allah Ta'ala toh ab bhi zinda baaqi hai, us par toh kabhi nahi maut aaye gi. Yeh sun kar us aurat ne kaha, Aai Uzair! Phir tu yeh toh bata ki Bani Israel se pehle ulama ko kaun ilm sikhata tha? Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala. Us ne kaha aap yeh rona-dhona le kar kyun baithe hain? Aap ko samajh mein aa gaya ki yeh Janab-e-Bari Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ki taraf se aap ko tanbih hai. Phir aap se farmaya gaya ki fulaan nehar par ja kar ghusal karo, wahin do rakat namaz ada karo, wahan tumhein ek shakhs milenge woh jo kuch khilayein woh kha lo. Chunanche aap wahin tashreef le gaye, naha kar namaz ada ki, dekha ki ek shakhs hain keh rahe hain munh kholo. Aap ne munh khol diya, unhon ne teen martaba koi cheez aap ke munh mein badi si daali. Usi waqt Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne aap ka seena khol diya aur aap Taurat ke sab se bare aalim ban gaye. Bani Israel mein gaye, un se farmaya ki main tumhare paas Taurat laya hoon. Unhon ne kaha hum sab aap ke nazdeek sachay hain. Aap ne apni ungli ke sath qalam ko lapet liya aur usi ungli se yeh yakwaqt poori Taurat likh daali. Idhar log ladaai se loote, un mein un ke ulama bhi wapas aaye, toh unhein Uzair (Alaihis Salam) ki is baat ka ilm hua. Yeh gaye aur paharon aur gharon mein Taurat Shareef ke jo nuskhe chhupa aaye the woh nikal laaye aur un nuskhon se Hazrat Uzair (Alaihis Salam) ke likhe hue nuskhe ka muqabla kiya toh bilkul sahi paya. Is par baaz jahilon ke dil mein shaitan ne yeh waswasa daal diya ki aap Allah ke bete hain. Hazrat Maseeh ko nasrani Allah ka beta kehte hain, un ka waqia toh zahir hai. Pas in dono grohon ki ghalat bayani Quran bayaan farma raha hai aur farmata hai ki yeh un ki sirf zabani baatein hain jo mahz be-daleel hain. Jis tarah un se pehle ke log kufr-o-zalalat mein thay, yeh bhi unhi ke mureed-o-muqallid hain. Allah unhein laanat kare, haq se kaise bhatak gaye?

Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi aur Ibn Jarir mein hai ke jab Adi bin Hatam ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ka deen pahuncha toh Sham ki taraf bhag nikla, Jahiliyat mein hi yeh Nasrani ban gaya tha, yahan uski behn aur uski jama'at qaid ho gayi, phir Huzoor ﷺ ne ba-taur ehsan uski behn ko azad kar diya aur raqam bhi di. Yeh seedhi apne bhai ke paas gayi aur unhein Islam ki raghbat dilayi aur samjhaya ke tum Rasool Kareem Alaihil Afdalus Salatus Tasleem ke paas chale jao, chunache yeh Madina Shareef aa gaye thay, apni qaum Tai ke sardar thay, unke baap ki sakhawat duniya bhar mein mashhoor thi. Logon ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko khabar pahunchayi, aap khud unke paas aaye, us waqt Adi ki gardan mein chandi ki saleeb latak rahi thi. Huzoor ﷺ ki zaban-e-mubarak se usi (ayat Itakhazu) ki tilawat ho rahi thi toh unhone kaha ke Yahood-o-Nasara ne apne ulama aur darveshon ki ibadat nahi ki. Aap ne farmaya: "Haan suno! Unke kiye hue haram ko haram samajhne lage aur jise unke ulama aur darvesh halal bata dein, use halal samajhne lage, yehi unki ibadat thi."

Phir aap ne farmaya: "Adi! Kya tum is se be-khabar ho ke Allah sab se bada hai? Kya tumhare khayal mein Allah se bada aur koi hai? Kya tum is se inkar karte ho ke ma'bud-e-barhaq Allah Ta'ala ke siva koi nahi? Kya tumhare nazdeek us ke siva aur koi bhi ibadat ke la-aiq hai?"

Phir aap ne unhein Islam ki dawat di, unhone maan li aur Allah ki tawheed aur Huzoor ﷺ ki risalat ki gawahi ada ki. Aap ka chehra khushi se chamakne laga aur farmaya: "Yahood par ghazab-e-ilahi utra hai aur Nasrani gumrah ho gaye hain."

Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman R.A aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A waghera se bhi is ayat ki tafseer isi tarah marwi hai ke is se murad halal-o-haram ke masail mein ulama aur aimma ki mahz baaton ki taqleed hai. Sadi farmate hain: "Unhone buzurgon ki manni shuru kar di aur Allah ki kitab ko ek taraf hata diya."

Isi liye Allah Kareem irshad farmata hai ke unhein hukm toh sirf yeh tha ke Allah ke siva aur kisi ki ibadat na karein, wahi jise haram kar de haram hai aur woh jise halal farma de halal hai. Isi ke farman-e-shariat hain, isi ke ahkam baja lane ke la-aiq hain, isi ki zat ibadat ki mustahiq hai. Woh mushrik se aur shirq se pak hai, us jaisa uska shareek, uska nazeer, uska madadgar, uska zidd ka koi nahi, woh aulad se pak hai, na us ke siva koi ma'bud na parwardigar.

Kaffara ki dili mazmoom khwahish. Farmata hai ki har qism ke kuffar ka irada aur chahat yahi hai ki Noor-e-Ilahi bujha dein, hidayat-e-Rabbani aur deen-e-haq ko mita dein toh khayal karlo ki agar koi shakhs apne munh ki phoonk se aftab ya mahtab ki roshni bujhani chahe toh kya yeh hosakta hai? Isi tarah yeh log bhi noor-e-rab ke bujhane ki chahat mein apni imkani koshish karein aakhir aajiz ho kar reh jayenge. Zaroori baat hai aur Allah ka faisla hai ki deen-e-haq, taleem-e-Rasool ﷺ ka bol bala hoga. Tum mitana chahte ho Allah is ko buland karna chahta hai, zahir hai ki Allah ki chahat tumhari chahat par ghalib rahegi. Tum go nakhush raho lekin aftab-e-hidayat beech aasman mein pahunch kar hi rahega. Arbi lughat mein kafir kehte hain kisi cheez ke chhupa lene wale ko, isi aitbaar se raat ko bhi kafir kehte hain isliye ki woh bhi tamam cheezon ko chhupa leti hai. Kisaan ko kafir kehte hain kyunki woh dane zameen mein chhupa deta hai, jaise farmaan hai (kamathalin ghaithin a’jabal-kuffara nabatuhu thumma yahiju fatarahu musfarran thumma yakunu hutaman wa fil-akhirati ‘adhabun shadidun wa maghfiratun minallahi wa ridwanun wa mal-hayatud-dunya illa mata’ul-ghurur 20) (Al-Hadid: 20). Isi Allah ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur deen-e-haq ke sath apna paighambar bana kar bheja hai, Huzoor ﷺ ki sachi khabron aur sahih iman aur nafa wale ilm pe mabni yeh hidayat hai aur umda aamal jo duniya aakhirat mein nafa dein un ka majmoo'a yeh deen-e-haq hai. Yeh tamam mazahib-e-alam par chaa kar rahega. Aan-Hazrat Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ farmate hain mere liye mashriq o maghrib ki zameen lapait di gayi, meri ummat ka mulk in tamam jagahon tak pahunchega. Farmate hain tumhare haathon par mashriq o maghrib fateh hoga, tumhare sardar jahannumi hain, bajjuz un ke jo muttaqi, parhezgar aur amanatdar hon. Farmate hain yeh deen tamam us jagah par pahunchega jahan par din raat pahunche, koi kachcha pakka ghar aisa baaqi na rahega jahan Allah Azzawajal Islam ko na pahunchaye. Azeezon ko azeez karega aur zaleelon ko zaleel karega, Islam ko izzat dene walon ko izzat milegi aur kufr ko zillat naseeb hogi. Hazrat Tamim Dari ؓ farmate hain main ne toh yeh baat khud apne ghar mein bhi dekh li, jo musalman hua us se khair o barkat, izzat o sharafat mili aur jo kafir raha use zillat o nukbat, nafrat o la'nat naseeb hui, pasti aur haqarat dekhi aur kamina-pan ke sath jizya dena pada. Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain ro-e-zameen par koi kachcha pakka ghar aisa baaqi na rahega jis mein Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala kalma-e-Islam ko dakhil na kar de, woh izzat walon ko izzat dega aur zaleelon ko zaleel karega, jinhein izzat deni chahega unhein Islam naseeb karega aur jinhein zaleel karna hoga woh ise nahi manenge lekin us ki mathati mein unhein aana padega.

Hazrat Adi farmate hain mere paas Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye mujh se farmaya Islam qubool kar taake salamati mile maine kaha main to ek deen ko manta hoon Aap ne farmaya tere deen ka tujh se zyada mujhe ilm hai maine kaha sach? Aap ne farmaya bilkul sach. Kya tu Rokusiya mein se nahi hai? Kya tu apni qaum se tax وصول (wasool) nahi karta? maine kaha yeh to sach hai. Aap ne farmaya tere deen mein yeh tere liye halal nahi pas yeh sunte hi main to jhuk gaya Aap ne farmaya main khoob janta hoon ke tujhe Islam se kaun si cheez rokti hai? Sun sirf ek yahi baat tujhe rokti hai ke musalman bilkul zaeef aur kamzor natawan hain tamam arab unhe ghere hue hain yeh un se nipat nahi sakte lekin sun Hira ka tujhe ilm hai? maine kaha dekha to nahi lekin suna zaroor hai. Aap ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke Allah Ta'ala is Amr-e-Ilahi ko poora farmayega yahan tak ke ek sandni sawar Hira se chal kar akele amn ke sath Makkah Mukarma pahunchega aur Baitullah Shareef ka tawaf karega. Wallah tum Kisra ke khazane fateh karoge maine kaha Kisra bin Hormuz ke? Aap ne farmaya haan Kisra bin Hormuz ke tum mein maal ki is qadar kasrat ho padegi ke koi lene wala na milega. Is hadis ko bayan karte waqt Hazrat Adi ne farmaya Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman poora hua. Yeh dekho aaj Hira se sawariyan chalti hain be-khof khatar baghair kisi ki panah ke Baitullah pahunch kar tawaf karti hain. Sadiq-o-Masdooq ki doosri peshingoi bhi poori hui. Kisra ke khazane fateh hue main khud us fauj mein tha jis ne Iran ki eent se eent baja di aur Kisra ke makhfi khazane apne qabze mein liye. Wallah mujhe yaqeen hai ke Sadiq-o-Masdooq ﷺ ki teesri peshingoi bhi qatan poori ho kar hi rahegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain din raat ka daur khatam na hoga jab tak phir Lat-o-Uzza ki ibadat na hone lage Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ne farmaya Rasool Allah ﷺ (ayat Huwal-lazi arsala) ke nazil hone ke baad se mera khayal to aaj tak yahi raha ke yeh poori baat hai Aap ne farmaya haan poori ho gayi aur mukammal hi rahegi jab tak Allah Pak ko manzoor hoga phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen ek paak hawa bhejenge jo har us shakhs ko bhi faut karegi jis ke dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar bhi iman hoga. Phir wahi log baaqi reh jayenge jin mein koi khair-o-khoobi na hogi pas woh apne baap dadon ke deen ki taraf phir se laut jayenge.

Farmate hain yeh deen tamam us jagah par pahunchega jahan par din raat pahunche, koi kachcha pakka ghar aisa baaqi na rahega jahan Allah Azzawajal Islam ko na pahunchaye. Azeezon ko azeez karega aur zaleelon ko zaleel karega, Islam ko izzat dene walon ko izzat milegi aur kufr ko zillat naseeb hogi. Hazrat Tamim Dari ؓ farmate hain main ne toh yeh baat khud apne ghar mein bhi dekh li, jo musalman hua us se khair o barkat, izzat o sharafat mili aur jo kafir raha use zillat o nukbat, nafrat o la'nat naseeb hui, pasti aur haqarat dekhi aur kamina-pan ke sath jizya dena pada. Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain ro-e-zameen par koi kachcha pakka ghar aisa baaqi na rahega jis mein Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala kalma-e-Islam ko dakhil na kar de, woh izzat walon ko izzat dega aur zaleelon ko zaleel karega, jinhein izzat deni chahega unhein Islam naseeb karega aur jinhein zaleel karna hoga woh ise nahi manenge lekin us ki mathati mein unhein aana padega.

Hazrat Adi farmate hain mere paas Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye mujh se farmaya Islam qubool kar taake salamati mile maine kaha main to ek deen ko manta hoon Aap ne farmaya tere deen ka tujh se zyada mujhe ilm hai maine kaha sach? Aap ne farmaya bilkul sach. Kya tu Rokusiya mein se nahi hai? Kya tu apni qaum se tax وصول (wasool) nahi karta? maine kaha yeh to sach hai. Aap ne farmaya tere deen mein yeh tere liye halal nahi pas yeh sunte hi main to jhuk gaya Aap ne farmaya main khoob janta hoon ke tujhe Islam se kaun si cheez rokti hai? Sun sirf ek yahi baat tujhe rokti hai ke musalman bilkul zaeef aur kamzor natawan hain tamam arab unhe ghere hue hain yeh un se nipat nahi sakte lekin sun Hira ka tujhe ilm hai? maine kaha dekha to nahi lekin suna zaroor hai. Aap ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke Allah Ta'ala is Amr-e-Ilahi ko poora farmayega yahan tak ke ek sandni sawar Hira se chal kar akele amn ke sath Makkah Mukarma pahunchega aur Baitullah Shareef ka tawaf karega. Wallah tum Kisra ke khazane fateh karoge maine kaha Kisra bin Hormuz ke? Aap ne farmaya haan Kisra bin Hormuz ke tum mein maal ki is qadar kasrat ho padegi ke koi lene wala na milega. Is hadis ko bayan karte waqt Hazrat Adi ne farmaya Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman poora hua. Yeh dekho aaj Hira se sawariyan chalti hain be-khof khatar baghair kisi ki panah ke Baitullah pahunch kar tawaf karti hain. Sadiq-o-Masdooq ki doosri peshingoi bhi poori hui. Kisra ke khazane fateh hue main khud us fauj mein tha jis ne Iran ki eent se eent baja di aur Kisra ke makhfi khazane apne qabze mein liye. Wallah mujhe yaqeen hai ke Sadiq-o-Masdooq ﷺ ki teesri peshingoi bhi qatan poori ho kar hi rahegi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain din raat ka daur khatam na hoga jab tak phir Lat-o-Uzza ki ibadat na hone lage Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ne farmaya Rasool Allah ﷺ (ayat Huwal-lazi arsala) ke nazil hone ke baad se mera khayal to aaj tak yahi raha ke yeh poori baat hai Aap ne farmaya haan poori ho gayi aur mukammal hi rahegi jab tak Allah Pak ko manzoor hoga phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen ek paak hawa bhejenge jo har us shakhs ko bhi faut karegi jis ke dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar bhi iman hoga. Phir wahi log baaqi reh jayenge jin mein koi khair-o-khoobi na hogi pas woh apne baap dadon ke deen ki taraf phir se laut jayenge.

Yahudiyon ke ulama ko ahbar aur Nasara ke abidon ko ruhban kehte hain. (Lowla yanhu-humur-rabbaniyuna wal-ahbaru 'an qawlihimul-isma wa aklihimus-suhta laba'sa ma kanu yasna'un 63) (Al-Ma'idah: 63) mein Yahud ke ulama ko ahbar kaha gaya hai. Nasraniyon ke abidon ko ruhban aur unke ulama ko qassis. Is ayat mein kaha gaya (Zalika bi-anna minhum qissisina wa ruhbanan wa annahum la yastakbirun 82) (Al-Ma'idah: 82) ayat ka maqsad logon ko bare ulama aur gumrah sufiyon aur abidon se hoshiyar karana aur darana hai. Hazrat Sufyan bin 'Uyainah (R.H) farmate hain: Hamare ulama mein se wohi bigarte hain, jin mein kuch na kuch shaibah yahudiyat ka hota hai aur hum Musalmanon mein sufiyon aur abidon mein se wohi bigarte hain jin mein nasraniyat ka shaibah hota hai. Sahih hadith sharif mein hai ke tum yaqinan apne se pehlon ki rawash par chal paroge. Aisi poori mushabahat hogi ke zara bhi farq na rahega logon ne pucha kya Yahud-o-Nasara ki rawash par? Aap ne farmaya haan unhi ki rawash par aur riwayat mein hai ke logon ne pucha kya Farsiyon aur Romiyon ki rawash par? Aap ne farmaya aur kaun log hain? Pas unke aqwal-o-af'al ki mushabahat se har mumkin bachna chahiye. Isliye ke yeh is wajahat se riyasat-o-mansab hasil karna aur is wajahat se logon ka maal ghasab karna chahte hain. Ahbar Yahud ko zamana-e-jahiliyat mein bara hi rasookh hasil tha. Unke tuhfe, hadiye, kharaj, chiraghi muqarrar thi jo baghair mange unhein pahunch jati thi. Rasulullah (ﷺ) ki nubuwwat ke baad isi tama ne unhein qubool-e-Islam se roka. Lekin haq ke muqable ki wajah se is taraf se bhi kore rahe aur akhirat se bhi haath dho baithe. Zillat-o-haqarat un par baras pari aur ghazab-e-Ilahi mein mubtala ho kar tabah-o-barbad ho gaye. Yeh haram-khor jama'at khud haq se ruk kar auron ke bhi darpe rehti thi haq ko baatil se khalat-malat kar ke logon ko bhi rah-e-haq se rok dete the. Jahilon mein baith kar gap hankte ke hum logon ko rah-e-haq ki taraf bulate hain halanki yeh sarih dhoka hai woh to jahannam ki taraf bulane wale hain qiyamat ke din yeh beyaro-madadgar chhor diye jayenge. Alamoon aur sufiyon yani waizoon aur abidon ka zikr karne ke baad ab amiron daulatmandoon aur ra'isoon ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke jis tarah yeh dono tabaqe apne andar badtareen logon ko bhi rakhte hain aise hi is teesre tabaqe mein bhi sharir-un-nafs log hote hain umuman unhi teen tabaqe ke logon ka awam par asar hota hai awam ki kaseer tadad unke sath balki unke peeche hoti hai pas unka bigadna goya mazhabi duniya ka satyanas hona hai jaise ke Hazrat Ibn al-Mubarak (R.H) kehte hain: Wa hal afsadad-deena illa al-muluku wa ahbaru su'in wa ruhbanuha yani deen waizoon, alamoon, sufiyon aur darweshoon ke napak tabaqe se hi bigadta hai. Kanz istilah-e-shara mein us maal ko kehte hain jis ki zakat ada ki jati ho.

Hazrat Ibn Umar R.H se yahi marwi hai balki farmate hain jis maal ki zakat de di jati ho woh agar satween zameen tale bhi ho toh woh kanz nahi aur jis ki zakat na di jati ho woh go zameen par zahir phaila pada ho kanz hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.H, Hazrat Jabir R.H, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.H se bhi mauqufan aur marfu'an yahi marwi hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.H bhi yahi farmate hain aur farmate hain baghair zakat ke maal se us maalدار ko dagha jayega. Aap ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdullah R.H se marwi hai ke yeh zakat ke utarne se pehle tha, zakat ka hukm nazil farma kar Allah ne use maal ki taharat bana diya. Khalifa-e-Barhaq Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H aur Arak bin Malik ne bhi yahi farmaya hai ke ise qoul-e-Rabbani (khuz min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum wa tuzakkihim biha wa salli 'alaihim inna salataka sakanun lahum wallahu sami'un 'alim) (At-Taubah: 103) ne mansukh kar diya hai. Hazrat Abu Umamah farmate hain ke talwaron ka zewar bhi kanz ya'ni khazana hai. Yaad rakho main tumhein wahi sunata hu jo maine Janab-e-Paighambar-e-Haq ﷺ se suna hai. Hazrat Ali R.H farmate hain ke chaar hazaar aur us se kam toh nafaqah hai aur us se zyada kanz hai. Lekin yeh qoul gharib hai. Maal ki kasrat ki muzammat aur kami ki madhat mein bohat si hadeesein warid hui hain, ba-taur namune ke hum bhi yahan un mein se chand naql karte hain. Musnad Abdur Razzaq mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Sone chandi walon ke liye halakat hai, teen martaba aap ka yahi farman sun kar sahaba par shaq guzra aur unhon ne sawal kiya ke phir hum kis qism ka maal rakhein? Hazrat Umar R.H ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh halat bayan kar ke yahi sawal kiya toh aap ne farmaya ke zikr karne wali zuban, shukr karne wala dil aur deen ke kamon mein madad dene wali biwi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke sone chandi ki muzammat ki yeh ayat jab utri aur sahaba ne aapas mein charcha kiya toh Hazrat Umar R.H ne kaha lo main Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kar aata hu, apni sawari tez kar ke Rasulullah ﷺ se ja mile aur riwayat mein hai ke sahaba R.H ne kaha phir hum apni aulaadon ke liye kya chhor jayein? Is mein hai ke Hazrat Umar R.H ke peeche hi peeche Hazrat Thouban R.H bhi the. Aap ne Hazrat Umar R.H ke sawal par farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne zakat isisi liye muqarrar farmai hai ke baqi ka maal pak ho jaye. Meras ke muqarrar karne ka zikr kiya ja raha hai ke jama karne mein koi harj nahi. Hazrat Umar R.H yeh sun kar mare khushi ke takbeerein kehne lage. Aap ne farmaya lo aur suno main tumhein behtareen khazana batau: Naik aurat jab is ka khawand is ki taraf nazar dale toh woh use khush kar de aur jab hukm de foran baja laye aur jab woh maujud na ho toh us ki namoos ki hifazat kare.

Hassan bin Atiyah kehte hain ke Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus R.A ek safar mein thay, ek manzil par utray aur apne ghulam se farmaya ke chhuri lao, khelein, mujhe bura maloom hua. Aap ne afsos zahir kiya aur farmaya, "Main ne toh Islam ke baad se ab tak aisi be-ehtiyati ki baat kabhi nahi ki thi, ab tum isey bhool jao aur ek hadith bayaan karta hoon isey yaad rakho." Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke jab log sona chandi jama karne lagein, toh tum in kalimaat ko kasrat se kaha karo:

Allahumma inni as'aluka-th-thabata fil-amri wal-'azimata 'ala-r-rushdi, wa as'aluka shukra ni'matika, wa as'aluka husna 'ibadatika, wa as'aluka qalban saliman, wa as'aluka lisanan sadiqan, wa as'aluka min khairi ma ta'lamu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu, wa astaghfiruka lima ta'lamu, innaka anta 'allamul-ghuyub.

(Tarjuma) Yani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se kaam ki sabit-qadmi aur bhalaaiyon ki pukhtagi aur teri naimaton ka shukr aur teri ibadaton ki achhaai aur salamati wala dil aur sachi zuban aur tere ilm mein jo bhalaai hai woh, aur tere ilm mein jo burai hai us ki panah, aur jin buraiyon ko tu jaanta hai un se istighfar talib karta hoon. Main manta hoon ke tu tamam ghaib janne wala hai."

Aayat mein bayaan hai ke Allah ki raah mein apne maal ko kharch na karne wale aur ise bacha bacha kar rakhne wale dardnaak azaab diye jayenge. Qayamat ke din usi maal ko khoob tapa kar garm aag jaisa kar ke iske se un ki peshaniyaan, pehlu aur kamar daghi jayegi aur ba-taur daant-dapat ke un se farmaya jayega ke lo apni jama-jatha ka maza chakho.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke farishton ko hukm hoga ke garm pani ka tarred dozakhiyon ke saron par bahao aur un se kaho ke azaab ka lutf uthao, tum bare zi-izzat aur buzurg samjhe jaate rahe ho, badla iska yeh hai.

Sabit hua ke jo shakhs jis cheez ko mehboob bana kar Allah ki ita'at se isey muqaddam rakhega, usi ke sath isey azaab hoga. In maaldaron ne maal ki mohabbat mein Allah ke farmaan ko bhula diya tha, aaj usi maal se unhein saza di ja rahi hai. Jaise ke Abu Lahab khullam-khulla Huzoor ﷺ ki dushmani karta tha aur uski biwi uski madad karti thi, qayamat ke din aag ke aur bhadkane ke liye woh apne gale mein rassi daal kar lakdiyan la la kar isey sulgayegi aur woh is mein jalta rahega.

Yeh maal jo yahan sab se zyada pasandeeda hain, yehi maal qayamat ke din sab se zyada muzir sabit honge. Isi ko garm kar ke is se daag diye jayenge.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ke aise maaldaron ke jism itne lambe chaude kar diye jayenge ke ek ek dinar o dirham is par aa jaye, phir kul maal aag jaisa bana kar alag alag kar ke sare jism par phaila diya jayega, yeh nahi ke ek ke baad ek daag lage, balki ek sath sab ke sab.

Marfu'an bhi yeh riwayat aayi hai lekin iski sanad sahih nahi. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Tawus farmate hain ke iska maal ek ajgar ban kar iske peeche lage ga, jo uzru samne aa jayega isi ko chaba jayega.

Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain jo apne baad khazana chhoda jaye us ka woh khazana Qiyamat ke din zehreela azdha ban kar jis ki ankhon par nuqte honge us ke peechhe lagega, yeh bhagta huwa poochega ke tu kaun hai? Woh kahega tera jama karda aur marne ke baad chhoda huwa khazana. Aakhir use pakad lega aur us ka haath chaba jayega phir baaqi jism bhi. Sahih Muslim waghera mein hai ke jo shakhs apne maal ki zakat na de us ka maal Qiyamat ke din aag ki takhtiyon jaisa bana diya jayega aur us se us ki peshani, pehlu aur kamar daghi jayegi. Pachaas hazaar saal tak logon ke faisle ho jaane tak to us ka yahi haal rahega phir use us ki manzil ki raah dikha di jayegi Jannat ki taraf ya Jahannam ki taraf. Imam Bukhari isi ayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Zaid bin Wahab Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se Rabza mein mile aur daryaft kiya ke tum yahan kaise aa gaye ho? Aap ne farmaya hum Sham mein the wahan main ne (وَالَّذِيْنَ يَكْنِزُوْنَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلَا يُنْفِقُوْنَهَا فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۙ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ) (9-At-Taubah: 34) ki tilawat ki to Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah R.A ne farmaya yeh ayat hum Musalmanon ke bare mein nahi yeh to Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai. Main ne kaha hamari aur un ke sab ke haq mein hai. Us mein mera un ka ikhtilaf ho gaya, unhon ne meri shikayat ka khat Darbar-e-Usmani mein likha, khilafat ka farman mere naam aaya ke tum yahan chale aao. Jab Madine pohncha to chaaron taraf se mujhe logon ne gher liya. Is tarah bheed lag gayi ke goya unhon ne is se pehle mujhe dekha hi na tha. Gharz main Madine mein thehra lekin logon ki aamad-o-raft se tang aa gaya. Aakhir main ne Hazrat Usman R.A se shikayat ki to aap ne mujhe farmaya ke tum Madine ke qareeb hi kisi sehra mein chale jao. Main ne is hukm ki bhi taameel ki lekin yeh keh diya ke Wallahu jo main kehta tha use hargiz nahi chhod sakta. Aap ka khayal yeh tha ke baal bachon ke khilane ke baad jo bache use jama kar rakhna mutlaqan haram hai. Isi ka aap fatwa dete the aur isi ko logon mein phailate the aur logon ko bhi is par aamada karte the. Isi ka hukm dete the aur is ke mukhalif logon par bada hi tashaddud karte the. Hazrat Muawiyah ne aap ko rokna chaha ke kahin logon mein aam zarar na phail jaye, yeh na maane to aap ne khilafat se shikayat ki. Amir-ul-Momineen ne unhe bula kar Rabza mein tanha rehne ka hukm diya, aap wahin Hazrat Usman R.A ki khilafat mein hi rehlat farma gaye. Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ne ba-toor imtihan ek martaba un ke pas ek hazaar ashrafiyan bhjwaayin, aap ne shaam se qabil sab idhar udhar raah-e-Khuda kharch kar daalin.

Sham ko wahi sahib jo unhein subh ko ek hazar ashrafiyan de gaye thay woh aaye aur kaha mujh se ghalti hogayi Ameer Muawiyah R.A ne woh ashrafiyan aur sahib ke liye bhizwai thin main ne ghalti se aap ko de din woh wapas kijiye aap ne farmaya tum par afrin hai mere paas to ab un mein se ek pai bhi nahi acha jab mera maal aajayega to main aap ko aap ki ashrafiyan wapas kar dunga. Ibn Abbas R.A bhi is ayat ka hukm aam batate hain. Suddi farmate hain yeh ayat Ahl-e-Qibla ke bare mein hai. Ahnaf bin Qais farmate hain main Madine mein aaya dekha ke Quraishion ki ek jamaat mehfil lagaye baithi hai main bhi is majlis mein baith gaya ke ek sahib tashreef laye maile kachile mote jhoote kapre pehne hue bohat khasta halat mein aur aate hi khare ho kar farmane lage rupiya paisa jama karne wale is se khabardar rahein ke qiyamat ke din jahannam ke angare un ki chhati ki batni par rakhe jayenge jo khowe ke haddi ke paar hojayenge phir peechhe ki taraf se aage ko surakh karte aur jalate hue nikal jayenge sab log sar neecha kiye baithe rahe koi bhi kuch na bola woh bhi mur kar chal diye aur ek suton se lag kar baith gaye main un ke paas pucha aur un se kaha ke mere khayal mein to in logon ko aap ki baat buri lagi aap ne farmaya yeh kuch nahi jaante.

Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se farmaya ke mere paas agar Uhad Pahar ke barabar bhi sona ho to mujhe yeh baat achhi nahi maloom hoti ke teen din guzarne ke baad mere paas is mein se kuch bhi bacha hua rahe haan agar qarz ki adaigi ke liye main kuch rakh loon to aur baat hai. Ghaliban isi hadith ki wajah se Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ka yeh mazhab tha jo aap ne upar parha Wallahu A'lam.

Ek martaba Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ko un ka hissa mila aap ki londhi ne usi waqt zarooriyat faraham karna shuru kiya. Saaman ki khareed ke baad saat dirham bach rahe hukm diya ke is ke floos le lo to Hazrat Abdullah bin Samit R.A ne farmaya ise aap apne paas rehne dijiye taake ba-waqt-e-zaroor kaam nikal jaye ya koi mehman aajaye to kaam na atke aap ne farmaya nahi mujh se mere Khaleel ﷺ ne ahd liya hai ke jo sona chandi sar-band kar ke rakhi jaye woh rakhne wale ke liye aag ka angara hai jab tak ke ise rah-e-Khuda na de de.

Ibn Asakir mein hai Hazrat Abu Saeed R.A se Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah se faqeer ban kar mil ghani ban kar na mil. Unhon ne pucha yeh kis tarah? Farmaya sail ko radd na kar jo mile ise chhupa na rakh unhon ne kaha yeh kaise ho sakega aap ne farmaya yehi hai warna aag hai. Is ki sanad zaeef hai.

Ahl-e-Suffah mein ek sahib ka intiqal hogaya woh dinar ya do dirham pasandaz kiye hue nikle aap ne farmaya yeh aag ke do daag hain tum log apne sathi ke janaze ki namaz parh lo aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Ahl-e-Suffah ke intiqal ke baad un ki tahband ki anti mein se ek dinar nikla aap ne farmaya ek daag aag ka phir doosre ka intiqal hua un ke paas se do dinar baramad hue.

Aap ne farmaya yeh do daag aag ke hain farmate hain jo log surkh-o-safaid yaani sona chaandi chhod kar mare ek ek qirat ke badle, ek ek takhti aag ki banayi jayegi aur uske qadam se lekar thodi tak uske jism mein is aag se daag kiye jayenge. Aap ka farman hai ki jis ne dinar se dinar aur darham se darham mila kar jama kar ke rakh chhoda uski khaal kushaad kar ke peshani aur pehlu aur kamar par isse daag diye jayenge aur kaha jayega yeh hai jise tum apni janon ke liye khazana banate rahe ab iska badla chakho iska rawi zaeef kazzab-o-matrook hai.
