Zillat-o-haqarat un par baras pari aur ghazab-e-Ilahi mein mubtala ho kar tabah-o-barbad ho gaye. Yeh haram-khor jama'at khud haq se ruk kar auron ke bhi darpe rehti thi haq ko baatil se khalat-malat kar ke logon ko bhi rah-e-haq se rok dete the. Jahilon mein baith kar gap hankte ke hum logon ko rah-e-haq ki taraf bulate hain halanki yeh sarih dhoka hai woh to jahannam ki taraf bulane wale hain qiyamat ke din yeh beyaro-madadgar chhor diye jayenge. Alamoon aur sufiyon yani waizoon aur abidon ka zikr karne ke baad ab amiron daulatmandoon aur ra'isoon ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke jis tarah yeh dono tabaqe apne andar badtareen logon ko bhi rakhte hain aise hi is teesre tabaqe mein bhi sharir-un-nafs log hote hain umuman unhi teen tabaqe ke logon ka awam par asar hota hai awam ki kaseer tadad unke sath balki unke peeche hoti hai pas unka bigadna goya mazhabi duniya ka satyanas hona hai jaise ke Hazrat Ibn al-Mubarak (R.H) kehte hain: Wa hal afsadad-deena illa al-muluku wa ahbaru su'in wa ruhbanuha yani deen waizoon, alamoon, sufiyon aur darweshoon ke napak tabaqe se hi bigadta hai. Kanz istilah-e-shara mein us maal ko kehte hain jis ki zakat ada ki jati ho.

Hazrat Ibn Umar R.H se yahi marwi hai balki farmate hain jis maal ki zakat de di jati ho woh agar satween zameen tale bhi ho toh woh kanz nahi aur jis ki zakat na di jati ho woh go zameen par zahir phaila pada ho kanz hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.H, Hazrat Jabir R.H, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.H se bhi mauqufan aur marfu'an yahi marwi hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.H bhi yahi farmate hain aur farmate hain baghair zakat ke maal se us maalدار ko dagha jayega. Aap ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdullah R.H se marwi hai ke yeh zakat ke utarne se pehle tha, zakat ka hukm nazil farma kar Allah ne use maal ki taharat bana diya. Khalifa-e-Barhaq Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H aur Arak bin Malik ne bhi yahi farmaya hai ke ise qoul-e-Rabbani (khuz min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum wa tuzakkihim biha wa salli 'alaihim inna salataka sakanun lahum wallahu sami'un 'alim) (At-Taubah: 103) ne mansukh kar diya hai. Hazrat Abu Umamah farmate hain ke talwaron ka zewar bhi kanz ya'ni khazana hai. Yaad rakho main tumhein wahi sunata hu jo maine Janab-e-Paighambar-e-Haq ﷺ se suna hai. Hazrat Ali R.H farmate hain ke chaar hazaar aur us se kam toh nafaqah hai aur us se zyada kanz hai. Lekin yeh qoul gharib hai. Maal ki kasrat ki muzammat aur kami ki madhat mein bohat si hadeesein warid hui hain, ba-taur namune ke hum bhi yahan un mein se chand naql karte hain. Musnad Abdur Razzaq mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Sone chandi walon ke liye halakat hai, teen martaba aap ka yahi farman sun kar sahaba par shaq guzra aur unhon ne sawal kiya ke phir hum kis qism ka maal rakhein? Hazrat Umar R.H ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh halat bayan kar ke yahi sawal kiya toh aap ne farmaya ke zikr karne wali zuban, shukr karne wala dil aur deen ke kamon mein madad dene wali biwi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke sone chandi ki muzammat ki yeh ayat jab utri aur sahaba ne aapas mein charcha kiya toh Hazrat Umar R.H ne kaha lo main Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kar aata hu, apni sawari tez kar ke Rasulullah ﷺ se ja mile aur riwayat mein hai ke sahaba R.H ne kaha phir hum apni aulaadon ke liye kya chhor jayein? Is mein hai ke Hazrat Umar R.H ke peeche hi peeche Hazrat Thouban R.H bhi the. Aap ne Hazrat Umar R.H ke sawal par farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne zakat isisi liye muqarrar farmai hai ke baqi ka maal pak ho jaye. Meras ke muqarrar karne ka zikr kiya ja raha hai ke jama karne mein koi harj nahi. Hazrat Umar R.H yeh sun kar mare khushi ke takbeerein kehne lage. Aap ne farmaya lo aur suno main tumhein behtareen khazana batau: Naik aurat jab is ka khawand is ki taraf nazar dale toh woh use khush kar de aur jab hukm de foran baja laye aur jab woh maujud na ho toh us ki namoos ki hifazat kare.

Hassan bin Atiyah kehte hain ke Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus R.A ek safar mein thay, ek manzil par utray aur apne ghulam se farmaya ke chhuri lao, khelein, mujhe bura maloom hua. Aap ne afsos zahir kiya aur farmaya, "Main ne toh Islam ke baad se ab tak aisi be-ehtiyati ki baat kabhi nahi ki thi, ab tum isey bhool jao aur ek hadith bayaan karta hoon isey yaad rakho." Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke jab log sona chandi jama karne lagein, toh tum in kalimaat ko kasrat se kaha karo:

Allahumma inni as'aluka-th-thabata fil-amri wal-'azimata 'ala-r-rushdi, wa as'aluka shukra ni'matika, wa as'aluka husna 'ibadatika, wa as'aluka qalban saliman, wa as'aluka lisanan sadiqan, wa as'aluka min khairi ma ta'lamu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu, wa astaghfiruka lima ta'lamu, innaka anta 'allamul-ghuyub.

(Tarjuma) Yani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se kaam ki sabit-qadmi aur bhalaaiyon ki pukhtagi aur teri naimaton ka shukr aur teri ibadaton ki achhaai aur salamati wala dil aur sachi zuban aur tere ilm mein jo bhalaai hai woh, aur tere ilm mein jo burai hai us ki panah, aur jin buraiyon ko tu jaanta hai un se istighfar talib karta hoon. Main manta hoon ke tu tamam ghaib janne wala hai."

Aayat mein bayaan hai ke Allah ki raah mein apne maal ko kharch na karne wale aur ise bacha bacha kar rakhne wale dardnaak azaab diye jayenge. Qayamat ke din usi maal ko khoob tapa kar garm aag jaisa kar ke iske se un ki peshaniyaan, pehlu aur kamar daghi jayegi aur ba-taur daant-dapat ke un se farmaya jayega ke lo apni jama-jatha ka maza chakho.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke farishton ko hukm hoga ke garm pani ka tarred dozakhiyon ke saron par bahao aur un se kaho ke azaab ka lutf uthao, tum bare zi-izzat aur buzurg samjhe jaate rahe ho, badla iska yeh hai.

Sabit hua ke jo shakhs jis cheez ko mehboob bana kar Allah ki ita'at se isey muqaddam rakhega, usi ke sath isey azaab hoga. In maaldaron ne maal ki mohabbat mein Allah ke farmaan ko bhula diya tha, aaj usi maal se unhein saza di ja rahi hai. Jaise ke Abu Lahab khullam-khulla Huzoor ﷺ ki dushmani karta tha aur uski biwi uski madad karti thi, qayamat ke din aag ke aur bhadkane ke liye woh apne gale mein rassi daal kar lakdiyan la la kar isey sulgayegi aur woh is mein jalta rahega.

Yeh maal jo yahan sab se zyada pasandeeda hain, yehi maal qayamat ke din sab se zyada muzir sabit honge. Isi ko garm kar ke is se daag diye jayenge.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ke aise maaldaron ke jism itne lambe chaude kar diye jayenge ke ek ek dinar o dirham is par aa jaye, phir kul maal aag jaisa bana kar alag alag kar ke sare jism par phaila diya jayega, yeh nahi ke ek ke baad ek daag lage, balki ek sath sab ke sab.

Marfu'an bhi yeh riwayat aayi hai lekin iski sanad sahih nahi. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Tawus farmate hain ke iska maal ek ajgar ban kar iske peeche lage ga, jo uzru samne aa jayega isi ko chaba jayega.

Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain jo apne baad khazana chhoda jaye us ka woh khazana Qiyamat ke din zehreela azdha ban kar jis ki ankhon par nuqte honge us ke peechhe lagega, yeh bhagta huwa poochega ke tu kaun hai? Woh kahega tera jama karda aur marne ke baad chhoda huwa khazana. Aakhir use pakad lega aur us ka haath chaba jayega phir baaqi jism bhi. Sahih Muslim waghera mein hai ke jo shakhs apne maal ki zakat na de us ka maal Qiyamat ke din aag ki takhtiyon jaisa bana diya jayega aur us se us ki peshani, pehlu aur kamar daghi jayegi. Pachaas hazaar saal tak logon ke faisle ho jaane tak to us ka yahi haal rahega phir use us ki manzil ki raah dikha di jayegi Jannat ki taraf ya Jahannam ki taraf. Imam Bukhari isi ayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Zaid bin Wahab Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se Rabza mein mile aur daryaft kiya ke tum yahan kaise aa gaye ho? Aap ne farmaya hum Sham mein the wahan main ne (وَالَّذِيْنَ يَكْنِزُوْنَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلَا يُنْفِقُوْنَهَا فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۙ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ) (9-At-Taubah: 34) ki tilawat ki to Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah R.A ne farmaya yeh ayat hum Musalmanon ke bare mein nahi yeh to Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai. Main ne kaha hamari aur un ke sab ke haq mein hai. Us mein mera un ka ikhtilaf ho gaya, unhon ne meri shikayat ka khat Darbar-e-Usmani mein likha, khilafat ka farman mere naam aaya ke tum yahan chale aao. Jab Madine pohncha to chaaron taraf se mujhe logon ne gher liya. Is tarah bheed lag gayi ke goya unhon ne is se pehle mujhe dekha hi na tha. Gharz main Madine mein thehra lekin logon ki aamad-o-raft se tang aa gaya. Aakhir main ne Hazrat Usman R.A se shikayat ki to aap ne mujhe farmaya ke tum Madine ke qareeb hi kisi sehra mein chale jao. Main ne is hukm ki bhi taameel ki lekin yeh keh diya ke Wallahu jo main kehta tha use hargiz nahi chhod sakta. Aap ka khayal yeh tha ke baal bachon ke khilane ke baad jo bache use jama kar rakhna mutlaqan haram hai. Isi ka aap fatwa dete the aur isi ko logon mein phailate the aur logon ko bhi is par aamada karte the. Isi ka hukm dete the aur is ke mukhalif logon par bada hi tashaddud karte the. Hazrat Muawiyah ne aap ko rokna chaha ke kahin logon mein aam zarar na phail jaye, yeh na maane to aap ne khilafat se shikayat ki. Amir-ul-Momineen ne unhe bula kar Rabza mein tanha rehne ka hukm diya, aap wahin Hazrat Usman R.A ki khilafat mein hi rehlat farma gaye. Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ne ba-toor imtihan ek martaba un ke pas ek hazaar ashrafiyan bhjwaayin, aap ne shaam se qabil sab idhar udhar raah-e-Khuda kharch kar daalin.

Sham ko wahi sahib jo unhein subh ko ek hazar ashrafiyan de gaye thay woh aaye aur kaha mujh se ghalti hogayi Ameer Muawiyah R.A ne woh ashrafiyan aur sahib ke liye bhizwai thin main ne ghalti se aap ko de din woh wapas kijiye aap ne farmaya tum par afrin hai mere paas to ab un mein se ek pai bhi nahi acha jab mera maal aajayega to main aap ko aap ki ashrafiyan wapas kar dunga. Ibn Abbas R.A bhi is ayat ka hukm aam batate hain. Suddi farmate hain yeh ayat Ahl-e-Qibla ke bare mein hai. Ahnaf bin Qais farmate hain main Madine mein aaya dekha ke Quraishion ki ek jamaat mehfil lagaye baithi hai main bhi is majlis mein baith gaya ke ek sahib tashreef laye maile kachile mote jhoote kapre pehne hue bohat khasta halat mein aur aate hi khare ho kar farmane lage rupiya paisa jama karne wale is se khabardar rahein ke qiyamat ke din jahannam ke angare un ki chhati ki batni par rakhe jayenge jo khowe ke haddi ke paar hojayenge phir peechhe ki taraf se aage ko surakh karte aur jalate hue nikal jayenge sab log sar neecha kiye baithe rahe koi bhi kuch na bola woh bhi mur kar chal diye aur ek suton se lag kar baith gaye main un ke paas pucha aur un se kaha ke mere khayal mein to in logon ko aap ki baat buri lagi aap ne farmaya yeh kuch nahi jaante.

Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se farmaya ke mere paas agar Uhad Pahar ke barabar bhi sona ho to mujhe yeh baat achhi nahi maloom hoti ke teen din guzarne ke baad mere paas is mein se kuch bhi bacha hua rahe haan agar qarz ki adaigi ke liye main kuch rakh loon to aur baat hai. Ghaliban isi hadith ki wajah se Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ka yeh mazhab tha jo aap ne upar parha Wallahu A'lam.

Ek martaba Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ko un ka hissa mila aap ki londhi ne usi waqt zarooriyat faraham karna shuru kiya. Saaman ki khareed ke baad saat dirham bach rahe hukm diya ke is ke floos le lo to Hazrat Abdullah bin Samit R.A ne farmaya ise aap apne paas rehne dijiye taake ba-waqt-e-zaroor kaam nikal jaye ya koi mehman aajaye to kaam na atke aap ne farmaya nahi mujh se mere Khaleel ﷺ ne ahd liya hai ke jo sona chandi sar-band kar ke rakhi jaye woh rakhne wale ke liye aag ka angara hai jab tak ke ise rah-e-Khuda na de de.

Ibn Asakir mein hai Hazrat Abu Saeed R.A se Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah se faqeer ban kar mil ghani ban kar na mil. Unhon ne pucha yeh kis tarah? Farmaya sail ko radd na kar jo mile ise chhupa na rakh unhon ne kaha yeh kaise ho sakega aap ne farmaya yehi hai warna aag hai. Is ki sanad zaeef hai.

Ahl-e-Suffah mein ek sahib ka intiqal hogaya woh dinar ya do dirham pasandaz kiye hue nikle aap ne farmaya yeh aag ke do daag hain tum log apne sathi ke janaze ki namaz parh lo aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Ahl-e-Suffah ke intiqal ke baad un ki tahband ki anti mein se ek dinar nikla aap ne farmaya ek daag aag ka phir doosre ka intiqal hua un ke paas se do dinar baramad hue.

Aap ne farmaya yeh do daag aag ke hain farmate hain jo log surkh-o-safaid yaani sona chaandi chhod kar mare ek ek qirat ke badle, ek ek takhti aag ki banayi jayegi aur uske qadam se lekar thodi tak uske jism mein is aag se daag kiye jayenge. Aap ka farman hai ki jis ne dinar se dinar aur darham se darham mila kar jama kar ke rakh chhoda uski khaal kushaad kar ke peshani aur pehlu aur kamar par isse daag diye jayenge aur kaha jayega yeh hai jise tum apni janon ke liye khazana banate rahe ab iska badla chakho iska rawi zaeef kazzab-o-matrook hai.

Ehtiram-e-Aadamiyat ka manshoor Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool Sadiq-o-Masdooq Hazrat Muhammad Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne hajj ke khutbe mein irshad farmaya ke zamana ghoom phir kar apni asliyat par aa gaya hai, saal ke barah mahine hua karte hain jin mein se chaar hurmat-o-adab wale hain. Teen pe dar pe: Zul-Qa'dah, Zul-Hijjah, Muharram aur chotha Rajab jo Mudar ke haan hai, jo Jamadi-ul-Akhra aur Sha'ban ke darmiyan mein hai. Phir poocha: Yeh kaun sa din hai? Hum ne kaha: Allah ko aur us ke Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai. Aap ne sakoot farmaya, hum samjhe ke shayad aap is din ka koi aur hi naam rakhenge. Phir poocha: Kya yeh Yaum-un-Nahr yaani qurbani ka din nahi? Hum ne kaha: Haan. Phir poocha: Yeh kaun sa mahina hai? Hum ne kaha: Allah jane aur us ka Rasool. Aap ne phir sakoot farmaya yahan tak ke hum ne khayal kiya ke shayad aap is mahine ka naam koi aur rakhenge. Aap ne farmaya: Kya yeh Zul-Hijjah nahi hai? Hum ne kaha: Haan. Phir aap ne poocha: Yeh kaun sa shehar hai? Hum ne kaha: Allah aur us ke Rasool ﷺ khoob janne wale hain. Aap phir khamosh ho rahe aur humein phir khayal aane laga ke shayad aap ko is ka koi aur hi naam rakhna hai, phir farmaya: Yeh Baldah (Makkah) nahi hai? Hum ne kaha: Beshak. Aap ne farmaya: Yaad rakho! Tumhare khoon, tumhare maal aur tumhari izzatein tum mein aapas mein aisi hi hurmat wali hain jaisi hurmat-o-izzat tumhare is din ki, tumhare is mahine mein, tumhare is shehar mein hai. Tum abhi abhi apne Rabb se mulaqat karoge aur woh tum se tumhare amaal ka hisab lega. Suno! Mere baad gumrah na ho jana ke ek doosre ki gardan zadni karne lago. Batao, kya main ne tabligh kar di? Suno! Tum mein se jo maujood hain, انہیں (unhein) chahiye ke jo maujood nahi, un tak pohncha dein. Bohat mumkin hai ke jise woh pohnchaye, woh un baaz se bhi zyada nigahdasht rakhne wala ho. Aur riwayat mein hai ke wast ayyam-e-tashreeq mein Mina mein Hajjat-ul-Wida' ke khutbe ke moqa' ka yeh zikr hai. Abu Harrah Riqaashi ke chacha jo sahabi hain, kehte hain ke is khutbe ke waqt Huzoor ﷺ ki naqah ki nakeel thame hue tha aur logon ki bheed ko roke hue tha. Aap ke pehle jumle ka yeh matlab hai ke jo kami beshi taqdeem o taakheer mahinoon ki jahiliyat ke zamane ke mushrik karte the, woh ulat pult kar us waqt theek ho gayi hai, jo mahina aaj hai wohi darhaqiqat bhi hai. Jaise ke Fatah-e-Makkah ke moqa' par aap ne farmaya ke yeh shehar ibtida-e-makhlooq se ba-hurmat-o-ba-izzat hai, woh aaj bhi hurmat wala hai aur qayamat tak hurmat wala hi rahega. Pas arbon mein jo riwaj par gaya tha ke un ke aksar hajj Zul-Hijjah ke mahine mein nahi hote the, ab ki martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ ke hajj ke moqa' par yeh baat na thi, balke hajj apne theek mahine par tha.

Ba'z log us ke sath yeh bhi kehte hain ke Siddique Akbar R.A ka hajj Zulqa'dah mein hua lekin yeh ghor talab qoul hai jaisa ke hum ma' saboot bayan karenge (INNAMAN NASI'U ZIYADATUN FIL KUFRI YUDALLU BIHIL LAZINA KAFAHRU YUHILLUNAHU AMAN WA YUHARRIMUNAHU AMAN LIYUWATI'U 'IDDATA MA HARRAMAL LAHU FAYUHILLU MA HARRAMAL LAHU ZUYJINA LAHUM SU'U A'MALIHIM WALLAHU LA YAHDILL QAUMAL KAFIRIN) (At-Taubah: 37) ki tafseer mein is qoul se bhi ziyada gharabat wala aik qoul ba'z salaf ka yeh bhi hai ke is saal Yahood-o-Nasara, Musalman sab ke hajj ka din ittefaq se aik hi tha yaani Eid-ul-Azha ka din. 

٭ Fasl ٭ 
Shaikh Alamuddin Sakhawi ne apni kitab Al-Mashoor fi Asma-ul-Ayyam wal-Mashoor mein likha hai ke Muharram ke mahine ko Muharram is ki ta'zim ki wajah se kehte hain lekin mere nazdeek to is naam ki wajah se is ki hurmat ki taakid hai is liye ke Arab jahiliyat mein isay badal daalte thay kabhi halal kar daalte kabhi haram kar daalte. Is ki jama muharmat, harim, maharim hai. 

Safar ki wajah tasmiyah yeh hai ke is mahine mein umuman un ke ghar khali rehte thay kyunke yeh lrai bhrai aur safar mein chal dete thay. Jab makan khali ho jaye to Arab kehte hain safar al-makan is ki jama asfar hai jaise jamal ki jama ajmal hai. 

Rabi-ul-Awwal ke naam ka sabab yeh hai ke is mahina mein un ki iqamat ho jati hai, irtibaa' kehte hain iqamat ko, is ki jama arbia' hai jaise naseeb ki jama ansiba aur jama is ki arbi'ah hai jaise rageef ki jama arghifah hai. Rabi-ul-Akhir ke mahine ka naam rakhna bhi isi wajah se hai. Goya yeh iqamat ka doosra mahina hai. 

Jamadi-ul-Oula ki wajah tasmiyah yeh hai ke is mahine mein pani jam jata tha un ke hisab mein mahine gardish nahi karte yaani theek har mausam par hi har mahina aata tha lekin yeh baat kuch jachti nahi is liye ke jab in mahino ka hisab chand par hai to zahir hai ke mausami halat har mah mein har saal yaksan nahi rahegi haan yeh mumkin hai ke is mahina ka naam jis saal rakha gaya ho us saal yeh mahina karkratay huway jare mein aaya ho aur pani mein jamood ho gaya ho. Chunacha aik shair ne yahi kaha hai ke Jamadi ki sakht andheri ratein jin mein kuta bhi ba-mushkil aik aadh martaba hi bhonk leta hai is ki jama jamadiyat hai. Jaise hubari hubariyat. Yeh muzakkar mu'annas dono tarah musta'mal hai. Jamadi-ul-Oula aur Jamadi-ul-Akhir bhi kaha jata hai. Jamadi-ul-Akhra ki wajah tasmiyah bhi yahi hai goya yeh pani ke jam jane ka doosra mahina hai. 

Rajab yeh ma'khouz hai tarjeeb se, tarjeeb kehte hain ta'zim ko chunke yeh mahina azmat-o-izzat wala hai is liye ise Rajab kehte hain is ki jama arjab, rajab aur rajabat hai. 

Sha'ban ka naam Sha'ban is liye hai ke is mein Arab log loot mar ke liye idhar udhar mutafriq ho jate thay. Sha'b ke ma'ni hain juda juda hona pas is mahine ka bhi yahi naam rakh diya gaya is ki jama sha'abeen, sha'banat aati hai.

Ramzan ko Ramzan is liye kehte hain ke is mein unton ke paon bưja-e-shiddat-e-garma ke jalne lagte hain. Ramzat-ul-fisaal us waqt kehte hain jab untiyon ke bachche sakht pyase hon. Is ki jama ramzanaat aur ramaazin aur raamzaa-e-aati hai. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh Allah ke namon mein se ek naam hai, yeh mahz ghalat aur na-qabil-e-iltifaat qaul hai. Main kehta hoon is bare mein ek hadith bhi waarid hui hai lekin woh zaeef hai. Main ne Kitab-us-Siyam ke shuru mein is ka bayan kar diya hai. Shawwal maakhuz hai shaalat-ul-ibil se. Yeh mahina unton ke masti_on ka mahina tha, yeh dumein utha diya karte the is liye is mahina ka yahi naam ho gaya. Is ki jama shawaweel, shawaawil, shawwalaat aati hai. Zul-Qa'dah ya Zul-Qi'dah ka naam hone ki wajah yeh hai ke is mah mein Arab log baith jaya karte the, na larhai ke liye nikalte na kisi aur safar ke liye. Is ki jama Zawat-ul-Qa'dah hai. Zul-Hijjah ko Zul-Hijjah bhi keh sakte hain, chunke isi mah mein Hajj hota tha is liye is ka yeh naam muqarrar ho gaya hai. Is ki jama Zawat-ul-Hijjah aati hai. Yeh to in mahinon ke namon ki wajah-e-tasmiyah thi. Ab hafte ke saat dinon ke naam aur in namon ki jama sunein. Itwar ke din ko Yom-ul-Ahad kehte hain, is ki jama ahad, auhad aur wuhood aati hai. Peer ke din ko Isnain kehte hain, is ki jama asnaaneen aati hai. Mangal ko Sulasah kehte hain, yeh muzakkar bhi bola jata hai aur moannas bhi, is ki jama sulaasaat aur asaalis aati hai. Budh ke din ko Arbi'aa kehte hain, jama arbi'awaat aur araabee'a aati hai. Jumerat ko Khamis kehte hain, jama akhmasah, akhaamis aati hai. Juma ko Juma aur Jum'ah aur Jum'ah kehte hain, is ki jama juma aur jamaa'at aati hai. Sanechar ya'ni hafte ke din ko Sabt kehte hain, Sabt ke maani hain qata' ke, chunke hafte ke dinon ki ginti yahin par khatam ho jati hai is liye ise Sabt kehte hain. Qadeem Arabon mein hafte ke din ke naam yeh thay: Awwal, Rahoon, Jabbaar, Dabbaar, Moonit, Aroobah, Shabbaar. Qadeem khaalis Arabon ke ashaar mein Arabon mein dinon ke naam paye jaate hain. Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai ke in baarah mah mein chaar hurmat wale hain. Jahiliyat ke Arab bhi inhein hurmat wale maante the lekin Basl naami ek giroh apne tashaddud ki bina par aath mahinon ko hurmat wala khayal karte the. Huzoor ﷺ ke farmaan mein Rajab ko Qabeela-e-Mudar ki taraf izafat karne ki wajah yeh hai ke jis mahine ko woh Rajab mahina shumaar karte the darasal wahi Rajab ka mahina Indallah bhi tha, jo Jamadi-ul-Akhir aur Shaban ke darmiyan mein hai. Qabeela-e-Rabee'a ke nazdeek Rajab Shaban aur Shawwal ke darmiyan ke mahine ka ya'ni Ramzan ka naam tha, pas Huzoor ﷺ ne khol diya ke hurmat wala Rajab Mudar ka hai na ke Rabee'a ka.

In chaar zi-hurmat mahino mein se teen pai-dar-pai is maslahat se hain ke haaji Zulqadah ke mahine mein nikle toh us waqt ladaaiyaan maar-peet jang-o-jadal qatal-o-qitaal band ho, log apne gharo mein baithe hue hon, phir Zulhijjah mein ahkaam-e-hajj ki adaayegi amn-o-amaan, umdagi aur shaan se hojaye, phir woh mah-e-Muharram ki hurmat mein waapas ghar pahunch jaaye. Darmiyaana saal mein Rajab ko hurmat wala banane ki gharz yeh hai ke zaairin apne tawaf-e-Baitullah ke shoq ko umrah ki surat mein ada karlein, go door-daraaz ilaaqo wale hon, woh bhi mahina bhar mein aamad-o-raft karein. Yehi Allah ka seedha aur sachcha deen hai.

Pas Allah ke farmaan ke mutabiq tum in paak mahino ki hurmat karo. In mein khususiyaat ke saath gunaho se bacho. Is liye kaha is ki gunaho ki burai aur badh jaati hai, jaise ke Haram Sharif ka gunah aur jagah ke gunah se badh jata hai. Farmaan-e-Rabbani hai ke jo Haram mein ilhad ka irada kare hum use dardnaak azaab denge, isi tarah se in muharram mahino mein kiya hua gunah aur dino mein kiye hue gunaho se badh jata hai. Isi liye Hazrat Imam Shafi'i aur ulama ki ek badi jama'at ke nazdeek in mahino ki qatal ki diyat bhi sakht hai, isi tarah Haram ke andar qatal ki aur zi-muharram rishtedaar ke qatal ki bhi diyat sakht hai.

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain "Fihen" se muraad saal bhar ke kul mahine hain. Pas in kul mahino mein gunaho se bacho, khususan in chaar mahino mein ke yeh hurmat wale hain, in ki badi izzat hai, in mein gunah saza ke اعتبار se aur nekiyan ajr-o-sawab ke اعتبار se badh jaati hain.

Hazrat Qatada R.A ka qaul hai ke in hurmat wale mahino ki saza aur bojh badh jata hai, go zulm har haal mein buri cheez hai lekin Allah Ta'ala apne jis amr ko chahe badhaye, dekhiye Allah Ta'ala ne apni makhlooq mein se bhi pasand farma liya, farishto mein insano mein apne rasool chun liye, isi tarah kalaam mein se apne zikr ko pasand farma liya aur zameen mein se masjido ko pasand farma liya aur mahino mein se Ramzan Sharif ko aur in chaaro mahino ko pasand farma liya, aur dino mein se Jumma ke din aur raato mein Lailatul Qadr ko, pas tumhe in cheezon ka lihaaz rakhna chahiye jinhe Allah ne azmat di hai.

Amoor ki ta'azim aqlmand aur faheem logo ke nazdeek itni zaroori hai jitni in ki ta'azim Allah Ta'ala Subhanahu ne batai hai. In ki hurmat ka adab na karna haraam hai, in mein jo kaam haraam hain unhe halaal na karlo, jo halaal hain unhe haraam na bana lo, jaise ke ahl-e-shirk karte the, yeh un ke kufr mein ziyaadati ki baat thi.

Phir farmaya ke tum sab ke sab kaafiro se jihaad karte raho, jaise ke woh sab ke sab tum mein se basar-e-jang hain. Hurmat wale in chaar mahino mein jang ki ibtida karna mansookh ya muhkam hone ke baare mein ulama ke do qaul hain: Pehla toh yeh hai ke yeh mansookh hai, yeh qaul zyada mashhoor hai. Is aayat ke alfaaz par ghor kijiye ke pehle toh farmaan hua ke in mahino mein zulm na karo, phir mushriko se jang karne ka zikr farmaya.

Zahiri alfaaz se toh maloom hota hai ke yeh hukum aam hai, hurmat ke mahine bhi is mein aa gaye, agar yeh mahine is se alag hote toh un ke guzar jaane ki qaid sath hi bayaan hoti. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Taif ka muhasira mah-e-Zul-Qa'dah mein kiya tha jo hurmat wale mahino mein se ek hai, jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke Aap Hawazin qabeela ki taraf mah-e-Shawwal mein chale, jab un ko hazeemat hui aur un mein se bache hue afraad bhag kar Taif mein panah guzin hue toh Aap wahan gaye aur chaalis din tak muhasira rakha, phir baghair fateh kiye hue wahan se wapas laut aaye, pas sabit hai ke Aap ne hurmat wale mahine mein muhasira kiya. 

Dusra qaul yeh hai ke hurmat wale mahino mein jang ki ibtida karna haram hai aur in mahino ki hurmat ka hukum mansookh nahi. Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke sha'air-ullah ko aur hurmat wale mahino ko halal na kiya karo aur farman hai: Al-shahr-ul-haram bi-shahr-il-harami wal-hurumatu qisasun, pas jo tum par ziyadati kare toh tum bhi un se waisi hi ziyadati ka badla lo. Aur farman hai: (Fa-iza insalakh-ul-ashhur-ul-hurumu faqtul-ul-mushrikina haisu wajattum-uhum wa khuzuhum wah-suruhum wa-q'udu lahum kulla marsadin, fa-in tabu wa aqamu-s-salata wa ata-u-z-zakata fa-khallu sabilahum, inna Allaha Ghafoor-ur-Raheem) (At-Taubah: 5). Hurmat wale mahino ke guzar jaane ke baad mushrikeen se jihad karo. Yeh pehle bayaan guzar chuka hai ke yeh har saal mein chaar mahine hain, na ke teesre mahine jo ke do qoulo mein se ek qaul hai. 

Phir farmaya ke tum sab musalman un se usi tarah lado jaise ke woh tum se sab ke sab larte hain. Ho sakta hai ke yeh apne pehle se judagana ho aur ho sakta hai ke yeh hukum bilkul naya aur alag ho musalmanon ko raghbat dilane aur unhe jihad par aamada karne ke liye, toh farmata hai ke jaise tum se jang karne ke liye woh mud-bhed aapas mein mil kar chaaron taraf se toot parte hain, tum bhi apne sab kalma-go ashqaas ko le kar un se muqabla karo. Yeh bhi mumkin hai ke is jumle mein musalmanon ko hurmat wale mahino mein jang karne ki rukhsat di ho jabke hamla un ki taraf se ho. Jaise (Ash-shahru-l-haramu bi-shahr-il-harami wal-hurumatu qisasun, fa-mani'tada 'alaykum fa'tadu 'alayhi bi-mithli ma'tada 'alaykum wattaqu-Allaha wa'lamu anna Allaha ma'a-l-muttaqin) (Al-Baqarah: 194) mein hai, aur jaise (Wa la tuqatiluhum 'inda-l-masjid-il-harami hatta yuqatilukum fihi, fa-in qatalukum faqtuluhum, kazalika jazau-l-kafirin) (Al-Baqarah: 191) mein bayaan hai ke un ke paas Masjid-e-Haram ke paas na lado jab tak ke wahan ladaai na karein, haan agar woh tum se ladein toh tum bhi un se lado.

Yahi jawab hurmat walay mahinay mein Huzoor ﷺ ke Taif ke mohasray ka hai ke darasal Hawazin aur Saqif ke sath jang ka yeh laraai tatma thi, unhon ne hi jang ki ibtida ki thi, idhar udhar se Aap ke mukhalifeen ko jama kar ke laraai ki dawat di thi, pas Huzoor ﷺ ne un ki taraf paish-qadami ki, yeh paish-qadami bhi hurmat walay mahinay mein na thi, yahan shikast kha kar yeh log Taif mein ja chupe aur wahan qila-band hogaye, Aap us markaz ko khali karane ke liye aur aage barhe, unhon ne musalmanon ko nuqsan pahunchaya ya musalmanon ki ek jama'at ko qatl kar dala, idhar mohasra jari raha, manjaniq waghera se chalis din tak un ko ghere rahey, al-gharz is jang ki ibtida hurmat walay mahinay mein nahi hui thi lekin jang ne tul khincha, hurmat wala mahina bhi aagaya, jab chand din guzar gaye Aap ne mohasra hata liya, pas jang ka jari rakhna aur cheez hai aur jang ki ibtida aur cheez hai, is ki bohat si nazirein hain, Wallahu A'lam. Ab is mein jo hadeesein hain hum unhein waarid karte hain, hum unhein seerat mein bhi bayan kar chuke hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Ahkaamat-e-Deen mein radd-o-badal intihai mazmoom soch hai. Mushrikeen ke kufr ki ziyadti bayaan ho rahi hai ke woh kis tarah apni faasid raaye ko aur apni naapaak khwahish ko Shariat-e-Rabbani mein daakhil kar ke Allah ke deen ke ahkaamat mein radd-o-badal kar dete thay. Haraam ko halaal aur halaal ko haraam bana lete thay. Teen mahine ki hurmat ko toh theek rakha phir chothe mahine Muharram ki hurmat ko is tarah badal diya ke Muharram ko Safar ke mahine mein kar diya aur Muharram ki hurmat nah ki. Taake bazahir saal ke chaar mahine ki hurmat bhi poori ho jaye aur asli hurmat ke mahine Muharram mein loot maar qatl-o-ghaarat bhi ho jaye aur is par apne qaseedon mein mubaalgha karte thay aur fakhriya apna yeh fel uchhalte thay. Inka ek sardaar tha Janadah bin Amr bin Umayyah Kinani, yeh har saal Hajj ko aata, iski kunyat Abu Sumamah thi, yeh munadi kar deta ke na toh Abu Sumamah ke muqabale mein koi aawaz utha sakta hai na iski baat mein koi aib-joi kar sakta hai, suno! Pehle saal ka Safar mahina halaal hai aur doosre saal ka haraam. Pas ek saal ke Muharram ki hurmat nah rakhte doosre saal ke Muharram ki hurmat mana lete. Inki isi ziyadti-e-kufr ka bayaan is aayat mein hai. Yeh shakhs apne gadhe par sawaar aata aur jis saal yeh Muharram ko hurmat wala bana deta log iski hurmat karte aur jis saal woh keh deta ke Muharram ko hum ne hata kar Safar mein aur Safar ko aage badha kar Muharram mein kar diya hai us saal Arab mein is mah-e-Muharram ki hurmat koi nah karta. Ek qoul yeh bhi hai ke Bani Kinana ke is shakhs ko Al-Qalamas kaha jata tha, yeh munadi kar deta ke is saal Muharram ki hurmat nah manai jaye agle saal Muharram aur Safar dono ki hurmat rahegi, pas is ke qoul par jahiliyat ke zamane mein amal kar liya jata aur ab hurmat ke asli mahine mein jis mein ek insaan apne baap ke qatil ko pa kar bhi iski taraf nigaah bhar kar nahi dekhta tha, ab aazadi se aapas mein khana-jangiyan aur loot maar hoti. Lekin yeh qoul kuch theek nahi maloom hota kyunke Quran-e-Kareem ne farmaya hai ke ginti mein woh muwafqat karte thay aur is soorat mein ginti ki muwafqat bhi nahi hoti balke ek saal mein teen mahine reh jaate hain aur doosre saal mein paanch mah ho jaate hain. Ek qoul yeh bhi hai ke Allah ki taraf se toh Hajj farz tha Dhil-Hijjah ke mahine mein lekin mushrik Dhil-Hijjah ka naam Muharram rakh lete phir barabar ginti ginte jaate aur is hisaab se jo Dhil-Hijjah aata us mein Hajj ada karte phir Muharram ke naam se khamoshi barat lete iska zikr hi nah karte phir laut kar Safar naam rakh dete phir Rajab ko Jamadi-uth-Thani phir Shaban ko Ramazan aur Ramazan ko Shawwal phir Zul-Qa'dah ko Shawwal, Dhil-Hijjah ko Zul-Qa'dah aur Muharram ko Dhil-Hijjah kehte aur is mein Hajj karte. Phir iska aa'adah karte aur do saal tak har ek mahine mein barabar Hajj karte. Jis saal Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Hajj kiya us saal mushrikeen ki is ginti ke mutabiq doosre baras ka Zul-Qa'dah ka mahina tha.

Aanhuzoor ﷺ ne Hajj ke mauqe par theek Zilhajj ka mahina tha aur usi ki taraf Aap ne apne khutbe mein ishara farmaya aur irshad hua ki zamana ghoom phir kar usi haiyyat par aagaya hai jis haiyyat par us waqt tha jab zameen o aasman Allah Ta'ala ne banaye lekin yeh qool bhi durust nahi maloom hota. Is wajah se ki agar Ziqadah mein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq ؓ ka Hajj hua toh yeh Hajj kaise sahi ho sakta hai? Halanki Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai (Aayat Wa azanum minallahi wa rasulihi ilan nasi yaum-ul-hajj-il-akbari alakh), yaani Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ki taraf se aaj ke Hajj-e-Akbar ke din mushrikon se alag-hadgi aur bezari ka elaan hai. Is ki mnadi Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq ؓ ke Hajj mein hi ki gayi pas agar yeh Hajj Zilhajj ke mahine mein na hota toh Allah Ta'ala us din ko Hajj ka din na farmata aur sirf mahinon ki taqdeem o takheer ko jiska bayan is aayat mein hai sabit karne ke liye is takalluf ki zaroorat bhi nahi kyunki woh toh uske baghair bhi mumkin hai. Kyunki mushrikeen ek saal toh Muharram-ul-Haram ke mahine ko halal kar lete aur uske awaz mah-e-safar ko hurmat wala kar lete saal ke baaqi mahine apni jagah rehte. Phir doosre Muharram ko haram samjhte aur iski hurmat o izzat baaqi rakhte taaki saal ke chaar hurmat wale mahine jo Allah ki taraf se muqarrar the un ki ginti mein mawafqat kar lein pas kabhi toh hurmat wale teeno mahine jo pe dar pe hain un mein se aakhri mah-e-Muharram ki hurmat rakhte kabhi use Safar ki taraf mo-akhar kar dete. Raha Huzoor ﷺ ka farman ki zamana ghoom phir kar apni asli halat par aagaya hai yaani us waqt jo mahina unke nazdeek hai wahi mahina sahi ginti mein bhi hai iska poora bayan hum is se pehle kar chuke hain Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Aqabah mein Rasool Allah ﷺ thehre musalman Aap ke paas jama ho gaye Aap ne Allah Ta'ala ki poori hamd o sana bayan farma kar farmaya ki mahinon ki takheer Shaitan ki taraf se kufr ki ziyadthi thi ki kafir behke. Woh ek saal Muharram ko hurmat wala karte aur Safar ko hillat wala phir Muharram ko hillat wala kar lete yahi un ki woh taqdeem takheer hai jo is aayat mein bayan hui.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq ؒ ne apni kitab As-Sirah mein is par bohat accha kalam kiya hai jo behad mufeed aur umdah hai. Aap tehreer farmate hain ki is kaam ko sab se pehle karne wala Almas Huzaifa bin Obaid tha. Phir Qaim bin Adi bin Amir bin Thalbah bin Harith bin Malik bin Kinanah bin Khuzaimah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar bin Nizar bin Ma'ad bin Adnan. Phir iska larka Abbad phir iska larka Qala phir iska larka Umayyah phir iska larka Auf phir iska larka Abu Sumamah Junadah isi ke zamane mein ishaat-e-Islam hui. Arab log Hajj se farig ho kar uske paas jama hote yeh khara ho kar unhe lecture deta aur Rajab, Zilhajj aur Ziqadah ki hurmat bayan karta aur ek saal toh Muharram ko halal kar deta aur Muharram-o-Safar ko bana deta aur ek saal Muharram ko hi hurmat wala keh deta ki Allah ki hurmat ke mahinon ki ginti muafiq ho jaye aur Allah ka haram halal bhi ho jaye.

Ghazwa-e-Tabuk aur Jihad se guraizan logon ko intibah: Ek taraf to garmi sakht par rahi thi doosri taraf phal pak gaye thay aur darakhton ke saaye barh gaye thay. Aise waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ek door daraaz ke safar ke liye tayar ho gaye, Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein apne sath chalne ke liye sab se farma diya. Kuch log jo reh gaye thay unhein jo tanbih ki gayi in ayaton ka shuru is ayat se hai ke jab tumhein Allah ki rah ke Jihad ki taraf bulaya jata hai to tum kyun zameen mein dhansne lagte ho? Kya duniya ki in fani cheezon ki hawas mein Akhirat ki baaqi naimaton ko bhula baithe ho? Suno duniya ki to Akhirat ke muqabale mein koi haisiyat hi nahi. Huzoor ﷺ ne apni kalme ki ungli ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya: "Is ungli ko koi samundar mein dubo kar nikale, us par jitna pani samundar ke muqabale mein hai, itna hi muqabala duniya ka Akhirat se hai." 

Hadrat Abu Hurairah ؓ se kisi ne poocha ke maine suna hai aap Hadith bayan farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ek neki ke badle ek lakh ka sawab deta hai? Aap ne farmaya: "Balki maine do lakh ka farman bhi Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai." Phir aap ne is ayat ke isi jumle ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke duniya jo guzar gayi aur jo baaqi hai woh sab Akhirat ke muqabale mein bahut hi kam hai. 

Marwi hai ke Abdul Aziz bin Marwan ne apne inteqal ke waqt apna kafan mangwaya, use dekh kar farmaya: "Bas mera to duniya se yahi hissa tha, main itni duniya le kar ja raha hoon." Phir peeth mor kar ro kar kehne lage: "Haye duniya! Tera zyada bhi kam hai aur tera kam to bahut hi chhota hai, afsos hum to dhoke mein hi rahe." 

Phir tark-e-Jihad par Allah Ta'ala danta hai ke sakht dardnak azab honge. Ek qabeele ko Huzoor ﷺ ne Jihad ke liye bulaya, woh na uthe, Allah Ta'ala ne un se barish rok li. Phir farmata hai ke apne dil mein utrana mat ke hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke madadgar hain, agar tum durust na rahe to Allah tumhein barbad kar ke apne Rasul ﷺ ke badle doosron ko madadgar kar dega, jo tum jaise na honge. Tum Allah ka kuch nahi bigaar sakte. Yeh nahi ke tum na jao to mujahideen Jihad kar hi na saken. Allah har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai, woh tumhare bagair bhi apne dushmanon par apne ghulamon ko ghalib kar sakta hai. 

Kaha gaya hai ke yeh (INFIRU KHIFAFAN WA THIQAALAN WA JAHIDU BI AMWALIKUM WA ANFUSIKUM FI SABILILLAHI ZALIKUM KHAIRUN LAKUM IN KUNTUM TA'LAMUN) (At-Tawbah: 41) aur (MA KANA LI AHLIL MADINATI WA MAN HAULAHUM MINAL A'RABI AN YATAHALLAFU 'AN RASULILLAHI WA LA YARGHABU BI ANFUSEHIM 'AN NAFSIHI, ZALIKA BI ANNAHUM LA YUSIBUHUM ZAMAUN WA LA NASABUN WA LA MAKMASATUN FI SABILILLAHI WA LA YATA'UNA MAWTI'AN YAGHIZUL KUFFARA WA LA YANALUUN 'AN ADUWWIN NAILAN ILLA KUTIBA LAHUM BIHI AMALUN SALIHUN INNALLAHA LA YUDI'U AJRAL MUHSININ) (At-Tawbah: 120).

(At-Taubah: 120) Yeh sab aayetein (Wa ma kana al-mu'minuna liyanfiru kaffah, falawla nafrata min kulli firqatim minhum ta'ifatun liyatafaqqahu fi ad-dini wa liyundiru qawmahum idha raja'u ilayhim la'allahum yahdharun) (Surah At-Taubah: 122) se mansukh hain lekin Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah) is ki tardid karte hain aur farmate hain ki yeh mansukh nahi balki in aayeton ka matlab yeh hai ki jinhein Rasoolullah (ﷺ) jihad ke liye nikalne ko farmaye woh farman sunte hi uth khade ho-jayein. Fi al-waqi' yeh taujih bahut umdah hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Tum Allah ka kuch nahi bigaar sakte. Yeh nahi ke tum na jao to mujahideen Jihad kar hi na saken. Allah har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai, woh tumhare bagair bhi apne dushmanon par apne ghulamon ko ghalib kar sakta hai. 

Kaha gaya hai ke yeh (INFIRU KHIFAFAN WA THIQAALAN WA JAHIDU BI AMWALIKUM WA ANFUSIKUM FI SABILILLAHI ZALIKUM KHAIRUN LAKUM IN KUNTUM TA'LAMUN) (At-Tawbah: 41) aur (MA KANA LI AHLIL MADINATI WA MAN HAULAHUM MINAL A'RABI AN YATAHALLAFU 'AN RASULILLAHI WA LA YARGHABU BI ANFUSEHIM 'AN NAFSIHI, ZALIKA BI ANNAHUM LA YUSIBUHUM ZAMAUN WA LA NASABUN WA LA MAKMASATUN FI SABILILLAHI WA LA YATA'UNA MAWTI'AN YAGHIZUL KUFFARA WA LA YANALUUN 'AN ADUWWIN NAILAN ILLA KUTIBA LAHUM BIHI AMALUN SALIHUN INNALLAHA LA YUDI'U AJRAL MUHSININ) (At-Tawbah: 120).

(At-Taubah: 120) Yeh sab aayetein (Wa ma kana al-mu'minuna liyanfiru kaffah, falawla nafrata min kulli firqatim minhum ta'ifatun liyatafaqqahu fi ad-dini wa liyundiru qawmahum idha raja'u ilayhim la'allahum yahdharun) (Surah At-Taubah: 122) se mansukh hain lekin Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah) is ki tardid karte hain aur farmate hain ki yeh mansukh nahi balki in aayeton ka matlab yeh hai ki jinhein Rasoolullah (ﷺ) jihad ke liye nikalne ko farmaye woh farman sunte hi uth khade ho-jayein. Fi al-waqi' yeh taujih bahut umdah hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Aghaz-e-Hijrat. Tum agar mere Rasul ﷺ ki imdad-o-ta'id chhor do toh main kisi ka mohtaj nahi hoon. Main aap iska nasir, mu'ayid, kafi aur hafiz hoon. Yaad rakho hijrat wale saal jabkeh kafiron ne aap ke qatl, qaid ya dais nikala dene ki sazish ki thi aur aap apne sachche sathi Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke sath tan tanha Makkah Sharif se buhukum-e-Ilahi tez raftari se nikle the toh kaun inka madadgar tha? Teen din ghar mein guzare taake dhoondhne wale mayus ho kar wapas chale jayein toh yahan se nikal kar Madina Sharif ka rasta lein. Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) lamha ba lamha ghabra rahe the ke kisi ko pata na chal jaye aisa na ho ke woh Rasul-e-Karim alaiha afdalus-salawati wat-taslim ko koi izaa pohanchaye. Huzoor ﷺ unki taskin farmate aur irshad farmate ke Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) un do ki nisbat tera kya khayal hai jinka teesra khud Allah Ta'ala hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Abu Quhafah ne An-Hazrat ﷺ se ghar mein kaha ke agar in kafiron mein se kisi ne apne qadmon ko bhi dekha toh woh hamein dekh lega, aap ne farmaya un do ko kya samajhta hai jinka teesra khud Allah hai. Al-gharz is mauqe par Janab-e-Bari Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne aap ki madad farmayi. Baaz buzurgon ne farmaya ke murad isse yeh hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) par Allah Ta'ala ne apni taskin nazil farmayi. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera ki yahi tafsir hai aur iski daleel yeh hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ toh mutma'in aur sukoon-o-taskin wale the hi lekin is khas haal mein taskin ka az sar-e-nau bhejna kuch iske khilaf nahi. Isliye isi ke sath farmaya ke apne ghaibana lashkar utar kar iski madad farmayi yaani farishton ke zariye Allah Ta'ala ne kalma-e-kufr daba diya aur apne kalme ka bol bala kiya. Shirk ko past kiya aur Tauhid ko uncha kiya. Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hota hai ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri ke liye, doosra hamiyat-e-qaumi ke liye, teesra logon ko khush karne ke liye larr raha hai toh in mein se Allah ki rah ka mujahid kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo kalma-e-haq ko buland o bala karne ki niyat se lare woh rah-e-haq ka mujahid hai. Allah Ta'ala intiqam lene par ghalib hai. Jis ki madad karna chahe karta hai na iske samne koi rok sake na iske irade ko koi badal sake. Kaun hai jo iske samne lab hila sake ya ankh mila sake. Iske sab aqwal afaal hikmat-o-maslahat, bhalayi aur khubi se pur hain. Ta'ala Shanuhu wa Jadda Majduhu.

Jihad har Musalman par farz hai. Kehte hain ke Surah Bara'at mein yeh ayat pehle utri hai is mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ke liye tamam Musalmanon ko Hadi-e-Umam Rasool Allah ﷺ ke humrah nikal khare hona chahiye, Ahl-e-Kitab Romeez se jihad ke liye tamam mominon ko chalna chahiye, khwah dil maane ya na maane, khwah asani nazar aaye ya tabiyat par garan guzare. Zikr ho raha tha ke koi burhape ka, koi bimar ka uzr kar de ga to yeh ayat utri. Burhe jawan sab ko Paighambar ka sath dene ka aam hukm hua, kisi ka koi uzr na chala. Hazrat Abu Talha Razi Allahu Anhu ne is ayat ki yahi tafsir ki aur is hukm ki tamil mein sarzameen-e-Sham mein chale gaye aur Nasraniyon se jihad karte rahe yahan tak ke jaan bakhshne wale Allah ko apni jaan supard kar di Razi Allahu Anhu wa Ardah. Aur rivayat mein hai ke ek martaba ap Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat karte hue is ayat par aaye to farmane lage hamare Rab ne to mere khayal se burhe jawan sab ko jihad ke liye chalne ki dawat di hai, mere pyare bachho mera saman taiyar karo, main mulk-e-Sham ke jihad mein sharakat ke liye zaroor jaunga. Bachhon ne kaha abba ji! Huzoor ﷺ ki hayat tak ap ne Huzoor ki matahti mein jihad kiya, Khilafat-e-Siddiqi mein ap mujahidin ke sath rahe, Khilafat-e-Farooqi ke ap mujahid mashhoor hain, ab ap ki umar jihad ki nahi rahi, ap ghar par aram kijiye, hum log ap ki taraf se maidan-e-jihad mein nikalte hain aur apni talwar ke johar dikhate hain. Lekin ap na mane aur usi waqt ghar se rawanah ho gaye, samundar par jane ke liye kashti li aur chale. Hanoz manzil-e-maqsood se kai din ki rah par the ke samundar ke ain darmiyan rooh Parvardigar ko sonp di. Nau din tak kashti chalti rahi lekin koi jazira ya tapu nazar na aya ke wahan ap ko dafnaya jata, nau din ke baad khushki par utre aur ap ko supard-e-lahd kiya, ab tak naash-e-mubarak joon ki toon thi Razi Allahu Anhu wa Ardah. Aur bhi bahut se buzurgon se "khafafan wa thaqalan" ki tafsir jawan aur burhe marwi hai. Al-gharz jawan hon, burhe hon, ameer hon, faqeer hon, farigh hon, mashghool hon, khush-haal hon ya tang-dil hon, bhari hon ya halke hon, haajat-mand hon, kari-gar hon, asani wale hon, sakhti wale hon, pesha-war hon ya tijarti hon, qawi hon ya kamzor jis halat mein bhi hon bila-uzr khare ho jaein aur rah-e-haq ke jihad ke liye chal paren. Is masle ki tafsir ke taur par Abu Amr Oza'i ka qaul hai ke jab andaroon-e-Rome hamla hua ho to Musalman halke-phulke aur sawar chalen aur jab in bandargahon ke kinaron par hamla ho to halke, bojhjhal, sawar, paidal har tarah nikal khare hon. Ba'az hazraat ka qaul hai ke (falawla nafrata min kulli firqatim minhum ta'ifatun liyatafaqqahoo fi-ddini wa liyunziro qawmahum iza raja'u ilaihim la'allahum yahzaroona) (At-Taubah: 122) se yeh hukm mansookh hai. Is par hum poori roshni dalenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Marwi hai ke ek bhari badan ke bare shakhs ne ap se apna hal zahir kar ke ijazat chahi lekin ap ne inkar kar diya aur yeh ayat utri.

Lekin yeh hukm Sahaba par sakht guzra phir Janab-e-Bari ne ise (Laisa 'alal-du'afa'i wa la 'alal-marda wa la 'alallazina la yajiduna ma yunfiquna harajun iza nasahu lillahi wa rasulihi ma 'alal-muhsinina min sabilin wallahu ghafurur rahim 9: At-Taubah: 91) se mansukh kar diya yani zaeefon bimaaron tang-dost faqeerun par jabke un ke paas kharch tak na ho agar woh Allah ke deen aur Shar'-e-Mustafa ke hami aur taraf-dar aur khair-khwah hon toh maidan-e-jang mein na jaane par koi haraj nahi. Hazrat Ayyub R.A awwal ghazway se lekar poori umar tak siwaye ek saal ke har ghazway mein maujood rahe aur farmate rahe ki khafeef-o-saqeel dono ko nikalne ka hukm hai aur insan ki haalat in do halaton se siwa nahi hoti. Hazrat Abu Rashid Harani ka bayaan hai ki maine Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad sawar-e-sarkar-e-risalat-ma'ab ko Hims mein dekha ki haddi utar gayi thi phir bhi haudaj mein sawar ho kar jihad ko ja rahe hain toh maine kaha ab toh shariat aap ko mazoor samajhti hai aap yeh takleef kyun utha rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya suno Surah Al-Bu'uth yani Surah Barat hamare samne utri hai jis mein hukm hai ki halke bhari sab jihad ko jao. Hazrat Hayyan bin Zaid Shar'i kehte hain ki Safwan bin Amr wali Hims ke sath Jarajimah ki janib jihad ke liye chale, maine Damashq ke ek umr-rasheeda buzurg ko dekha ki hamla karne walon ke sath apne oont par sawar woh bhi aa rahe hain un ki bhouwein un ki ankhon par pad rahi hain shaykh-e-fani ho chuke hain maine paas ja kar kaha chacha sahib aap toh ab Allah ke nazdeek bhi mazoor hain yeh sun kar aap ne apni ankhon par se bhouwein hataen aur farmaya bhatije suno Allah Ta'ala ne halke aur bhari hone ki dono suraton mein hum se jihad mein nikalne ki talab ki hai. Suno jahan Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat hoti hai wahan us ki azmayish bhi hoti hai phir us par ba'ad az sabit-qadami Allah ki rahmat barasti hai. Suno Allah ki azmayish shukr-o-sabr-o-zikrullah aur tawheed-e-khalis se hoti hai. Jihad ke hukm ke baad Malik-e-Zameen-o-Zaman apni rah mein apne Rasul ki marzi mein maal-o-jaan ke kharch ka hukm deta hai aur farmata hai ki duniya akhirat ki bhalayi isi mein hai. Duniyawi nafa toh yeh hai ki thoda sa kharch hoga aur bahut si ghaneemat milegi akhirat ke nafa se badh kar koi nafa nahi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ki Allah Ta'ala ke zimme do baton mein se ek zaroori hai woh mujahid ko ya toh shaheed kar ke jannat ka malik bana deta hai ya use salamati aur ghaneemat ke sath wapas lautata hai khud Ilah-ul-Alamin ka farman-e-ali-shan hai ki tum par jihad farz kar diya gaya hai bawajood yeh ki tum is se katra kha rahe ho. Lekin bahut mumkin hai ki tumhari na chahi hui cheez hi darasal tumhare liye behtar ho aur ho sakta hai ki tumhari chahat ki cheez fi-waqi' tumhare haq mein behad muzir ho suno tum toh bilkul nadan ho aur Allah Ta'ala poora poora dana beena hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ) ne aik shakhs se farmaya: "Musalman hoja." Uss ne kaha: "Ji toh chahta nahi." Aap ne farmaya: "Go na chahe." (Musnad Ahmad)

Ayyar logon ko benaqab kar do jo log Ghazwa-e-Tabouk mein jaane se reh gaye thay aur uske baad Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aa kar apne jhoote aur banawati uzr pesh karne lage thay. Unhein is aayat mein danta ja raha hai ke darasal unhein koi mazori na thi, agar koi insan ghanimat aur qareeb ka safar hota toh yeh sath ho lete, lekin sham tak ke lambe safar ne unke ghutne tor diye aur mashaqat ke khayal ne unke iman kamzor kar diye. Ab yeh aa kar jhooti qasmein kha kha kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ko dhoka de rahe hain ke agar koi uzr na hota toh bhala hum sharaf-e-ham-rakabi chhorne wale thay? Hum toh jaan-o-dil se aap ke qadmon mein hazir ho jaate. Allah farmata hai unke jhoot ka mujhe ilm hai, unhon ne toh apne aap ko gharat kar diya.

Na udhar ke na udhar ke! SubhanAllah, Allah ki apne mahboob se kaisi baatein ho rahi hain? Sakht baat ke sunane se pehle hi maafi ka ailaan sunaya jata hai, iske baad rukhsat dene ka ahad bhi Surah An-Noor mein kiya jata hai aur irshad-e-ali hota hai: (Fa iza istaznuka li ba'di sha'nihim fazan liman shi'ta minhum wastaghfir lahumullah, innallaha Ghafurur Rahim) (An-Noor: 62). Yani in mein se koi agar aap se apne kisi kaam aur shughl ki wajah se ijazat chahe toh aap jise chahein ijazat de sakte hain. Yeh aayat un ke bare mein utri hai jinhone aapas mein tay kar liya tha ke Huzoor ﷺ se ijazat talbi toh karein, agar ijazat ho jaye toh aur achha aur agar ijazat na bhi dein toh bhi hum is ghazwa mein jayenge toh nahi. Isi liye Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar unhein ijazat na milti toh itna faida zaroor hota ke sachche uzr wale aur jhoote bahane banane wale khul jaate. Naik-o-bad mein zahiri tameez ho jati. Itaat-guzar toh hazir ho jaate, na-farman bawajood ijazat na milne ke bhi na nikalte, kyunki unhone toh tay kar liya tha ke Huzoor ﷺ haan kahein ya na kahein hum toh jihad mein jaane ke nahi. Isi liye Janab-e-Bari ne iske baad ki aayat mein farmaya ke yeh mumkin hi nahi ke sachche imandar log rah-e-haq ke jihad se rukne ki ijazat tujh se talab karein, woh toh jihad ko mujib-e-qurbat-e-Ilahiya maan kar apni jaan-o-amlak ke fida karne ke aarzoo-mand rehte hain. Allah bhi is muttaqi jama'at se ba-khubi aagah hai. Bila uzr-e-shar'i bahane bana kar jihad se ruk jaane ki ijazat talab karne wale toh be-iman log hain jinhe dar-e-akhirat ki jaza ki koi ummeed hi nahi, un ke dil aaj tak teri shariat ke bare mein shak-o-shubha mein hi hain, yeh hairan-o-pareshan hain, ek qadam un ka aage barhta hai toh doosra peeche hatta hai, unhein sabit-qadmi aur istiqlal nahi, yeh halak hone wale hain, yeh na udhar ke hain na udhar ke, yeh Allah ke gumrah kiye hue hain, toh inke sanwarne ka koi rasta na payega.

Ghalat go, ghalat kar kuffar o munafiq uzr karne walon ke ghalat hone ki ek zahiri daleel yeh bhi hai ke agar unka irada hota to kam az kam saman-e-safar to tayar kar lete lekin yeh to elan aur hukm ke bad bhi kai din guzarne ke bawajood hath par hath dhare baithe rahe, ek tinka bhi udhar se udhar na kiya. Darasal Allah ko unka tumhare sath nikalna pasand hi na tha is liye unhe peeche hata diya aur qudrati taur par unse keh diya gaya ke tum to baithne walon ka hi sath do.

Unke sath ko napasand rakhne ki wajah yeh thi ke yeh poore namurad, aala darje ke buzdil, bade hi darpok hain. Agar yeh tumhare sath hote to patta khadaka aur banda sarka ki misal ko asal kar dikhate aur unke sath hi tum mein bhi fasad barpa ho jata. Yeh udhar ki udhar, idhar ki udhar laga, bakar bujha kar baat ka batangar bana kar aapas mein phoot aur adawat dalwate aur koi naya fitna khada kar ke tumhe aapas mein hi uljha dete. 

Unke manne wale, unke ham-khayal, unki policy ko achhi nazar se dekhne wale khud tum mein bhi maujood hain, woh apne bhole pan se unki sharr-angiziyon se be-khabar rehte hain jiska natija momino ke haq mein nihayat bura nikalta hai, aapas mein shar o fasad phail jata hai. Mujahid (R.H) waghera ka qaul hai ke matlab yeh hai ke tumhare andar kuch log aise bhi hain jo unke hami aur hamdard hain, yeh log tumhari jasusi karte rehte hain aur tumhari pal pal ki khabrein unhe pahunchate rehte hain. Lekin yeh maani karne se woh latafat baqi nahi rehti jo shuru aayat se hai yani un logon ka tumhare sath na nikalna Allah ko is liye bhi napasand raha ke tum mein baaze woh bhi hain jo unki maan liya karte hain. Yeh to bahut durust hai lekin unke na nikalne ki wajah ke liye jasusi ki koi khususiyaat nahi ho sakti. Isi liye Qatada (R.H) waghera mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain ke ijazat talab karne walon mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool aur Jadd bin Qais bhi tha aur yahi bade bade ruwasa aur zi-asar munafiq the. Allah ne unhe door daal diya, agar yeh sath hote to unke samne unki baat maan lene wale waqt par unke sath ho kar musalmanon ke nuqsan ka baais ban jate, Muhammadi lashkar mein abtari phail jati kyunki yeh log wajahat wale the aur kuch musalman unke haal se na-waqif hone ki wajah se unke zahiri Islam aur charb-kalami par maftoon the aur ab tak unke dilon mein unki mohabbat thi. Yeh unki la-ilmi ki wajah se thi. Sach hai poora ilm Allah hi ko hai, ghaib hazir jo ho chuka ho aur hone wala ho sab us par roshan hai. Isi apne ilm-e-ghaib ki bina par woh farmata hai ke tum musalnano! Unka na nikalna hi ghaneemat samjho, yeh hote to aur fasad o fitna barpa karte, na khud jihad karte na karne dete. Isi liye farman hai ke agar kuffar dobara bhi duniya mein lautaye jayen to naye sire se phir wahi karein jis se mana kiye jayen aur yeh jhoote ke jhoote hi rahein.

Ek aur ayat mein hai ke agar ilm-e-Ilahi mein unke dilon mein koi bhi khair hoti to Allah Ta'ala 'Azza wa Jall unhein zaroor suna deta lekin ab to yeh haal hai ke sunein bhi to munh mod kar laut jayein aur jagah hai ke agar hum un par likh dete ke tum aapas mein hi maut ka khel khelo ya jalawatan hojao to siwaye bahut kam logon ke yeh hargiz ise na karte. Halanki unke haq mein behtar aur achha yahi tha ke jo nasihat unhein ki jaye yeh ise baja layein taake is soorat mein hum unhein apne paas se ajr-e-azeem dein aur rah-e-mustaqeem dikhayein. Aisi ayetein aur bhi bahut saari hain.

Ghalat go, ghalat kar kuffar o munafiq uzr karne walon ke ghalat hone ki ek zahiri daleel yeh bhi hai ke agar unka irada hota to kam az kam saman-e-safar to tayar kar lete lekin yeh to elan aur hukm ke bad bhi kai din guzarne ke bawajood hath par hath dhare baithe rahe, ek tinka bhi udhar se udhar na kiya. Darasal Allah ko unka tumhare sath nikalna pasand hi na tha is liye unhe peeche hata diya aur qudrati taur par unse keh diya gaya ke tum to baithne walon ka hi sath do.

Unke sath ko napasand rakhne ki wajah yeh thi ke yeh poore namurad, aala darje ke buzdil, bade hi darpok hain. Agar yeh tumhare sath hote to patta khadaka aur banda sarka ki misal ko asal kar dikhate aur unke sath hi tum mein bhi fasad barpa ho jata. Yeh udhar ki udhar, idhar ki udhar laga, bakar bujha kar baat ka batangar bana kar aapas mein phoot aur adawat dalwate aur koi naya fitna khada kar ke tumhe aapas mein hi uljha dete. 

Unke manne wale, unke ham-khayal, unki policy ko achhi nazar se dekhne wale khud tum mein bhi maujood hain, woh apne bhole pan se unki sharr-angiziyon se be-khabar rehte hain jiska natija momino ke haq mein nihayat bura nikalta hai, aapas mein shar o fasad phail jata hai. Mujahid (R.H) waghera ka qaul hai ke matlab yeh hai ke tumhare andar kuch log aise bhi hain jo unke hami aur hamdard hain, yeh log tumhari jasusi karte rehte hain aur tumhari pal pal ki khabrein unhe pahunchate rehte hain. Lekin yeh maani karne se woh latafat baqi nahi rehti jo shuru aayat se hai yani un logon ka tumhare sath na nikalna Allah ko is liye bhi napasand raha ke tum mein baaze woh bhi hain jo unki maan liya karte hain. Yeh to bahut durust hai lekin unke na nikalne ki wajah ke liye jasusi ki koi khususiyaat nahi ho sakti. Isi liye Qatada (R.H) waghera mufassireen ka yahi qaul hai.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain ke ijazat talab karne walon mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool aur Jadd bin Qais bhi tha aur yahi bade bade ruwasa aur zi-asar munafiq the. Allah ne unhe door daal diya, agar yeh sath hote to unke samne unki baat maan lene wale waqt par unke sath ho kar musalmanon ke nuqsan ka baais ban jate, Muhammadi lashkar mein abtari phail jati kyunki yeh log wajahat wale the aur kuch musalman unke haal se na-waqif hone ki wajah se unke zahiri Islam aur charb-kalami par maftoon the aur ab tak unke dilon mein unki mohabbat thi. Yeh unki la-ilmi ki wajah se thi. Sach hai poora ilm Allah hi ko hai, ghaib hazir jo ho chuka ho aur hone wala ho sab us par roshan hai. Isi apne ilm-e-ghaib ki bina par woh farmata hai ke tum musalnano! Unka na nikalna hi ghaneemat samjho, yeh hote to aur fasad o fitna barpa karte, na khud jihad karte na karne dete. Isi liye farman hai ke agar kuffar dobara bhi duniya mein lautaye jayen to naye sire se phir wahi karein jis se mana kiye jayen aur yeh jhoote ke jhoote hi rahein.

Ek aur ayat mein hai ke agar ilm-e-Ilahi mein unke dilon mein koi bhi khair hoti to Allah Ta'ala 'Azza wa Jall unhein zaroor suna deta lekin ab to yeh haal hai ke sunein bhi to munh mod kar laut jayein aur jagah hai ke agar hum un par likh dete ke tum aapas mein hi maut ka khel khelo ya jalawatan hojao to siwaye bahut kam logon ke yeh hargiz ise na karte. Halanki unke haq mein behtar aur achha yahi tha ke jo nasihat unhein ki jaye yeh ise baja layein taake is soorat mein hum unhein apne paas se ajr-e-azeem dein aur rah-e-mustaqeem dikhayein. Aisi ayetein aur bhi bahut saari hain.

Fitna-o-Fasad ki Aag: Allah Ta'ala munafiqeen se nafrat dilane ke liye farma raha hai ke kya bhool gaye muddaton toh yeh fitna-o-fasad ki aag sulgate rahe hain aur tere kaam ke ulat dene ki beesiyon tadbeerein kar chuke hain. Madine mein Aap ka qadam aate hi tamam Arab ne ek ho kar museebaton ki baarish Aap par barsa di. Bahar se woh charh daude andar se Yahood-e-Madina aur munafiqeen-e-Madina ne baghawat kar di lekin Allah Ta'ala ne ek hi din mein sab ki kamanein tod dein, unke jod dheele kar diye, unke josh thande kar diye, Badr ke ma'ركة ne unke hosh-hawas bhula diye aur unke arman zibah kar diye. Raees-ul-Munafiqeen Abdullah bin Ubi ne saaf keh diya ke bas ab yeh log hamare bas ke nahi rahe, ab toh siwa iske koi chara nahi ke zahir mein Islam ki muwafaqat ki jaye, dil mein jo hai so hai, waqt aane do dekha jayega aur dikha diya jayega. Jaise jaise haq ki bulandi aur tawheed ka bol bala hota gaya yeh log hasad ki aag mein jalte gaye, aakhir haq ne qadam jamaye, Allah ka kalma ghalib aa gaya aur yeh yunhi seena peette aur dande bajate rahe.

Jad bin Qais jaise badtameezon ka hashar. Jad bin Qais se Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Is saal Nasraniyon ke jalawat karne mein tu hamara sath dega? To us ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Mujhe to maaf rakhiye, meri saari kaum janti hai ke main aurton ka betarah shaidayi hoon, Eusai aurton ko dekh kar mujh se to apna nafs roka na ja sakega. Aap ne is se munh mod liya. Isi ka bayan is ayat mein hai ke is munafiq ne yeh bahana banaya halanki woh fitne mein to pada hua hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ka sath chhodna, jihad se munh modna yeh kya kam fitna hai? Yeh munafiq Bani Salma qabeele ka raees-e-azam tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne jab is qabeele ke logon se daryaft farmaya ke tumhara sardar kaun hai? To unhon ne kaha: Jad bin Qais jo bada hi shaum aur bakheel hai. Aap ne farmaya: Bukhal se badh kar aur kya buri bimari hai? Suno! Ab se tumhara sardar naujawan, safed aur khoobsurat Hazrat Bishr bin Bara bin Ma'roor hain. Jahannam kafiroun ko gher lene wali hai, na is se woh bach saken, na bhag saken, na nijat pa saken.

Badfitrat logon ka doghla pan - In badbatin logon ki Androni khabasat ka bayan hota hai ke Musalmanon ki fath-o-nusrat se, un ki bhalai aur taraqi se un ke tan badan mein aag lag jati hai aur agar Allah na kare yahan is ke khilaf hua toh bare shor-o-ghal machate hain ga ga kar apni chalaki ke afsane gaye jate hain ke miyan isi wajeh se hum toh un se bache rahe mare khushi ke baghein bajane lagte hain. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke un ko jawab dekar ranj rahat aur hum khud Allah ki taqdeer aur us ki mansha ke matahat hain woh hamara Maula hai woh hamara aaqa hai woh hamari panah hai hum momin hain aur mominon ka bharosa usi par hota hai woh hamein kafi hai bas hai woh hamara kar-saz hai aur behtareen kar-saz hai.

Shahadat mili to Jannat, bach gaye to Ghazi. Musalmanon ke jihad mein do hi anjam hote hain aur dono har tarah achhe hain, agar shahadat mili to Jannat apni hai aur agar fateh mili to ghanimat-o-ajr hai. Pas ai munafiqo tum jo hamari babat intezar kar rahe ho woh इन्हीं do achhaiyon mein se ek ka hai aur hum jis baat ka intezar tumhare bare mein kar rahe hain woh do buraiyon mein se ek ka hai yani ya to yeh ke Allah ka azab barah-rast tum par aa jaye ya hamare hathon se tum par Allah ki maar pade ke qatl-o-qaid ho jao. Achha ab tum apni jagah aur hum apni jagah muntazir rahein dekhein parda-e-ghaib se kya zahir hota hai?

Tumhare kharch karne ka Allah bhooka nahi, tum khushi se do to, aur narazgi se do to, woh to qubul farmane ka nahi is liye ke tum fasiq log ho. Tumhare kharch ki adam-qubuliyat ka bias tumhara kufr hai aur aamal ki qubuliyat ki shart kufr ka na hona balki iman ka hona hai, sath hi kisi amal mein tumhara naik qasd aur sachi himmat nahi. Namaz ko aate ho to bhi bujhe dil se, girte parte marte parte sust aur kahil ho kar. Dekha-dekhi majma-e-mein do chaar de bhi dete ho to mare ji se, dil ki tangi se.

Sadiq-o-Masduq Hadhrat Muhammad Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Allah nahi thakta lekin tum thak jao, Allah pak hai woh pak cheez hi qubul farmata hai, muttaqiyon ke aamal qubul hote hain tum fasiq ho tumhare aamal qubuliyat se gire hue hain.

Kasrat-e-Mal-o-Doulat Azab Bhi Hai: In ke maal-o-aulad ko lalachai hui nigahon se na dekh. In ki duniya ki is hera pheri ki koi haqeeqat na gin, yeh in ke haq mein koi bhali cheez nahi, yeh to in ke liye duniyawi saza bhi hai ke na is mein se zakat nikle na Allah ke naam khairat ho. Qatadah kehte hain yahan matlab muqaddam moakhkhar hai yaani tujhe in ke maal-o-aulad ache na lagne chahiyein, Allah ka irada is se unhein is hayat-e-duniya mein hi saza dene ka hai. Pehla qaul Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) ka hai, wohi acha aur qawi hai, Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Is mein yeh aise phanse rahenge ke marte dam tak rah-e-hidayat naseeb nahi hogi. Yun hi bad-tarij pakad liye jayenge aur unhein pata bhi na chalega, yahi hashr-o-jahat, maal-o-doulat jehannum ki aag ban jayega.

Maal-o-daulat ke haris munafiq: Baz munafiq An-Hazrat ﷺ par tuhmat lagate ke aap maal-e-zakat sahi taqsim nahi karte waghera. Aur is se un ka irada siwaye apne nafe ke husool ke aur kuch na tha, unhein kuch mil jaye to razi razi hain. Agar ittefaq se yeh reh jayein to bas un ke nathne phule jate hain. Huzoor ﷺ ne maal-e-zakat jab idhar udhar taqsim kar diya to Ansar mein se kisi ne haank lagai ke yeh adl nahi, is par yeh ayat utri. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek no-muslim sehrai Huzoor ﷺ ko sona chandi baantte hue dekh kar kehne laga ke agar Allah ne tujhe adl ka hukm diya hai to tu adl nahi karta. Aap ne farmaya: "Tu tabah ho, agar main bhi adil nahi to zameen par aur kaun adil hoga?" Phir aap ne farmaya: "Is se aur is jaiseyon se bacho, meri ummat mein in jaise log honge, Quran padhenge lekin halq se niche nahi utrega, woh jab niklein unhein qatal kar dalo, phir niklein to maar dalo, phir jab zahir hon phir gardanein maro." 

Aap farmate hain: "Allah ki qasam na main tumhein doon na tum se rokun, main to ek khazin hun." 

Jang-e-Hunain ke maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqsim ke waqt Zul-Khuwaisharah Harqoosi naam ek shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ par etraz kiya tha aur kaha tha: "Tu adl nahi karta, insaaf se kaam kar." Aap ne farmaya: "Agar main bhi adl na karun to phir teri barbadi kahin nahi jasakti." Jab us ne peeth pheri to aap ne farmaya: "Is ki nasal se ek kaum niklegi jin ke namazon ke muqable mein tumhari namazein tumhein haqeer maloom hongi aur un ke rozo ke muqable mein tum mein se ek aur ko apne roze haqeer maloom honge, lekin woh deen se aise nikal jayenge jaise teer kamaan se, tumhein jahan bhi mil jayein un ke qatal mein kami na karo, asman tale un maqtoolon se badtar maqtool aur koi nahi."

Phir irshad hai ke unhein Rasool ke haathon jo kuch bhi Allah ne dilwa diya tha agar yeh us par qanaat karte, sabr-o-shukr karte aur kehte ke Allah hamein kafi hai, woh apne fazl se apne Rasool ke haathon hamein aur bhi dilwayega, hamari umidein Zaat-e-Ilahi se hi wabasta hain, to yeh un ke haq mein behtar tha. 

Pas in mein Allah ki taleem hai ke Allah Ta'ala jo de us par insan ko sabr-o-shukr karna chahiye, tawakkul Zaat-e-Wahid par rakhe, usi ko kafi waafi samjhe, raghbat aur tawajjo, lalach aur umid aur tawaqqa us ki Zaat-e-Pak se rakhe. Rasool Kareem Alaihil Afdalus Salatu wat Tasleem ki ita’at mein sar-o-mu farq na kare aur Allah Ta'ala se taufiq talab kare ke jo ahkaam hon unhein baja lane aur jo mana kaam hon unhein chhor dene aur jo khabrein hon unhein maan lene aur sahi ita'at karne mein woh rehbari farmaye.

Zakat aur Sadaqat ka Masarif Nabi ﷺ nahi balkah Allah ke Hukum ke tahat hain? 

Upar ki aayat mein un jahil munafiqoon ka zikr tha jo Zat-e-Rasool ﷺ par taqseem-e-sadaqat mein aitraz kar بیٹھتے (baithte) the. Ab yahan is aayat mein bayan farma diya ke taqseem-e-zakat paighambar ki marzi par mauquf nahi balkah hamare bataye hue masarif mein hi lagti hai. Hum ne khud is ki taqseem kar di hai kisi aur ke supurd nahi ki. 

Abu Dawood mein hai, Ziyad bin Haris Sudai R.A farmate hain: Main ne sarkar-e-nabuwat mein hazir ho kar aap ke hath par bait ki, ek shakhs ne aa kar aap se sawal kiya ke mujhe sadqe mein se kuch dilwaiye, aap ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala nabi, ghair nabi kisi ke hukum par taqseem-e-zakat ke bare mein razi nahi hua yahan tak ke khud is ne taqseem kar di hai, aath masarif muqarrar kar diye hain, agar tu un mein se kisi mein hai to main tujhe de sakta hoon. 

Imam Shafi'i wagairah to farmate hain ke zakat ke maal ki taqseem un aathon qisam ke tamam logon par karni wajib hai, aur Imam Malik wagairah ka qaul hai ke wajib nahi balkah un mein se kisi ek ko hi de dena kafi hai go aur qisam ke log bhi hon. Aam ahl-e-ilm ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Aayat mein bayan-e-masarif hai nah ke un sab ko dene ke wujub ka zikr. In aqwal ki daleelon aur munazaron ki jagah yeh kitab nahi, Wallahu A'lam.

Faqeeron ko sab se pehle is liye bayan farmaya ke un ki hajat bahut sakht hai. Go Imam Abu Hanifa ke nazdeek miskeen faqeer se bhi bure haal wala hai. Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain ke jis ke hath tale maal na ho usi ko faqeer nahi kehte balkah faqeer woh bhi hai jo muhtaj ho, gira para ho go kuch khata kamata bhi ho. Ibn Ulayyah kehte hain is riwayat mein 'akhlaq' ka lafz hai, 'akhlaq' kehte hain hamare nazdeek tijarat ko lekin jamoor is ke barkhilaf hain. 

Aur bahut se hazrat farmate hain faqeer woh hai jo sawal se bachne wala ho aur miskeen woh hai jo sail ho, logon ke piche lagne wala aur gharon aur galiyon mein ghoomne wala. Qatadah kehte hain faqeer woh hai jo beemari wala ho aur miskeen woh hai jo sahih salim jism wala ho. Ibrahim kehte hain murad is se muhajir fuqara hain. Sufyan Thauri kehte hain yaani dehatiyon ko is mein se kuch na mile. Ikrimah kehte hain musalman fuqara ko masakeen na kaho, miskeen to sirf ahl-e-kitab ke log hain. 

Ab woh hadeethein suniye jo un aathon qismon ke mutalliq hain.

Fuqara: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain sadqa maldar aur tandrust tawana par halal nahi. Kuch shakhson ne Huzoor ﷺ se sadqe ka maal manga, aap ne baghaur niche se upar tak unhein hatta-katta, qawi tandrust dekh kar farmaya: Agar tum chaho to tumhe de doon magar ameer shakhs ka aur qawi taqat aur kamau shakhs ka is mein koi hissa nahi.

Masakeen: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain miskeen yahi ghoom ghoom kar ek luqma, do luqme, ek khajoor, do khajoor le kar tal jaane wale hi nahi. Logon ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ phir masakeen kaun log hain? Aap ne farmaya: Jo be-parwahi ke barabar na paye, na apni aisi halat rakhe ke koi dekh kar pehchan le aur kuch de de, na kisi se khud koi sawal kare.

Sadaqa wasool karne wale yeh tehsil-dar hain unhein ujrat isi maal se milegi. Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke qarabat-dar jin par sadaqa haram hai is ohde par nahi asakte. Abdul Muttalib bin Rabia bin Harith aur Fazal bin Abbas Rasoolullah ﷺ ke paas yeh darkhast lekar gaye ke hamein sadaqa wasooli ka amil bana dijiye. Aap ne jawab diya ke Muhammad ﷺ aur Aal-e-Muhammad ﷺ par sadaqa haram hai yeh to logon ka mail-kachil hai.

Jin ke dil behlaye jaate hain, un ki kayi qismein hain. Baaz ko to is liye diya jata hai ke woh Islam qubool kar lein jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Safwan bin Umayyah ko ghaneemat-e-Hunain ka maal diya tha halankah woh us waqt kufr ki halat mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nikla tha, uska apna bayan hai ke Aap ki is dad-o-dahash ne mere dil mein Aap ki sab se ziyada mohabbat paida kar di halankah pehle sab se bada dushman Aap ka main hi tha. Baaz ko is liye diya jata hai ke un ka Islam mazboot ho jaye aur un ka dil Islam par lag jaye, jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hunain wale din Makkah ke azad karda logon ke sardaron ko sau sau oont ata farmaye aur irshad farmaya ke main ek ko deta hoon dusre ko jo is se ziyada mera mehboob hai nahi deta, is liye ke aisa na ho ke yeh oundhe munh jahannam mein gir padein. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Ali R.A ne Yaman se kachcha sona mitti samet Aap ki khidmat mein bheja to Aap ne sirf chaar shakhson mein hi taqseem farmaya: Aqra bin Habis, Aiynah bin Badr, Alqamah bin Ulashah aur Zaid Khair, aur farmaya ke main in ki diljooi ke liye inhein de raha hoon. Baaz ko is liye bhi diya jata hai ke woh apne aas-paas walon se sadaqa pahunchaye ya aas-paas ke dushmanon ki nighdasht rakhe aur unhein Islam walon par hamla karne ka mauqa na de. In sab ki tafseel ki jagah ahkam-o-furoo ki kitabein hain na ke tafsir, Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Umar R.A aur Shabi aur ek jamaat ka qaul hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ke wisal ke baad ab yeh masraf baqi nahi raha kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne Islam ko izzat de di hai, musalman mulkon ke malik ban gaye hain aur bahut se bandgan-e-Allah inke matehat hain. Lekin aur buzrugon ka qaul hai ke ab bhi Mualifta-ul-Quloob ko zakat deni jaiz hai. Fateh Makkah aur Fateh Hawazan ke baad bhi Huzoor Alaihis Salam ne in logon ko maal diya. Dusre yeh ke ab bhi aisi zarooratein pesh aa jaya karti hain.

Azadgi-e-gardan ke bare mein bahut se buzurg farmate hain ke murad is se woh ghulam hain jinhon ne raqam muqarrar kar ke apne malikon se apni azadgi ki shart kar li hai, unhein maal-e-zakat se raqam di jaye ke woh ada kar ke azad ho jayein. Aur buzurg farmate hain ke woh ghulam jis ne yeh shart na likhwai ho use bhi maal-e-zakat se khareed kar azad karne mein koi dar-khauf nahi. Gharz mukatib ghulam aur mahz ghulam dono ki azadgi zakat ka ek masraf hai. Ahadis mein bhi is ki bahut kuch fazilat وارد (warid) hui hai yahan tak ke farmaya hai ke azad karda ghulam ke har har uzw ke badle azad karne wale ka har har uzw jahannam se azad ho jata hai yahan tak ke sharmgah ke badle sharmgah bhi.

Is liye ke har neki ki jaza usi jaisi hoti hai Qur'an farmata hai tumhein wahi jaza di jayegi jo tum ne kiya hoga. Hadis mein hai teen qisam ke logon ki madad Allah ke zimme haq hai: woh ghazi jo Allah ki raah mein jihad karta ho, woh mukatib ghulam, aur qarz-dar jo adaigi ki niyat rakhta ho, woh nikah karne wala jis ka irada bad-kari se mehfooz rehne ka ho. Kisi ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe jannat se qareeb aur dozakh se door kar de. Aap ne farmaya: Nasmah azad kar aur gardan khulasi kar. Us ne kaha ke yeh dono ek hi cheez nahin? Aap ne farmaya: Nahin, nasmah ki azadagi yeh hai ke tu akela hi kisi ghulam ko azad kar de aur gardan khulasi yeh hai ke tu bhi is mein jo tujh se ho sake madad kare.

Qarz-dar ki bhi kayi qismein hain: ek shakhs dusre ka bojh apne upar le le, kisi ke qarz ka apna zaman ban jaye phir is ka maal khatam ho jaye ya woh khud qarz-dar ban jaye, ya kisi ne burai par qarz uthaya ho aur ab woh tauba kar le, pas unhein bhi maal-e-zakat diya jaye ga ke yeh qarz ada kar dein. Is masle ki asl Qabeesah bin Mukhariq Hilali ki yeh riwayat hai ke main ne dusre ka hawala apni taraf liya tha phir main Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua to Aap ne farmaya: Tum tehro hamare paas maal-e-sadaqah aayega hum is mein se tumhein dein ge. Phir farmaya: O Qabeesah! Sun, teen qisam ke logon ko hi sawal halal hai: ek to woh jo zaman pade pas is raqam ke pura hone tak use sawal jaiz hai phir sawal na kare. Dusra woh jis ka maal kisi aafat-e-nagahani se zaya ho jaye use bhi sawal karna durust hai yahan tak ke zarurat puri ho jaye. Teesra woh shakhs jis par faqa guzrne lage aur is ki qoum ke teen zi-hosh log is ki shahadat ke liye khade ho jayein ke haan beshak fulan shakhs par faqay guzrne lage hain, ise bhi mang lena jaiz hai tawaqtike is ka sahara ho jaye aur saman-e-zindagi muhayya ho jaye. Is ke siwa auron ko sawal karna haram hai agar woh mang kar kuch le kar khayein ge to haram khayein ge (Muslim Sharif).

Ek shakhs ne zamana-e-Nabwi mein ek bagh kharida qudrat-e-Ilahi se aasmani aafat se bagh ka phal mara gaya is se woh bahut qarz-dar ho gaya. Huzoor ﷺ ne is ke qarz-khwahon se farmaya ke tumhein jo mile le lo is ke siwa tumhare liye aur kuch nahin (Muslim). Aap farmate hain ke ek qarz-dar ko Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din bula kar apne samne khada kar ke puchega ke tu ne qarz kyun liya aur kyun raqam zaya ki jis se logon ke huqooq barbad hue? Woh jawab dega ke Allah tuje khoob ilm hai main ne na is ki raqam khai na pi na udai balki mere haan mislan chori ho gayi ya aag lag gayi ya koi aur aafat aa gayi. Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Mera banda sacha hai aaj tere qarz ke ada karne ka sab se zyada mustahiq main hi hoon. Phir Allah Ta'ala koi cheez mangwa kar is ke nekiyon ke palde mein rakh dega jis se nekiyan buraiyon se barh jayenge aur Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ise apne fazl-o-rahmat se jannat mein le jayega (Musnad Ahmad).

Rah-e-Ilahi mein woh mujahideen-e-ghazi dakhil hain jin ka daftar mein koi haq nahi hota. Hajj bhi rah-e-ilahi mein dakhil hai. Musafir jo safar mein besaro-saman reh gaya ho usay bhi maal-e-zakat se apni raqam di jaye jis se woh apne shehar se safar ko jane ka qasd rakhte hon lekin maal na ho toh usay bhi safar kharch maal-e-zakat se dena jaiz hai jo use aamad-o-raft ke liye kafi ho. Ayat ke is lafz ki daleel ke alawa Abu Dawood waghera ki yeh hadees bhi is ki daleel hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maaldar par zakat haram hai bajuz paanch qisam ke maaldaron ke: ek toh woh jo zakat wasool karne par muqarrar ho, doosra woh jo maal-e-zakat ki kisi cheez ko apne maal se khareed le, teesra qarz-dar, chautha rah-e-ilahi ka ghazi mujahid, paanchwan woh jisay koi miskeen ba-toor tohfe ke apni koi cheez jo zakat mein use mili ho de aur riwayat hai ke zakat maaldar ke liye halal nahi magar fi sabilillah jo ho ya safar mein ho aur jisay is ka koi miskeen parosi ba-toor tohfe-hadiye ke de ya apne haan bula le.

Zakat ke in aathon masarif ko bayan farma kar phir irshad hota hai ke yeh Allah ki taraf se farz hai yani muqarrar hai Allah ki taqdeer is ki taqseem aur is ka farz karna. Allah Ta'ala zahir batin ka alim hai apne bandon ki maslihaton se waqif hai. Woh apne qaul, feil, shariyat aur hukm mein hikmat wala hai bajuz is ke koi bhi layq-e-ibadat nahi na is ke siwa koi kisi ka palne wala hai.

Nukta-cheen munafiqon ka maqsad: munafiqon ki ek jama'at bari mozi hai, apni baaton se Allah ke Rasul ﷺ ko dukh pohanchati hai aur kehti hai ke yeh Nabi toh kaanon ka bara hi kacha hai, jis se jo suna maan liya. Jab hum us ke paas jayenge aur qasmein khayenge, woh hamari baat ka yaqeen kar lega. Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala farmata hai ke woh behtar kaanon wala, behtareen sunne wala hai, woh sadiq o kazib ko khoob janta hai, woh Allah ki baatein manta hai, aur ba-iman logon ki sachai bhi janta hai. Woh mominon ke liye rahmat hai aur be-imanon ke liye Allah ki hujjat hai. Rasul ke satane walon ke liye dardnak azab hai.

Nadan aur kor-maghz kaun? Waqia yeh hua tha ke munafiqon mein se ek shakhs keh raha tha ke hamare sardar aur raees bare hi aqal-mand, dana aur tajruba-kar hain agar Muhammad ﷺ ki baatein haq hoteen toh yeh kya aise bewaqoof thay ke unhein na mante? Yeh baat ek sachche Musalman Sahabi ne sun li aur usne kaha Wallahu Huzoor ﷺ ki sab baatein bilkul sach hain aur na manne walon ki bewaqofi aur kor-maghz hone mein koi shak nahin hai. Jab yeh Sahabi darbar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir huwe toh yeh waqia bayan kiya ke Aap ﷺ ne us shakhs ko bulwa bheja lekin woh sakht qasmein kha-kha kar kehne laga ke maine toh yeh baat kahi hi nahi yeh toh mujh par tuhmat bandhta hai, us Sahabi ne dua ki ke Parwardigar tu sachche ko sachcha aur jhoote ko jhoota kar dikha, us par yeh ayat-e-sharifa nazil hui. Kya unko yeh baat maloom nahi ke Allah aur Rasool ke mukhalif abadi aur jahannami hain? Zillat-o-ruswai, azab-e-dozakh bhugatne wale hain, isse barh kar shoomi-e-tali', isse zyada ruswai, isse barh kar shaqawat aur kya hogi?

Zillat-o-ruswai, azab-e-dozakh bhugatne wale hain, isse barh kar shoomi-e-tali', isse zyada ruswai, isse barh kar shaqawat aur kya hogi?

Nabi Akram ﷺ se ghabratey bhi hain, aapas mein baith kar baatein toh ganth lete lekin phir khof-zada rehte ke kahin Allah ki taraf se Musalmanon ko ba-zariya Wahi-e-Ilahi khabar na ho jaye aur aayat mein hai tere samne aa kar woh duayein dete hain jo Allah ne nahi din phir apne ji mein akarte hain ke hamare is qaul par Allah hamein koi saza kyun nahi deta? Inke liye Jahannam ki kafi saza maujood hai jo bad-tareen jagah hai. Yahan farmata hai deeni baaton aur Musalmanon ki halat par dil khol kar mazak uralo. Allah bhi woh raaz afsha kar dega jo tumhare dilon mein hai. Yaad rakho ek din ruswa aur zareel ho kar rahoge. Chunacha farman hai ke yeh bimar dil log yeh na samjhein ke inke dilon ki badiyan zahir hi na hongi. Hum toh unhein is qadar fazihat karenge aur aisi nishaniyan tere samne rakh denge ke tu unke lab-o-lehje se hi unhein pehchan lega. Is surat ka naam hi Surah Al-Fadhibah hai is liye ke is ne munafiqon ki qalayi khol di.

Musalman baham گفتگو (guftgu) mein mohtat raha karein. Ek munafiq keh raha tha ke hamare yeh Quran khwan log bare shikam daar, shikhi baaz aur bare fazool aur buzdil hain. Huzoor ﷺ ke paas jab iska zikr hua to yeh uzr pesh karta hua aaya ke Ya Rasool Allah hum to yunhi waqt guzari ke liye hans rahe the. Aap ne farmaya haan tumhari hansi ke liye Allah, Rasool aur Quran hi reh gaya hai? Yaad rakho agar kisi ko hum maaf kar denge to kisi ko sakht saza bhi denge. 

Is waqt Huzoor ﷺ apni untni par sawar ja rahe the, yeh munafiq Aap ki talwar par hath rakhe pattharon se thokar khata hua mazrat karta sath sath ja raha tha, Aap iski taraf dekhte bhi na the. Jis musalman ne iska yeh qool suna tha, usne usi waqt jawab bhi diya tha ke tu bakta hai, jhootha hai, tu munafiq hai. Yeh waqia Jang-e-Tabouk ke moqa ka hai, masjid mein isne yeh zikr kiya tha.

Seerat Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke Tabouk jate hue Huzoor ﷺ ke sath munafiqon ka ek giroh bhi tha jin mein Wadee'ah bin Sabit aur Fahsh bin Humair waghairah the. Yeh aapas mein guftgu kar rahe the ke Nasraniyon ki larai ko arbon ki aapas ki larai jaisi samajhna sakkt khatarnak ghalti hai, acha hai inhein wahan pitne do phir hum bhi yahan inki durgat banayenge. In par inke doosre sardar Fahsh ne kaha bhai in baaton ko choro warna yeh zikr phir Quran mein aayega. Kore kha lena hamare nazdeek to is ruswai se behtar hai. 

Aage aage yeh log yeh tazkre karte ja hi rahe the ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Ammar se farmaya jaana zara dekhna yeh log jal gaye, in se pooch to ke yeh kya zikr kar rahe the? Agar yeh inkar karein to tu kehna ke tum yeh baatein kar rahe the. Hazrat Ammar ne ja kar in se yeh kaha, yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur uzr mazrat karne lage ke Huzoor hansi hansi mein hamare munh se aisi baat nikal gayi. Wadee'ah ne to yeh kaha lekin Fahsh bin Humair ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah Aap mera aur mere baap ka naam mulahiza farmayein, pas is wajah se yeh lagho harkat aur humaqat mujh se sarzad hui, maaf farmaya jaaun. 

Pas is se Janab-e-Bari ne darguzar farma liya aur is aayat mein usi se darguzar farmane ka zikr bhi hua hai. Iske baad isne apna naam badal liya, Abdur Rahman rakha, sacha musalman ban gaya aur Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke Ya Allah mujhe apni rah mein shaheed karna ke yeh dhabba dhul jaye. Chunancha Yamama wale din yeh buzurg shaheed kar diye gaye aur inki naash bhi na mili (Razi Allahu Anhu wa Razo Anhu).

In munafiqon ne ba-tor-e-taana zani ke kaha tha ke lijiye kya aankhein phat gayin hain ab yeh chale hain ke romiyon ke qile aur un ke mehlaat fateh karein bhala is aqlmandi aur door-bini ko to dekhiye jab Huzoor ﷺ ko Allah Ta'ala ne un ki un baaton par muttala kar diya to yeh saaf munkar ho gaye aur qasmein kha kha kar kaha ke hum ne yeh baat nahi kahi hum to aaps mein hansi khel kar rahe thay haan un mein ek shakhs tha jise Insha'Allah Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya hoga yeh kaha karta tha ke ya Allah main tere kalaam ki ek aayat sunta hoon jis mein mere gunah ka zikr hai jab bhi sunta hoon mere rongte khade ho jaate hain aur mera dil kapkapane lagta hai. Parwardigar tu meri tauba qabool farma aur mujhe apni raah mein shaheed kar aur is tarah ke na koi mujhe ghusal de na kafan de na dafan kare yahi hua jang-e-Yamamah mein yeh shuhada ke sath shaheed hue tamam shuhada ki laashein mil gayin lekin un ki naash ka pata hi na chala. Janab-e-Bari ki taraf se aur munafiqon ko jawab mila ke ab bahane na banao tum zubani imandaar bane thay lekin ab usi zuban se tum kafir ho gaye yeh qoul kufr ka kalma hai ke tum ne Allah Rasool aur Quran ki hansi urai. Hum agar kisi se darguzar bhi kar jayein lekin tum sab se yeh mamla nahi hone ka tumhare is jurm aur is badtareen khata aur is kafirana guftagu ki tumhe sakht tareen saza bhugatna padegi.
