Iske baad isne apna naam badal liya, Abdur Rahman rakha, sacha musalman ban gaya aur Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke Ya Allah mujhe apni rah mein shaheed karna ke yeh dhabba dhul jaye. Chunancha Yamama wale din yeh buzurg shaheed kar diye gaye aur inki naash bhi na mili (Razi Allahu Anhu wa Razo Anhu).

In munafiqon ne ba-tor-e-taana zani ke kaha tha ke lijiye kya aankhein phat gayin hain ab yeh chale hain ke romiyon ke qile aur un ke mehlaat fateh karein bhala is aqlmandi aur door-bini ko to dekhiye jab Huzoor ﷺ ko Allah Ta'ala ne un ki un baaton par muttala kar diya to yeh saaf munkar ho gaye aur qasmein kha kha kar kaha ke hum ne yeh baat nahi kahi hum to aaps mein hansi khel kar rahe thay haan un mein ek shakhs tha jise Insha'Allah Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya hoga yeh kaha karta tha ke ya Allah main tere kalaam ki ek aayat sunta hoon jis mein mere gunah ka zikr hai jab bhi sunta hoon mere rongte khade ho jaate hain aur mera dil kapkapane lagta hai. Parwardigar tu meri tauba qabool farma aur mujhe apni raah mein shaheed kar aur is tarah ke na koi mujhe ghusal de na kafan de na dafan kare yahi hua jang-e-Yamamah mein yeh shuhada ke sath shaheed hue tamam shuhada ki laashein mil gayin lekin un ki naash ka pata hi na chala. Janab-e-Bari ki taraf se aur munafiqon ko jawab mila ke ab bahane na banao tum zubani imandaar bane thay lekin ab usi zuban se tum kafir ho gaye yeh qoul kufr ka kalma hai ke tum ne Allah Rasool aur Quran ki hansi urai. Hum agar kisi se darguzar bhi kar jayein lekin tum sab se yeh mamla nahi hone ka tumhare is jurm aur is badtareen khata aur is kafirana guftagu ki tumhe sakht tareen saza bhugatna padegi.

Ek ke haath nekiyon ke khet dusre ke haath buraiyon ki waba. Munaafiqon ki khislatein mominon ke bilkul barkhilaf hoti hain. Momin bhaliyon ka hukum karte hain aur buraiyon se rokte hain, munaafiq buraiyon ka hukum dete hain aur bhaliyon se mana karte hain. Momin sakhi hote hain, munaafiq bakheel hote hain. Momin zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rehte hain, munaafiq yaad-e-Ilahi bhulae rehte hain. Isi ke badle Allah bhi un ke sath woh maamla karta hai jaise kisi ko koi bhool gaya ho. Qayamat ke din yahi un se kaha jayega ke tum hum tumhein theek usi tarah bhula denge jaise tum is din ki mulaqat ko bhulae hue the. Munaafiq rah-e-haq se door ho gaye hain, gumrahi ke chakardaar bhool bhulaiyon mein phans gaye hain. In munaafiqon aur kafiron ki in bad-aamaliyon ki saza un ke liye Allah Ta'ala Jahannam ko muqarrar farma chuka hai jahan woh abad-ul-abad tak rahenge. Wahan ka azaab unhein bas hoga. Unhein Rabb-e-Raheem apni rehmat se door kar chuka hai aur un ke liye is ne daaimi aur mustaqil azaab rakhe hain.

Unhein Rabb-e-Raheem apni rehmat se door kar chuka hai aur un ke liye is ne daaimi aur mustaqil azaab rakhe hain.

In logon ko bhi agle logon ki tarah azab pahuche. Khallaq se murad yahan deen hai. Jaise agle log jhoot aur batil mein koodte phandte rahe. Aise hi in logon ne bhi kiya. Inke yeh fasid aamal akart ho gaye. Na duniya mein soodmand hue na akhirat mein sawab dilane wale hain. Yahi sareeh nuqsan hai ke amal kiya aur sawab na mila. Ibn Abbas farmate hain jaise aaj ki raat kal ki raat se mushabeh hoti hai usi tarah is ummat mein bhi Yahudiyon ki mushabehat aa gayi mera to khayal hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke tum un ki pairwi karoge yahan tak ke agar un mein se koi goh janwar ke surakh mein dakhil hua hai to tum bhi us mein ghuso ge. Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai ke us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum apne se pehle ke logon ke tareeqon ki tabadari karoge bilkul balisht ba balisht aur zira' ba zira' aur haath ba haath. Yahan tak ke agar woh kisi ke bil mein ghuse hain to yaqeenan tum bhi ghuso ge logon ne poocha is se murad aap ki kaun log hain ? Kya Ahl-e-Kitab ? Aap ne farmaya aur kaun ? Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Hurairah ne farmaya agar tum chaho to Quran ke in lafzon ko parh lo (Kalladhina min qablikum kanu ashadda minkum quwwatan) 9. At-Tawbah: 69. Hazrat Abu Hurairah farmate hain Khallaq se murad deen hai. Aur tum ne bhi usi tarah ka khoz kiya jis tarah ka unhon ne. Logon ne poocha kya Farsiyon aur Romiyon ki tarah ? Aap ne farmaya aur log hi hain kaun ? Is hadith ke mafhoom par shahid sahih ahadeeb mein bhi hain.

Badkaron ke mazi se ibrat hasil karo. In badkardar munafiqon ko wa'az sunaya ja raha hai ki apne se pehle ke apne jaison ke halaat par ibrat ki nazar daalo. Dekho ki nabiyon ki takzeeb kya phal layi? Qaum-e-Noh ka gharq hona aur siwa musalmanon ke kisi ka na bachna yaad karo. Aadiyon ka Hud (A.S) ke na manne ki wajah se hawa ke jhonkon se tabaah hona yaad karo, Samudiyon ka Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ke jhutlane aur Allah ki nishaani oontni ke kaat daalne se ek jigar doz karake ki aawaz se tabaah-o-barbaad hona yaad karo. Ibrahim (A.S) ka dushmanon ke haathon se bach jaana aur unke dushmanon ka ghaarat hona, Namrud bin Kanaan bin Kosh jaise baadshah ka ma' apne lao lashkar ke tabaah hona na bhoolo. Woh sab la'nat ke maare be-nishan kar diye gaye, Qaum-e-Shu'aib unhi badkardariyon aur kufr ke badle zalzale aur saiban wale din ke azaab se teh-o-baala kar di gayi jo Madyan ki rehne wali thi. Qaum-e-Lut jin ki bastiyan ulti padi hain Madyan aur Sadum waghera Allah ne unhein bhi apne Nabi Lut (A.S) ke manne aur apni bad-fa'li na chhorne ke baais ek ek ko paiwand-e-zamin kar diya. Unke paas hamare Rasul hamari Kitab aur khule mo'jize aur saaf dalelein lekar pahunche lekin unhein ne ek na maani. Bil-akhir apne zulm se aap barbaad hue. Allah Ta'ala ne to haq wazeh kar diya, Kitab utaar di, Rasul bhej diye, hujjat khatam kar di lekin yeh rasulon ke muqable par aamada hue, Kitabullah ki ta'mil se bhaage, haq ki mukhalifat ki, pas la'nat-e-Rab utri aur unhein khaak-e-siyah kar gayi.

Musalman aik doosre ke dast-o-bazu hain. Munafiqon ki bad-khaslatein bayaan farma kar musalmanon ki naik sifatein bayaan farma raha hai ke yeh aik doosre ki madad karte hain, aik doosre ka dast-o-bazu bane rehte hain. Sahih hadith mein hai ke momin momin ke liye misal diwar ke hai jis ka aik hissa doosre hisse ko taqwiyat pohanchata aur mazboot karta hai. Aap ﷺ ne yeh farmate hue apne haathon ki ungliyan aik doosri mein daal kar dikha bhi diya. Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke momin apni dosti aur sulook mein misal aik jism ki maanind hain ke aik hisse ko bhi agar takleef ho to tamam jism beemari aur bedari mein mubtala ho jata hai. Yeh paak nafs logon auron ki tarbiyat se bhi ghaafil nahi rehte. Sab ko bhalaaiyan dikhate hain, achhi baatein batate hain, bure kaamon se, buri baaton se imkaan bhar rokte hain. Hukum-e-Ilahi bhi yehi hai. Farmata hai tum mein aik jama'at zaroor aisi honi chahiye jo bhalaaiyon ka hukum kare, buraaiyon se mana kare. Yeh namazi hote hain. Saath hi zakat bhi dete hain taake aik taraf Allah ki ibadat ho, doosri jaanib makhlooq ki diljooi ho. Allah Rasool ki itaa'at hi un ka dil-chasp mashghala hai, jo hukum mila baja laaye, jis se roka ruk gaye. Yehi log hain jo Rahmat-e-Ilahi ke mustahiq hain. Yehi sifatein hain jin se Allah ki rehmat un ki taraf lapakti hai. Allah Azeez hai, woh apne farman-bardaron ki khud bhi izzat karta hai aur unhein zi-izzat bana deta hai. Darasal izzat Allah hi ke liye hai aur us ne apne rasoolon aur apne imandaar ghulamon ko bhi izzat de rakhi hai. Us ki hikmat hai ke un mein yeh sifatein rakhein aur munafiqon mein woh khaslatein rakhein. Us ki hikmat ki teh ko kaun pohanch sakta hai? Jo chahe kare woh barkaton aur bulandiyon wala hai.

Mominon ko neki ke inaamat

Momino ki un nekiyon par jo ajr-o-sawab unhein milega un ka bayan ho raha hai ke abdi neamatein, hamishgi ki rahaten, baqi rehne wali jannatein jahan qadam qadam par khushgawar pani ke chashme ubal rahe hain, jahan buland-o-bala, khubsurat, muzayyan, saaf suthray araish-o-zebaish wale mahalat aur makanat hain. 

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain, do jannatein to sirf sone ki hain, un ke bartan aur jo kuch bhi wahan hai sab sone hi sone ka hai aur do jannatein chandi ki hain, bartan bhi aur kul cheezein bhi, un mein aur Deedare Ilahi mein koi hijab bajuz us kibriyai ki chadar ke nahi jo Allah Jalla Wa'ala ke chehre par hai, yeh jannat-e-adn mein honge. 

Aur hadith mein hai ke momin ke liye jannat mein ek khaima hoga, ek hi moti ka bana huwa, us ka tul saath mil ka hoga, momin ki biwiyan wahin hongi jin ke paas yeh aata jata rahega lekin ek dusre ko dikhai na dengi. 

Aap ka farman hai ke jo Allah-o-Rasool ﷺ par iman laye, namaz qaim rakhe, Ramadan ke roze rakhe, Allah par haq hai ke use jannat mein le jaye, us ne hijrat ki ho ya apne watan mein hi raha ho. 

Logon ne kaha, phir hum auron se bhi yeh hadith bayan kar dein? 

Aap ne farmaya, jannat mein ek sau darje hain jo Allah Ta'ala ne apni rah ke mujahidon ke liye banaye hain, har do darjon mein itna hi fasla hai jitna zameen-o-asman mein. Pas jab bhi tum Allah se jannat ka sawal karo to Jannat-ul-Firdaus talab karo, woh sab se unchi aur sab se behtar jannat hai, jannaton ki sab nahrein wahin se nikalti hain, us ki chhat Rahman ka arsh hai. 

Farmate hain, ahl-e-jannat jannati bala khanon ko is tarah dekhenge jis tarah tum asman ke chamakte dhamakte sitaron ko dekhte ho. 

Yeh bhi maloom rahe ke tamam jannaton mein khalis ek aala maqam hai jis ka naam Wasila hai kyunke woh arsh ke bilkul hi qareeb hai, yeh jagah hai Hazrat Muhammad Rasulullah ﷺ ki. 

Aap farmate hain, jab tum mujh par durood padho to Allah se mere liye Wasila talab kiya karo. 

Pucha gaya, Wasila kya hai? 

Farmaya, jannat ka woh aala darja jo ek hi shakhs ko milega aur mujhe Allah ki zaat se qawi umeed hai woh shakhs main hi hun. 

Aap farmate hain, muazzin ki azan ka jawab do jaise kalmaat woh kehta hai tum bhi kaho, phir mujh par durood padho, jo shakhs mujh par ek martaba durood bhejta hai Allah Ta'ala us par apni das rehmatein nazil farmata hai, phir mere liye Wasila talab karo aur jannat ki ek manzil hai jo tamam makhlooq-e-ilahiya mein se ek hi shakhs ko milegi, mujhe umeed hai ke woh mujhe hi inayat hogi, jo shakhs mere liye Allah se us wasile ki talab kare us ke liye meri shafalat Roz-e-Qayamat halal ho gayi. 

Farmate hain, mere liye Allah se Wasila talab karo, duniya mein yeh jo bhi mere liye wasile ki dua karega main Qiyamat ke din us ka gawah aur sifarshi banunga. 

Sahaba ne ek din aap se pucha ke Ya Rasulullah hamein jannat ki baatein sunaiye, un ki bina kis cheez ki hai?

Farmaya sone chandi ki eonton ki, us ka gara khalis mushk hai, us ke kankar lulu aur yaqut hai, us ki mitti zafaran hai, is mein jo jaye ga woh nematon mein hoga jo kabhi khali na hon woh hamesha ki zindagi payega jis ke baad maut ka khatka bhi nahi, na us ke kapre kharab hon na us ki jawani dhale. Farmate hain jannat mein aise bala khane hain jinka andar ka hissa bahar se nazar aata hai aur bahar ka hissa andar se. Ek arabi ne pucha Huzoor ﷺ yeh bala khane kin ke liye hain? Aap ne farmaya jo acha kalam kare, khana khilaye, roze rakhe aur raton ko logon ke sone ke waqt tahajjud ki namaz ada kare. 

Farmate hain koi hai jo jannat ka shayiq aur us ke liye mehnat karne wala ho? Wallah jannat ki koi char diwari mahdud karne wali nahi, woh to ek chamakta hua buq'ah-e-noor hai aur mehakta hua gulistan hai aur buland-o-bala pakeeza mehlat hain aur jari-o-sari nahrein hain aur gadraye hue aur pake mewon ke khushe hain aur josh-e-jamal ladhe phande hain, sabza hai phayla hua, kushadgi aur rahat hai, amn aur chain hai, nemat aur rehmat hai, aalishan khush manzar koshak aur hawliyan hain. Yeh sunkar log bol uthe ke Huzoor hum sab is jannat ke mushtaq aur us ke hasil karne ke liye koshish karne wale hain. Aap ne farmaya Insha'Allah kaho, pas logon ne Insha'Allah kaha. 

Phir farmata hai in tamam nematon se aala aur bala nemat Allah ki razamandi hai. Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal jannatiyon ko pukarega ke aye Ahl-e-Jannat! Woh kahenge Labbayka Rabbana wa Sa'dayka wal-khayru fi yadayka. Puchega kaho tum khush ho gaye? Woh jawab denge ke khush kyun na hote tu ne to aye Parwardigar humein woh diya jo makhlooq mein se kisi ko na mila hoga. Allah Ta'ala farmayega lo main tumhein is se bohat hi afzal aur aala cheez ata farmata hoon. Woh kahenge ya Allah is se behtar cheez aur kya ho sakti hai? Allah Ta'ala farmayega suno main ne apni razamandi tumhein ata farmai, aaj ke baad main kabhi bhi tum se na-khush na hounga. 

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab jannati jannat mein pohch jayenge Allah Azzawajal farmayega kuch aur chahiye to doon? Woh kahenge ya Allah jo tu ne humein ata farma rakha hai is se behtar to koi aur cheez ho hi nahi sakti. Allah farmayega woh meri razamandi hai jo sab se behtar hai. Imam Hafiz Ziya Maqdisi ne Sifat-e-Jannat mein ek mustaqil kitab likhi hai, is mein is hadis ko shart-e-sahih par bataya hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Char Talwarein? Kafiron munafiqon se jihad ka aur un par sakhti ka hukum hua. Mominon se jhuk kar milne ka hukum hua. Kafiron ki asli jagah jahannam muqarrar farma di. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ko Allah Ta'ala ne chaar talwaron ke sath mabouth farmaya, ek talwar to mushrikon mein, farmata hai (Aayat: Fa iza insalakh-ul-ashhur-ul-hurumu faqtul-ul-mushrikin) hurmat wale mahinon ke guzarte hi mushrikon ki khoob khabar lo. Doosri talwar Ahl-e-Kitab ke kuffar mein, farmata hai (Qatilul-lazina la yu'minuna ilakh) jo Allah par qayamat ke din iman nahi late, Allah Rasul ke haram kiye hue ko haram nahi mante, Deen-e-Haq ko qabul nahi karte, un Ahl-e-Kitab se jihad karo jab tak ke woh zillat ke sath jhuk kar apne hath se jizya dena منظور na kar lein. Teesri talwar munafiqin hain, irshad hota hai: (Aayat: Jahid-il-kuffara wal-munafiqina) kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad karo. Chauthi talwar baghiyon mein, farman hai: (Aayat: Faqatilul-lati tabghi hatta tafii ila amr-Allah) baghiyon se lado jab tak ke palat kar woh Allah ke ahkaam ki hukm-bardari ki taraf na aa jayein. Is se sabit hota hai ke munafiq jab apna nifaq zahir karne lagein to un se talwar se jihad karna chahiye. Imam Ibn Jarir ka pasandida qaul bhi yahi hai. Ibn Masood ؓ farmate hain hath se na ho sake to un ke munh par dant-dapat se. Ibn Abbas farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala ne kafiron se talwar ke sath jihad karne ka hukum diya hai aur munafiqon ke sath zabani jihad ko farmaya hai aur yeh ke un par narmi na ki jaye. Mujahid ka bhi taqriban yahi قول hai. Un par hadd-e-shari ka jari karna bhi un se jihad karna hai, maqsud yeh hai ke kabhi talwar bhi un ke khilaf uthani padegi warna jab tak kaam chale zaban kafi hai jaisa mauqa ho kar lein. Qasmeen kha kha kar kehte hain ke unhon ne aisi koi baat zaban se nahi nikali. Halanki darhaqiqat kufr ka bol bol chuke hain aur apne zahiri Islam ke baad khula kufr kar chuke hain. Yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubi ke bare mein utri hai, ek Jahni aur ek Ansari mein ladai ho gayi. Jahni shakhs Ansari par chha gaya to us munafiq ne Ansar ko us ki madad par ubhara aur kehne laga: Wallah hamari aur is Muhammad ﷺ ki to wahi misal hai ke "Apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke woh tujhe hi kate." Wallah agar hum ab ki martaba Madine wapas gaye to hum zi-izzat log un tamam kamine logon ko wahan se nikal kar bahar karenge. Ek musalman ne ja kar Huzoor ﷺ se yeh guftagu dohra di. Aap ne use bulwa kar us se sawal kiya to yeh qasam kha kar inkar kar gaya, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat nazil farmai. Hazrat Anas farmate hain ke meri kaum ke jo log Harrah ki jang mein kaam aaye un par mujhe bada hi ranj aur sadma ho raha tha, is ki khabar Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam tak pahunchi to us ne mujhe khat mein likha ke Rasulullah ﷺ se maine suna hai, aap dua karte hain ke: Ya Allah Ansar ko aur Ansar ke ladkon ko bakhsh de. Neeche ke rawi Ibn al-Fadl ko is mein shaq hai ke aap ne apni is dua mein un ke poton ka naam bhi liya ya nahi?

Pas Hazrat Anas R.A ne maujud logon mein se kisi se Hazrat Zaid ki nisbat sawal kiya toh usne kaha yahi woh Zaid hain jin ke kaanon ki suni hui baat ki sachai ki shahadat khud Rab-e-Aleem ne di. Waqia yeh hai ke Huzoor ﷺ khutba parh rahe the ke ek munafiq ne kaha agar yeh sacha hai toh hum toh gadhoon se bhi zyada ahmaq hain. Hazrat Zaid ne kaha Wallahu An-Hazrat ﷺ bilkul sache hain aur beshak tu apni himaqat mein gadhe se barha hua hai. Phir Aap ne yeh baat Huzoor ﷺ ke gosh guzaar ki lekin woh munafiq palat gaya aur saaf inkar kar gaya aur kaha ke Zaid ne jhoot bola. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari aur Hazrat Zaid ki sachai bayaan farmai. Lekin mashhoor baat yeh hai ke yeh waqia Ghazwa Bani Al-Mustaliq ka hai, mumkin hai ravi ko is ayat ke zikr mein wahm ho gaya ho aur doosri ayat ke badle ise bayaan kar diya ho. Yahi hadith Bukhari Sharif mein hai lekin is jumle tak ke zinda woh hain jin ke kaanon ki suni hui baat ki sachai ki shahadat khud Rab-e-Aleem ne di. Mumkin hai ke baad ka hissa Musa bin Uqba ravi ka apna qoul ho. Isi ki ek riwayat mein yeh pichhla hissa Ibn Shihab ke qoul se marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Maghazi Umawi mein Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A ke bayaan kardah Tabuk ke waqia ke baad hai ke jo munafiq moakhar chor diye gaye the aur jin ke baare mein Quran nazil hua, un mein se baaz An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath bhi the. Un mein Jilas bin Suwaid bin Samit bhi tha, unke ghar mein Umair bin Saad ki walida thin jo apne sath Hazrat Umair ko bhi le gayi thin. Jab in munafiqon ke baare mein Qurani aayatein nazil huin toh Jilas kehne laga ke wallah agar yeh shakhs apne qoul mein sacha hai toh hum toh gadhoon se bhi badtar hain. Hazrat Umair bin Saad R.A yeh sun kar farmane lage ke yun toh aap mujhe sab se zyada mahboob hain aur aap ki takleef mujh par meri takleef se bhi zyada shaaq hai lekin aap ne is waqt toh aisi baat munh se nikali hai ke agar main ise pohnchaun toh ruswai hai aur na pohnchaun toh halakat hai, ruswai yaqinan halakat se halki cheez hai. Yeh keh kar yeh buzurg hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ hue aur saari baat Aap ko keh sunai. 

Jilas ko jab yeh pata chala toh usne sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir ho kar qasmein kha kha kar kaha ke Umair jhoota hai maine yeh baat hargiz nahi kahi. Is par yeh ayat utri. Marwi hai ke iske baad Jilas ne tauba kar li aur durust ho gaye. Yeh tauba ki baat bohat mumkin hai ke Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq ki apni kahi hui ho, Hazrat Ka'ab ki yeh baatein nahi, Wallahu A'lam. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jilas bin Suwaid bin Samit apne sotile bete Hazrat Mus'ab R.A ke sath Quba se aa rahe the, dono gadhoon par sawar the, is waqt Jilas ne yeh kaha tha. Is par un ke sahibzade ne farmaya ke ae dushman-e-Rab main teri is baat ki Rasool Allah ﷺ ko khabar karunga. Farmate hain ke mujhe toh darr lag raha tha ke kahin mere baare mein Quran na nazil ho ya mujh par koi azab-e-Ilahi na aa jaye ya is gunah mein main bhi apne baap ka shareek na kar diya jaun, chunache main seedha hazir hua aur tamam baat Huzoor ﷺ ko ma' apne darr ke suna di.

Ibn Jarir mein Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ aik saaye daar darakht tale baithe hue farmane lage ke abhi tumhare paas aik shakhs aayega aur tumhe shaitan dekhega khabardar tum us se kalam na karna usi waqt aik insan keeri aankhon wala aaya Aap ne us se farmaya tu aur tere sathi mujhe galiyan kyun dete ho? Woh usi waqt gaya aur apne sathiyon ko lekar aaya sab ne kasme kha kha kar kaha hum ne koi aisa lafz nahi kaha yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ne un se darguzar farma liya phir yeh aayat utri. Is mein jo yeh farmaya gaya hai ke unhon ne woh qasd kiya jo poora na hua murad is se Julas ka yeh irada hai ke apne soteele larke ko jis ne Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein baat keh di thi qatal kar de. Aik qoul hai ke Abdullah bin Ubi ne khud Huzoor ﷺ ke qatal ka irada kiya tha. Yeh qoul bhi hai ke baaz logon ne irada kar liya tha ke use sardar bana dein go Rasulullah ﷺ raazi na hon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke das se oopar oopar aadmiyon ne Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein raste mein Huzoor ﷺ ko dhokha de kar qatal karna chaha tha. Chunacha Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ farmate hain main aur Hazrat Ammar An-Hazrat ﷺ ki oontni ke aage peeche the aik chalta tha doosra nakeel thamta tha hum Uqbah mein the ke barah shakhs munh par naqab dale aaye aur oontni ko gher liya Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe lalkara aur woh dam daba kar bhag khade hue Aap ne hum se farmaya kya tum ne unhe pehchana? Hum ne kaha nahi lekin un ki sawariyan hamari nigahon mein hain Aap ne farmaya yeh munafiq the aur Qiyamat tak un ke dil mein nifaq rahega. Jaante ho ke kis irade se aaye the? Hum ne kaha nahi farmaya Allah ke Rasul ko Uqbah mein pareshan karne aur takleef pohanchane ke liye. Hum ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ un ki qoum ke logon se kehwa dijiye ke har qoum wale apne dushmano se lade un par fatah hasil karke phir apne un sathiyon ko bhi qatal kar dala. Aap ne un ke liye baddua ki ke ya Allah un ke dilon par aatishin phore paida kar de. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk se wapsi mein Huzoor ﷺ ne ailan kara diya ke main Uqbah ke raste mein jaunga. Is ki rah koi na aaye Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ Aap ki oontni ki nakeel thame hue the aur Hazrat Ammar ؓ peeche se chala rahe the ke aik jamat apni oontniyon par sawar aa gayi Hazrat Ammar ؓ ne un ki sawariyon ko marna shuru kiya aur Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ ne Huzoor ﷺ ke farman se Aap ki sawari ko neeche ki taraf chalana shuru kar diya jab neeche maidan aa gaya Aap sawari se utar aaye itne mein Ammar ؓ bhi wapas pohch gaye. Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke yeh log kaun the pehchane bhi? Hazrat Ammar ؓ ne kaha munh to chupe hue the lekin sawariyan maloom hain poocha un ka irada kya tha jaante ho? Jawab diya ke nahi Aap ne farmaya unhon ne chaha tha ke shor kar ke hamari oontni ko bhadka dein aur hume gira dein. Aik shakhs se Hazrat Ammar ؓ ne un ki tadad daryaft ki to us ne kaha chouda. Aap ne farmaya agar tu bhi un mein tha to pandrah.

Huzoor ﷺ ne un mein se teen shakhso ke naam ginwaaye, unho ne kaha, Wallahi hum ne to munadi ki nida suni aur na hamein apne sathyiyon ke kisi bad irade ka ilm tha. Hazrat Ammar R.H farmate hain ke baaqi ke barah log Allah Rasool se ladaai karne wale hain duniya mein aur aakhirat mein bhi. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq ne un mein se bohat se logo ke naam bhi ginwaaye hain, wallahu a'lam.

Sahih Muslim mein hai ke Ahl-e-Aqbah mein se ek shakhs ke sath Hazrat Ammar R.H ka kuch taalluq tha, to us ko aap ne qasam de kar Ashab-e-Aqbah ki ginti daryaft ki, logo ne bhi us se kaha ke haan bata do. Us ne kaha ke hamein maloom hai ke woh chaudah thay, agar mujhe bhi shamil kiya jaaye to pandrah hue. Un mein se barah to dushman-e-Allah aur Rasool ﷺ hi thay aur teen shakhso ki qasam par ke na hum ne munadi ki na nida suni, na hamein jaane walo ke irade ka ilm tha, is liye mazoor rakhe gaye. 

Garmi ka mausam tha, paani bohat kam tha, aap ne farma diya tha ke mujh se pehle wahan koi na pahuche, lekin is par bhi kuch log pahunch gaye thay, aap ne un par laanat ki. Aap ka farman hai ke mere sathyiyon mein barah munafiq hain, jo na jannat mein jaayenge na us ki khushboo paayenge, aath ke kandho par to aatshi phoda hoga jo seene tak pahuchega aur unhe halak kar dega. Isi baais Hazrat Huzaifa R.H ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ka raaz-dar kaha jata tha, aap ne sirf unhi ko in munafiqo ke naam bataye thay, wallahu a'lam.

Tabarani mein un ke naam yeh hain: Mut'ib bin Qushair, Wadi'ah bin Sabit, Jaddin bin Abdullah bin Nabiel bin Harith jo Amr bin Awf ke qabile ka tha, aur Harith bin Yazid, Ta'i Aws bin Qaiti, Harith bin Suwaid, Safih bin Darah, Qais bin Fahr, Suwaid, Da'in qabila Bani Ja'li ke, Qais bin Amr bin Sahl, Zaid bin Lasit aur Sulalah bin Hammam, yeh dono qabila Bani Qainqa' ke hain, yeh sab bazahir musalman bane hue thay.

Is aayat mein is ke baad farmaya gaya hai ke unho ne isi baat ka badla liya hai ke unhe Allah ne apne fazl se apne Rasool ke haatho maldar banaya. Agar un par Allah ka poora fazl ho jata to unhe hidayat bhi naseeb ho jaati, jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Ansar se farmaya: Kya main ne tumhe gumrahi ki halat mein nahi paya tha ke phir Allah ne meri wajah se tumhari rahebari ki? Tum mutafarriq thay, Allah Ta'ala ne meri wajah se tum mein ulfat daal di. Tum faqir be-nawa thay, Allah ne mere sabab se tumhe ghani aur maldar kar diya. Har sawal ke jawab mein Ansar R.H farmate jaate thay ke beshak Allah ka aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ka is se zyada ehsan hai.

Al-Gharz bayan yeh hai ke be-qusoor hone ke badle yeh log dushmani aur be-imani par utar aaye. Jaise Surah Buruj mein hai ke in musalmano mein se ek kaafirro ka intiqam sirf un ke iman ke baais tha. Hadith mein hai ke Ibn Jamil sirf is baat ka intiqam leta hai ke woh faqir tha, Allah ne use ghani kar diya.

Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh ab bhi tauba karlein toh unke haq mein behtar hai aur agar woh apne usi tareeqe par karband rahein toh unhein duniya mein bhi sakht saza hogi qatl, sadma-o-gham aur dozakh ke zaleel-o-past karne wale naqabil-e-bardasht azaab ki saza bhi. Duniya mein koi na hoga jo unki taraf-dari kare, unki madad kare, unke kaam aaye, unse burai hataye ya unhein nafa pahunchaye, yeh be-yaar-o-madadgar reh jayenge.

Char Talwarein? Kafiron munafiqon se jihad ka aur un par sakhti ka hukum hua. Mominon se jhuk kar milne ka hukum hua. Kafiron ki asli jagah jahannam muqarrar farma di. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ko Allah Ta'ala ne chaar talwaron ke sath mabouth farmaya, ek talwar to mushrikon mein, farmata hai (Aayat: Fa iza insalakh-ul-ashhur-ul-hurumu faqtul-ul-mushrikin) hurmat wale mahinon ke guzarte hi mushrikon ki khoob khabar lo. Doosri talwar Ahl-e-Kitab ke kuffar mein, farmata hai (Qatilul-lazina la yu'minuna ilakh) jo Allah par qayamat ke din iman nahi late, Allah Rasul ke haram kiye hue ko haram nahi mante, Deen-e-Haq ko qabul nahi karte, un Ahl-e-Kitab se jihad karo jab tak ke woh zillat ke sath jhuk kar apne hath se jizya dena منظور na kar lein. Teesri talwar munafiqin hain, irshad hota hai: (Aayat: Jahid-il-kuffara wal-munafiqina) kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad karo. Chauthi talwar baghiyon mein, farman hai: (Aayat: Faqatilul-lati tabghi hatta tafii ila amr-Allah) baghiyon se lado jab tak ke palat kar woh Allah ke ahkaam ki hukm-bardari ki taraf na aa jayein. Is se sabit hota hai ke munafiq jab apna nifaq zahir karne lagein to un se talwar se jihad karna chahiye. Imam Ibn Jarir ka pasandida qaul bhi yahi hai. Ibn Masood ؓ farmate hain hath se na ho sake to un ke munh par dant-dapat se. Ibn Abbas farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala ne kafiron se talwar ke sath jihad karne ka hukum diya hai aur munafiqon ke sath zabani jihad ko farmaya hai aur yeh ke un par narmi na ki jaye. Mujahid ka bhi taqriban yahi قول hai. Un par hadd-e-shari ka jari karna bhi un se jihad karna hai, maqsud yeh hai ke kabhi talwar bhi un ke khilaf uthani padegi warna jab tak kaam chale zaban kafi hai jaisa mauqa ho kar lein. Qasmeen kha kha kar kehte hain ke unhon ne aisi koi baat zaban se nahi nikali. Halanki darhaqiqat kufr ka bol bol chuke hain aur apne zahiri Islam ke baad khula kufr kar chuke hain. Yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubi ke bare mein utri hai, ek Jahni aur ek Ansari mein ladai ho gayi. Jahni shakhs Ansari par chha gaya to us munafiq ne Ansar ko us ki madad par ubhara aur kehne laga: Wallah hamari aur is Muhammad ﷺ ki to wahi misal hai ke "Apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke woh tujhe hi kate." Wallah agar hum ab ki martaba Madine wapas gaye to hum zi-izzat log un tamam kamine logon ko wahan se nikal kar bahar karenge. Ek musalman ne ja kar Huzoor ﷺ se yeh guftagu dohra di. Aap ne use bulwa kar us se sawal kiya to yeh qasam kha kar inkar kar gaya, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat nazil farmai. Hazrat Anas farmate hain ke meri kaum ke jo log Harrah ki jang mein kaam aaye un par mujhe bada hi ranj aur sadma ho raha tha, is ki khabar Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam tak pahunchi to us ne mujhe khat mein likha ke Rasulullah ﷺ se maine suna hai, aap dua karte hain ke: Ya Allah Ansar ko aur Ansar ke ladkon ko bakhsh de. Neeche ke rawi Ibn al-Fadl ko is mein shaq hai ke aap ne apni is dua mein un ke poton ka naam bhi liya ya nahi?

Pas Hazrat Anas R.A ne maujud logon mein se kisi se Hazrat Zaid ki nisbat sawal kiya toh usne kaha yahi woh Zaid hain jin ke kaanon ki suni hui baat ki sachai ki shahadat khud Rab-e-Aleem ne di. Waqia yeh hai ke Huzoor ﷺ khutba parh rahe the ke ek munafiq ne kaha agar yeh sacha hai toh hum toh gadhoon se bhi zyada ahmaq hain. Hazrat Zaid ne kaha Wallahu An-Hazrat ﷺ bilkul sache hain aur beshak tu apni himaqat mein gadhe se barha hua hai. Phir Aap ne yeh baat Huzoor ﷺ ke gosh guzaar ki lekin woh munafiq palat gaya aur saaf inkar kar gaya aur kaha ke Zaid ne jhoot bola. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari aur Hazrat Zaid ki sachai bayaan farmai. Lekin mashhoor baat yeh hai ke yeh waqia Ghazwa Bani Al-Mustaliq ka hai, mumkin hai ravi ko is ayat ke zikr mein wahm ho gaya ho aur doosri ayat ke badle ise bayaan kar diya ho. Yahi hadith Bukhari Sharif mein hai lekin is jumle tak ke zinda woh hain jin ke kaanon ki suni hui baat ki sachai ki shahadat khud Rab-e-Aleem ne di. Mumkin hai ke baad ka hissa Musa bin Uqba ravi ka apna qoul ho. Isi ki ek riwayat mein yeh pichhla hissa Ibn Shihab ke qoul se marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Maghazi Umawi mein Hazrat Ka'ab bin Malik R.A ke bayaan kardah Tabuk ke waqia ke baad hai ke jo munafiq moakhar chor diye gaye the aur jin ke baare mein Quran nazil hua, un mein se baaz An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath bhi the. Un mein Jilas bin Suwaid bin Samit bhi tha, unke ghar mein Umair bin Saad ki walida thin jo apne sath Hazrat Umair ko bhi le gayi thin. Jab in munafiqon ke baare mein Qurani aayatein nazil huin toh Jilas kehne laga ke wallah agar yeh shakhs apne qoul mein sacha hai toh hum toh gadhoon se bhi badtar hain. Hazrat Umair bin Saad R.A yeh sun kar farmane lage ke yun toh aap mujhe sab se zyada mahboob hain aur aap ki takleef mujh par meri takleef se bhi zyada shaaq hai lekin aap ne is waqt toh aisi baat munh se nikali hai ke agar main ise pohnchaun toh ruswai hai aur na pohnchaun toh halakat hai, ruswai yaqinan halakat se halki cheez hai. Yeh keh kar yeh buzurg hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ hue aur saari baat Aap ko keh sunai. 

Jilas ko jab yeh pata chala toh usne sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir ho kar qasmein kha kha kar kaha ke Umair jhoota hai maine yeh baat hargiz nahi kahi. Is par yeh ayat utri. Marwi hai ke iske baad Jilas ne tauba kar li aur durust ho gaye. Yeh tauba ki baat bohat mumkin hai ke Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq ki apni kahi hui ho, Hazrat Ka'ab ki yeh baatein nahi, Wallahu A'lam. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jilas bin Suwaid bin Samit apne sotile bete Hazrat Mus'ab R.A ke sath Quba se aa rahe the, dono gadhoon par sawar the, is waqt Jilas ne yeh kaha tha. Is par un ke sahibzade ne farmaya ke ae dushman-e-Rab main teri is baat ki Rasool Allah ﷺ ko khabar karunga. Farmate hain ke mujhe toh darr lag raha tha ke kahin mere baare mein Quran na nazil ho ya mujh par koi azab-e-Ilahi na aa jaye ya is gunah mein main bhi apne baap ka shareek na kar diya jaun, chunache main seedha hazir hua aur tamam baat Huzoor ﷺ ko ma' apne darr ke suna di.

Dua qabul hui to apna ahd bhool gaya. Bayan ho raha hai ki in munafiqon mein woh bhi hai jis ne ahd kiya ki agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala maldar kar de to main bari sakhawat karun aur naik ban jaun, lekin jab Allah ne use ameer aur khushhal bana diya us ne wada shikni ki aur bakhil ban baitha, jis ki saza mein Qudrat ne us ke dil mein hamesha ke liye nifaq daal diya.

Yeh ayat Sa'labah bin Hatib Ansari ke bare mein nazil hui hai, us ne Huzoor ﷺ se darkhwast ki ki mere liye malداری ki dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya: "Thora maal jis ka shukr ada ho, us bahut se behtar hai jo apni taqat se zyada ho." Us ne phir dobara bhi darkhwast ki to aap ne phir samjhaya ki: "Tu apna haal Allah ke Nabi jaisa rakhna pasand karta hai? Wallahu agar main chahta to yeh pahar sone chandi ke ban kar mere sath chalte." 

Us ne kaha: "Huzoor wallahu mera irada hai ki agar Allah mujhe maldar kar de to main khoob sakhawat ki dad dun, har ek ko is ka haq ada karun." 

Aap ne is ke liye maal mein barkat ki dua ki. Us ki bakriyon mein is tarah ziyadati shuru hui jaise keere barh rahe hon, yahan tak ki Madinah Sharif us ke janwaro ke liye tang ho gaya. Yeh ek maidan mein nikal gaya, Zohar Asr to jama'at ke sath ada karta, baqi namazein jama'at se nahi milti thin. Janwaro mein aur barkat hui use aur door jana para, ab siwaye Jum'ah ke aur sab jama'atein us se choot gain. 

Maal barhta gaya, hafta baad Jum'ah ke liye aana bhi us ne chor diya, aane jaane wale qafilon se pooch liya karta tha ki Jum'ah ke din kya bayan hua? Ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ ne is ka haal daryaft kiya, logon ne sab kuch bayan kar diya. Aap ﷺ ne izhar-e-afsos kiya. 

Udhar ayat utri ki in ke maal se sadqe le aur sadqe ke ahkaam bhi bayan hue. Aap ne do shakhso ko jin mein ek qabilah Juhainah ka aur dusra qabilah Sulaim ka tha, unhe tahseel-dar bana kar sadqa lene ke ahkaam likh kar unhe parwana de kar bheja aur farmaya ki Sa'labah se aur falane Bani Sulaim se sadqa le aao. 

Yeh dono Sa'labah ke pas pohnche, farman-e-Paighambar dikhaya, sadqa talab kiya to woh kehne laga: "Wah wah! Yeh to Jizyah ki behan hai, yeh to bilkul aisa hi hai jaise kafiron se jizyah liya jata hai, yeh kya baat hai? Achha ab to jao, lotte hue aana."

Munafiqon ka momino ki hausla shikni ka ek andaz:
Munafiqon ki ek bad-khaslat yeh bhi hai ke unki zubanon se koi bhi bach nahi sakta, na sakhi na bakhil. Yeh aib-joo bad-go log bahut bure hain. Agar koi shakhs bari raqam Allah ki rah mein de to yeh use riyakaar kehne lagte hain aur agar koi miskeen apni mali kamzori ki bina par thora bahut de to yeh naak bhon charha kar kehte hain, "Lo, inki is haqeer cheez ka bhi Allah bhooka tha." 

Chunancha jab sadaqat dene ki aayat utri hai to Sahaba R.A apne apne sadaqat liye hue hazir hote hain. Ek sahib ne dil khol kar bahut bari raqam di to use in munafiqon ne riyakaar ka khitab diya. Bechare ek sahib miskeen aadmi the, sirf ek sa' anaj laye the, unhe kaha ke iske is sadqe ki Allah ko kya zaroorat pari thi? Iska bayan is aayat mein hai. 

Ek martaba Aap ﷺ ne Baqi' mein farmaya ke jo sadaqa dega, main uski babat Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne gawahi dunga. Us waqt ek Sahabi ne apne amame mein se kuch dena chaha lekin phir lapait liya. Itne mein ek sahib jo siyah rang aur chote qad ke the, ek oontni lekar aage barhe jinse zyada achhi oontni Baqi' bhar mein na thi. Kehne lage, "Ya Rasulallah ﷺ! Yeh Allah ke naam par khairat hai." Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bahut achha." Usne kaha, "Lijiye, sambhaliye." Is par kisi ne kaha, "Isse to oontni hi achhi hai." 

Aap ﷺ ne sun liya aur farmaya, "Tu jhoota hai, yeh tujh se aur isse teen guna achha hai. Afsos, sainkron oont rakhne wale tujh jeson par afsos!" Teen martaba yehi farmaya, phir farmaya, "Magar woh jo apne maal ko is tarah is tarah kare" aur hath bhar bhar kar Aap ﷺ ne apne hathon se dayen bayen ishara kiya, yaani rah-e-Khuda har naik kaam mein kharch kare. Phir farmaya, "Unhone fلاح pa li jo kam maal wale aur zyada ibadat wale hon."

Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf 40 uqiyah chandi laye aur ek ghareeb Ansari ek sa' anaj laye. Munafiqon ne ek ko riyakaar bataya, doosre ke sadqe ko haqeer keh diya. 

Ek martaba Aap ﷺ ke hukm se logon ne maal khairat dena aur jama karna shuru kiya. Ek sahib ek sa' khajoorain le aaye aur kehne lage, "Huzoor ﷺ! Mere paas khajooron ke do sa' the, ek main ne apne aur apne bachon ke liye rok liya aur ek le aaya." Aap ﷺ ne use bhi jama shuda maal mein dal dene ko farmaya. Is par munafiq bakwas karne lage ke Allah aur Rasul ﷺ to isse be-niyaz hain. 

Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne kaha, "Mere paas ek sau uqiyah sona hai, main yeh sab sadaqa karta hoon." 
Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya, "Hosh mein bhi hai?" 
Aap ne jawab diya, "Haan, hosh mein hoon." 
Farmaya, "Phir kya kar raha hai?" 
Aap ne farmaya, "Sunno, mere paas aath hazar hain jin mein se chaar hazar to main Allah ko qarz de raha hoon aur chaar hazar apne liye rakh leta hoon." 
Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala tujhe barkat de jo tu ne rakh liya hai aur jo tu ne kharch kar diya hai." 
Munafiq un par baten banane lage ke logon ko apni sakhawat dikhane ke liye itni bari raqam de di.

Pas Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utar kar bari rakam aur choti rakam walon ki sachai aur un munafiqon ka mozi pan zahir kar diya. Bani Ajlan ke Asim bin Adi (R.A) ne bhi us waqt bari rakam khairat mein di thi jo ek sau wasq par mushtamil thi. Munafiqon ne use riyakari par mahmul kiya tha. Apni mehnat mazduri ki thori si khairat dene wale Abu Aqeel thay. Yeh qabila Bani Aneef ke shakhs thay un ke ek sa'a khairat par munafiqon ne hansi aur hajju ki thi aur riwayat mein hai ki yeh chanda Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujahidin ki ek jama'at ko jihad par rawana karne ke liye kiya tha. Is riwayat mein hai ki Hazrat Abdur Rahman ne do hazaar rakhe thay. Dusre buzurg ne raat bhar ki mehnat mein do sa'a khajuren hasil kar ke ek sa'a rakh liya aur ek sa'a de diya. Yeh Hazrat Abu Aqeel (R.A) thay raat bhar apni peeth par bojh dhote rahe thay. Un ka naam Habab tha. Aur qaul hai ki Abdur Rahman bin Abdullah bin Thalaba tha. Pas munafiqon ke is tamskhur ki saza mein Allah ne hi un se yehi badla liya. In munafiqon ke liye akhirat mein alimnak azab hain aur un ke aamal ka un amaloon jaisa hi bura badla hai.

Munafiq ke liye istighfar karne ki mمانعت (mamanat) hai. Farmata hai ke yeh munafiq is qabil nahi ke aye Nabi tu un ke liye Allah se bakhshish talab kare, ek bar nahi agar tu sattar martaba bhi bakhshish un ke liye chahe to Allah unhein nahi bakhshega. Yeh jo sattar ka zikr hai is se murad sirf ziyadati hai, woh sattar se kam ho ya bahut zyada ho. Baaz ne kaha hai ke murad is se sattar ka hi adad hai. Chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke main to un ke liye sattar bar se bhi zyada istighfar karunga taake Allah unhein bakhsh de. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne ek aur ayat mein farmadiya ke un ke liye tera istighfar karna na karne ke barabar hai. Abdullah bin Ubayy munafiq ka beta Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz karta hai ke mera baap naz'a ki halat mein hai, meri khwahish hai ke aap us ke pas tashreef le chalein, us ke janaze ki namaz bhi padhein. Aap ne pucha tera naam kya hai? Us ne kaha Hubab. Aap ne farmaya tera naam Abdullah hai, Hubab to shaitan ka naam hai. Ab aap un ke sath hue, un ke baap ko apna kurta apne paseene wala pehnaya, us ke janaze ki namaz padhai. Aap se kaha bhi gaya ke aap us ke janaze par namaz padh rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne sattar martaba ke istighfar se bhi na bakhshne ko farmaya hai to main sattar bar phir sattar bar phir sattar bar phir istighfar karunga.

Jahannum ki aag kaali hai jo log Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nahin gaye thay aur gharon mein hi baithne par akad rahe thay. Jinhein Rah-e-Khuda mein maal o jaan se jihad karna mushkil maloom hota tha jinhon ne ek doosre ke kaan bhare thay ke is garmi mein kahan niklo ge? Ek taraf phal pakke hue hain saaye badhe hue hain doosri jaanib loo ke thappade chal rahe hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala un se farmata hai ke Jahannum ki aag jis ki taraf tum apni is bad-kirdari se ja rahe ho woh is garmi se zyada badhi hui hararat apne andar rakhti hai. Yeh aag to us aag ka satrawan hissa hai jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai aur riwayat mein hai ke tumhari yeh aag aatish-e-dozakh ke satar ajzaa mein se ek juz hai phir bhi yeh samandar ke paani mein do dafa bujhayi hui hai warna tum us se koi faida hasil na kar sakte. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ek hazar saal tak aatish-e-dozakh dhonki gayi to surkh ho gayi phir ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi to safed ho gayi phir ek hazar saal tak dhonki gayi to siyah ho gayi pas woh andheri raat jaisi sakht siyah hai. Ek baar aap ne (Yaa Ayyuhal-Lazeena Aamanoo Qoo Anfusakum wa Ahleekum Naaranw wa Qooduhan-Naasu wal-Hijaaratu ‘Alaiha Malaaikatun Gilaazun Shidaadun Laa Ya’soon-Allah Ma Amarahum wa Yaf’aloona Ma Yu’maroon) (At-Tahrim: 6) ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ek hazar saal tak jalaye jaane se woh safed pad gayi phir ek hazar saal tak bhadkane se surkh ho gayi phir ek hazar saal tak dhonke jaane se siyah ho gayi pas woh siyah raat jaisi hai us ke sholon mein bhi chamak nahin. Ek hadith mein hai ke agar dozakh ki aag ki ek chingari mashriq mein ho to uski hararat maghrib tak pahunch jaaye. Abu Yala ki ek ghareeb riwayat mein hai ke agar is masjid mein ek lakh balki us se bhi zyada aadmi hon aur koi jahannami yahan aa kar saans le to uski garmi se masjid aur masjid wale sab jal jayenge. Aur hadith mein hai ke sab se halke azaab wala dozakh mein woh hoga jis ke dono paon mein do jotیاں aag ki tasme samet hongi jis ki garmi se uski khopdi ubal rahi hogi aur woh samajh raha hoga ke sab se zyada sakht azaab usi ko ho raha hai halanki darasal sab se halka azaab usi ka hai. Quran farmata hai ke woh aag aisi shola-zan hai jo khaal utaar deti hai. Aur kayi aayton mein hai un ke saron par kholta hua garam paani bahaya jayega. Jis se un ke pait ki tamam cheezein aur un ki khaalein jhulas jayengi phir lohe ke hathodon se un ke sar kachle jayenge. Woh jab wahan se nikalna chahenge usi mein lota diye jayenge aur kaha jayega ke jalne ka azaab chakho. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke jin logon ne hamari aayton se inkar kiya unhein hum bhadakti hui aag mein daal denge un ki khaalein jhulasti jayengi aur hum un khaalon ke badle aur khaalein badalte jayenge ke woh khoob azaab chakhen.

Is ayat mein bhi farmaya hai ke agar unhein samajh hoti toh woh jaan lete ke jahannam ki aag ki garmi aur tezi bahut zyada hai. Toh yaqinan yeh bawajood mausami garmi ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath jihad mein khushi khushi nikalte aur apne jaan o maal ko rah-e-Allah mein fida karne par tul jaate. Arab ka shair kehta hai ke tu ne apni umar sardi garmi se bachne ki koshish mein guzar di halanke tujhe laiq tha ke Allah ki nafarmaniyon se bachta ke jahannam ki aag se bach jaye. Ab Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala in bad-batin munafiqon ko dara raha hai ke thodi si zindagi mein yahan toh jitna chahein hans lein. Lekin is aane wali zindagi mein in ke liye rona hai jo kabhi khatam na hoga. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke logo roo aur rona na aaye toh zabardasti roo jahannami royeinge yahan tak ke un ke rukhsaaron par nahar jaise gadhe padjayein ge aakhir aansu khatam hojayein ge ab aankhein khoon barsane lagein gi un ki aankhon se is qadar aansu aur khoon beha hoga ke agar koi is mein kashti chalani chahe toh chala sakta hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke jahannami jahannam mein royeinge aur khoob rote raheinge, aansu khatam hone ke baad peep nikalna shuru hoga. Us waqt dozakh ke daroghe un se kahein ge ae badbakht raham ki jagah toh tum kabhi ho na roye ab yahan ka rona dhona lahasil hai. Ab yeh oonchi aawazon se chala chala kar jannatiyon se faryaad karein ge ke tum log hamare rishte qanbe ke ho suno hum qabron se pyase uthe the phir maidan-e-hashar mein bhi pyase hi rahe aur aaj tak yahan bhi pyase hi hain, hum par raham karo kuch pani hamare halq mein chho do ya jo rozi Allah ne tumhe di hai is mein se hi thoda bahut hamein de do. Chaalis saal tak koton ki tarah cheekhte raheinge chaalis saal ke baad unhein jawab milega ke tum yunhi dhatkaye hue bhooke pyase hi in sadrail aur atal sakht azabon mein pade raho ab yeh tamam bhalaiyon se mayous hojayein ge.

Makaron ki Saza

Farman hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala tujhe salamati ke sath is ghazwe se wapas Madine pohncha de aur un mein se koi jamaat tujh se kisi aur ghazwe mein tere sath chalne ki darkhwast kare to ba-taur un ko saza dene ke to saaf keh dena ke na to tum mere sath walon mein mere sath chal sakte ho na tum meri hamrahi mein dushmanon se jang kar sakte ho. Tum jab moqe par dagha de gaye aur pehli martaba hi baith rahe to ab taiyari ke kya ma'ne?

Pas yeh ayat misal (Wa nuqallibu af'idatahum wa absarahum kama lam yu'minu bihi awwala marratin wa nadaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahun) (Al-An'am: 110) ke hai. Badi ka bura badla badi ke baad milta hai jaise ke neki ki jaza bhi neki ke baad milti hai.

Umrah-e-Hudaibiyah ke waqt Qurani ne farmaya tha (Sa yaqulul mukhallafuna izantalaqtum ila maganima lita'khuzuha zaruna nattabi'kum) (Al-Fath: 15) ya'ni jab tum ghanimatein lene chaloge yeh peechhe reh jane wale log tum se kahenge ke hamein ijazat do hum bhi tumhare sath ho lein. Yahan farmaya ke un se keh dena ke baith rehne walon mein hi tum bhi raho. Jo auraton ki tarah gharon mein ghuse rehte hain.

Munafiqon ka janaza

Hukum hota hai ke Ae Nabi tum munafiqon se bilkul be-taalluq ho jao. In mein se koi mar jaye to tum na uske janaze ki namaz parho na uski qabar par ja kar iske liye dua-e-istighfar karo. Is liye ke yeh kufr-o-fisq par zinda rahe aur is par mare. Yeh hukum to aam hai go is ka shan-e-nuzul khas Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ke bare mein hai jo munafiqon ka raees aur imam tha. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke is ke marne par is ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdullah Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur darkhwast ki ke mere baap ke kafan ke liye aap khas apna pehna hua kurta inayat farmaiye. Aap ne de diya. Phir kaha ke aap khud is ke janaze ki namaz parhaiye. Aap ne yeh darkhwast bhi manzoor farma li aur namaz parhane ke irade se uthe lekin Hazrat Umar ؓ ne aap ka daman thaam liya aur arz ki ke Huzoor ﷺ aap is ke janaze ki namaz parhayenge? Halanki Allah Ta'ala ne is se mana farmaya hai. Aap ne farmaya suno Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya hai ke tu in ke liye istighfar kare ya na kare agar tu in ke liye sattar martaba bhi istighfar karega to bhi Allah Ta'ala inhein nahi bakhshega. To main sattar martaba se bhi zyada istighfar karunga. 

Hazrat Umar ؓ farmane lage Ya Rasool Allah yeh munafiq tha lekin taham Huzoor ﷺ ne is ke janaze ki namaz parhai. Is par yeh aayat utri. 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is namaz mein sahaba bhi aap ki iqtida mein the. Ek riwayat mein hai Hazrat Umar ؓ farmate hain ke jab aap is ki namaz ke liye khare ho gaye to main saff mein se nikal kar aap ke samne aa kar khara ho gaya aur kaha ke kya aap is dushman-e-Rab Abdullah bin Ubayy ke janaze ki namaz parhayenge? Halanki falan din is ne yun kaha aur falan din yun kaha. Uski woh tamam baatein doharayein. Huzoor ﷺ muskurate hue sab sunte rahe aakhir mein farmaya Umar mujhe chor de. Allah Ta'ala ne istighfar ka mujhe ikhtiyar diya hai agar mujhe maloom ho jaye ke sattar martaba se zyada istighfar in ke gunah maaf kara sakta hai to main yaqinan sattar martaba se zyada istighfar karunga. 

Chanacha aap ne namaz bhi parhai janaze ke sath bhi chale dafan ke waqt bhi maujood rahe. Is ke baad mujhe apni is gustakhi par bahut hi afsos hone laga ke Allah aur Rasool Allah khoob ilm wale hain maine aisi aur is qadar jurrat kyun ki? Kuch hi dair hogi ke yeh dono aayetein nazil ho gayin. Is ke baad aakhir dam tak na Huzoor ﷺ ne kisi munafiq ke janaze ki namaz parhi na uski qabar par aa kar dua ki. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke is ke sahibzade ؓ ne aap se yeh bhi kaha tha ke agar aap tashreef na laye to hamesha ke liye yeh baat hum par reh jaye gi. Jab aap tashreef laye to use qabar mein utar diya gaya tha aap ne farmaya is se pehle mujhe kyun na laye? Chanacha woh qabar se nikala gaya. Aap ne is ke sare jism par thatkar dam kiya aur use apna kurta pehnaya. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke woh khud yeh wasiyat karke mara tha ke is ke janaze ki namaz khud Rasool Allah ﷺ parhayein.

Us ke larke ne aakar Huzoor ﷺ ko is ki aarzoo aur is ki aakhri vasiyat ki bhi khabar di. Aur yeh bhi kaha ke is ki vasiyat yeh bhi hai ke isay aap ke pairahan mein kafnaya jaye. Aap is ke janazey ki namaz se farigh huway hi thay ke Hazrat Jibraeel yeh aayatein lekar utray. Aur rivayat mein hai ke Jibraeel ne aap ka daman taan kar namaz ke iraday ke waqt yeh aayat sunai lekin yeh rivayat zaeef hai aur rivayat mein hai is ne apni beemari ke zamane mein Huzoor ko bulaya aap tashreef le gaye aur ja kar farmaya ke yahoodiyon ki mohabbat ne tujhe tabaah kardiya is ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yeh waqt daant dapt ka nahi balkay meri khwahish hai ke aap mere liye dua-e-istighfar karein main mar jaon to mujhay apne pairahan mein kafnayein. Baaz salaf se marwi hai ke kurta dene ki wajah yeh thi ke jab Hazrat Abbas ؓ aaye to un ke jism par kisi ka kapra theek nahi aaya aakhir is ka kurta liya woh theek aagaya yeh bhi lamba chora chori chakli haddi ka aadmi tha. Pas is ke badlay mein aap ne usay is ke kafan ke liye apna kurta ata farmaya. Is aayat ke utrne ke baad na to kisi munafiq ke janazey ki namaz aap ne parhi na kisi ke liye istighfar kiya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jab aap ko kisi janazey ki taraf bulaya jata to aap pooch lete agar logon se bhalaiyan maloom hotin to aap ja kar is ke janazey ki namaz parhatay aur agar koi aisi waisi baat kaan mein parti to saaf inkaar karde-tay. Hazrat Umar ؓ ka tareeqa aap ke baad yeh raha ke jis ke janazey ki namaz Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ parhtay is ke janazey ki namaz aap bhi parhtay jis ki Hazrat Huzaifa na parhtay aap bhi na parhtay is liye ke Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ ko Huzoor ﷺ ne munafiqon ke naam ginwa diye thay aur sirf unhi ko yeh naam maloom thay isi bina par unhein Raazdar-e-Rasool kaha jata tha. Balkay ek martaba aisa bhi hua ke Hazrat Umar ؓ ek shakhs ke janazey ki namaz ke liye khara hone lage to Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ ne chutki lekar unhein rok diya. Janazey ki namaz aur istighfar in donon cheezon se munafiqon ke baare mein musalmanon ko rok dena. Yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke musalmanon ke baare mein in donon cheezon ki poori takeed hai. In mein murdon ke liye poora nafa aur zindon ke liye kamil ajr-o-sawab hai. Chunacha hadees-e-shareef hai aap farmatay hain jo janazey mein jaye aur namaz parhe jane tak sath rahe usay ek qirat sawab milta hai aur jo dafan tak sath rahe usay do qirat miltay hain. Poocha gaya ke qirat kya hai? Farmaya sab se chhota qirat Uhad pahaad ke barabar hota hai. Isi tarah yeh bhi Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarakah thi ke mayyat ke dafan se farigh ho kar wahin is ki qabar ke paas thehar kar hukum farmatay ke apne sathi ke liye istighfar karo is ke liye sabit-qadmi ki dua karo is se us waqt sawal jawab ho raha hai.
Isi mazmoon ki ayat-e-karimah guzar chuki hai aur wahin uski poori tafsir bhi bihamdillah likh di gayi hai jis ke dohrane ki zaroorat nahi.

In logon ki burai bayan ho rahi hai jo wus'at, taqat, quwwat hone ke bawajood jihad ke liye nahi nikalte, ji churaate hain aur hukum-e-Rabbani sun kar phir Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aa aa kar apne ruk rehne ki ijazat chahte hain. Unki beham-e-ti toh dekho ke yeh aurton jaise ho gaye hain, lashkar chale gaye, yeh namard zanaane aurton ki tarah peeche reh gaye. Waqt-e-jang buzdal, darpok aur gharon mein ghuse rehne wale, waqt-e-amn barh barh kar baatein banane wale. Yeh bhonkne wale kutton aur garajne wale badalon ki tarah dhol ke pol hain. Chunancha aur jagah khud Quran-e-Kareem ne bayan farmaya hai ke khauf ke waqt aisi aankhein pherne lagte hain jaise koi mar raha ho aur jahan woh mauqa guzar gaya lage charb-zubaani karne aur lambe chaure dawe karne, baatein banane. Jihad aur Ma'zoor Log

Yeh bayaan un logon ka hai jo haqeeqatan kisi shar'i uzr ke baais jihad mein shamil na ho sakte thay. Madina ke ird-gird ke yeh log aa kar apni kamzori-o-zaeefi be-taqati bayaan kar ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ se ijazat lete hain ke agar Huzoor ﷺ unhein waqai ma'zoor samjhein toh ijazat de dein. Yeh Banu Ghffar ke qabele ke log thay. 

Ibn Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein (Wa ja'al-mu'azziroona minal-a'rabi liyu'znahum wa qa'adallazeena kazabullaha wa rasoolahu sayusibullazeena kafaroo minhum 'azabun aleem) [9 Taubah: 90] hai ya'ni ahl-e-uzr log. Yahi ma'ana matlab ziyada zahir hai kyunke usi jumle ke baad un logon ka bayaan hai jo jhoote thay. Yeh na aaye na apna ruk jaane ka sabab pesh kiya na Huzoor ﷺ se ruk rehne ki ijazat chahi. 

Ba'z buzurg farmate hain ke uzr pesh karne wale bhi darasal uzr wale na thay. Isi liye unke uzr maqbool na hue lekin pehla qaul pehla hi hai wohi ziyada zahir hai Wallahu A'lam. Iski ek wajah toh wohi hai jo humne upar bayaan ki doosri wajah yeh hai ke azab ka hukm bhi unhi ke liye hoga jo baithe rahe rahe.

Adam-e-Jihad ke shar'i uzr:

Is aayat mein un shar'i uzron ka bayan ho raha hai jin ke hote hue agar koi shakhs jihad mein na jaye to us par shar'i harj nahi. Pas un sababun mein se ek qism to woh hai jo lazmi hoti hai kisi halat mein insan se alag nahi hotin jaise paidaishi kamzori ya andha pan ya langra pan, koi loola langra ya apahaj, bimar ya bilkul hi nataqat ho. Doosri qism ke woh uzr hote hain jo kabhi hain aur kabhi nahi, ittefaqiya asbab mein maslan koi bimar ho gaya hai ya bilkul faqir ho gaya hai, saman-e-safar saman-e-jihad muhayya nahi kar sakte waghera. 

Pas yeh log شرکت-e-jihad (shirkat-e-jihad) na kar saken to un par shara'an koi muwakhza, gunah ya aar nahi, lekin unhein apne dil mein salahiyat aur khulus rakhna chahiye. Musalmanon ke, Allah ke deen ke khair khwah bane rahein, auron ko jihad par aamada karein. Baithe baithe jo khidmat mujahideen ki anjam de sakte hon dete rahein. Aise naik karon par koi wajah-e-ilzam nahi. Allah bakhshne wala meharban hai.

Hawariyon ne Isa Nabiullah se pucha ke hamein bataiye Allah ka khair khwah kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo Allah ke haq ko logon ke haq par muqaddam kare aur jab ek kaam deen ka aur ek duniya ka aa jaye to deeni kaam ki ahmiyat ka poora lihaz rakhe phir farig ho kar duniyawi kaam ko anjam de.

Ek martaba qaht-sali ke mauqe par log namaz-e-istisqa ke liye maidan mein nikle, un mein Hazrat Bilal bin Sa'd bhi the. Aap ne khade ho kar Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ki phir farmaya: "Ae hazirin! Kya tum yeh mante ho ke tum sab Allah ke gunehgar bande ho?" Sab ne ikrar kiya. Ab aap ne dua shuru ki ke "Parwardigar! Hum ne tere kalam mein suna padha hai ke naik bandon par koi mushkil nahi. Hum apni buraiyon ka ikrar karte hain, pas tu humein maaf farma, hum par rahem farma, hum par apni rehmat se barishein barsa." Ab aap ne hath uthaye aur aap ke sath hi aur sab ne bhi hath uthaye, rehmat-e-ilahi josh mein aayi aur usi waqt jhoom jhoom kar rehmat ki badliyan barasne lagein.

Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) ka bayan hai ke main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka munshi tha, Surah Bara'at jab utar rahi thi main use bhi likh raha tha, mere kaan mein qalam uda hua tha, jihad ki aayatein utar rahi thin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muntazir the ke dekhein ke ab kya hukum nazil hota hai? Itne mein ek nabina sahabi aaye aur kehne lage: "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main jihad ke ahkaam is andhape mein kaise baja la sakta hoon?" Usi waqt yeh aayat utri.

Phir un ka zikr hota hai jo jihad ki shirkat ke liye tadapte hain magar qudrati asbab se majboor ho kar badil-na-khwasta ruk jate hain. Jihad ka hukum hua, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka elan hua, mujahideen ka lashkar jama hona shuru hua to ek jamat aayi jin mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mughaffal bin Muqarrin Muzani waghera the, unhon ne kaha ke "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hamare paas sawariyan nahi, aap hamari sawariyon ka intezam kar dein taaki hum bhi rah-e-haq mein jihad karne aur aap ki hamrakabi ka shraf hasil karein." Aap ne jawab diya ke "Wallah! Mere paas to ek bhi sawari nahi."

Yeh na-umeed ho kar rote peete gham-zada aur ranjeeda ho kar lote, un par is se ziyada bhaari bojh koi na tha ke yeh us waqt ham- رکابی (ham-rikabi) ki aur jihad ki saadat se mahroom reh gaye aur aurton ki tarah unhein yeh muddat gharon mein guzaarni padegi, na un ke paas khud hi kuch hai na kahin se kuch milta hai, pas Janab-e-Bari ne yeh ayat nazil farma kar un ki taskeen kardi. 

Yeh ayat qabila Muzaina ki shakh Bani Muqran ke bare mein utri hai. Muhammad bin Ka'b ka bayan hai ke yeh saat aadmi the: Bani Amr ke Salim bin Awf, Bani Waqif ke Harami bin Amr, Bani Mazin ke Abdul Rahman bin Ka'b, Bani Ma'lla ke Fazlullah, Bani Salma ke Amr bin Uthma aur Abdullah bin Amr Muzni aur Banu Haritha ke Aliya bin Zaid. Ba'z riwayaton mein kuch namon mein her-pher bhi hai. 

Inhi naik niyat buzurgon ke bare mein Allah ke Rasool, Rasoolon ke sartaj ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke: "Aisay mere mujahid sathiyo! Tum ne Madine mein jo log apne peechhe chhode hain, un mein woh bhi hain ke tum jo kharch karte ho, jis maidan mein chalte ho, jo jihad karte ho, sab mein woh bhi sawab ke shareek hain." 

Phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sun kar Sahaba ne kaha: "Woh bawajood apne gharon mein rehne ke sawab mein hamare shareek hain?" 

Aap ne farmaya: "Haan, is liye ke woh mazoor hain, uzr ke baais ruke hain." 

Ek aur ayat mein hai: "Unhein bimariyon ne rok liya hai." 

Phir un logon ka bayan farmaya jinhein fi-waqt koi uzr nahi, maldar, hatte-katte hain, lekin phir bhi sarkar-e-nubuwwat mein aa kar bahane tarash tarash kar jihad mein sath nahi dete, aurton ki tarah ghar mein baith jate hain, zameen pakad lete hain. 

Farmaya: "Un ki bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se un ke dilon par Allah ki mohar lag chuki hai, ab woh apne bhale bure ke ilm se bhi kore ho gaye hain."

Phir un ka zikr hota hai jo jihad ki shirkat ke liye tadapte hain magar qudrati asbab se majboor ho kar badil-na-khwasta ruk jate hain. Jihad ka hukum hua, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka elan hua, mujahideen ka lashkar jama hona shuru hua to ek jamat aayi jin mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mughaffal bin Muqarrin Muzani waghera the, unhon ne kaha ke "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hamare paas sawariyan nahi, aap hamari sawariyon ka intezam kar dein taaki hum bhi rah-e-haq mein jihad karne aur aap ki hamrakabi ka shraf hasil karein." Aap ne jawab diya ke "Wallah! Mere paas to ek bhi sawari nahi."

Yeh na-umeed ho kar rote peete gham-zada aur ranjeeda ho kar lote, un par is se ziyada bhaari bojh koi na tha ke yeh us waqt ham- رکابی (ham-rikabi) ki aur jihad ki saadat se mahroom reh gaye aur aurton ki tarah unhein yeh muddat gharon mein guzaarni padegi, na un ke paas khud hi kuch hai na kahin se kuch milta hai, pas Janab-e-Bari ne yeh ayat nazil farma kar un ki taskeen kardi. 

Yeh ayat qabila Muzaina ki shakh Bani Muqran ke bare mein utri hai. Muhammad bin Ka'b ka bayan hai ke yeh saat aadmi the: Bani Amr ke Salim bin Awf, Bani Waqif ke Harami bin Amr, Bani Mazin ke Abdul Rahman bin Ka'b, Bani Ma'lla ke Fazlullah, Bani Salma ke Amr bin Uthma aur Abdullah bin Amr Muzni aur Banu Haritha ke Aliya bin Zaid. Ba'z riwayaton mein kuch namon mein her-pher bhi hai. 

Inhi naik niyat buzurgon ke bare mein Allah ke Rasool, Rasoolon ke sartaj ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke: "Aisay mere mujahid sathiyo! Tum ne Madine mein jo log apne peechhe chhode hain, un mein woh bhi hain ke tum jo kharch karte ho, jis maidan mein chalte ho, jo jihad karte ho, sab mein woh bhi sawab ke shareek hain." 

Phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sun kar Sahaba ne kaha: "Woh bawajood apne gharon mein rehne ke sawab mein hamare shareek hain?" 

Aap ne farmaya: "Haan, is liye ke woh mazoor hain, uzr ke baais ruke hain." 

Ek aur ayat mein hai: "Unhein bimariyon ne rok liya hai." 

Phir un logon ka bayan farmaya jinhein fi-waqt koi uzr nahi, maldar, hatte-katte hain, lekin phir bhi sarkar-e-nubuwwat mein aa kar bahane tarash tarash kar jihad mein sath nahi dete, aurton ki tarah ghar mein baith jate hain, zameen pakad lete hain. 

Farmaya: "Un ki bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se un ke dilon par Allah ki mohar lag chuki hai, ab woh apne bhale bure ke ilm se bhi kore ho gaye hain."

Fasiq aur Chuhe ki Mumasilat

Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmata hai ki jab tum maidan-e-jihad se wapas Madine pahunchoge toh sabhi munafiq uzr-o-mazrat karne lagenge. Tum unse saaf keh dena ki hum tumhari un baaton mein nahi aayenge. Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari niyaton se humein khabardar kar diya hai. Duniya mein hi Allah Ta'ala tumhare kartoot sab logon ke saamne khol kar rakh dega. Phir aakhirat mein toh tumhein Allah Ta'ala ke saamne pesh hona hi hai woh zahir-o-batin ka janne wala hai. Tumhare ek ek kaam ka badla dega khair-o-shar ki jaza, saza sab bhugatni padegi. 

Phir irshad hota hai ki yeh log tum ko razi karne ke liye apni mazduri aur majboori ko sach sabit karne ke liye qasmein tak khayenge. Tum unhein munh bhi na lagana. Unke etiqad najas hain unka batin batil hai. Aakhirat mein unka thikana jahannam hai. Jo unke khataon aur gunahon ka badla hai. Sun unki khwahish sirf tumhein razamand karna hai aur bilfarz tum unse razi ho bhi jao. Toh bhi Allah Ta'ala in badkaron se kabhi razi nahi hoga. Yeh Allah-o-Rasool ki ita'at se baahar hain. Shariat se kharij hain. 

Chuha chunke bil se bigaad karne ke liye nikalta hai isliye Arab ise Fowaiqa kehte hain (Fasiq ki tasgeer). Isi tarah khushe se jab tari zahir hoti hai toh kehte hain Fasaqatir-Rutbah, pas yeh chunke Allah-o-Rasool ki ita'at se nikal jaate hain isliye unhein Fasiq kehte hain.

Dehat, sehra aur shehar har jagah insani fitrat yaksan hai. Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ki dehatiyon aur sehra-nisheen baduon mein kuffar-o-munafiq bhi hain aur momin musalman bhi hain. Lekin kafiron aur munafiqon ka kufr-o-nifaq nihayat sakht hai. Un mein is baat ki mutlaqan ahliyat nahi ki woh Allah Ta'ala ki un hadon ka ilm hasil karein jo usne apne Rasul ﷺ par nazil farmai hain.

Chunache ek a'rabi Hazrat Zaid bin Sohan ke paas baitha hua tha us waqt yeh is majlis mein logon ko kuch bayaan farma rahe thay. Nahawand wale din unka hath kat gaya tha. A'rabi bol utha ki aap ki baton se to aap ki mohabbat mere dil mein paida hoti hai, lekin aap ka yeh kata hua hath mujhe aur hi shubah mein dalta hai. Aap ne farmaya isse tumhein kya shak hua yeh to bayan hath hai. To a'rabi ne kaha, Wallahi mujhe nahi maloom ki dayan hath kahte hain ya bayan? Unhon ne farmaya Allah Azzawajal ne sach farmaya ki a'rab bade hi sakht kufr-o-nifaq wale aur Allah ki hadon ke bilkul hi na janne wale hain.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai: "Jo badiyah-nisheen hua usne ghalat-o-jafa ki. Aur jo shikar ke peeche pad gaya usne ghaflat ki. Aur jo badshah ke paas pahuncha woh fitne mein pada." Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Nisai mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib kehte hain.

Chunke sehra-nisheenos mein umuman sakhti aur bad-khulqi hoti hai, Allah Azzawajal ne un mein se kisi ko apni risalat ke sath mumtaz nahi farmaya balki Rasul hamesha shehari log hote rahe. Jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai: (Ayat: Wa ma arsalna min qablika illa rijalan nuhi ilaihim min ahlil qura) (12:109) - Humne tujh se pehle jitne bhi Rasul bheje sab insan mard thay jin ki taraf hum wahi nazil farmate thay woh sab mutamaddan bastiyon ke log thay.

Ek a'rabi ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko kuch hadiya pesh kiya, Aap ﷺ ne us ke hadiye se kayi guna zyada inaam diya jab ja kar ba-mushkil tamam razi hua. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ab se maine qasd kiya hai ki siwaye Quraishi, Thaqafi, Ansori ya Dosi ke kisi ka tuhfa qubool na karunga." Yeh is liye ki yeh charon sheharon ke rehne wale thay, Makkah, Ta'if, Madinah aur Yemen ke log thay, pas yeh fitratan un badiyah-nisheenos ki nisbat narm akhlaq aur door-andesh log thay, un mein a'rab jaisi sakhti aur khurdra-pan na tha.

Allah khoob jaanta hai ki iman-o-ilm ata farmai jane ka ahl kaun hai? Woh apne bandon mein iman-o-kufr, ilm-o-jahl, nifaq-o-Islam ki taqseen mein ba-hikmat hai. Us ke zabardast ilm ki wajah se us ke kamon ki baaz-purs isse koi nahi kar sakta. Aur is hikmat ki wajah se us ka koi kaam be-ja nahi hota.

In badiyah-nisheenos mein woh bhi hain jo Allah ki rah ke kharch ko na-haq aur tawan aur apna sarih nuqsan jaante hain aur har waqt isi ke muntazir rehte hain ki tum musalmanon par kab bala-o-musibat aaye, kab tum hawaadis-o-afat mein ghir jao. Lekin un ki yeh bad-khwahi unhi ke aage aaye gi, unhi par burai ka zawaal aaye ga. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki duaaon ka sunne wala hai.

Aur khoob jaanta hai kaun mustahiq-e-imdad kaun hai aur zillat ke laiq kaun hai. Duaon ke talabgaar muttabi' hain, mubtadi' nahi. A'raab ki is kaum ko bayan farma kar ab un mein se bhale logon ka haal bayan ho raha hai, woh Allah par iman rakhte hain, akhirat ko maante hain. Rah-e-haq mein kharch kar ke Allah ki qurbat talash karte hain, sath hi Rasool Allah ﷺ ki duaen lete hain. Beshak un ko Allah ki qurbat haasil hai. Allah unhein apni rehmaten ata kar dega. Woh bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.
