Sabiqon ko Basharat

Is mubarak aayat mein Allah Tabarak Wa Ta'ala un Muhajireen-o-Ansar se jo sabqat le jaane walon mein awwaleen the aur un ki taabedaari karne ki wajah se unhein apni raza-mandi ka izhar farma raha hai ke unhein ne'amaton wali abdi jannatein aur hamesha ki ne'amatein milein gi. Sha'bi kehte hain "Un se murad woh Muhajir-o-Ansar hain jo Hudaibiyah wale saal Bai'at-ur-Rizwan mein shareek the". Lekin Hazrat Musa Ash'ari waghairah se marwi hai ke "Jinhon ne donon qiblon ki taraf namaz parhi thi". Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne ek shakhs ko is aayat ki tilawat karte hue sun kar is ka hath pakad kar daryaft farmaya ke tumhein yeh aayat kis ne parha'i hai? Us ne kaha Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'b (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne. Aap ne farmaya tum mere sath un ke pas chalo. Jab un ke pas pahunche to aap ne poocha tum ne ise yeh aayat isi tarah parha'i hai? Aap ne farmaya haan aap ne poocha kya tum ne Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ise sunna hai? Unhon ne jawab diya haan. Aap ne farmaya mera to khayal tha ke jis buland darje par hum pahunche hain is par hamare baad koi nah pahunche ga. Hazrat Ubayy (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya is aayat ki tasdeeq Surah Juma'h ki (aayat Wa Akhareena Minhum etc.) se aur Surah Hashr ki ("Wal-lazeena ja'oo min ba'dihim yaqooloona Rabbana-ghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-lazeena sabaqoona bil-eemani wa la taj'al fee quloobina ghillal-lil-lazeena aamanoo Rabbana innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem" 59. (Al-Hashr: 10) se aur Surah Anfal ki ("Wal-lazeena aamanoo wa hajaro wa jahadoo fee sabeelillahi wal-lazeena aawaw wa nasaroo ula'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqan lahum maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem" 8. (Al-Anfal: 74) se bhi hoti hai. Hazrat Hasan "Wal-Ansara" parhte the aur mazkoorah aayat ya'ni Wal-Sabiqoona... etc. par 'atf daal kar parhte. Allah Ta'ala 'Azeem-o-Kabeer khabar deta hai ke woh Sabiqeen Awwaleen Muhajir-o-Ansar se khush hai aur un se bhi khush jo ihsan ke sath un ke muttabi' hain. Afsos un par hai, khanah kharab woh hain jo un se dushmani rakhein, unhein bura kahein ya un mein se kisi ek ko bhi bura kahein ya is se dushmani rakhein. Khususan sahabah Ansar-o-Muhajireen ke sardar sab se behtar-o-afzal Siddeeq-e-Akbar Khaleefah 'Azeem Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se jo bhi bughz rakhe ya un ki shan mein koi gustakhi ka kalmah bole Allah us se naraz hai. Ruswa-e-makhlooq Rafziyon ka badtareen giroh afzal sahabah ko bura kehta hai, un se dushmani rakhta hai. Allah us se apni panah mein rakhe. Yehi baat daleel hai is par ke un ki aqlein ulti hain aur un ke dil oondhe hain. Unhein Quran par eeman kahan hai? Jab ke yeh un par tabarra bhejte hain jin ki baabat Quran mein Allah Ta'ala ki raza-mandi ka izhar khule lafzon mein bayan karta hai. (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een). Haan Ahl-e-Sunnat un se khush hain jin se Allah Ta'ala razi hai aur un ko bura kehte hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne bura kaha hai. Allah ke doston se woh muhabbat karte hain.

Allah ke dushmanon ke woh bhi dushman hain. Woh muttabi' hain mubtadi' nahin. Woh pairawi aur iqtida karte hain. Nafarmani aur khilaf nahin karte. Yehi jama'at Allah Ta'ala se kamyabi hasil karne wali hai aur yehi Allah ke sacche bande hain, Katharahumullah.))

Munafaqat ke khugar shahri

Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko batlata hai ke "Madine ke ard-gird rehne wale ganwaron mein aur khud Ahl-e-Madinah mein bahut se munafiq hain. Jo barabar apne nfaq ke khugar ho chuke hain". "Tamarrada fulan 'alallah" is waqt kehte hain jab koi Allah Ta'ala ke samne sarkashi aur nafarmani kare. Phir farmata hai ke tum to unhein jaante nahin hum jaante hain. Aur aayat mein hai "Agar hum chahein to tujhe aur unko dikha dein aur tu unki alaamaat aur chehron se unhein pehchan le. Yaqeenan tu unhein unki baaton ke lab-o-lehje se jaan le ga." Gharaz un donon aayaton mein koi farq nah samajhna chahiye. Nishaniyon se pehchan lena aur baat hai aur Allah ki taraf ka qat'i ilm ke fulan fulan munafiq hai aur cheez hai pas ba'az munafiq logon ki munafaqat Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par khul gayi thi magar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka tamam munafiqon ko jaanna mumkin nahin tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to sirf itna jaante the ke Madine mein ba'az munafiq hain. Subh-o-sham woh darbar-e-risalat mein hazir raha karte the aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nigahon ke samne the. Is qaul ki sihhat Musnad Ahmad ki is hadees se bhi hoti hai. Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne ek martaba Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke log kehte hain ke Makkah ka hamara koi ajr nahin. Aap ne farmaya tumhare paas tumhare ajr aa hi jaayein ge go tum lomri ke bhat mein ho. Phir Aap ne unke kaan se apna munh laga kar farmaya ke mere in saathiyon mein bhi munafiq hain. Pas matlab yeh hua ke ba'az munafiq ghalat salat baatein bak diya karte hain, yeh bhi aisi hi baat hai.

("Wa hammoo bima lam yanaaloo wa ma naqamoo illa an aghnaahumullahu wa rasooluhu min fazlihi fa in yatooboo yaku khairal lahum wa in yatawallaw yu'azzibhumullahu 'azaaban aleeman fid-dunya wal-aakhirah wa ma lahum fil-arzi miw waliyyiw wa la naseer" - Surah At-Tawbah: 74) ki tafseer mein hum keh aaye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Huzaifah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko barah ya pandrah munafiqon ke naam bataye the. Pas is se bhi yeh saabit nahin hota ke ek ek kar ke tamam munafiqon ka Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ilm tha. Nahin balke chand makhsoos logon ka Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko ilm kara diya tha wallahu a'lam. Ibn Asakir mein hai ke "Harmalah naami ek shakhs Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga eeman to yahan hai aur apni zaban ki taraf ishara kiya. Aur nfaq yahan hai aur hath se apne dil ki taraf ishara kiya aur nahin zikr kiya Allah ka magar thoda. Pas Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki: Ae Allah ise zikr karne wali zaban, shukr karne wala dil de aur ise meri aur mujh se muhabbat rakhne walon ki muhabbat inayat farma aur is ke kaam ka anjam ba-khair kar. Ab to woh kehne laga Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere saathiy aur bhi hain jin ka main sardar tha, woh sab bhi munafiq hain agar ijazat ho to unhein bhi le aaon.

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno jo hamare paas aayega hum uske liye istaghfar karein ge aur jo apne deen (nifaq) par aada rahega Allah hi us ke saath aula hai. Tum kisi ki parda dari na karo." Hazrat Qatadah (Rahimahullah / R.H) is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain logon ko kya ho gaya hai ke woh takalluf se auron ka haal bayan karne baith jaate hain ke falaan jannati hai aur falaan dozakhi hai. Is se khud is ki haalat poochho to yehi kahega ke mein nahin jaanta. Halanke insaan apni haalat se ba-nisbat auron ki haalat ke zyada aalim hota hai. Yeh log woh takalluf karte hain jo takalluf Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ne bhi nahin kiya. Nabi-Allah Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ka qaul hai "Wa maa 'ilmi bima kaanoo ya'maloon" un ke a'maal ka mujhe 'ilm nahin. Nabi-Allah Hazrat Shu'aib (Alaihis Salam / A.S) farmate hain (Wa maa ana 'alaikum bi-hafeez) (Surah Al-An'am: 104) mein tum par koi nigahban nahin. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai (La ta'lamuhum, nahnu na'lamuhum, sanu'azzibuhum marrataini thumma yuraddoona ila 'azabin 'azeem) (Surah At-Tawbah: 101) tu unhein nahin jaanta hum hi jaante hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke ek martaba Juma'h ke khutbe mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae falaan tu nikal ja tu munafiq hai aur ae falaan tu bhi yahan se chala ja tu munafiq hai. Pas bahut se logon ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid se chale jaane ka hukm farmaya. Un ka nifaq musalmanon par khul gaya yeh poore ruswa huaye. Yeh to masjid se nikal kar ja rahe the aur Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aa rahe the. Aap un se zara katra gaye yeh samajh kar ke shayad namaz ho chuki aur yeh log farigh ho kar ja rahe hain aur mein ghair haazir reh gaya. Aur woh log bhi Aap se sharmaye yeh samajh kar ke un par bhi hamara haal khul gaya hoga. Ab masjid mein aakar dekha ke abhi namaz to hui nahin. To ek shakhs ne Aap ko kaha lijiye khush ho jaiye. Aaj Allah ne munafiqon ko khoob sharminda-o-ruswa kiya. Yeh to tha pehla 'azaab jabke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein masjid se nikalwa diya. Aur doosra 'azaab 'azaab-e-qabr hai. Do martaba ke 'azaab se Mujahid ke nazdeek muraad qatl-o-qaid hai. Aur riwayat mein bhook aur qabr ka 'azaab hai. Ibn Juraij farmate hain 'azaab-e-dunya aur 'azaab-e-qabr muraad hai. Abdul Rahman bin Zaid farmate hain dunya ka 'azaab to maal-o-aulaad hai. Jaise Quran mein hai (Fala tu'jibka amwaluhum wa la awladuhum, innama yureedullahu liyu'azzibahum biha fil-hayatid-dunya wa tazhaqa anfusuhum wa hum kafiroon) (Surah At-Tawbah: 55) ya'ni tujhe unka maal aur unki auladein achhi na lagni chahiyein Allah ka irada to un ki wajah se unhein dunya mein 'azaab dena hai". Pas yeh museebatein un ke liye 'azaab hain haan mominon ke liye ajr-o-sawab hain. Aur doosra 'azaab Jahannam ka Aakhirat ke din hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain "Pehla 'azaab to yeh ke Islam ke ahkaam bazahir maanne pade, iske mutabiq 'amal karna pada jo dili mansha ke khilaf hai. Doosra 'azaab qabr ka.

Phir un donon ke siwa da'imi Jahannam ka azab. Qatadah kehte hain ke azab-e-duniya aur azab-e-qabr par azab-e-azeem ki taraf lautaya jana hai. "Mazkoor hai ke Hazrat Huzaifah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne posheedah taur par barah munafiqon ke naam bataye the. Aur farmaya tha ke un mein se chhah ko dabeelah kafi hoga jo Jahannam ki aag ka angara hoga. Jo un ke shane par zahir hoga aur seene tak pahunch jaye ga. Aur chhah buri maut marein ge. Yehi wajah thi ke Janab Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) jab dekhte ke koi aisa waisa daaghdar shakhs mara hai to intezar karte ke us ke janaze ki namaz Hazrat Huzaifah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) padhte hain ya nahin? Agar woh padhte to aap bhi padhte warna nah padhte. Marwi hai ke Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Hazrat Huzaifah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se daryaft kiya ke kya main bhi un mein hoon? Unhon ne jawab diya nahin aap un munafiqon mein nahin. Aur aap ke ba'ad mujhe is se kisi par be-khaufi nahin.

Tasahul aur susti se bacho

Munafiqon ka haal ooper ki aayaton mein bayan farmaya jo Allah ki rah mein jihad se be-imani, shak aur jhutlane ke taur par jee churate hain aur shamil nahin hote. Is aayat mein un ka bayan ho raha hai jo hain to iman dar aur sacche pakke Musalman. Lekin susti aur talab-e-rahat ki wajah se jihad mein shamil na hue. Unhein apne gunahon ka iqrar hai, Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka i'tiraf karte hain. Doosre yeh ke un ki neekiyan bhi hain. Pas yeh neeki badi wale log Allah Ta'ala ke hawale hain is ki ma'afi aur darguzar ke matahat hain. Yeh aayat go mu'ayyan logon ke bare mein hai lekin hukum ke i'tabar se aam hai, har Musalman jo neeki ke sath badi mein bhi mulawwis ho woh Allah ke supurd hai.

Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Abu Lubabah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai jab ke unhon ne Banu Qurayzah se kaha tha ke zabah hai aur apne hath se apne halq ki taraf isharah kiya tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke "Un ke aur un ke sathiyon ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai yeh log Ghazwah-e-Tabook se peeche rah gaye the. Hazrat Abu Lubabah ke sath aur bhi panch ya saat ya nau aadmi the. Jab Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas tashreef laye to un buzurgon ne apne ta'een Masjid-e-Nabawi ke sutoonon se bandh diya tha ke jab tak khud Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne dast-e-mubarak se na kholenge hum is qaid se aazad na honge jab yeh aayat utri Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khud un ke bandhan khole aur un se darguzar farma liya.

Bukhari Shareef mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Mere pas aaj raat ko do aane wale aaye jo mujhe utha kar le chale. Hum ek shehar mein pahunche jo sone chandi ki eenton se bana hua tha. Wahan humein chand aise log mile jin ka aadha dhad to bahut hi sudaul, nihayat khushnama aur khoobsurat tha aur aadha nihayat hi bura aur badsoorat. Un donon ne un se kaha jaao is is nahar mein ghota lagaao. Woh gaye aur ghota laga kar wapas aaye woh burai un se door ho gayi thi aur woh nihayat khoobsurat aur acche ho gaye the. Phir un donon ne mujh se farmaya ke yeh Jannat-e-'Adn hai. Yehi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki manzil hai. Aur jinhein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne abhi dekha yeh woh log hain jo neekiyon ke sath badiyan bhi milaye hue the. Allah Ta'ala ne un se darguzar farma liya aur unhein ma'af farmaya."

Imam Bukhari (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne is aayat ki tafseer mein is hadees ko isi tarah mukhtasaran hi riwayat kiya hai.

Sadqah maal ka tazkiyah hai Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmata hai ke "Aap un ke maalon ka sadqah liya karein. Taake is wajah se unhein paaki aur suthra'i hasil ho." Is ki zameer ka marja' baaz ke nazdeek woh musalman hain jinhon ne apni neekiyon ke saath kuch bura'iyan bhi kar leen theen. Lekin hukum is ka aam hai. Arab ke baaz qabeelon ko isi se dhoka hua tha ke yeh hukum Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath khaas hai. Isi wajah se unhon ne Khaleefa-e-Barhaq Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko (zakat ko farz maan kar) zakat dene se inkaar kiya tha. Jis par aap ne ma' baqi Sahabah ke un se lara'i ki ke woh zakat Khaleefatur Rasool ko isi tarah ada karein jis tarah Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ada karte the. Yahan tak ke agar woh ek baccha oontni ka ya ek rassi bhi nah deonge to bhi mein un se lara'i jari rakhunga. Hukum hota hai ke un se zakatein le aur un ke liye dua'ein kar. Chunanche Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke walid Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas apna sadqah le kar aaye to hasb-e-aadat Aap ne dua ki ke Ae Allah Al-e-Abi Aufa par apni rahmatein nazil farma. Isi tarah jab Aap ke paas kisi qisam ka sadqah aata to Aap un ke liye dua farmate. Ek aurat ne Aap se aa kar darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool Allah mere liye aur mere khawand ke liye dua keejiye. Aap ne farmaya "Sallallahu alaiki wa ala zaujiki". "Salawataka" ki aur qira'at "Salawatuka" hai. Pehli qira'at mufrad ki hai doosri jama' ki hai. Farmata hai ke teri dua un ke liye Allah ki rahmat ka ba'is hai. Aur un ke waqar-o-izzat ka sabab hai. Allah Ta'ala teri dua'on ka sunne wala hai. Aur ise bhi woh ba-khoobi jaanta hai ke kaun un dua'on ka mustahiq hai aur kaun is ka ahl hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kisi ke liye dua karte to ise aur is ki aulaad ko aur is ki aulaad ki aulaad ko pohanchti thi. Phir farmaya. Kya unhein itna bhi ilm nahin ke Allah Ta'ala apne bando'n ki taubah qabool farmane wala hai? Aur wahi un ke sadqaat leta hai? Is ne bando'n ko taubah aur sadqay ki taraf bahut ziyadah raghbat dila'i hai. Yeh dono cheezein gunahon ko door kar dene wali, unhein maaf karane wali aur unko mita dene wali hain. Taubah karne walon ki taubah Allah Azzawajal qabool farmata hai aur halal kama'i se sadqah dene walon ka sadqah Allah Ta'ala apne daayein haath mein le kar sadqah karne wale ke liye ise paalta hai. Yahan tak ke ek khajoor ko Uhud ke pahaar ke barabar kar deta hai. Chunanche Tirmidhi waghairah mein hai Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala sadqah qabool farmata hai apne daayein haath se ise leta hai aur jis tarah tum apne ko paalte ho isi tarah Allah Ta'ala ise barhata rehta hai yahan tak ke ek ek khajoor Uhud pahaar ke barabar ho jaati hai. Is ki tasdeeq Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ki kitab mein bhi maujood hai phir isi aayat ka yeh hi jumlah Aap ne tilawat farmaya. Aur Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman bhi. (Yamhaqullahur-riba wa yurbis-sadaqat) ya'ni sood ko Allah Ta'ala ghatata hai aur sadqay ko barhata hai.

Sadqah Allah Azzawajal ke hath mein jata hai, is se pehle ke woh sa'il ke hath mein jaye. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamane mein musalmanon ne jihad kiya jis mein un par Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Khalid imam the. Musalmanon mein se ek shakhs ne maal-e-ghanimat mein se ek sau Rumi dinar chura liye jab lashkar wahan se laut kar wapas aa gaya to ise sakht nadamat hui woh in dinaron ko le kar imam ke pas aaya lekin unhon ne in se lene se inkar kar diya ke mein ab le kar kya karun? Lashkar to mutafarriq ho gaya kaise bant sakta hun? Ab to tu ise apne pas hi rehne de. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ke pas hi lana. Is ne Sahaba Karam (Rizwanullahi Alaihim / R.A) se poochna shuru kiya lekin har ek yehi jawab deta raha. Yeh miskeen in dinaron ko Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke pas laya aur harchand kaha ke aap inhein le lijiyen lekin aap ne bhi nah liye. Ab to yeh rota peetta wahan se nikla. Raste mein ise Hazrat Abdullah bin Sha'ir Saksaki (Rahimahullah / R.H) mile. Yeh mashhur Dimashqi hain aur asl mein Hims ke hain. Yeh bahut bade faqeeh the. Unhon ne poocha ke kyun ro rahe ho? Is shakhs ne apna tamam waqiah bayan kiya. Aap ne farmaya jo mein kahunga woh karo ge bhi? Is ne kaha yaqeenan. Aap ne farmaya ja'o aur khums to Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko de a'o. Ya'ni bees dinar. Aur baqi ke assi dinar Allah ki rah mein is pure lashkar ki taraf se khairat kar do. Allah Ta'ala in sab ke naam aur makan jaanta hai aur woh apne bandon ki taubah qabool karta hai. Is shakhs ne yehi kiya. Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ne farmaya Wallah mujhe agar yeh maslah soojh jata aur mein ise yeh fatwa de deta to mujhe is sari sultanat aur milkiyat se zyada mahboob tha. Is ne nihayat achha fatwa diya.

(Yamhaqullahur-riba wa yurbis-sadaqat) ya'ni sood ko Allah Ta'ala ghatata hai aur sadqay ko barhata hai.

Sadqah Allah Azzawajal ke hath mein jata hai, is se pehle ke woh sa'il ke hath mein jaye. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamane mein musalmanon ne jihad kiya jis mein un par Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Khalid imam the. Musalmanon mein se ek shakhs ne maal-e-ghanimat mein se ek sau Rumi dinar chura liye jab lashkar wahan se laut kar wapas aa gaya to ise sakht nadamat hui woh in dinaron ko le kar imam ke pas aaya lekin unhon ne in se lene se inkar kar diya ke mein ab le kar kya karun? Lashkar to mutafarriq ho gaya kaise bant sakta hun? Ab to tu ise apne pas hi rehne de. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ke pas hi lana. Is ne Sahaba Karam (Rizwanullahi Alaihim / R.A) se poochna shuru kiya lekin har ek yehi jawab deta raha. Yeh miskeen in dinaron ko Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke pas laya aur harchand kaha ke aap inhein le lijiyen lekin aap ne bhi nah liye. Ab to yeh rota peetta wahan se nikla. Raste mein ise Hazrat Abdullah bin Sha'ir Saksaki (Rahimahullah / R.H) mile. Yeh mashhur Dimashqi hain aur asl mein Hims ke hain. Yeh bahut bade faqeeh the. Unhon ne poocha ke kyun ro rahe ho? Is shakhs ne apna tamam waqiah bayan kiya. Aap ne farmaya jo mein kahunga woh karo ge bhi? Is ne kaha yaqeenan. Aap ne farmaya ja'o aur khums to Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko de a'o. Ya'ni bees dinar. Aur baqi ke assi dinar Allah ki rah mein is pure lashkar ki taraf se khairat kar do. Allah Ta'ala in sab ke naam aur makan jaanta hai aur woh apne bandon ki taubah qabool karta hai. Is shakhs ne yehi kiya. Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ne farmaya Wallah mujhe agar yeh maslah soojh jata aur mein ise yeh fatwa de deta to mujhe is sari sultanat aur milkiyat se zyada mahboob tha. Is ne nihayat achha fatwa diya.

Apne a'maal se hoshiyar raho. Jo log Allah Ta'ala ke ahkamaat ke khilaaf karte hain unhein Allah Ta'ala dara raha hai ke un ke a'maal Allah ke saamne hain. Aur us ke Rasool aur tamaam Musalmano ke saamne Qayamat ke din khulne wale hain. Chhote se chhota aur posheeda se posheeda amal bhi us din sab par zahir ho jaye ga. Tamaam asraar khul jayein ge dilon ke bheed zahir ho jayein ge. Aur yeh bhi hota hai ke kabhi kabhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala logon par bhi un ke a'maal duniya mein hi zahir kar deta hai. Chananche Musnad Ahmad mein hai "Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke agar tum mein se koi kisi thoos patthar mein ghus kar jis ka nah darwaza ho, nah us mein koi sooraakh ho, koi amal kare Allah Ta'ala us ke amal ko logon ke saamne zahir kar de ga khwah kaisa hi amal ho." Abu Dawood Tayalisi ki riwayat se maloom hota hai ke "Zindon ke a'maal un ke qabeelon aur biradariyon par pesh kiye jaate hain agar woh achhe hote hain to woh log apni qabron mein khush hote hain aur agar woh bure hote hain to woh kehte hain ya Allah unhein taufeeq de ke yeh tere farmaan par aamil ban jayein". Musnad Ahmad mein bhi yahi farmaan-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke "Tumhare a'maal tumhare khweesh-o-aqaarib murdon ke saamne pesh kiye jaate hain agar woh nek hote hain to woh khush ho jaate hain aur agar is ke siwa hote hain to woh kehte hain ya Allah unhein maut nah aaye jab tak ke tu unhein hidayat ata nah farma jaise ke tu ne humein hidayat di" (lekin in riwayaton ki sandein qaabil-e-ghaur hain). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) farmati hain ke jab tujhe kisi shakhs ke nek a'maal bahut achhe lagein to tu keh de ke achha hai amal kiye chale jao Allah aur us ka Rasool aur momin tumhare a'maal anqareeb dekh lein ge. Ek marfoo' hadith bhi isi mazmoon ki aayi hai us mein hai kisi ke a'maal par khush nah ho jao jab tak yeh nah dekh lo ke us ka khatima kis par hota hai? Basa auqaat aisa bhi hota hai ke insaan ek zamana-e-daraaz tak nek amal karta rehta hai ke agar woh us waqt marta to qat'an jannati ho jata. Lekin phir us ki haalat badal jaati hai aur woh bad-a'maaliyon mein phans jata hai. Aur basa auqaat aisa bhi hota hai ke insaan ek lambi muddat tak buraiyan karta rehta hai ke agar isi haalat mein mare to jahannam mein hi jaye lekin phir us ka haal badal jata hai aur nek amal shuru kar deta hai. Allah Ta'ala jab kisi bande ke saath bhala irada karta hai to use us ki maut se pehle aamil bana deta hai. Logon ne kaha hum is ka matlab nahin samjhe Aap ne farmaya matlab yeh hai ke use taufeeq-e-khair ata farmata hai aur us par use maut aati hai.

Is se murad woh teen buzurg sahabah hain jin ki taubah dheel mein pad gayi thi. Hazrat Murarah bin Rabi, Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik, Hazrat Hilal bin Umayyah (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A). Yeh Jang-e-Tabuk mein shareek nahin hue the. Shak aur nifaq ke taur par nahin balkeh susti, rahat-talabi, phalon ki pukhtagi, saaye ke husool waghairah ke liye. In mein se kuch logon ne to apne ta'een masjid ke sutoonon se bandh liya tha jaise Hazrat Abu Lubabah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aur un ke saathi. Aur kuch logon ne aisa nahin kiya tha in mein yeh teenon buzurg the. Pas auron ki to taubah qabool ho gayi aur in teenon ka kaam peeche daal diya gaya yahan tak ke (Laqad taab-Allahu 'alan-Nabiyyi wal-Muhajireena wal-Ansaril-ladheenat-taba'oohu fee sa'atil-'usrati mim ba'di ma kaada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqim minhum thumma taaba 'alaihim, innahoo bihim ra'oofur-raheem - Surah At-Taubah: 117) nazil hui jo is ke baad aa rahi hai. Aur is ka poora bayan bhi Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki riwayat mein aa raha hai. Yahan farmata hai ke woh Allah ke irade par hain agar chahein saza de agar chahein ma'afi de. Lekin zahir hai ke Us ki rahmat Us ke ghazab par ghalib hai. Woh khoob jaanta hai ke saza ke laaiq kaun hai. Aur mustahaq-e-ma'afi kaun hai? Woh apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein Hakeem hai. Us ke siwa na to koi ma'bood na Us ke siwa koi murabbi.

Ek qissa ek ibrat, Masjid-e-Zirar. In paak aayaton ka sabab-e-nuzool suniye! Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Makkah Shareef se hijrat kar ke Madine pahunche. Is se pehle Madine mein ek shakhs tha jis ka naam Abu Aamir Rahib tha. Yeh Khazraj ke qabile mein se tha. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein Nasrani ban gaya tha, Ahl-e-Kitab ka ilm bhi parha tha. Aabid bhi tha aur qabila-e-Khazraj is ki buzurgi ka qael tha. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahan aaye, musalmanon ka ijtima Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas hone laga. Yeh quwwat pakadne lage yahan tak ke Badr ki ladai hui aur is mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ghalib rakha to yeh jal bhun gaya. Khulam khula mukhalifat-o-adawat karne laga aur yahan se bhaag kar kuffar-e-Makkah se mil gaya. Aur unhein musalmanon se ladai karne par aamada karne laga. Yeh to adawat-e-Islam mein pagal ho rahe the, tayyar ho gaye aur apne saath Arab ke aur bhi bahut se qabail ko mila kar jang ke irade se nikal khade hue aur maidan-e-Uhud mein jam kar lade. Is ladai mein musalmanon ka jo haal hua woh zahir hai. Unka poora imtihan ho gaya. Go anjam-e-kar musalmanon ka hi bhala hua aur aaqibat Allah se darne walon ke liye hi hai. Isi fasiq ne musalmanon aur kafiron ke darmiyan bahut se gaddhe khod rakhe the, jin mein se ek mein Allah ke Rasool-e-Muhtaram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gir pade, chehre par zakhm aaye. Saamne se neeche ki taraf ke chaar daant toot gaye. Sir bhi zakhmi hua. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Shuru ladai ke waqt hi Abu Aamir fasiq apni qaum ke paas gaya aur bahut hi khushamad aur chaploosi ki ke tum meri madad aur muwafaqat karo. Lekin unhon ne bil-ittafaq jawab diya ke Allah teri aankhein thandi na kare tu na-murad hai. Ae badkar ae Allah ke dushman tu hamein rah-e-haq se behkane ko aaya hai, al-gharz bura bhala keh kar na-umeed kar diya gaya. Yeh lauta aur yeh kehta hua ke meri qaum to mere baad bahut hi shareer ho gayi hai. Madine mein is nahanjaar ko Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bahut samjhaaya tha Quran parh parh kar nasihat ki thi aur Islam ki raghbat dilayi thi lekin is ne na maana tha. To Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke liye bad-dua ki thi ke Allah Ta'ala ise kaheen door daraz zillat-o-haqarat ke saath maut de. Jab is ne dekha ke Uhud mein bhi is ki chahat poori na hui aur Islam ka kalimah bulandi par hi hai to yeh yahan se Shah-e-Room Hiraql ke paas pahuncha aur ise Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ladai ke liye aamada kiya. Is ne bhi is se wa'da kar liya aur tamanna-ein dilayein. Is waqt is ne apne ham-khayal logon ko jo munafiqana rang mein Madine Shareef mein rehte sehte the aur jin ke dil ab tak shakk-o-shubah mein the likha ke ab mein musalmanon ki jarein kaat doonga, mein ne Hiraql ko aamada kar diya hai woh lashkar-e-jarraar le kar charhai karne wala hai. Musalmanon ko naak chane jabwa dega aur un ka beej bhi baaqi na rakhega. Tum ek makan masjid ke naam se ta'meer karo taake mere qasid jo aaein woh wahein thehrein, wahein mashware hoan aur hamare liye woh panah ki aur ghaat lagane ki mahfooz jagah ban jaye.

Unhon ne Masjid-e-Quba ke paas hi ek aur masjid ki tameer shuru kar di aur Tabook ki larai ke liye Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki rawangi se pehle hi ise khoob mazboot aur pukhta bana liya aur aa kar Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne lage ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamari masjid mein tashreef laiye aur namaz ada kijaiye taake hamare liye yeh baat hujjat ho jaye aur ham wahan namaz shuru kar dein. Zaeef aur kamzor logon ko door jaane mein bari takleef hoti thi. Khususan jaare ki raaton mein kamzor, beemar aur ma'zoor log door daraz ki masjid mein bari diqqat se pohanchte hain is liye ham ne qareeb hi yeh masjid bana li hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is waqt to safar darpesh hai paa ba rikab hoon Insha'Allah wapsi mein sahi. Is tarah Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is kufr ke morche se bacha liya. Jab maidan-e-Tabook se aap salamati aur ghaneemat ke saath wapas laute, abhi Madine Sharif se ek din ya kuch kam ke faasle par the ke Allah ki wahi nazil hui aur is Masjid-e-Zirar ki haqeeqat aap par zahir kar di gayi. Aur is ke baaniyon ki niyat ka bhi ilm aap ko kara diya gaya. Aur wahan ki namaz se rok kar Masjid-e-Quba mein jis ki bunyaad Allah ke khauf par rakhi gayi thi, namaz parhne ka hukum sadir hua. Pas aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne waheen se Musalmanon ko bhej diya ke jaao mere pohanchne se pehle is masjid ko tor do. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain "Abu Aamir khabeeth in Ansariyon se keh gaya tha ke tum masjid ke naam se imarat bana lo aur jo tum se ho sake tayyari rakho, hathyaar waghaira muhayya kar lo, main Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke paas ja raha hoon aur us se madad le kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke saathiyon ko yahan se nikal doon ga. Pas yeh log jab yeh masjid tayyar kar chuke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hamari chahat hai ke aap hamari is masjid mein tashreef laain, wahan namaz parhein aur hamare liye barakat ki dua karein. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari ke is masjid mein hargiz khare bhi na hona. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab aap Zee Awan mein utre aur masjid ki ittela mili aap ne Malik bin Wa Khushum (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aur Ma'n bin Yazid (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko bulaya, un ke bhai Umar bin Adi ko bulwaya aur hukum diya ke in zalimon ki masjid mein jaao aur ise gira do balki jala do. Yeh donon buzurg tabar tor jaldi jaldi chale. Salim bin Auf ke mahalle mein ja kar Hazrat Malik ne Hazrat Ma'n se farmaya aap yaheen thehriye, yeh mere qabile ke logon ke makan hain yahan se aag lata hoon. Chunanche gaye aur ek khajoor ka sulagta hua tana le aaye aur seedhe is Masjid-e-Zirar mein pohanch kar is mein aag laga di aur kudal chalani shuru kar di. Wahan jo log the idhar udhar bhaag gaye aur in buzurgon ne is imarat ko jar se khod dala. Pas is baare mein yeh aayatein utri hain. Is ke baani baarah shakhs the. Khuzzam bin Khalid Banu Abd bin Zaid mein se jo Bani Amr bin Auf mein se hain isi ke ghar mein se Masjid-e-Shiqaq nikli thi. Aur Tha'labah bin Hatib jo Bani Ubaid mein se tha aur Banu Umayyah ke mawali jo Abu Lubabah bin Abdul Mundhir ke qabile mein se the. Quran farmata hai ke yeh log qasmein kha kha kar kahein ge ke hamari niyat nek thi.

Logon ke aaram ki gharaz se hum ne isey banaya hai. Lekin Allah ki gawahi hai ke yeh jhoote hain. Balkeh unhon ne Masjid-e-Quba ko zarar puhanchane aur Allah ke saath kufr karne aur mominon mein judai daalne aur Allah-o-Rasool ke dushmanon ko panah dene ke liye isey banaya hai. Yeh kameen-gah hai Abu Aamir Fasiq ki jo logon mein rahib mashhoor hai. Allah ki laanatein is par nazil hon.

Farman hai ke "Tu hargiz is masjid mein nah khada hona." Is farman mein aap ki ummat bhi dakhil hai. Unhein bhi is masjid mein namaz padhni haram qaraar di gayi. Phir raghbat dilayi jaati hai ke Masjid-e-Quba mein namaz ada karo. Jis ki bunyad Allah ke dar par aur Rasool ki itaat par rakhi gayi hai aur Musalmanon ke ittefaq par aur un ki khair-khwahi par banayi gayi hai. Isi masjid mein tumhara namazein padhna durust aur haq-bajanib hai chunanche Sahih Hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sawaar aur paidal is masjid mein aaya karte they.

Aur hadith mein hai ke jab aap hijrat kar ke Madine Shareef puhanche aur Bani Umar bin Auf mein thehre aur is paak masjid ki bunyad rakhi us waqt khud Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne qiblah ki jihat mu'ayyan ki thi. Wallahu A'lam.

Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain (Aayat Fiihi Rijaalun) Masjid-e-Quba walon ke baare mein utri hai, woh paani se istinja kiya karte they. Yeh masjid za'eef hai. Imam Tirmidhi isey ghareeb batlate hain.

Tabrani mein hai "Is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad aap ne Uwaim bin Sa'idah ke paas aadmi bheej kar daryaft farmaya ke aakhir yeh kaun si taharat hai jis ki sana Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat bayan farma raha hai? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum mein se jo mard aurat paakhane se nikalta hai woh paani se istinja kiya karta hai. Us ne farmaya bas yehi woh taharat hai."

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke paas Masjid-e-Quba mein tashreef laye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari masjid ke bayan mein tumhari taharat ki aaj tareef ki hai to batlao ke tumhari woh taharat kaise hai? Unhon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) humein aur to kuch maloom nahin han itni baat zaroor hai ke hum ne apne parosi Yahudiyon ki nisbat jab se yeh maloom kiya ke woh paakhane se nikal kar paani se paaki karte hain, hum ne us waqt se apna yehi wateera bana liya hai.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne yeh sawal Hazrat Uwaim bin Adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se kiya tha. Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Saabit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka farman hai ke paani se taharat karna hi woh pakeezgi thi jis ki tareef Allah Azza wa Jal ne ki. Aur riwayat mein un ke jawab mein hai ke hum Taurat ke hukum ki roo se paani se istinja karna lazmi samajhte hain.

Al-gharaz jis masjid ka is aayat mein zikr hai woh Masjid-e-Quba hai. Is ki tasreeh bohat se Salaf-e-Saleheen ne ki hai. Lekin ek Sahih Hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke taqwe par banne wali masjid Masjid-e-Nabwi hai jo Madine Shareef ke darmiyan hai. Gharaz in donon baaton mein koi ikhtilaaf nahin jab ke Masjid-e-Quba shuru din se taqwe ki bunyadon par hai to Masjid-e-Nabwi is wasf ki is se bhi ziyada mustahaq hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jo masjid Allah ke dar par banayi gayi hai woh yeh meri masjid hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke do shakhson mein is bare mein ikhtilaf hua ke is ayat mein kaunsi masjid murad hai, Huzoor Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh meri yeh masjid hai. In dono mein se ek ka qaul tha ke yeh masjid Masjid-e-Quba hai aur doosre ka qaul tha ke yeh masjid Masjid-e-Nabwi hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi, Nasa'i waghairah mein hai. In dono shakhson mein se ek to Banu Khudrah qabeele ka tha aur doosra Banu Amr bin Auf mein se tha. Khudri ka da'wa tha ke yeh Masjid-e-Nabwi hai aur Umri kehta tha Masjid-e-Quba hai. Hazrat Abu Sa'eed (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghar ja kar daryaft farmate hain ke woh masjid kahan hai jis ki bunyadein shuru se hi parhezgari par hain? Aap ne kuch kankar utha kar unhein zameen par phenk kar farmaya woh tumhari yehi masjid hai. Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi hai. Salaf ki aur khalaf ki ek jama'at ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad yeh dono masjidein hain, Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala ke is farman se sabit hua ke jin agli masjidon ki pehle din se buniad Allah ke taqwe par rakhi gayi ho wahan namaz padhna mustahab hai. Aur jahan Allah ke neek bandon ki jama'at ho jo deen ke hamil hon, wuzu achhi tarah karne wale hon, kamil taharat ke saath rehne wale hon, gandgiyon se door hon un ke saath namaz padhna mustahab hai. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba ko subh ki namaz padha'i jis mein Surah-e-Room padhi. Is mein Aap ko kuch waham sa ho gaya, namaz se farigh ho kar Aap ne farmaya Qur'an Kareem ki qira'at mein khalt malt ho jane ka ba'is tum mein se woh log hain jo hamare saath namaz mein shamil hote hain lekin wuzu achhi tarah nahin karte, hamare saath ke namaziyon ko wuzu nihayat umdah karna chahiye. Is hadith se bhi sabit hota hai ke taharat ka kamal Allah ki ibadaton ke baja lane unhein poori karne aur kamil kar ke aur shar'i haisiyat se baja lane mein sahulat paida karta hai. Allah Ta'ala paak rehne walon se muhabbat rakhta hai. Hazrat Abu Al-Aaliyah farmate hain ke pani se istinja karna beshak taharat hai. Lekin a'la taharat gunahon se bachna hai. Hazrat A'mash farmate hain gunahon se taubah karna aur shirk se bachna poori pakeezgi hai. Upar hadith guzar chuki ke jab Ahl-e-Quba se un ki is Allah ki pasandeedah taharat ki nisbat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to unhon ne apne jawab mein pani se istinja karna bayan kiya. Pas yeh ayat un ke haq mein utri hai. Bazzar mein hai ke unhon ne kaha hum pattharon se safa'i kar ke phir pani se dhote hain. Lekin is riwayat mein Muhammad bin Abdul Aziz ka Zuhri se tafarrud hai aur un se bhi un ke bete ke siwa aur koi rawi nahin. Is hadith ko in lafzon se maine yahan sirf is liye warid kiya hai ke fuqaha mein yeh mashhoor hai lekin muhaddithein kul ke kul ise ma'roof nahin batate khusoosan muta'akhkhireen log, Wallahu A'lam.

Yeh to adawat-e-Islam mein pagal ho rahe the, tayyar ho gaye aur apne saath Arab ke aur bhi bahut se qabail ko mila kar jang ke irade se nikal khade hue aur maidan-e-Uhud mein jam kar lade. Is ladai mein musalmanon ka jo haal hua woh zahir hai. Unka poora imtihan ho gaya. Go anjam-e-kar musalmanon ka hi bhala hua aur aaqibat Allah se darne walon ke liye hi hai. Isi fasiq ne musalmanon aur kafiron ke darmiyan bahut se gaddhe khod rakhe the, jin mein se ek mein Allah ke Rasool-e-Muhtaram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gir pade, chehre par zakhm aaye. Saamne se neeche ki taraf ke chaar daant toot gaye. Sir bhi zakhmi hua. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Shuru ladai ke waqt hi Abu Aamir fasiq apni qaum ke paas gaya aur bahut hi khushamad aur chaploosi ki ke tum meri madad aur muwafaqat karo. Lekin unhon ne bil-ittafaq jawab diya ke Allah teri aankhein thandi na kare tu na-murad hai. Ae badkar ae Allah ke dushman tu hamein rah-e-haq se behkane ko aaya hai, al-gharz bura bhala keh kar na-umeed kar diya gaya. Yeh lauta aur yeh kehta hua ke meri qaum to mere baad bahut hi shareer ho gayi hai. Madine mein is nahanjaar ko Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bahut samjhaaya tha Quran parh parh kar nasihat ki thi aur Islam ki raghbat dilayi thi lekin is ne na maana tha. To Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke liye bad-dua ki thi ke Allah Ta'ala ise kaheen door daraz zillat-o-haqarat ke saath maut de. Jab is ne dekha ke Uhud mein bhi is ki chahat poori na hui aur Islam ka kalimah bulandi par hi hai to yeh yahan se Shah-e-Room Hiraql ke paas pahuncha aur ise Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ladai ke liye aamada kiya. Is ne bhi is se wa'da kar liya aur tamanna-ein dilayein. Is waqt is ne apne ham-khayal logon ko jo munafiqana rang mein Madine Shareef mein rehte sehte the aur jin ke dil ab tak shakk-o-shubah mein the likha ke ab mein musalmanon ki jarein kaat doonga, mein ne Hiraql ko aamada kar diya hai woh lashkar-e-jarraar le kar charhai karne wala hai. Musalmanon ko naak chane jabwa dega aur un ka beej bhi baaqi na rakhega. Tum ek makan masjid ke naam se ta'meer karo taake mere qasid jo aaein woh wahein thehrein, wahein mashware hoan aur hamare liye woh panah ki aur ghaat lagane ki mahfooz jagah ban jaye.

Unhon ne Masjid-e-Quba ke paas hi ek aur masjid ki tameer shuru kar di aur Tabook ki larai ke liye Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki rawangi se pehle hi ise khoob mazboot aur pukhta bana liya aur aa kar Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne lage ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamari masjid mein tashreef laiye aur namaz ada kijaiye taake hamare liye yeh baat hujjat ho jaye aur ham wahan namaz shuru kar dein. Zaeef aur kamzor logon ko door jaane mein bari takleef hoti thi. Khususan jaare ki raaton mein kamzor, beemar aur ma'zoor log door daraz ki masjid mein bari diqqat se pohanchte hain is liye ham ne qareeb hi yeh masjid bana li hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is waqt to safar darpesh hai paa ba rikab hoon Insha'Allah wapsi mein sahi. Is tarah Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is kufr ke morche se bacha liya. Jab maidan-e-Tabook se aap salamati aur ghaneemat ke saath wapas laute, abhi Madine Sharif se ek din ya kuch kam ke faasle par the ke Allah ki wahi nazil hui aur is Masjid-e-Zirar ki haqeeqat aap par zahir kar di gayi. Aur is ke baaniyon ki niyat ka bhi ilm aap ko kara diya gaya. Aur wahan ki namaz se rok kar Masjid-e-Quba mein jis ki bunyaad Allah ke khauf par rakhi gayi thi, namaz parhne ka hukum sadir hua. Pas aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne waheen se Musalmanon ko bhej diya ke jaao mere pohanchne se pehle is masjid ko tor do. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain "Abu Aamir khabeeth in Ansariyon se keh gaya tha ke tum masjid ke naam se imarat bana lo aur jo tum se ho sake tayyari rakho, hathyaar waghaira muhayya kar lo, main Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke paas ja raha hoon aur us se madad le kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke saathiyon ko yahan se nikal doon ga. Pas yeh log jab yeh masjid tayyar kar chuke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hamari chahat hai ke aap hamari is masjid mein tashreef laain, wahan namaz parhein aur hamare liye barakat ki dua karein. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari ke is masjid mein hargiz khare bhi na hona. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab aap Zee Awan mein utre aur masjid ki ittela mili aap ne Malik bin Wa Khushum (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aur Ma'n bin Yazid (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko bulaya, un ke bhai Umar bin Adi ko bulwaya aur hukum diya ke in zalimon ki masjid mein jaao aur ise gira do balki jala do. Yeh donon buzurg tabar tor jaldi jaldi chale. Salim bin Auf ke mahalle mein ja kar Hazrat Malik ne Hazrat Ma'n se farmaya aap yaheen thehriye, yeh mere qabile ke logon ke makan hain yahan se aag lata hoon. Chunanche gaye aur ek khajoor ka sulagta hua tana le aaye aur seedhe is Masjid-e-Zirar mein pohanch kar is mein aag laga di aur kudal chalani shuru kar di. Wahan jo log the idhar udhar bhaag gaye aur in buzurgon ne is imarat ko jar se khod dala. Pas is baare mein yeh aayatein utri hain. Is ke baani baarah shakhs the. Khuzzam bin Khalid Banu Abd bin Zaid mein se jo Bani Amr bin Auf mein se hain isi ke ghar mein se Masjid-e-Shiqaq nikli thi. Aur Tha'labah bin Hatib jo Bani Ubaid mein se tha aur Banu Umayyah ke mawali jo Abu Lubabah bin Abdul Mundhir ke qabile mein se the. Quran farmata hai ke yeh log qasmein kha kha kar kahein ge ke hamari niyat nek thi.

Logon ke aaram ki gharaz se hum ne isey banaya hai. Lekin Allah ki gawahi hai ke yeh jhoote hain. Balkeh unhon ne Masjid-e-Quba ko zarar puhanchane aur Allah ke saath kufr karne aur mominon mein judai daalne aur Allah-o-Rasool ke dushmanon ko panah dene ke liye isey banaya hai. Yeh kameen-gah hai Abu Aamir Fasiq ki jo logon mein rahib mashhoor hai. Allah ki laanatein is par nazil hon.

Farman hai ke "Tu hargiz is masjid mein nah khada hona." Is farman mein aap ki ummat bhi dakhil hai. Unhein bhi is masjid mein namaz padhni haram qaraar di gayi. Phir raghbat dilayi jaati hai ke Masjid-e-Quba mein namaz ada karo. Jis ki bunyad Allah ke dar par aur Rasool ki itaat par rakhi gayi hai aur Musalmanon ke ittefaq par aur un ki khair-khwahi par banayi gayi hai. Isi masjid mein tumhara namazein padhna durust aur haq-bajanib hai chunanche Sahih Hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sawaar aur paidal is masjid mein aaya karte they.

Aur hadith mein hai ke jab aap hijrat kar ke Madine Shareef puhanche aur Bani Umar bin Auf mein thehre aur is paak masjid ki bunyad rakhi us waqt khud Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne qiblah ki jihat mu'ayyan ki thi. Wallahu A'lam.

Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain (Aayat Fiihi Rijaalun) Masjid-e-Quba walon ke baare mein utri hai, woh paani se istinja kiya karte they. Yeh masjid za'eef hai. Imam Tirmidhi isey ghareeb batlate hain.

Tabrani mein hai "Is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad aap ne Uwaim bin Sa'idah ke paas aadmi bheej kar daryaft farmaya ke aakhir yeh kaun si taharat hai jis ki sana Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat bayan farma raha hai? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum mein se jo mard aurat paakhane se nikalta hai woh paani se istinja kiya karta hai. Us ne farmaya bas yehi woh taharat hai."

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke paas Masjid-e-Quba mein tashreef laye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tumhari masjid ke bayan mein tumhari taharat ki aaj tareef ki hai to batlao ke tumhari woh taharat kaise hai? Unhon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) humein aur to kuch maloom nahin han itni baat zaroor hai ke hum ne apne parosi Yahudiyon ki nisbat jab se yeh maloom kiya ke woh paakhane se nikal kar paani se paaki karte hain, hum ne us waqt se apna yehi wateera bana liya hai.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne yeh sawal Hazrat Uwaim bin Adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se kiya tha. Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Saabit (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka farman hai ke paani se taharat karna hi woh pakeezgi thi jis ki tareef Allah Azza wa Jal ne ki. Aur riwayat mein un ke jawab mein hai ke hum Taurat ke hukum ki roo se paani se istinja karna lazmi samajhte hain.

Al-gharaz jis masjid ka is aayat mein zikr hai woh Masjid-e-Quba hai. Is ki tasreeh bohat se Salaf-e-Saleheen ne ki hai. Lekin ek Sahih Hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke taqwe par banne wali masjid Masjid-e-Nabwi hai jo Madine Shareef ke darmiyan hai. Gharaz in donon baaton mein koi ikhtilaaf nahin jab ke Masjid-e-Quba shuru din se taqwe ki bunyadon par hai to Masjid-e-Nabwi is wasf ki is se bhi ziyada mustahaq hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke jo masjid Allah ke dar par banayi gayi hai woh yeh meri masjid hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke do shakhson mein is bare mein ikhtilaf hua ke is ayat mein kaunsi masjid murad hai, Huzoor Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh meri yeh masjid hai. In dono mein se ek ka qaul tha ke yeh masjid Masjid-e-Quba hai aur doosre ka qaul tha ke yeh masjid Masjid-e-Nabwi hai. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi, Nasa'i waghairah mein hai. In dono shakhson mein se ek to Banu Khudrah qabeele ka tha aur doosra Banu Amr bin Auf mein se tha. Khudri ka da'wa tha ke yeh Masjid-e-Nabwi hai aur Umri kehta tha Masjid-e-Quba hai. Hazrat Abu Sa'eed (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghar ja kar daryaft farmate hain ke woh masjid kahan hai jis ki bunyadein shuru se hi parhezgari par hain? Aap ne kuch kankar utha kar unhein zameen par phenk kar farmaya woh tumhari yehi masjid hai. Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi hai. Salaf ki aur khalaf ki ek jama'at ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad yeh dono masjidein hain, Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala ke is farman se sabit hua ke jin agli masjidon ki pehle din se buniad Allah ke taqwe par rakhi gayi ho wahan namaz padhna mustahab hai. Aur jahan Allah ke neek bandon ki jama'at ho jo deen ke hamil hon, wuzu achhi tarah karne wale hon, kamil taharat ke saath rehne wale hon, gandgiyon se door hon un ke saath namaz padhna mustahab hai. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba ko subh ki namaz padha'i jis mein Surah-e-Room padhi. Is mein Aap ko kuch waham sa ho gaya, namaz se farigh ho kar Aap ne farmaya Qur'an Kareem ki qira'at mein khalt malt ho jane ka ba'is tum mein se woh log hain jo hamare saath namaz mein shamil hote hain lekin wuzu achhi tarah nahin karte, hamare saath ke namaziyon ko wuzu nihayat umdah karna chahiye. Is hadith se bhi sabit hota hai ke taharat ka kamal Allah ki ibadaton ke baja lane unhein poori karne aur kamil kar ke aur shar'i haisiyat se baja lane mein sahulat paida karta hai. Allah Ta'ala paak rehne walon se muhabbat rakhta hai. Hazrat Abu Al-Aaliyah farmate hain ke pani se istinja karna beshak taharat hai. Lekin a'la taharat gunahon se bachna hai. Hazrat A'mash farmate hain gunahon se taubah karna aur shirk se bachna poori pakeezgi hai. Upar hadith guzar chuki ke jab Ahl-e-Quba se un ki is Allah ki pasandeedah taharat ki nisbat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to unhon ne apne jawab mein pani se istinja karna bayan kiya. Pas yeh ayat un ke haq mein utri hai. Bazzar mein hai ke unhon ne kaha hum pattharon se safa'i kar ke phir pani se dhote hain. Lekin is riwayat mein Muhammad bin Abdul Aziz ka Zuhri se tafarrud hai aur un se bhi un ke bete ke siwa aur koi rawi nahin. Is hadith ko in lafzon se maine yahan sirf is liye warid kiya hai ke fuqaha mein yeh mashhoor hai lekin muhaddithein kul ke kul ise ma'roof nahin batate khusoosan muta'akhkhireen log, Wallahu A'lam.

Woh ke jis ne Allah ke dar aur Allah ki raza ki talab ke liye buniyaad rakhi aur jis ne Musalmanon ko zarar pohanchane aur kufr karne aur phoot dalwane aur mukhalifeen-e-Allah-o-Rasool ko panah dene ke liye buniyaad rakhi yeh donon barabar nahin ho sakte. Yeh doosre qisam ke log to apni buniyaad us khandaq ke kanare par rakhte hain. Jis mein aag bhari hui ho aur ho bhi woh buniyaad aisi kamzor ke aag mein jhuk rahi ho zahir hai ke ek din woh aag mein gir pare gi. Zalimon aur fasadiyon ka kaam bhi nek nateeja nahin hote. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke main ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein Masjid-e-Zirar se dhuwan nikalte dekha. Imam Ibn Jareer (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka qaul hai ke hum se zikr kiya gaya hai ke jin logon ne is masjid ko toda aur is ki buniyaadein ukheer phenkein unhon ne is ke neeche se dhuwan uthta paya. Khalf bin Bama'in kehte hain main ne munafiqon ki is Masjid-e-Zirar ko jis ka zikr in aayaton mein dekha hai ke is ke ek patthar se dhuwan nikal raha tha ab woh kooda karkat dalne ki jagah bani hui hai. Un ke ek bad kartoot ki wajah se un ke dil mein nafaq jagah pakar gaya hai jo kabhi bhi talne wala nahin yeh shak shubha mein hi rahein ge jaise ke Bani Israel ke woh log jinon ne bichhra pooja tha un ke dilon mein bhi is ki muhabbat ghar kar gayi thi. Haan jab un ke dil paash paash ho jayein yaani woh khud mar jayein. Allah Tabarak Wa Ta'ala apne bandon ke a'maal se khabardaar hai. Aur khair-o-shar ka badla dene mein ba-hikmat hai.

Mujahideen Ke Liye Istisna'i In'aamaat

Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke momin bande jab rah-e-haq mein apne maal aur apni jaanein dein. Allah Ta'ala is ke badle mein apne fazl-o-karam aur lutf-o-rahm se unhein jannat ata farmaaye ga. Banda apni cheez jo dar-haqeeqat Allah Ta'ala ki hi hai us ki rah mein kharch karta hai to us ki itaat guzaari se Malik-ul-Mulk khush ho kar us par apna aur fazl karta hai, SubhanAllah kitni zabardast aur giraan qeemat Parwardigaar kaisi haqeer cheez par deta hai. Dar-asl har musalman Allah se yeh sauda kar chuka hai. Use ikhtiyaar hai ke woh ise poora kare ya yunhi apni gardan mein latkaaye hue duniya se uth jaaye. Isi liye mujahideen jab jihaad ke liye jaate hain to kaha jaata hai ke us ne Allah Ta'ala se byopaar kiya. Ya'ni woh khareed-o-farokht jise woh pehle se kar chuka tha us ne poori ki. 

Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Lailat-ul-Uqbah mein bai'at karte hue kaha ke Ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne Rabb ke liye aur apne liye jo chahein shart manwa lein. Aap ne farmaya main apne Rabb ke liye tum se yeh shart qabool karata hoon ke isi ki ibaadat karna, us ke saath kisi aur ko shareek na karna. Aur apne liye tum se is baat ki paabandi karata hoon ke jis tarah apni jaan-o-maal ki hifazat karte ho meri bhi hifazat karna. Hazrat Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne poocha jab hum yunhi karein to humein kya mile ga? Aap ne farmaya jannat! Yeh sunte hi khushi se kahne laga Wallah is saude mein to hum bahut hi nafa' mein rahein ge. Bas ab pukhta baat hai na hum ise torein ge na torne ki darxwast karein ge pas yeh aayat naazil hui yeh Allah ki rah mein jihaad karte hain, na is ki parwah hoti hai ke hum maare jaayein ge na Allah ke dushmanon par waar karne mein unhein ta'ammul hota hai, marte hain aur maarte hain. Aison ke liye yaqeenan jannat waajib hai. 

Bukhari-Muslim ki hadees mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah ki rah mein nikal khada ho jihaad ke liye, rasoolon ki sachai maan kar, ise ya to fawt kar ke bahisht-e-bareen mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala le jaata hai ya poore poore ajr aur behtareen ghaneemat ke saath wapas ise lautata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne yeh baat apne zimme zaroori kar li hai aur apne rasoolon par apni behtareen kitabon mein naazil bhi farmaayi hai. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) par utri hui Tauraat mein, Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) par utri hui Injeel mein aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utre hue Quran mein Allah ka yeh wa'da maujood hai. Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaihim Ajma'een. Allah kabhi wa'da khilaafi nahin karta. Allah se zyada wa'don ka poora karne wala aur koi nahin ho sakta. Na us se zyada sachai kisi ki baaton mein hoti hai. Jis ne is khareed-o-farokht ko poora kiya us ke liye khushi hai aur mubarakbaad hai, woh kaamyab hai aur jannaton ki abdi ni'maton ka maalik hai.

Moomineen Ki Sifaat

Jin moominon ka oopar zikr hua hai un ki paak aur behtareen siftein bayan ho rahi hain ke woh tamam gunahon se taubah karte rehte hain, buraiyon ko chhodte jaate hain, apne Rab ki ibadat par jame rehte hain, har qism ki ibadaton mein khaas taur par qabil-e-zikr cheez Allah ki hamd-o-sana hai is liye woh is ki hamd ba-kasrat ada karte hain aur fi'li ibadaton mein khusoosiyat ke sath afzal ibadat roza hai is liye woh ise bhi achhai se rakhte hain. Khane peene ko, jima' ko tark kar dete hain. Yehi muraad lafz Sa'ihun se yahan hai. Yehi vasf Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ka Qur'an ne bayan farmaya hai aur yehi lafz Sa'ihat wahan bhi hai. Ruku sujood karte rehte hain. Ya'ni namaz ke paband hain. Allah ki in ibadaton ke sath hi sath makhlooq ke nafa' se bhi ghaafil nahin. Allah ki ita'at ka har ek ko hukm karte hain. Buraiyon se rokte rehte hain. Khud ilm haasil kar ke bhalai burai mein tameez kar ke Allah ke ahkaam ki hifazat kar ke phir auron ko bhi is ki raghbat dete hain. Haq Ta'ala ki ibadat aur is ki makhlooq ki hifazat dono zer-e-nazar rakhte hain. Yehi baatein imaan ki hain aur yehi ausaaf moominon ke hain. Unhein khushkhabriyan hoon.

Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) siyahat se muraad roza lete hain. Isi tarah Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) bhi balke aap se marwi hai ke Qur'an Kareem mein jahan kahin yeh lafz aaya hai wahan yehi matlab hai. Dahhak bhi yehi kehte hain. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) farmati hain ke is ummat ki siyahat roza hai. Mujahid, Sa'eed, 'Ata, Abdur Rahman, Dahhak, Sufyan waghairah kehte hain ke muraad Sa'ihun se Sa'imoon hai. Ya'ni jo roze Ramazan ke rakhein. Abu 'Amr kehte hain roze par dawaam karne wale. Ek marfoo' hadith mein bhi hai ke muraad Sa'ihun se rozedar hain lekin is hadith ka mauqoof hona hi ziyada sahih hai. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is lafz ka matlab poochha gaya to aap ne yeh farmaya. Tamam aqwaal se ziyada sahih aur ziyada mashhoor to yehi qaul hai. Aur aisi daleelein bhi hain jin se sabit hota hai ke muraad siyahat se Allah ki rah mein jihaad hai. Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mujhe siyahat ki ijazat dijiye. Aap ne farmaya meri ummat ki siyahat Allah ki rah mein jihaad karna hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein siyahat ka zikr aaya to aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne hamein is ke badle apni rah ka jihaad aur har oonchai par Allahu Akbar kahna ata farmaya hai. Hazrat 'Ikrimah farmate hain aur muraad is se ilm-e-deen ke talib-e-ilm hain. Abdur Rahman farmate hain Allah ki rah ke muhajir hain. Ba'z log soofiya tabqah ke jo is se muraad lete hain ke zameen ki sair karna, safar mein rehna, idhar udhar jaana aana, pahadon, darron, junglon aur bandon mein phirna is ka naam siyahat hai, yeh mahz ghalat fehmi hai, yeh siyahat mashroo' nahin. Haan Allah na kare agar basti mein rehne se deen mein koi fitnah padne ka andesha ho to aur baat hai.

Jaise ke Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain qareeb hai ke momin ka sab se behtar maal bakriyan ban jaayein jin ke peeche woh pahadon ki chotiyon aur baarish barasne ki jagahon mein pada rahe, apne deen ko le kar fitnon se bhaagta aur bachta rahe. Allah ki hudood ki hifazat karne wale yani baqool Ibn Abbas Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at par qa'im rehne wale baqool Hasan Basri faraiz ki pabandi karne wale, Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke baja laane wale.

Mushrikeen ke liye dua-e-maghfirat ki Nabi Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mumana'at.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Abu Talib ki maut ke waqt us ke paas Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef le gaye. Wahan us waqt Abu Jahl aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayya bhi tha. Aap ne farmaya: Chacha! "La ilaha illallah" keh le, is kalme ki wajah se Allah Azza wa Jal ke haan mein teri sifarish to kar sakoon. Yeh sun kar un donon ne kaha ke ae Abu Talib! Kya tu Abdul Muttalib ke deen se phir jaye ga? Is par us ne kaha: Mein to Abdul Muttalib ke deen par hoon. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Khair, mein jab tak mana na kar diya jaon tere liye bakhshish mangta rahonga. Lekin (ooper wali aayat) utri. Ya'ni Nabi ko aur mominon ko layeq nahin ke woh mushrikon ke liye bakhshish mangain go woh un ke qareebi rishtedar hi hoan. Un par to yeh zahir ho chuka hai ke mushrik jahannami hain. Isi baare mein (إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ - Surah Al-Qasas: 56) bhi utri hai. Ya'ni tu jise muhabbat kare usey raah nahin dikha sakta balkeh Allah Ta'ala jise chahe raah dikhata hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne ek shakhs ki zabani apne mushrik maa baap ke liye istaghfar sun kar us se kaha ke tu mushrikon ke liye istaghfar karta hai? Us ne jawab diya ke kya Hazrat Ibrahim ne apne baap ke liye istaghfar nahin kiya? Farmate hain: Mein ne ja kar yeh zikr Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya. Is par yeh aayat utri. Kaha jab ke woh mar gaya phir mein nahin jaanta, yeh qaul Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai hum taqreeban ek hazar aadmi Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath ek safar mein the, aap manzil par utre, do rak'at namaz ada ki phir hamari taraf munh kar ke baithe. Us waqt Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aankhon se aansu jari the. Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) yeh dekh kar taab na la sake, uth kar arz kiya ke mere maa baap aap par fida hoan, kya baat hai? Aap ne farmaya: Baat yeh hai ke mein ne apne Rabb Azza wa Jal se apni walida ke liye istaghfar karne ki ijazat talab ki to mujhe ijazat na mili. Is par meri aankhein bhar aain ke meri maa hai aur jahannam ki aag hai. Achha aur suno! Mein ne tumhein teen cheezon se mana kiya tha ab woh mumana'at hat gayi hai. Ziyarat-e-quboor se mana kiya tha, ab tum karo kyunke is se tumhein bhalai yaad aaye gi. Mein ne tumhein teen din se zyada qurbani ke gosht ko rokne se mana farmaya tha ab tum khao aur jis tarah chaho rok rakho. Aur mein ne tumhein ba'z khas bartanon mein peene ko mana farmaya tha lekin ab tum jis bartan mein chaho pee sakte ho lekin khabardar nashe wali cheez hargiz na peena.

Ibn Jareer mein hai ke Makkah Shareef aate hue Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek nishan-e-qabr ke paas baith gaye aur kuch der khitab kar ke aap khade hue hum ne poochha ke ya Rasoolullah! Yeh kya baat thi? Aap ne farmaya: Mein ne apne Parwardigar se apni maa ki qabr ke dekhne ki ijazat mangi woh to mil gayi lekin is ke liye istaghfar karne ki ijazat mangi to na mili. Ab jo aap ne rona shuru kiya to hum ne to aap ko kabhi aisa itna rote nahin dekha.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke aap qabrastan ki taraf nikle, hum bhi aap ke sath the. Wahan aap ek qabr ke pas baith kar der tak munajat mein mashghool rahe, phir rone lage. Hum bhi khoob roye phir khade hue toh hum sab bhi khade ho gaye aap ne Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko aur hamein bula kar farmaya ke tum kaise roye? Hum ne kaha aap ko rota dekh kar aap ne farmaya yeh qabr meri maa Aamnah ki thi mein ne ise dekhne ki ijazat chahi thi jo mujhe mili thi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke dua ki ijazat na mili aur (Aayat Ma Kana etc.) utri pas jo maa ki muhabbat mein sadmah hona chahiye mujhe hua. Dekho mein ne ziyarat-e-qabr ki tumhein maman'at ki thi. Lekin ab mein rukhsat deta hoon kyunke is se aakhirat yaad aati hai.

Tabrani mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook ki wapsi mein umrah ke waqt Thaniyah Usfan se utarte hue aap ne sahabah se farmaya tum uqbah mein thehro, mein abhi aaya. Wahan se utar kar aap apni walidah ki qabr par gaye. Allah Ta'ala se der tak munajat karte rahe. Phir phoot phoot kar rona shuru kiya aap ke rone se sab log rone lage aur yeh samjhe ke aap ki ummat ke bare mein koi nayi baat paida hui jis se aap is qadar ro rahe hain. Unhein rota dekh kar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas palte aur daryaft farmaya ke tum log kyun ro rahe ho? Unhon ne jawab diya aap ko rota dekh kar aur yeh samajh kar ke shayad aap ki ummat ke bare mein koi aisa naya hukm utra jo taqat se bahar hai.

Aap ne farmaya suno baat yeh hai ke yahan meri maa ki qabr hai. Mein ne apne Parwardigar se Qayamat ke din apni maa ki shafa'at ki ijazat talab ki lekin Allah Ta'ala ne ata nahin farmayi toh mera dil bhar aaya aur mein rone laga. Jibra'eel aaye aur mujh se farmaya Ibrahim ka istighfar apne baap ke liye sirf ek wa'ade se tha jis ka wa'ada ho chuka tha lekin jab us par khul gaya ke us ka baap Allah ka dushman hai toh woh fauran bezaar ho gaya pas aap bhi apni maa se isi tarah bezaar ho jaiye jis tarah Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) apne baap se bezaar ho gaye. Pas mujhe apni maa par rahm aur tars aaya. Phir mein ne dua ki ke meri ummat par se charon sakhtiyan door kar di jayein Allah Ta'ala ne do toh door farma dein lekin do ke door farmane se inkar farma diya.

1. Aasman se patthar barsa kar un ki halakat.
2. Zameen unhein dhansa kar un ki halakat.
3. Un mein phoot aur ikhtilaf ka padna.
4. Un mein ek ko ek se eezayein pahunchna.

Un charon cheezon se bachao ki meri dua thi do pehli cheezein toh mujhe inayat ho gayein meri ummat aasmani pathrao se aur zameen mein dhansaye jaane se toh bacha di gayi. Haan aapas ka ikhtilaf aapas ki sar phatool yeh nahin uthi. Aap ki walidah ki qabr ek teele tale thi is liye aap raste se ghoom kar wahan gaye the.

Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur siyaq ajeeb hai. Lekin is se bhi zyada ghareeb aur munkar woh riwayat hai jo Imam Khateeb Baghdadi ne apni kitab banam Sabiq Lahiq mein majhool sanad se warid ki hai jis mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki walidah ko zindah kar diya aur eeman layein phir mar gayein.

Is tarah ki Suhaili ki ek riwayat hai jis mein ek nahin kayi ek rawi majhool hain. Is mein hai ke Aap ke maa baap dono dobara zinda huaye phir iman laye Ibn Dihya ne isi riwayat par nazrein jama kar kaha hai ke yeh nayi zindagi isi tarah ki hai jis tarah marwi hai ke suraj doob jaane ke baad wapas lauta aur Hazrat Ali ne namaz-e-asr ada ki. Tahawi to kehte hain ke suraj wali yeh riwayat sabit hai. Qurtubi kehte hain un ki do baar ki zindagi shar'an ya aqlan mumtani nahin. Kehte hain mein ne suna hai ke Aap ke chacha Abu Talib ko bhi Allah Ta'ala ne zinda kiya aur Aap par iman laya. Mein kehta hoon agar sahih riwayat se yeh riwayatein sabit hoon to beshak mani' koi nahin (lekin teenon riwayatein mehaz gap hain) Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain Aap ne irada kiya ke apni maa ke liye istighfar karein is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mana farmaya. To Aap ne Hazrat Ibrahim ke istighfar ko pesh kiya. Is ka jawab (aayat Ma kana istighfaru... al-ayah) mein mil gaya. Farmate hain is aayat se pehle mushrikeen ke liye istighfar kiya jata tha. Ab mamnoo ho gaya. Haan zindon ke liye ja'iz raha. Logon ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hamare badon mein aise bhi the jo paros ka ikram karte the, silah rahmi karte the, ghulam azaad karte the, zimmedari ka khayal rakhte the. To kya hum un ke liye istighfar na karein ? Aap ne farmaya kyun nahin, mein bhi apne walid ke liye istighfar karta hoon jaise ke Hazrat Ibrahim apne walid ke liye karte the. Is par (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi wal-ladhina amanu an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikina wa lau kanu uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum as-habul-jahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 113) tak nazil hui. Phir Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ka uzr bayan hua aur farmaya (Wa ma kana istighfaru Ibrahima li-abihi illa 'am mau'idatiw wa'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduwwul lillahi tabarra'a minhu inna Ibrahima la-awwahun halim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 114). Mazkoor hai ke Nabi-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe chand baatein wahi ki hain jo mere kanon mein goonj rahi hain aur mere dil mein jagah pakde huaye hain. Mujhe hukm farmaya gaya ke mein kisi is shakhs ke liye istighfar na karoon jo shirk par mara ho. Aur yeh ke jo shakhs apna faltu maal de de is ke liye yeh afzal hai aur jo rok rakhe is ke liye burai hai. Haan barabar sarabar hasb-e-zaroorat par Allah ke haan malamat nahin. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ek Yahudi mar gaya jis ka ek ladka tha lekin woh Musalman tha is liye apne baap ke janaze mein woh shareek na hua. Jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ko yeh baat maloom hui to farmane lage isay janaze mein jana chahiye tha aur dafan mein bhi maujood rehna chahiye tha aur baap ki zindagi tak is ke liye hidayat ki dua karni chahiye thi. Haan maut ke baad isay is ki halat par chhor deta.

Phir aap ne (Wa ma kana stighfaru Ibraheema li-abihi illa 'an maw'idatin wa'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduwwul lillahi tabarra'a minhu inna Ibraheema la-awwahun haleem 9:114) tilawat farmayi ke Hazrat Ibrahim ne yeh tariqa nahin chhora. Is ki sehat ki gawah Abu Dawood waghairah ki yeh riwayat bhi ho sakti hai ke Abu Talib ki maut par Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aakar kehte hain ke ya RasulAllah aap ke burohe chacha gumrah mar gaye hain. Aap ne farmaya jaao unhein dafna kar seedhe mere paas aao ilakh. Marwi hai ke jab Abu Talib ka janazah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se guzra to aap ne farmaya mein tujh se silah rehmi ka rishta nibha chuka. Hazrat Ata bin Abi Rabah farmate hain mein to qiblah ki taraf munh karne walon mein se kisi ke janazay ki namaz nah chhorunga. Go woh koi habshan zina se hamilah hi ho. Is liye Allah Ta'ala ne mushrikon par hi namaz-o-du'a haram ki hai aur farmaya hai (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi walladhina amanu an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikina walau kanu uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabul-jaheem 9:113). Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se ek shakhs ne suna ke woh kehte hain Allah Ta'ala is par rehm farmaye jo Abu Hurairah aur is ki maa ke liye astaghfar kare. To is ne kaha baap ke liye bhi. Aap ne farmaya nahin is liye ke mera baap shirk par mara hai. Aayat mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim par apne baap ka Allah ka dushman hona khul gaya. Ya'ni woh kufr hi par mar gaya. Marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din jab Hazrat Ibrahim se un ka baap milega. Nihayat sarasimegi pareshani ki halat mein chehra ghubar aalood aur kala pada hua hoga kahega ke Ibrahim aaj mein teri nafarmani nah karunga. Hazrat Ibrahim Janab-e-Bari mein arz karein ge ke mere Rab tu ne mujhe Qayamat ke din ruswa nah karne ka wa'dah kiya hua hai. Aur mera baap teri rehmat se door ho kar 'azab mein mubtala ho yeh bahut badi ruswai hai. Is par farmaya jaye ga ke apni peeth peeche dekho. Dekhein ge ke ek bijju keechad mein lathda hua khada hai. Ya'ni aap ke walid ki surat maskh ho gayi hogi aur is ke paon pakad kar ghaseet kar ise dozakh mein daal diya jaye ga. Farmata hai ke Ibrahim bada hi du'a karne wala tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se awwah ka matlab daryaft kiya gaya to aap ne farmaya rone dhone wala, Allah Ta'ala ke samne giryah-o-zari karne wala. Ibn Mas'ood farmate hain bahut hi rehm karne wala, makhlooq-e-Rab ke sath narmi aur sulook aur meharbani karne wala. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai poore yaqeen wala. Sacche iman wala, taubah karne wala, habshi zaban mein awwah mumin aur moqin yaqeen-o-iman wale ko kehte hain. Zun-Najjadain nami ek sahabi ko is bina par ke jab Qur'an Kareem mein Allah Ta'ala ka zikr hota to woh usi waqt du'a ke sath aawaz uthate the RasulAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne awwah farmaya. (Musnad Ahmad) Awwah se murad tasbeeh padhne wala.

Zuha ki namaz parhne wala. Apne gunahon ki yaad aane par istaghfar karne wala. Allah ke deen ki hifazat karne wala. Rabb se darne wala. Poshidah agar koi gunah ho jaye to taubah karne wala bhi marwi hai. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ek shakhs ka zikr hua kaha ke woh Allah Ta'ala ki bakasrat yaad karta hai aur Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karta rehta hai. Aap ne farmaya woh awwah hai. (Ibn Jarir) Isi Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek mayyit ko dafan kar ke farmaya yaqeenan tu awwah ya'ni bakasrat tilawat-e-Kalamullah Sharif karne wala tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek shakhs Baitullah Sharif ka tawaaf karte hue apni dua mein oh oh kar raha tha. Is ke intiqal ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ke dafan mein shamil the chunke raat ka waqt tha is liye aap ke sath charagh bhi tha. (Ibn Jarir) Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai. Ka'b Ahbar farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim ke samne Jahannam ka zikr hota tha to aap is se panah manga karte the. Ibn Abbas farmate hain "Awwah ya'ni faqeeh". Imam Ibn Jarir ka faislah yeh hai ke sab se behtar qawl in tamam aqwal mein yeh hai ke murad is lafz se bakasrat dua karne wala hai. Alfaaz ke munasib bhi yehi hai kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne yahan zikr yeh farmaya hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) apne walid ke liye istaghfar kiya karte the aur the bhi bakasrat dua mangne wale. Bardbaar bhi the, jo aap par zulm kare, aap se bura pesh aaye aap tahammul kar jaya karte the. Baap ne aap ko eeza di saaf keh diya tha ke tu mere ma'boodon se munh pher raha hai to agar apni is harkat se baaz na aaya to mein tujhe patthar maar maar kar maar daalon ga. Wagairah lekin phir bhi aap ne un ke liye istaghfar karne ka waadah kar liya, pas Allah farmata hai ke Ibrahim awwah aur haleem the.
