Wahan se utar kar aap apni walidah ki qabr par gaye. Allah Ta'ala se der tak munajat karte rahe. Phir phoot phoot kar rona shuru kiya aap ke rone se sab log rone lage aur yeh samjhe ke aap ki ummat ke bare mein koi nayi baat paida hui jis se aap is qadar ro rahe hain. Unhein rota dekh kar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas palte aur daryaft farmaya ke tum log kyun ro rahe ho? Unhon ne jawab diya aap ko rota dekh kar aur yeh samajh kar ke shayad aap ki ummat ke bare mein koi aisa naya hukm utra jo taqat se bahar hai.

Aap ne farmaya suno baat yeh hai ke yahan meri maa ki qabr hai. Mein ne apne Parwardigar se Qayamat ke din apni maa ki shafa'at ki ijazat talab ki lekin Allah Ta'ala ne ata nahin farmayi toh mera dil bhar aaya aur mein rone laga. Jibra'eel aaye aur mujh se farmaya Ibrahim ka istighfar apne baap ke liye sirf ek wa'ade se tha jis ka wa'ada ho chuka tha lekin jab us par khul gaya ke us ka baap Allah ka dushman hai toh woh fauran bezaar ho gaya pas aap bhi apni maa se isi tarah bezaar ho jaiye jis tarah Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) apne baap se bezaar ho gaye. Pas mujhe apni maa par rahm aur tars aaya. Phir mein ne dua ki ke meri ummat par se charon sakhtiyan door kar di jayein Allah Ta'ala ne do toh door farma dein lekin do ke door farmane se inkar farma diya.

1. Aasman se patthar barsa kar un ki halakat.
2. Zameen unhein dhansa kar un ki halakat.
3. Un mein phoot aur ikhtilaf ka padna.
4. Un mein ek ko ek se eezayein pahunchna.

Un charon cheezon se bachao ki meri dua thi do pehli cheezein toh mujhe inayat ho gayein meri ummat aasmani pathrao se aur zameen mein dhansaye jaane se toh bacha di gayi. Haan aapas ka ikhtilaf aapas ki sar phatool yeh nahin uthi. Aap ki walidah ki qabr ek teele tale thi is liye aap raste se ghoom kar wahan gaye the.

Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur siyaq ajeeb hai. Lekin is se bhi zyada ghareeb aur munkar woh riwayat hai jo Imam Khateeb Baghdadi ne apni kitab banam Sabiq Lahiq mein majhool sanad se warid ki hai jis mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki walidah ko zindah kar diya aur eeman layein phir mar gayein.

Is tarah ki Suhaili ki ek riwayat hai jis mein ek nahin kayi ek rawi majhool hain. Is mein hai ke Aap ke maa baap dono dobara zinda huaye phir iman laye Ibn Dihya ne isi riwayat par nazrein jama kar kaha hai ke yeh nayi zindagi isi tarah ki hai jis tarah marwi hai ke suraj doob jaane ke baad wapas lauta aur Hazrat Ali ne namaz-e-asr ada ki. Tahawi to kehte hain ke suraj wali yeh riwayat sabit hai. Qurtubi kehte hain un ki do baar ki zindagi shar'an ya aqlan mumtani nahin. Kehte hain mein ne suna hai ke Aap ke chacha Abu Talib ko bhi Allah Ta'ala ne zinda kiya aur Aap par iman laya. Mein kehta hoon agar sahih riwayat se yeh riwayatein sabit hoon to beshak mani' koi nahin (lekin teenon riwayatein mehaz gap hain) Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain Aap ne irada kiya ke apni maa ke liye istighfar karein is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mana farmaya. To Aap ne Hazrat Ibrahim ke istighfar ko pesh kiya. Is ka jawab (aayat Ma kana istighfaru... al-ayah) mein mil gaya. Farmate hain is aayat se pehle mushrikeen ke liye istighfar kiya jata tha. Ab mamnoo ho gaya. Haan zindon ke liye ja'iz raha. Logon ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hamare badon mein aise bhi the jo paros ka ikram karte the, silah rahmi karte the, ghulam azaad karte the, zimmedari ka khayal rakhte the. To kya hum un ke liye istighfar na karein ? Aap ne farmaya kyun nahin, mein bhi apne walid ke liye istighfar karta hoon jaise ke Hazrat Ibrahim apne walid ke liye karte the. Is par (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi wal-ladhina amanu an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikina wa lau kanu uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum as-habul-jahim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 113) tak nazil hui. Phir Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ka uzr bayan hua aur farmaya (Wa ma kana istighfaru Ibrahima li-abihi illa 'am mau'idatiw wa'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduwwul lillahi tabarra'a minhu inna Ibrahima la-awwahun halim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 114). Mazkoor hai ke Nabi-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe chand baatein wahi ki hain jo mere kanon mein goonj rahi hain aur mere dil mein jagah pakde huaye hain. Mujhe hukm farmaya gaya ke mein kisi is shakhs ke liye istighfar na karoon jo shirk par mara ho. Aur yeh ke jo shakhs apna faltu maal de de is ke liye yeh afzal hai aur jo rok rakhe is ke liye burai hai. Haan barabar sarabar hasb-e-zaroorat par Allah ke haan malamat nahin. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ek Yahudi mar gaya jis ka ek ladka tha lekin woh Musalman tha is liye apne baap ke janaze mein woh shareek na hua. Jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ko yeh baat maloom hui to farmane lage isay janaze mein jana chahiye tha aur dafan mein bhi maujood rehna chahiye tha aur baap ki zindagi tak is ke liye hidayat ki dua karni chahiye thi. Haan maut ke baad isay is ki halat par chhor deta.

Phir aap ne (Wa ma kana stighfaru Ibraheema li-abihi illa 'an maw'idatin wa'adaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu 'aduwwul lillahi tabarra'a minhu inna Ibraheema la-awwahun haleem 9:114) tilawat farmayi ke Hazrat Ibrahim ne yeh tariqa nahin chhora. Is ki sehat ki gawah Abu Dawood waghairah ki yeh riwayat bhi ho sakti hai ke Abu Talib ki maut par Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aakar kehte hain ke ya RasulAllah aap ke burohe chacha gumrah mar gaye hain. Aap ne farmaya jaao unhein dafna kar seedhe mere paas aao ilakh. Marwi hai ke jab Abu Talib ka janazah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se guzra to aap ne farmaya mein tujh se silah rehmi ka rishta nibha chuka. Hazrat Ata bin Abi Rabah farmate hain mein to qiblah ki taraf munh karne walon mein se kisi ke janazay ki namaz nah chhorunga. Go woh koi habshan zina se hamilah hi ho. Is liye Allah Ta'ala ne mushrikon par hi namaz-o-du'a haram ki hai aur farmaya hai (Ma kana lin-nabiyyi walladhina amanu an yastaghfiru lil-mushrikina walau kanu uli qurba mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahum annahum ashabul-jaheem 9:113). Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se ek shakhs ne suna ke woh kehte hain Allah Ta'ala is par rehm farmaye jo Abu Hurairah aur is ki maa ke liye astaghfar kare. To is ne kaha baap ke liye bhi. Aap ne farmaya nahin is liye ke mera baap shirk par mara hai. Aayat mein farman-e-Ilahi hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim par apne baap ka Allah ka dushman hona khul gaya. Ya'ni woh kufr hi par mar gaya. Marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din jab Hazrat Ibrahim se un ka baap milega. Nihayat sarasimegi pareshani ki halat mein chehra ghubar aalood aur kala pada hua hoga kahega ke Ibrahim aaj mein teri nafarmani nah karunga. Hazrat Ibrahim Janab-e-Bari mein arz karein ge ke mere Rab tu ne mujhe Qayamat ke din ruswa nah karne ka wa'dah kiya hua hai. Aur mera baap teri rehmat se door ho kar 'azab mein mubtala ho yeh bahut badi ruswai hai. Is par farmaya jaye ga ke apni peeth peeche dekho. Dekhein ge ke ek bijju keechad mein lathda hua khada hai. Ya'ni aap ke walid ki surat maskh ho gayi hogi aur is ke paon pakad kar ghaseet kar ise dozakh mein daal diya jaye ga. Farmata hai ke Ibrahim bada hi du'a karne wala tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se awwah ka matlab daryaft kiya gaya to aap ne farmaya rone dhone wala, Allah Ta'ala ke samne giryah-o-zari karne wala. Ibn Mas'ood farmate hain bahut hi rehm karne wala, makhlooq-e-Rab ke sath narmi aur sulook aur meharbani karne wala. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai poore yaqeen wala. Sacche iman wala, taubah karne wala, habshi zaban mein awwah mumin aur moqin yaqeen-o-iman wale ko kehte hain. Zun-Najjadain nami ek sahabi ko is bina par ke jab Qur'an Kareem mein Allah Ta'ala ka zikr hota to woh usi waqt du'a ke sath aawaz uthate the RasulAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne awwah farmaya. (Musnad Ahmad) Awwah se murad tasbeeh padhne wala.

Zuha ki namaz parhne wala. Apne gunahon ki yaad aane par istaghfar karne wala. Allah ke deen ki hifazat karne wala. Rabb se darne wala. Poshidah agar koi gunah ho jaye to taubah karne wala bhi marwi hai. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ek shakhs ka zikr hua kaha ke woh Allah Ta'ala ki bakasrat yaad karta hai aur Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karta rehta hai. Aap ne farmaya woh awwah hai. (Ibn Jarir) Isi Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek mayyit ko dafan kar ke farmaya yaqeenan tu awwah ya'ni bakasrat tilawat-e-Kalamullah Sharif karne wala tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek shakhs Baitullah Sharif ka tawaaf karte hue apni dua mein oh oh kar raha tha. Is ke intiqal ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ke dafan mein shamil the chunke raat ka waqt tha is liye aap ke sath charagh bhi tha. (Ibn Jarir) Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai. Ka'b Ahbar farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim ke samne Jahannam ka zikr hota tha to aap is se panah manga karte the. Ibn Abbas farmate hain "Awwah ya'ni faqeeh". Imam Ibn Jarir ka faislah yeh hai ke sab se behtar qawl in tamam aqwal mein yeh hai ke murad is lafz se bakasrat dua karne wala hai. Alfaaz ke munasib bhi yehi hai kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne yahan zikr yeh farmaya hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam / A.S) apne walid ke liye istaghfar kiya karte the aur the bhi bakasrat dua mangne wale. Bardbaar bhi the, jo aap par zulm kare, aap se bura pesh aaye aap tahammul kar jaya karte the. Baap ne aap ko eeza di saaf keh diya tha ke tu mere ma'boodon se munh pher raha hai to agar apni is harkat se baaz na aaya to mein tujhe patthar maar maar kar maar daalon ga. Wagairah lekin phir bhi aap ne un ke liye istaghfar karne ka waadah kar liya, pas Allah farmata hai ke Ibrahim awwah aur haleem the.

Ma'siyat ka tasalsul gumrahi ka beej hai. Allah Ta'ala khabar de raha hai ke woh Kareem-o-Aadil Allah kisi qaum ko hidayat karne ke baad hujjat poori kiye baghair gumrah nahin karta. Jaise aur jagah hai ke Samoodiyon ko hum ne hidayat di lekin unhon ne beenai ke bawajood andhe pan ko tarjeeh di. Oopar ki aayat ki munasabat ki wajah se mushrikon ke liye istighfar na karne ke bare mein khas taur par aur Allah Ta'ala ki har ma'siyat ke chhodne aur har ta'at ke baja laane mein aam taur par Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke liye bayan farma chuka hai. Ab jo chahe kare, jo chahe chhode. Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala aisa nahin karta ke mominon ko mushrik mardon ke istighfar se roke baghair hi un ke is istighfar ki wajah se unhein apne nazdeek gumrah bana de. Halanke is se peshtar woh unhein eeman ki rah par la chuka hai. Pas pehle apni kitab ke zariye unhein is se rok raha hai. Ab jo maan gaya aur Allah ki muman'at ke kaam se ruk gaya is par is se pehle kiye hue kaam ki wajah se gumrahi lazim nahin ho jati. Is liye ke ta'at-o-ma'siyat hukum-o-muman'at ke baad hoti hai. Is se pehle mutee' aur aasi zahir nahin hota. Pehle hi in cheezon ko woh zahir farma deta hai jis se bachana chahta hai. Woh poora ba-khabar aur sab se badh kar ilm wala hai. Phir momineen ko mushrikeen se aur un ke zi-ikhtiyar badshahon se jihad ki raghbat dilata hai. Aur unhein apni madad par bharosa karne ko farmata hai ke zameen-o-aasman ka mulk mein hi hoon. Tum mere dushmanon se mar'oob mat hona. Kaun hai jo un ka himayati ban sake? Aur kaun hai jo un ki madad par mere muqable mein aa sakta hai? Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne as-hab ke majma mein baithe hue farmane lage kya jo mein sunta hoon tum bhi sun rahe ho? Unhon ne jawab diya ke Hazrat hamare kaan mein koi aawaz nahin aa rahi. Aap ne farmaya mein aasmanon ka charcharana sun raha hoon dar-haqeeqat mein un ka charcharana theek bhi hai. In mein ek balisht bhar jagah aisi nahin jahan koi na koi farishta sajde mein aur qiyam mein na ho. Ka'ab Ahbar farmate hain sari zameen mein sui ke naake barabar ki jagah bhi aisi nahin jahan koi na koi farishta muqarrar na ho jo yahan ka ilm Allah ki taraf na pahunchata ho. Aasman ke farishton ki ginti zameen ke sangrezon se badi hai. Arsh ke uthane wale farishton ke takhne aur pindli ke darmiyan ka fasla ek sau saal ka hai.

Tapte sehra, shiddat ki pyas aur mujahideen sargaram-e-safar mujahid waghera farmate hain ke yeh ayat Jang-e-Tabuk ke bare mein utri hai is jang mein jaane ke waqt saal bhi qahat ka tha, garmiyon ka mausam tha, khane peene ki kami thi, raaston mein paani na tha. Shaam ke mulk tak ka door daraaz ka safar tha. Samaan-e-rasad ki itni kami ke do do aadmiyon mein ek ek khajoor batti thi. Phir to yeh ho gaya tha ke ek khajoor ek jamaat ko milti yeh choos kar use deta woh aur ko aur ek ek choos kar paani pi leta. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apni rehmat un par lazim kar di aur unhein wapas laya. 

Hazrat Umar R.A se jab is sakhti ka sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya. Sakht garmiyon ke zamane mein hum nigalne ko the, ek manzil mein toh pyas ke maare hamari gardanein tootne lageen yahan tak ke log apne oonton ko zabih kar ke uski ojhari nichod kar us paani ko peete aur phir use apne kaleje se laga lete us waqt Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A Rasulullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue. Aur arz kiya ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki duaaon ko hamesha hi qubool farmaya hai. Ab bhi dua kijiye ke Allah qubool farmaye aap ne haath utha kar dua shuru ki us waqt asman

Jang-e-Tabuk mein adam-e-shumooliyat se pasheman Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik (R.A) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ubaidullah jo aap ke nabeena ho jaane ke baad aap ka hath thaam kar le jaya le aaya karte the. Kehte hain ke Jang-e-Tabuk ke mauqa par mere walid ke reh jaane ka waqia khud unki zabani yeh hai ke farmate hain main is ke siwa kisi aur ghazwe mein peeche nahin raha. Haan Ghazwa-e-Badr ka zikr nahin, is mein jo log shamil nahin hue the un par koi sarzanish nahin hui. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to qafle ke irade se chale the lekin wahan Allah ki marzi se Quraish ke jangi markaz se larai thehr gayi. To chunke yeh larai be-khabari mein hui is liye main is mein hazir na ho saka is ke bajaye Alhamdulillah main Lailat-ul-Aqabah mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath tha jab ke hum ne Islam par muwafaqat ki thi aur mere nazdeek to yeh cheez Badr se bhi ziyada mahboob hai go Badr ki shohrat logon mein bahut ziyada hai. Achha ab Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ki ghair haziri ka waqia suniye is waqt mujhe jo aasani aur quwwat thi woh is se pehle kabhi muyassar na aai thi. Is waqt mere paas do do oontniyan theen. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis ghazwe mein jaate tauriya karte yaani aise alfaz kehte ke log saaf matlab na samjhein. Lekin chunke is waqt mausam sakht garam tha, safar bahut door daraz ka tha, dushman bari taddad mein tha, pas aap ne Musalmanon ke samne apna maqsad saaf saaf wazeh kar diya ke woh poori poori tayyari kar lein. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath is waqt Musalmanon ki taddad bhi itni ziyada thi ke register mein un ke naam na aa sake. Pas koi baaz-purs na thi jo bhi chahta ke main ruk jaon woh ruk sakta tha aur Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par is ka rukna makhfi reh sakta tha. Haan Allah ki wahi aa jaye yeh to baat hi aur hai. Is larai ke safar ke waqt phal pake hue the saaye barhe hue the. Musalman Sahaba aur khud Huzoor tayyariyon mein the, meri yeh halat thi ke subah nikalta tha ke saman tayyar kar loon lekin idhar idhar sham ho jaati aur main khali hath ghar laut jaata. Aur kehta koi baat nahin rupya hath tale hai, kal khareed loon ga aur tayyari kar loon ga. Yahan tak ke yunhi subah sham subah sham aaj kal aaj kal karte kooch ka din aa gaya aur lashkar-e-Islam ba-janib-e-Tabuk chal para main ne kaha koi baat nahin ek do din mein main bhi pahunchta hoon. Yunhi aaj ka kaam kal par dala aur kal ka parson par yahan tak ke lashkar door ja pahuncha. Gire pare log bhi chal diye main ne kaha khair door ho gaye aur kai din ho gaye to kya main tez chal kar ja miloon ga lekin afsos ke yeh bhi mujh se na ho saka iradon hi iradon mein reh gaya. Ab to yeh halat thi main bazaron mein nikalta to mujhe siwaye munafiqon aur beemar loole langre andhe mareezon aur mazoor logon ke aur koi nazar na aata. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Tabuk pahunch kar mujhe yaad farmaya ke Ka'b bin Malik ne kya kiya? Is par Banu Salmah ke ek shakhs ne kaha ise to achhe kapron aur jism ki rahat rasaani ne rook rakha hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Mu'adh bin Jabal (R.A) ne farmaya aap yeh durust nahin farma rahe Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamara khayal to Ka'b ki nisbat behtar hi hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho rahe. Jab mujhe maloom hua ke ab Aap laut rahe hain to mera jee bohat hi ghabraya. Aur mein heele bahane sochne laga ke yoon yoon bahana bana kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghusse se nikal jaunga apne walon se bhi rai mila loonga. Yahan tak ke mujhe maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine Sharif ke qareeb aa gaye to mein dil se baatil aur jhoot bilkul alag ho gaya. Aur mein ne samajh liya ke jhoote heele mujhe nijaat nahin dilwa sake. Sach hi ka aakhir bol bala rehta hai. Pas mein ne pukhta irada kar liya ke jhoot bilkul nahin bolunga. Saaf saaf sach sach baat keh dunga. Aap khair se tashreef laye aur hasb-e-aadat pehle masjid mein aaye do raka'at namaz ada ki aur wahein baithe. Isi waqt is jihad mein shirkat na karne wale aane lage aur uzr mazirat heele bahane karne lage. Yeh log assi se kuch oopar oopar the. Aap un ki baatein sunte aur androoni halat supurd-e-Allah kar ke zahiri baaton ko qabool farma kar un ke liye istighfar karte. Mein bhi hazir hua aur salam kiya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ghusse ke saath tabassum farmaya aur mujhe apne paas bulaya mein qareeb aan kar baith gaya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum kaise ruk gaye? Tum ne sawari bhi khareed li thi. Mein ne kaha Ya RasoolAllah agar Aap ke siwa kisi aur ke paas mein baitha hota to beesiyon baatein bana leta. Bolne mein aur baatein banane mein mein kisi se peeche nahin hoon. Lekin mein jaanta hoon ke aaj agar jhoot sach mila kar Aap ke ghusse se mein azaad ho gaya to mumkin hai kal Allah Ta'ala Aap ko haqeeqat-e-haal se muttala farma kar phir mujh se naraz kar de. Aur aaj mere sach ki bina par agar Aap mujh se bigde to ho sakta hai ke meri sachai ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala Aap ko mujh se phir khush kar de. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sach to yeh hai ke Wallah mujhe koi uzr na tha. Mujhe is waqt jo aasani aur fursat thi itni to kabhi is se pehle muyassar bhi nahin hui. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai to sacha hai. Achha tum jao Allah Ta'ala hi tumhare bare mein jo faisla kare ga wohi hoga. Mein khada ho gaya, Banu Salmah ke chand shakhs bhi mere saath hi uthe aur saath hi chale aur mujh se kehne lage is se pehle to tum se kabhi koi is qism ki khata nahin hui. Lekin ajab hai ke tum ne koi uzr mazirat pesh nahin ki jaise ke auron ne ki, phir Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare liye istighfar karte to tumhein yeh kafi tha. Algharaz kuch is tarah yeh log mere peeche pade ke mujhe khayal aane laga ke phir wapas jaun aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne apni pehli baat ko jhutla kar koi heela ghalat salat mein bhi pesh kar doon. Phir mein ne poochha kyun jee koi aur bhi mere jaisa is maamle mein aur hai? Unhon ne kaha haan haan do shakhs aur hain aur unhein bhi wohi jawab mila hai jo tumhein mila hai. Mein ne kaha woh kaun kaun hain unhon ne jawab diya Murarah bin Rabee Aamri aur Hilal bin Umayyah Waqfi in donon saleh aur neek Badri sahabiyon ka naam jab mein ne suna to mujhe poora itminan ho gaya aur ghar chal gaya. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum teenon se kalam karne se Musalmanon ko rok diya tha.

Log hum se alag ho gaye koi hum se bolta chalta na tha yahan tak ke mujhe to apna watan pardes ma'loom hone laga ke goya mein yahan ki kisi cheez se waqif hi nahin. Pachas raatein hum par isi tarah guzar gain. Woh do Badri buzurg to thak haar kar apne apne makan mein baith rahe bahar andar aana jana bhi unhon ne chhod diya. Mein zara ziyada aane jaane wala aur tez tabi'at wala tha. Na mein ne masjid jana chhada, na bazaron mein jana aana tark kiya. Haan mujh se koi bolta na tha. Namaz ke ba'ad jab ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) logon ke majma' mein tashreef farma hote to mein aata aur salam karta aur apne jee mein kehta ke mere salam ke jawab mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hont hile bhi ya nahin phir Aap ke qareeb hi kahin baith jata aur kankhiyon se Aap ko dekhta rehta. Jab mein namaz mein hota to Aap ki nigah mujh par padti lekin jahan mein Aap ki taraf iltifaat karta, Aap meri taraf se munh mor lete. Aakhir is tark-e-kalami ki tawaal muddat ne mujhe pareshan kar diya. Ek roz mein apne chacha zad bhai Abu Qatadah ke bagh ki deewar se kood kar un ke pas gaya. Mujhe un se bahut hi muhabbat thi. Mein ne salam kiya lekin Wallah unhon ne jawab na diya. Mein ne kaha Abu Qatadah tujhe Allah ki qasam kya tu nahin jaanta ke mein Allah aur Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se muhabbat rakhta hoon? Us ne khamoshi ikhtiyar ki mein ne dobara unhein qasam di aur poochha woh phir bhi khamosh rahe mein ne sih bara unhein qasam de kar yahi sawal kiya is ke jawab mein bhi woh khamosh rahe aur farmaya Allah aur us ke Rasul ko ziyada ilm hai. Ab to mein apne dil ko na rok saka. Meri donon aankhon se aansu behne lage aur bahut ghamgeen ho kar phir deewar par chadh kar bahar nikal gaya. Mein bazar mein ja raha tha ke mein ne Sham ke ek Qibti ko jo Madine mein ghalla bechne aaya tha yeh poochhte huye ke koi mujhe Ka'b bin Malik ka pata bata de logon ne ise meri taraf isharah kar ke bata diya woh mere pas aaya aur mujhe Shah-e-Ghassan ka khatt diya. Mein likha padha to tha hi. Mein ne padha to is mein likha tha hamein ma'loom hua hai ke tumhare sardar ne tum par zulm kiya hai tum koi aise gire pade aadmi nahin ho tum yahan darbar mein chale aao hum har tarah ki khidmat guzariyon ke liye tayyar hain. Mein ne apne dil mein sochha yeh ek aur museebat aur min-janib-Allah aazmaish hai. Mein ne to ja kar chulhe mein is ruq'e ko jala diya. Chalis raatein jab guzar chukin to mein ne dekha ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka qasid mere pas aa raha hai us ne aakar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka paigham pahunchaya tum apni biwi se alaihda raho. Mein ne poochha ya'ni kya talaq de doon ya kya karoon? Us ne kaha nahin talaq na do lekin un se milo julo nahin. Mere donon sathiyon ke pas bhi yahi paigham pahuncha.

Main ne to apni biwi se keh diya ke tum apne meke chali jao aur wohin raho jab tak ke Allah Ta'ala is amr ka faisla na kar de. Haan Hazrat Hilal bin Umayya ki biwi ne aakar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke mere khawand bahut burhe hain, kamzor bhi hain aur ghar mein koi khadim bhi nahin agar aap ijazat dein to main un ka kaam kaaj kar diya karoon. Aap ne farmaya is mein koi haraj nahin lekin woh tum se milein nahin. Unhon ne kaha Wallah un mein to harkat ki sakat hi nahin aur jab se yeh baat paida hui hai tab se le kar aaj tak un ke aansu thame hi nahin. Mujh se bhi mere ba'az doston ne kaha ke tum bhi itni ijazat to hasil kar lo jitni Hazrat Hilal ke liye mili hai. Lekin main ne jawab diya ke main is bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kuch nahin kahoon ga. Allah jaane aap jawab mein kya irshad farmayein? Zahir hai ke woh burhe aadmi hain aur main jawan hoon. Das din is baat par bhi guzar gaye aur hum se salam kalaam band hone ki poori pachas raatein guzar chukin. Is pachaswein raat ko subh ki namaz main ne apne ghar ki chhat par ada ki aur main dil-bardashta hairan-o-pareshan isi halat mein baitha hua tha jis ka naqsha Quran-e-Kareem ne kheencha hai ke apni jaan se tang tha, zameen ba-wujud apni kushadgi ke mujh par tang thi ke mere kaan mein Sal'a pahari par se kisi ki aawaz aayi ke woh ba-aawaz-e-buland keh raha tha ke ae Ka'b bin Malik khush ho ja. Wallah main is waqt sajde mein gir para aur samajh gaya ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall ki taraf se qabooliyat-e-tauba ki koi khabar aa gayi. Baat bhi yehi thi subh ki namaz ke baad Rasul-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh khabar Sahaba se bayan farmaai thi aur yeh sunte hi woh paidal aur sawar hum teenon ki taraf daur pare the ke hamein khabar pahunchayein. Ek sahib to apne ghorhe par sawar meri taraf khushkhabri liye hue aa rahe the lekin Aslam ke ek sahib ne daur kar pahar par charh kar ba-aawaz-e-buland mera naam le kar mujhe khushkhabri pahunchai sawar se pehle un ki aawaz mere kaan mein aa gayi. Jab yeh sahib mere paas pahunche to main ne apne pehne hue dono kaprhe unhein ba-taur-e-inaam de diye Wallah is din mere paas aur kuch bhi na tha. Do kaprhe aur udhaar le kar main ne pehne aur Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hone ke liye ghar se nikla. Raste mein jauq dar jauq log mujh se milne lage aur mujhe meri tauba ki bisharat mubarakbaad dene lage, ke Ka'b Allah Ta'ala ka tumhari tauba ko qabool farma lena tumhein mubarak ho. Main jab masjid mein pahuncha to Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef farma the aur deegar Sahaba bhi hazir-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) the. Mujhe dekhte hi Hazrat Talha bin Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) kharhe ho gaye aur daurte hue aage barh kar mujh se musafaha kiya aur mujhe mubarak baad di. Muhajireen mein se siwaye un ke aur koi sahib kharhe nahin hue. Hazrat Ka'b Hazrat Talha ki is muhabbat ko hamesha hi apne dil mein liye rahe. Jab main ne ja kar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se salam kiya, is waqt Aap ke chehra-e-mubarak ki ragein khushi se chamak rahi theen. Aap ne farmaya Ka'b tum par tumhari paidaish se le kar aaj tak aaj jaisa khushi ka din koi nahin guzra.

Main ne kaha ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh khushkhabri aap ki taraf se hai ya Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ki jaanib se? Aap ne farmaya nahin nahin balkeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jab koi khushi hoti toh aap ka chehra misl-e-chaand ke tukde ke chamakne lag jata tha aur har shakhs chehra-e-mubarak ko dekhte hi pehchan liya karta tha. Main ne aap ke paas beith kar arz kiya ke ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne nazr maani hai ke Allah Ta'ala meri taubah qabool farma le toh mera sab maal Allah ke naam sadqah hai. Is ke Rasul ke supurd hai. Aap ne farmaya thoda bahut maal apne paas rakh lo, yeh hi tumhare liye behtar hai. Main ne kaha jo hissah mera Khaibar mein hai woh toh mera raha baaqi lillah khairat hai. Ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) meri najaat ka zariya mera sach bolna hai main ne yeh bhi nazr maani hai ke baaqi zindagi bhi siwaye sach ke koi kalmah zaban se nahin nikalunga. Mera imaan hai ke sach ki wajah se jo ne'mat Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ata farmayi woh kisi musalman ko nahin mili. Is waqt se le kar aaj tak Bahamdulillah main ne kabhi jhoot nahin bola. Aur jo umar baaqi hai, is mein bhi Allah Ta'ala se mujhe yeh hi umeed hai. Allah Rabbul Izzat ne (Aayat Laqad Taab Allah) se kayi aayatein tak hamari taubah ke baare mein naazil farmayin. Islam ki ne'mat ke baad mujh par Allah Ta'ala ki badi ne'mat yeh bhi hai ke main ne is din Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne koi jhooti baat nah kahi jaise ke auron ne jhooti baatein banayin warna main bhi un ki tarah halak hojata. Un jhoote logon ko Kalamullah Shareef mein bahut hi bura kaha gaya. Farmaya (Aayat Sayahlifuna Billahi Lakum Al-ayah,) yaani tumhare wapas aane ke baad yeh log qasmein kha kha kar chahte hain ke tum un se chashm-poshi karlo. Achha tum chashm-poshi karlo lekin yaad rahe ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh log gande aur paleed hain. Un ka thikana Jahannam hai jo un ke amal ka badla hoga. Yeh tumhein raza-mand karne ke liye halaf utha rahe hain tum go un se raazi hojao lekin aise faasiq logon se Allah khush nahin. Tum teenon ke amr un logon ke amr se peeche daal diya gaya tha. Un ke uzr toh Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabool farmaye the, un se dobara bai'at karli thi aur un ke liye istighfar bhi kiya tha. Aur hamara mu'amlah taakheer mein pad gaya tha jis ka faislah khud Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya. Isi liye aayat ke alfaaz (Aayat Wa 'Alath-Thalaathatil-Ladhina Khullifu) hain. Pas is peeche chhod diye jaane se muraad ghazway se ruk jana nahin balkeh un logon ke jhoote uzr ke qabool kiye jaane se hamara mu'amlah mu'akhkhar kar dena hai. Yeh hadees bilkul sahih hai Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Alhamdulillah is hadees mein is aayat ki poori aur sahih tafseer maujood hai. Ke teenon buzurg Ansari the (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) Ajma'een. Ek riwayat mein Murarah bin Raabi'ah ke badle Raabi' bin Murarah aaya hai. Ek mein Raabi' bin Murar ya Murar bin Raabi' hai. Lekin sahih wohi hai jo Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai yaani Murarah bin Raabi' (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A). Haan Zuhri ki oopar wali riwayat mein jo yeh lafz hai ke woh dono Badri Sahabi the jo Hazrat Ka'b ki tarah chhod diye gaye the yeh khata hai.

In teenon buzurgon mein se ek bhi Badri nahin Vallahu A'lam. Chunke aayat mein zikr tha ke kisi tarah in buzurgon ne sahih sachha waqia keh diya jis se go kuchh dinon tak woh ranj-o-gham mein rahe lekin aakhir salamati aur abadi rahat mili. Is ke baad hi farmata hai ke ae momino sach bola karo aur sachai ko lazim pakde raho sachon mein ho jao taake halakat se najat pao, gham ranjam se chhoot jao. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke logo sachai ko lazim karlo, sach bhalai ki rahbari karta hai aur bhalai jannat ki rahbari karti hai. Insaan ke sach bolne aur sach par kar-band rahne se Allah ke haan Siddeeq likh liya jata hai. Jhoot se bacho. Jhoot bolte rahne se Allah ke haan Kazzab likh liya jata hai. Yeh hadees Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain qasdan ya mazaqan kisi haalat mein bhi jhoot insaan ke laaiq nahin. Kyunke Allah Maalik-ul-Mulk farmata hai eeman walo Allah se daro aur sachon ke saathi ban jao, pas kya tum is mein kisi ke liye bhi rukhsat paate ho? Baqaul Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) sachon se muraad Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ashaab hain. Agar sachon ke saath banna chahte ho to duniya mein be-raghbat raho aur musalmanon ko na satao.

Jang-e-Tabuk mein adam-e-shumooliyat se pasheman Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik (R.A) ke sahibzade Hazrat Ubaidullah jo aap ke nabeena ho jaane ke baad aap ka hath thaam kar le jaya le aaya karte the. Kehte hain ke Jang-e-Tabuk ke mauqa par mere walid ke reh jaane ka waqia khud unki zabani yeh hai ke farmate hain main is ke siwa kisi aur ghazwe mein peeche nahin raha. Haan Ghazwa-e-Badr ka zikr nahin, is mein jo log shamil nahin hue the un par koi sarzanish nahin hui. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to qafle ke irade se chale the lekin wahan Allah ki marzi se Quraish ke jangi markaz se larai thehr gayi. To chunke yeh larai be-khabari mein hui is liye main is mein hazir na ho saka is ke bajaye Alhamdulillah main Lailat-ul-Aqabah mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath tha jab ke hum ne Islam par muwafaqat ki thi aur mere nazdeek to yeh cheez Badr se bhi ziyada mahboob hai go Badr ki shohrat logon mein bahut ziyada hai. Achha ab Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ki ghair haziri ka waqia suniye is waqt mujhe jo aasani aur quwwat thi woh is se pehle kabhi muyassar na aai thi. Is waqt mere paas do do oontniyan theen. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis ghazwe mein jaate tauriya karte yaani aise alfaz kehte ke log saaf matlab na samjhein. Lekin chunke is waqt mausam sakht garam tha, safar bahut door daraz ka tha, dushman bari taddad mein tha, pas aap ne Musalmanon ke samne apna maqsad saaf saaf wazeh kar diya ke woh poori poori tayyari kar lein. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath is waqt Musalmanon ki taddad bhi itni ziyada thi ke register mein un ke naam na aa sake. Pas koi baaz-purs na thi jo bhi chahta ke main ruk jaon woh ruk sakta tha aur Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par is ka rukna makhfi reh sakta tha. Haan Allah ki wahi aa jaye yeh to baat hi aur hai. Is larai ke safar ke waqt phal pake hue the saaye barhe hue the. Musalman Sahaba aur khud Huzoor tayyariyon mein the, meri yeh halat thi ke subah nikalta tha ke saman tayyar kar loon lekin idhar idhar sham ho jaati aur main khali hath ghar laut jaata. Aur kehta koi baat nahin rupya hath tale hai, kal khareed loon ga aur tayyari kar loon ga. Yahan tak ke yunhi subah sham subah sham aaj kal aaj kal karte kooch ka din aa gaya aur lashkar-e-Islam ba-janib-e-Tabuk chal para main ne kaha koi baat nahin ek do din mein main bhi pahunchta hoon. Yunhi aaj ka kaam kal par dala aur kal ka parson par yahan tak ke lashkar door ja pahuncha. Gire pare log bhi chal diye main ne kaha khair door ho gaye aur kai din ho gaye to kya main tez chal kar ja miloon ga lekin afsos ke yeh bhi mujh se na ho saka iradon hi iradon mein reh gaya. Ab to yeh halat thi main bazaron mein nikalta to mujhe siwaye munafiqon aur beemar loole langre andhe mareezon aur mazoor logon ke aur koi nazar na aata. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Tabuk pahunch kar mujhe yaad farmaya ke Ka'b bin Malik ne kya kiya? Is par Banu Salmah ke ek shakhs ne kaha ise to achhe kapron aur jism ki rahat rasaani ne rook rakha hai. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Mu'adh bin Jabal (R.A) ne farmaya aap yeh durust nahin farma rahe Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamara khayal to Ka'b ki nisbat behtar hi hai.

Aur mein heele bahane sochne laga ke yoon yoon bahana bana kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ghusse se nikal jaunga apne walon se bhi rai mila loonga. Yahan tak ke mujhe maloom hua ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine Sharif ke qareeb aa gaye to mein dil se baatil aur jhoot bilkul alag ho gaya. Aur mein ne samajh liya ke jhoote heele mujhe nijaat nahin dilwa sake. Sach hi ka aakhir bol bala rehta hai. Pas mein ne pukhta irada kar liya ke jhoot bilkul nahin bolunga. Pachas raatein hum par isi tarah guzar gain. Woh do Badri buzurg to thak haar kar apne apne makan mein baith rahe bahar andar aana jana bhi unhon ne chhod diya. Mein zara ziyada aane jaane wala aur tez tabi'at wala tha. Na mein ne masjid jana chhada, na bazaron mein jana aana tark kiya. Haan mujh se koi bolta na tha. Namaz ke ba'ad jab ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) logon ke majma' mein tashreef farma hote to mein aata aur salam karta aur apne jee mein kehta ke mere salam ke jawab mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hont hile bhi ya nahin phir Aap ke qareeb hi kahin baith jata aur kankhiyon se Aap ko dekhta rehta. Jab mein namaz mein hota to Aap ki nigah mujh par padti lekin jahan mein Aap ki taraf iltifaat karta, Aap meri taraf se munh mor lete. Aakhir is tark-e-kalami ki tawaal muddat ne mujhe pareshan kar diya. Ek roz mein apne chacha zad bhai Abu Qatadah ke bagh ki deewar se kood kar un ke pas gaya. Mujhe un se bahut hi muhabbat thi. Mein ne salam kiya lekin Wallah unhon ne jawab na diya. Mein ne kaha Abu Qatadah tujhe Allah ki qasam kya tu nahin jaanta ke mein Allah aur Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se muhabbat rakhta hoon? Us ne khamoshi ikhtiyar ki mein ne dobara unhein qasam di aur poochha woh phir bhi khamosh rahe mein ne sih bara unhein qasam de kar yahi sawal kiya is ke jawab mein bhi woh khamosh rahe aur farmaya Allah aur us ke Rasul ko ziyada ilm hai. Ab to mein apne dil ko na rok saka. Meri donon aankhon se aansu behne lage aur bahut ghamgeen ho kar phir deewar par chadh kar bahar nikal gaya. Mein bazar mein ja raha tha ke mein ne Sham ke ek Qibti ko jo Madine mein ghalla bechne aaya tha yeh poochhte huye ke koi mujhe Ka'b bin Malik ka pata bata de logon ne ise meri taraf isharah kar ke bata diya woh mere pas aaya aur mujhe Shah-e-Ghassan ka khatt diya. Mein likha padha to tha hi. Mein ne padha to is mein likha tha hamein ma'loom hua hai ke tumhare sardar ne tum par zulm kiya hai tum koi aise gire pade aadmi nahin ho tum yahan darbar mein chale aao hum har tarah ki khidmat guzariyon ke liye tayyar hain. Mein ne apne dil mein sochha yeh ek aur museebat aur min-janib-Allah aazmaish hai. Mein ne to ja kar chulhe mein is ruq'e ko jala diya. Chalis raatein jab guzar chukin to mein ne dekha ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka qasid mere pas aa raha hai us ne aakar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka paigham pahunchaya tum apni biwi se alaihda raho. Mein ne poochha ya'ni kya talaq de doon ya kya karoon? Us ne kaha nahin talaq na do lekin un se milo julo nahin. Mere donon sathiyon ke pas bhi yahi paigham pahuncha.

Main ne to apni biwi se keh diya ke tum apne meke chali jao aur wohin raho jab tak ke Allah Ta'ala is amr ka faisla na kar de. Haan Hazrat Hilal bin Umayya ki biwi ne aakar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke mere khawand bahut burhe hain, kamzor bhi hain aur ghar mein koi khadim bhi nahin agar aap ijazat dein to main un ka kaam kaaj kar diya karoon. Aap ne farmaya is mein koi haraj nahin lekin woh tum se milein nahin. Unhon ne kaha Wallah un mein to harkat ki sakat hi nahin aur jab se yeh baat paida hui hai tab se le kar aaj tak un ke aansu thame hi nahin. Mujh se bhi mere ba'az doston ne kaha ke tum bhi itni ijazat to hasil kar lo jitni Hazrat Hilal ke liye mili hai. Lekin main ne jawab diya ke main is bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kuch nahin kahoon ga. Allah jaane aap jawab mein kya irshad farmayein? Zahir hai ke woh burhe aadmi hain aur main jawan hoon. Das din is baat par bhi guzar gaye aur hum se salam kalaam band hone ki poori pachas raatein guzar chukin. Is pachaswein raat ko subh ki namaz main ne apne ghar ki chhat par ada ki aur main dil-bardashta hairan-o-pareshan isi halat mein baitha hua tha jis ka naqsha Quran-e-Kareem ne kheencha hai ke apni jaan se tang tha, zameen ba-wujud apni kushadgi ke mujh par tang thi ke mere kaan mein Sal'a pahari par se kisi ki aawaz aayi ke woh ba-aawaz-e-buland keh raha tha ke ae Ka'b bin Malik khush ho ja. Wallah main is waqt sajde mein gir para aur samajh gaya ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall ki taraf se qabooliyat-e-tauba ki koi khabar aa gayi. Baat bhi yehi thi subh ki namaz ke baad Rasul-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh khabar Sahaba se bayan farmaai thi aur yeh sunte hi woh paidal aur sawar hum teenon ki taraf daur pare the ke hamein khabar pahunchayein. Ek sahib to apne ghorhe par sawar meri taraf khushkhabri liye hue aa rahe the lekin Aslam ke ek sahib ne daur kar pahar par charh kar ba-aawaz-e-buland mera naam le kar mujhe khushkhabri pahunchai sawar se pehle un ki aawaz mere kaan mein aa gayi. Jab yeh sahib mere paas pahunche to main ne apne pehne hue dono kaprhe unhein ba-taur-e-inaam de diye Wallah is din mere paas aur kuch bhi na tha. Do kaprhe aur udhaar le kar main ne pehne aur Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hone ke liye ghar se nikla. Raste mein jauq dar jauq log mujh se milne lage aur mujhe meri tauba ki bisharat mubarakbaad dene lage, ke Ka'b Allah Ta'ala ka tumhari tauba ko qabool farma lena tumhein mubarak ho. Main jab masjid mein pahuncha to Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef farma the aur deegar Sahaba bhi hazir-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) the. Mujhe dekhte hi Hazrat Talha bin Abdullah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) kharhe ho gaye aur daurte hue aage barh kar mujh se musafaha kiya aur mujhe mubarak baad di. Muhajireen mein se siwaye un ke aur koi sahib kharhe nahin hue. Hazrat Ka'b Hazrat Talha ki is muhabbat ko hamesha hi apne dil mein liye rahe. Jab main ne ja kar Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se salam kiya, is waqt Aap ke chehra-e-mubarak ki ragein khushi se chamak rahi theen. Aap ne farmaya Ka'b tum par tumhari paidaish se le kar aaj tak aaj jaisa khushi ka din koi nahin guzra.

Main ne kaha ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh khushkhabri aap ki taraf se hai ya Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ki jaanib se? Aap ne farmaya nahin nahin balkeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jab koi khushi hoti toh aap ka chehra misl-e-chaand ke tukde ke chamakne lag jata tha aur har shakhs chehra-e-mubarak ko dekhte hi pehchan liya karta tha. Main ne aap ke paas beith kar arz kiya ke ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne nazr maani hai ke Allah Ta'ala meri taubah qabool farma le toh mera sab maal Allah ke naam sadqah hai. Is ke Rasul ke supurd hai. Aap ne farmaya thoda bahut maal apne paas rakh lo, yeh hi tumhare liye behtar hai. Main ne kaha jo hissah mera Khaibar mein hai woh toh mera raha baaqi lillah khairat hai. Ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) meri najaat ka zariya mera sach bolna hai main ne yeh bhi nazr maani hai ke baaqi zindagi bhi siwaye sach ke koi kalmah zaban se nahin nikalunga. Mera imaan hai ke sach ki wajah se jo ne'mat Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ata farmayi woh kisi musalman ko nahin mili. Is waqt se le kar aaj tak Bahamdulillah main ne kabhi jhoot nahin bola. Aur jo umar baaqi hai, is mein bhi Allah Ta'ala se mujhe yeh hi umeed hai. Allah Rabbul Izzat ne (Aayat Laqad Taab Allah) se kayi aayatein tak hamari taubah ke baare mein naazil farmayin. Islam ki ne'mat ke baad mujh par Allah Ta'ala ki badi ne'mat yeh bhi hai ke main ne is din Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne koi jhooti baat nah kahi jaise ke auron ne jhooti baatein banayin warna main bhi un ki tarah halak hojata. Un jhoote logon ko Kalamullah Shareef mein bahut hi bura kaha gaya. Farmaya (Aayat Sayahlifuna Billahi Lakum Al-ayah,) yaani tumhare wapas aane ke baad yeh log qasmein kha kha kar chahte hain ke tum un se chashm-poshi karlo. Achha tum chashm-poshi karlo lekin yaad rahe ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh log gande aur paleed hain. Un ka thikana Jahannam hai jo un ke amal ka badla hoga. Yeh tumhein raza-mand karne ke liye halaf utha rahe hain tum go un se raazi hojao lekin aise faasiq logon se Allah khush nahin. Tum teenon ke amr un logon ke amr se peeche daal diya gaya tha. Un ke uzr toh Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabool farmaye the, un se dobara bai'at karli thi aur un ke liye istighfar bhi kiya tha. Aur hamara mu'amlah taakheer mein pad gaya tha jis ka faislah khud Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya. Isi liye aayat ke alfaaz (Aayat Wa 'Alath-Thalaathatil-Ladhina Khullifu) hain. Pas is peeche chhod diye jaane se muraad ghazway se ruk jana nahin balkeh un logon ke jhoote uzr ke qabool kiye jaane se hamara mu'amlah mu'akhkhar kar dena hai. Yeh hadees bilkul sahih hai Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Alhamdulillah is hadees mein is aayat ki poori aur sahih tafseer maujood hai. Ke teenon buzurg Ansari the (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) Ajma'een. Ek riwayat mein Murarah bin Raabi'ah ke badle Raabi' bin Murarah aaya hai. Ek mein Raabi' bin Murar ya Murar bin Raabi' hai. Lekin sahih wohi hai jo Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai yaani Murarah bin Raabi' (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A). Haan Zuhri ki oopar wali riwayat mein jo yeh lafz hai ke woh dono Badri Sahabi the jo Hazrat Ka'b ki tarah chhod diye gaye the yeh khata hai.

In teenon buzurgon mein se ek bhi Badri nahin Vallahu A'lam. Chunke aayat mein zikr tha ke kisi tarah in buzurgon ne sahih sachha waqia keh diya jis se go kuchh dinon tak woh ranj-o-gham mein rahe lekin aakhir salamati aur abadi rahat mili. Is ke baad hi farmata hai ke ae momino sach bola karo aur sachai ko lazim pakde raho sachon mein ho jao taake halakat se najat pao, gham ranjam se chhoot jao. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke logo sachai ko lazim karlo, sach bhalai ki rahbari karta hai aur bhalai jannat ki rahbari karti hai. Insaan ke sach bolne aur sach par kar-band rahne se Allah ke haan Siddeeq likh liya jata hai. Jhoot se bacho. Jhoot bolte rahne se Allah ke haan Kazzab likh liya jata hai. Yeh hadees Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain qasdan ya mazaqan kisi haalat mein bhi jhoot insaan ke laaiq nahin. Kyunke Allah Maalik-ul-Mulk farmata hai eeman walo Allah se daro aur sachon ke saathi ban jao, pas kya tum is mein kisi ke liye bhi rukhsat paate ho? Baqaul Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) sachon se muraad Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ashaab hain. Agar sachon ke saath banna chahte ho to duniya mein be-raghbat raho aur musalmanon ko na satao.

Ghazwa-e-Tabook Mein Shamil Nah Hone Walon Ko Tanbeeh

Un logon ko Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath nahin gaye the Allah Ta'ala dant raha hai ke Madine walon ko aur is ke aas paas ke logon ko mujahideen ke barabar sawab wala nahin samajhna chahiye, woh is ajr-o-sawab se mahroom rah gaye jo un mujahideen fi sabilillah ko mila. Mujahideen ko un ki pyas par, takleef par, bhook par, theherne aur chalne par, zafar aur ghalbe par, gharaz har har harkat-o-sukoon par Allah ki taraf se ajr-e-azeem milta rehta hai. Rab ki zaat is se paak hai ke kisi neeki karne wale ki mehnat barbaad kar de.

Mujahideen ke a'maal ka behtareen badla Qurbat-e-Ilahi hai

Yeh mujahid jo kuch thoda bahut kharch karein aur rah-e-Allah mein jis zameen par chalein phirein, woh sab un ke liye likh liya jata hai. Yeh nukta yaad rahe ke oopar ka kaam zikr karke ajr ke bayan mein lafz "bi" laye thay aur yahan nahin laye is liye ke woh ghair ikhtiyaari af'aal thay aur yeh khud un se saadir hote hain. Pas yahan farmata hai ke unhein un ke a'maal ka behtareen badla Allah Ta'ala dega. Is aayat ka bahut bada hissa aur is ka kaamil ajr Hazrat Uthman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne sameta hai. Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein aap ne dil khol kar maal kharch kiya. Chunanche Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Nabi Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khutbe mein is sakhti ke lashkar ki imdad ka zikr farma kar is ki raghbat dilai to Hazrat Uthman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ke ek sau oont ma' apne kajawe palaan rasiyon waghairah ke mein doonga. Aap ne phir isi ko bayan farmaya to phir se Hazrat Uthman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya ek sau aur bhi doonga. Aap ek zeena mimbar ka utre phir raghbat dilai to Hazrat Uthman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne phir farmaya ek sau aur bhi. Aap ne khushi khushi apna haath hilate huway farmaya bas Uthman! Aaj ke baad koi amal nah bhi kare to bhi yeh hi kaafi hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek hazar dinaar ki theeli la kar Hazrat Uthman ne aap ke palle mein daal di. Aap unhein apne haath se ulat pulat karte jaate thay aur farma rahe thay aaj ke baad yeh jo bhi amal karein unhein nuqsan nah dega. Baar baar yeh hi farmate rahe. Is aayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain jis qadar insan apne watan se Allah ki rah mein door nikalta hai, utna hi Allah ke qurb mein barhta hai.

Nabi Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Ko Tanha Nah Chhoden

Is aayat mein is bayan ki tafseel hai jo Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chalne ke muta'alliq tha. Salaf ki ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke jab khud Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jihad mein niklein to aap ka sath dena har Musalman par wajib hai jaise farmaya: "Infiroo khifaafan wa thiqaalan wa jaahidoo bi-amwaalikum wa anfusikum fee sabeelillaahi zaalikum khairun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon" (Surah At-Tawbah: 41) aur farmaya hai (aayat "Maa kaana li-ahlil-madeenati...") yani halke bhaari nikal khade ho jao. Madine aur is ke aas paas ke logon ko laaiq nahin ke woh Rasulullah ke peeche reh jayein. Pas yeh hukum is aayat se mansookh ho gaya.

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh qabeelon ke nikalne ka bayan hai aur har qabeele ki ek jama'at ke nikalne ka agar woh sab nah jayein taake aap ke sath jaane wale aap par utri hui wahi ko samjhein aur wapas aakar apni qaum ko dushman ke haalaat se baakhabar karein. Pas unhein dono baatein is kooch mein haasil ho jayeingi. Aur aap ke baad qabeelon mein se jaane wali jama'at ya to deeni samajh ke liye hogi ya jihad ke liye. Kyunke yeh farz-e-kifayah hai.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se is aayat ke yeh ma'ni bhi marwi hain ke Musalmanon ko yeh chahiye ke sab ke sab chale jayein aur Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tanha chhod dein. Har jama'at mein se chand log jayein aur aap ki ijazat se jayein jo baaqi hain woh un ke baad jo Quran utre, jo ahkaam bayan hoin, unhein sikhein, samjhein. Jab yeh aa jayein to unhein sikhayein padhayein. Is waqt aur log jayein. Yeh silsilah jaari rehna chahiye.

Mujahid farmate hain: Yeh un sahabiyon ke baare mein utri hai jo baadiya nasheenon mein gaye wahan unhein fawaid bhi pahunche aur nafa' ki cheezein bhi mileen. Aur logon ko unhon ne hidayat bhi keen. Lekin ba'z logon ne unhein ta'nah diya ke tum log apne saathiyon ke peeche reh jaane wale ho. Woh maidaan-e-jihad mein gaye aur tum aaraam se yahan hum mein ho. Un ke bhi dil mein yeh baat baith gayi wahan se wapas Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chale aaye. Pas yeh aayat utri aur unhein ma'zoor samajha gaya.

Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain ke jab Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) lashkaron ko bhejein to kuch logon ko aap ki khidmat mein hi rehna chahiye ke woh deen sikhein aur kuch log jayein apni qaum ko da'wat-e-haq dein aur unhein aglay waqiaat se ibrat dilayein.

Dahhak farmate hain jab Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nafs-e-nafees jihad ke liye niklein is waqt siwaye ma'zooron, andhon waghairah ke kisi ko halal nahin ke aap ke sath nah jaye aur jab aap lashkaron ko rawana farmayein to kisi ko halal nahin ke aap ki ijazat baghair jaye. Yeh log jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas rahte the, apne saathiyon ko jab ke woh wapas laut'te un ke baad ka utra hua Quran aur bayan shudah ahkaam suna dete pas aap ki maujoodgi mein sab ko nah jaana chahiye.

Marwi hai ke yeh aayat jihad ke baare mein nahin balkeh jab Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qabeele Mudar par qaht saali ki bad-du'a ki aur un ke haan qaht pada to un ke poore qabeele ke qabeele Madeene Shareef mein chale aaye.

Jahan jhoot moot Islam zahir kar ke Sahaba par apna baar daal diya. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne Mominon ko mutanabbeh kiya ke dar-asl yeh Momin nahin. Aap ne unhein un ki jama'aton ki taraf wapas kiya aur un ki qaum ko aisa karne se daraya. Kehte hain ke har qabile mein se kuch log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein aate, Deen-e-Islam seekhte wapas ja kar apni qaum ko Allah Rasool ki ata'at ka hukm karte, Namaz Zakat ke masail samjhate, un se saaf farma dete ke jo Islam qabool kar le ga woh hamara hai warna nahin. Jahan tak ke maan baap ko bhi chhod dete. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein masle masail se aagah kar dete, hukm ahkam sikha padha dete woh Islam ke muballigh ban kar jaate manne walon ko khush khabriyan dete, na manne walon ko darate.

Ikrimah farmate hain jab (Illa tanfiroo yu'azzibkum 'azaaban aleeman wa yastabdil qauman ghairakum wa la tadurroohu shai'an wallahu 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer) (9: At-Tawbah: 39) aur aayat (Ma kaana li-ahlil-madinati wa man haulahum minal-a'raabi an yatakhallfoo 'an Rasoolillahi wa la yarghaboo bi-anfusihim 'an nafsih, zaalika bi-annahum la yuseebuhum zama'un wa la nasabun wa la makhmasatun fee sabeelillahi wa la yata'oona mauti'an yagheedhul-kuffaara wa la yanaaloona min 'aduwwin nailan illa kutiba lahum bihi 'amalun saalih, innallaha la yudee'u ajral-muhsineen) (9: At-Tawbah: 120) utrein toh munafiqon ne kaha phir toh baadiyah nasheen log halak ho gaye ke woh Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath nahin jaate. Ba'z Sahaba bhi un mein taleem-o-tableegh ke liye gaye huwe the pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat nazil farmayi aur (Wallazeena yuhaajjoona fillahi min ba'di ma-stujeeba lahu hujjatuhum daahidhatun 'inda Rabbihim wa 'alaihim ghadhabun wa lahum 'azaabun shadeed) (42: Ash-Shura: 16) bhi utri.

Hasan Basri farmate hain ke jo log Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath gaye hain woh mushrikon par ghalbah-o-nusrat dekh kar wapas aan kar apni qaum ko dara dein.

Islami markaz ka istahkam awwaleen usool hai. Islami markaz ke muttasil jo kuffar hain, pehle to Musalmanon ko un se nimatna chahiye. Isi hukum ke bamojib Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pehle Jazeerat-ul-Arab ko saaf kiya, yahan ghalba paakar Makkah, Madinah, Taif, Yemen, Yamamah, Hajar, Khaibar, Hadhramaut waghairah kul ilaaqa fatah kar ke yahan ke logon ko Islami jhanday tale khada kar ke Ghazwa-e-Room ki tayyari ki. Jo awwal to Jazeerat-ul-Arab se mulhaq tha doosre wahan ke rehne wale Ahl-e-Kitab thay. Tabook tak pohanch kar haalat ki nasaazgari ki wajah se aage ka azam tark kiya. Yeh waqia 9 Hijri ka hai. Daswein saal Hujjat-ul-Wada mein mashghool rahe. Aur Hajj ke sirf ikasi din baad Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ko pyare huay. Aap ke baad Aap ke naib, dost aur khaleefa Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aaye is waqt Deen-e-Islam ki bunyaden mutazalzil ho rahi thin ke Aap ne unhein majboot kar diya aur Musalmanon ki abtari ko bartari se badal diya. Deen se bhaagne walon ko wapas Islam mein le aaye. Murtaddon se duniya khaali ki. Un sarkashon ne jo Zakat rok li thi un se wasool ki, jahilon par haq waazih kiya. Amanat-e-Rasool ada ki. Aur un ibtidai zaroori kaamon se farigh hote hi Islami lashkaron ko sar zameen-e-Room ki taraf dauda diya ke Saleeb paraston ko hidayat karein. Aur aise hi jarrar lashkar Faris ki taraf bheje ke wahan ke aatish kade thandey karein. Pas Aap ki safarat ki barkat se Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne har taraf fatah ata farmai. Kisra aur Qaisar khaak mein mil gaye. Un ke parastar bhi ghaarat-o-barbaad huay, un ke khazane raah-e-Allah mein kaam aaye. Aur jo khabar Allah ke Rasool Salamullah Alaihi de gaye thay woh poori hui. Jo kasar reh gayi thi Aap ke wasi aur wali Shaheed-e-Mehrab Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke haathon poori hui. Kafiron aur munafiqon ki rag hamesha ke liye kuchal di gayi. Un ke zor dha diye gaye. Aur mashriq-o-maghrib tak Farooqi saltanat phail gayi. Qareeb-o-baeed se bharpoor khazane Darbar-e-Farooq mein aane lage aur shar'i tor par Hukum-e-Ilahi ke matahat Musalmanon mein, mujahideen mein taqseem hone lage. Is paak nafs, paak rooh shaheed ki shahadat ke baad Muhajireen-o-Ansar ke ijma se Amr-e-Khilafat Ameer-ul-Moomineen Shaheed-ud-Dar Hazrat Uthman bin Affan (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke supurd hua. Is waqt Islam apni asli shaan se zuhoor pazeer tha. Islam ke lambay aur zor aawar haathon ne roo-e-zameen par qabza jama liya tha. Bandon ki gardanen Allah ke samne kham ho chukin thin. Hujjat-e-Rabbani zahir thi, Kalimah-e-Ilahi ghalib tha. Shaan-e-Uthman apna kaam karti jaati thi. Aaj is ko halqa bagosh kiya to kal is ko yake baad deegare kai mamalik Musalmanon ke haathon zer-e-nageen-e-khilafat huay. Yehi tha is aayat ke pehle jumlay par amal ke nazdeek ke kafiron se jihad karo. Phir farmata hai ke ladai mein unhein tumhara zor-e-baazu maloom ho jaye. Kamil Moomin woh hai jo apne moomin bhai se to narmi barte lekin apne dushman kafir par sakht ho.

Jaise farman hai: "(Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu man yartadda minkum 'an dinihi fasawfa ya'tillahu biqawmiy-yuhibbuhum wa yuhibbunahu adhillatin 'alal-mu'minina 'a-'izzatin 'alal-kafirina yujahiduna fi sabilillahi wa la yakhafuna lawmata la'im, dhalika fadlullahi yu'tihi may-yasha'u wallahu Wasi'un 'Alim)" [5. Al-Ma'idah: 54] ya'ni Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko layega jo us ke mahbub hon aur woh bhi us se muhabbat rakhte hon. Mominon ke samne to narm hon aur kafiron par zi-'izzat hon. Is tarah aur aayat mein hai ke Muhammad Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke sath wale aapas mein narm-dil hain, kafiron par sakht hain. Irshad hai: "(Ya ayyuhan-Nabiyyu jahidil-kuffara wal-munafiqina waghluz 'alaihim wa ma'wahum Jahannamu wa bi'sal-masir)" [9. At-Tawbah: 73] ya'ni Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad karo aur un par sakhti karo. Hadith mein hai ke mein dahuk hon ya'ni apnon mein narmi karne wala aur qattal hon ya'ni dushmanan-e-Rabb se jihad karne wala. Phir farmata hai ke jaan rakho ke Allah Ta'ala parhezgaron ke sath hai. Ya'ni kafiron se laro, bharosa Allah par rakho, aur yaqin mano ke jab tum us se darte rahoge, us ki farmanbardari karte rahoge, to us ki madad-o-nusrat bhi tumhare sath rahe gi. Dekh lo khair ke tinon zamanon tak Musalmanon ki yahi halat rahi. Dushman tabah-hal aur maghlub rahe. Lekin jab un mein taqwa aur ita'at kam ho gayi, fitne fasad par gaye, ikhtilaf aur khwahish-pasandi shuru ho gayi, to woh baat na rahi, dushmanon ki lalcha'i hu'i nazrein un ki taraf uthin. Woh apni kamin-gahon se nikal khare hu'e, idhar ka rukh kiya lekin phir bhi Musalman salatin aapas mein uljhe rahe, woh idhar-udhar se nawale lene lage. Aakhir dushman aur barhe, saltanatein kuchalni shuru kin, mulk fatah karne shuru kiye. Aah! Aksar hissa Islami Musalmanon ke hath se nikal gaya. Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ka yahi hukm us se pehle tha aur us ke ba'd bhi hai ke woh phir se Musalmanon ko ghalba de aur kafiron ki chotiyan un ke hath mein de de. Dunya jahan mein un ka bol-bala ho, aur phir se mashriq se le kar maghrib tak parcham-e-Islam lahrane lage. Woh Allah Karim-o-Jawad hai.

Farman-e-Ilahi mein shak-o-shubha kufr ka marz hai. Quran ki koi surat utri aur munafiqon ne aapas mein kana-phoosi shuru ki ke batao is surat ne kis ka iman zyada kar diya? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke imandaron ke iman to Allah ki aayatein barha deti hain. Yeh aayat bohat bari daleel hai is par ke iman ghat'ta barhta rehta hai. Aksar a'immah aur ulama ka yahi mazhab hai, salaf ka bhi aur khalaf ka bhi. Balkey bohat se buzurgon ne is par ijma naql kiya hai. Hum is mas'ale ko khoob tafseel se Sharh-e-Bukhari ke shuru mein bayan kar aaye hain. Haan jin ke dil pehle hi se shak-o-shubha ki bemari mein hain un ki kharabi aur bhi barh jaati hai. Quran mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai lekin kafir to is se aur bhi apna nuqsan kar liya karte hain. Yeh imandaron ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai be-imanon ke to kanon mein bojh hai. Un ki aankhon par andhapa hai woh to bohat hi fasle se pukare ja rahe hain. Yeh bhi kitni bari badbakhti hai ke dilon ki hidayat ki cheez bhi un ki zalalat-o-halakat ka ba'is banti hai. Is ki misal aisi hi hai jaise umdah ghiza bhi bad-mizaj ko muwafiq nahin aati.

Azab se dochar hone ke baad bhi munafiq baaz nahin ata

Yeh munafiq itna bhi nahin sochte ke har saal do ek dafa zaroor woh kisi na kisi azab mein mubtala kiye jaate hain. Lekin phir bhi unhein apne guzashta gunahon se taubah naseeb hoti hai na aainda ke liye ibrat hoti hai. Kabhi qaht saali hai kabhi jang hai, kabhi jhooti gappein hain jin se log bechain ho rahe hain. Farman-e-Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai kaamon mein sakhti barh rahi hai. Bakhili aam ho rahi hai. Har saal apne se pehle ke saal se bad aa raha hai. Jab koi surat utarti hai ek doosre ki taraf dekhta hai ke koi dekh to nahin raha? Phir haq se palat jaate hain na haq ko samajhein na maanein wa'az se munh pheer lein aur aise bhaagein jaise gadha sher se. Haq ko suna aur daayein baayein khasak gaye. Un ki is be-imani ka badla yehi hai ke Allah ne un ke dil bhi haq se pheer diye. Un ki kaji ne un ke dil bhi terhe kar diye. Yeh badla hai Allah ke khitab ko be-parwahi kar ke na samajhne ka is se bhaagne aur munh mor lene ka.

Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan-e-azeem hain. Musalmanon ko Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala apna ehsan-e-azeem yaad dila raha hai ke us ne apne fazl-o-karam se khud unhi mein se un ki hi zuban mein apna Rasool bheja. Hazrat Khalilullah ne yahi dua ki thi. Isi ka bayan (ayat Laqad mann-allahu al-kh) mein hai. Yahi Hazrat Jafar bin Abu Talib ne darbar-e-Najashi mein aur yeh Hazrat Mughirah bin Shubah ne darbar-e-Kisra mein bayan farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne hum mein hum hi mein se ek Rasool bheja. Jis ka nasab humein maloom, jis mein se koi burai Allah ne aap ki zaat mein paida nahi hone di. Nasab-nama bilkul khara tha. Khud aap ka farman hai ke Hazrat Adam se le kar mujh tak bi-fazlihi koi burai jahiliyat ki zina-kari waghera nahi pohanchi, main sahih-un-nasab hoon. Phir itne narm dil ke ummat ki takleefon se khud kaanp uthein. Aasan narmi aur sadagi wala deen lekar aaye hain. Jo bahut aasan hai, sahil hai, kamil hai aur aala aur umdah hai. Woh tumhari hidayat ke mutamanni hain, woh dunyawi ukhrawi nafa tumhein pohanchana chahte hain. Hazrat Abu Zar farmate hain humein Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne is hal mein chhoda ke jo parinda ud kar nikalta us ka ilm bhi aap humein kar dete. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Jannat se qareeb karne wali aur jahannam se door karne wali tamam cheezein main tum se bayan kar chuka hoon. Aap ka farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par jo kuch haram kiya hai woh anqareeb tum par zahir karne wala hai aur is ki baz-purs qatan hone wali hai. Jis tarah patange aur parwane aag par girte hain is tarah tum bhi gir rahe ho aur main tumhari koliyan bhar bhar kar tumhein is se rok raha hoon. Huzoor ﷺ soye hue hain ke do farishte aate hain ek paon ki taraf baithta hai dusra sirhane. Phir paon wala sirhane wale se kehta hai: Is ki aur is ki ummat ki misal bayan karo. Us ne farmaya: Yeh misal samjho ke ek qoum safar mein hai, ek chatil maidan mein pohanchti hai jahan un ka saman-e-khurak khatam ho jata hai, ab na to aage badhne ki quwat, na peechhe hatne ki sakat. Aise waqt ek bhala aadmi achhe libas wala un ke pas aata hai aur kehta hai ke main tumhein is biyaban se chhutkara dila kar aisi jagah pohncha sakta hoon jahan tumhein nuthre hue pani ke labalab hoz aur mewon ke lade hue darakht aur hari bhari lehlahati khetiyan milein bashart-e-ke tum mere peeche ho lo. Unhon ne us ki baat ko maan liya aur woh unhein aisi hi jagah le gaya wahan unhon ne khaya piya aur khoob phale phole. Ab us ne kaha: Dekho main ne tumhein is bhook pyas se najat dilai aur yahan amn-o-chain mein laya. Ab ek aur baat tum se kehta hoon woh bhi mano. Is se aage is se bhi behtar jagah hai, wahan ke hoz, wahan ke mewa, wahan ke khet, is se bahut hi aala hain. Ek jamaat ne to use sacha mana aur haan kar li, lekin dusre giroh ne isi par bas kar liya aur us ki tabadari se hat gaye (Musnad Ahmad). Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ par durood-o-salam bheje. Aao ek waqia aap ki kamal shafqat ka suno!

Aik a'arabi Rasul ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur khoon-baha ada karne ke liye aap se imdad talab ki. Aap ne usay bohat kuch diya. Phir poocha kyun sahib main ne tum se sulook kiya? Us ne kahan kuch bhi nahi is se kya hoga? Sahaba bohat bigray. Qareeb tha ke usay lipt jayen ke itna lene par bhi yeh nashukri karta hai? Aur Huzoor ﷺ ke sawal ka aisa ghalat aur gustakhana jawab deta hai. Lekin Aap ﷺ ne unhein rok diya, ghar par tashreef le gaye. Wohin usay bula liya. Sara waqia keh sunaya phir usay aur bhi bohat kuch diya. Phir poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Us ne kahan haan ab dil se razi hoon. Allah Ta'ala aap ko aap ke ahl-o-ayal mein hum sab ki taraf se naik badla de. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno! Tum aaye. Tum ne mujh se manga, main ne diya phir main ne tum se poocha ke khush ho? To tum ne ulta palta jawab diya jis se mere sahabi tum se nalan hain. Ab main ne phir de dula kar tumhein razi kar liya. Ab tum un ke samne bhi isi tarah apni razamandi zahir karna jaise ab tum ne mere samne ki hai taake un ka ranj bhi door ho jaye. Us ne kaha bohat acha. Chunancha jab woh sahaba ke majma mein aap ke paas aaya aap ne farmaya dekho yeh shakhs aaya tha is ne mujh se manga tha, main ne aise diya tha, phir is se poocha tha, to is ne aisa jawab diya tha jo tumhein nagawar guzra. Main ne ise phir apne ghar bulaya aur zyada diya to yeh khush ho gaya. Kyun bhai a'arabi yehi baat hai? Us ne kaha haan ya Rasoolallah, Allah Ta'ala aap ko hamare ahl-o-ayal aur qabeelay ki taraf se behtareen badla inayat farmaye. Aap ne mujh se bohat acha salook kiya. Jazakallah Us waqt aap ne farmaya meri aur is a'arabi ki misal suno! Jaise woh shakhs jis ki oontni bhag gayi log us ke pakadne ko daude woh un se badak kar aur bhagne lagi. Aakhir oontni wale ne kaha logo tum ek taraf hat jao mujhe aur meri oontni ko chhor do, is ki kho-khaslat se main waqif hoon aur yeh meri hi hai. Chunancha us ne narmi se usay bulana shuru kiya. Zameen se ghaas phoons tor kar apni muthi mein le kar usay dikhaya aur apni taraf bulaya, woh aa gayi. Us ne is ki nakeel tham li aur palan-o-kajawah daal diya. Suno! Is ke pehli dafa ke bigadne par agar main bhi tumhara sath deta to yeh jahannami ban jata. Ibrahim bin Hakam bin Aban ke zaf ki wajah se is ki sanad zaeef hai. Jaise farman hai ke اے نبی momino ke samne apna bazu past rakho. Log meri nafarmani karein to keh do ke main tumhare amaal se bari hoon. Tu hamesha apna bharosa Rabb-e-Azeez-o-Raheem par rakh. Munharifeen-e-shariat se aap be-niyaz ho jayen yahan bhi farmata hai agar yeh log teri shariat se munh pher lein to tu keh de ke mujhe Allah kafi hai. Is ke siva koi mabood nahi, mera tawakkal usi ki paak zaat par hai. Jaise farman hai mashriq-o-maghrib ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai is ke siva koi bhi layiq-e-ibadat nahi tu usi ko apna kar-saz thehra. Woh Rabb-e-Arsh-e-Azeem hai. Yani har cheez ka malik-o-khaliq wahi hai.

Arsh-e-Azeem tamam makhlooqat ki chhat hai. Aasman-o-zameen aur kul kainat ba-qudrat-e-Rab Arsh tale hai. Us Allah ka ilm har cheez par shamil hai aur har cheez ko apne ihate mein kiye hue hai. Us ki qudrat har cheez par haavi hai woh har ek ka karsaz hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab farmate hain sab se aakhri aayat Quran ki yahi hai. Marwi hai ke jab Khilafat-e-Siddiqi mein Quran ko jama kiya toh kaatibon ko Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab likhvate the, jab is se pehle ki (aayat la yafqahoon) tak pahunche toh kehne lage ke yahi aakhri aayat hai. Aap ne farmaya nahin is ke baad Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mujhe do aayatein aur parhwaai hain. Phir Aap ne un dono aayaton ki tilawat farmayi aur farmaya ke Quran ki aakhri aayatein yeh hain. Pas khatam bhi usi par hua jis par shuru hua tha yaani La ilaha illa Allah par. Yahi wahi tamam nabiyon par aati rahi hai ke mere siva koi pooja ke laayiq nahin. Tum sab meri hi ibaadat karo. Yeh riwayat bhi ghareeb hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Harith bin Khuzaimah ؓ in dono aayaton ko lekar aaye. Khud Rasool Allah ﷺ ne parhaai hain aur mujhe khoob achhi tarah hifz hain. Is par Hazrat Umar ؓ ne gawahi di ke maine bhi unhein Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai. Yeh gawahi sun kar Aap ne farmaya agar in ke saath teesri aayat bhi hoti toh main ise alag surat bana leta tum unhein Quran ki kisi surat ke saath likh lo. Chunancha Surah Bara'at ke aakhir mein yeh likh li gayi. Pehle yeh baat bhi bayaan ho chuki hai ke Hazrat Umar ؓ ne hi Quran ke jama karne ka mashwara Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ ko diya tha aur ba-hukm-e-khalifa Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit ؓ ne ise jama karna shuru kiya tha. Is jamaat mein Hazrat Umar ؓ bhi aamad-o-raft rakhte the. Sahih hadees mein hai Hazrat Zaid farmate hain. Surah Bara'at ka aakhri hissa maine Khuzaimah bin Sabit ya Abu Khuzaimah ke paas paaya. Yeh bhi hum likh aaye hain ke ek jamaat sahaba ne is ka mazakra Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ro-b-ru kiya jaise ke Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Sabit ne kaha tha. Jab ke un ke samne is ki ibtedaayi baat kahi thi. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Abu Darda ؓ se marwi hai ke jo shakhs subh-o-sham (aayat Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem) ko saat saat martaba parh le Allah Ta'ala ise is ki tamam pareshaniyon se nijat dega. Ek riwayat mein hai ke khwah sadaqat se parha ho ya na parha ho lekin yeh ziyadati ghareeb hai. Ek marfoo riwayat bhi isi qism ki hai lekin woh bahut munkar hai Wallahu A'lam.

Us ne kahan kuch bhi nahi is se kya hoga? Sahaba bohat bigray. Qareeb tha ke usay lipt jayen ke itna lene par bhi yeh nashukri karta hai? Aur Huzoor ﷺ ke sawal ka aisa ghalat aur gustakhana jawab deta hai. Lekin Aap ﷺ ne unhein rok diya, ghar par tashreef le gaye. Wohin usay bula liya. Sara waqia keh sunaya phir usay aur bhi bohat kuch diya. Phir poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Us ne kahan haan ab dil se razi hoon. Allah Ta'ala aap ko aap ke ahl-o-ayal mein hum sab ki taraf se naik badla de. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno! Tum aaye. Tum ne mujh se manga, main ne diya phir main ne tum se poocha ke khush ho? To tum ne ulta palta jawab diya jis se mere sahabi tum se nalan hain. Ab main ne phir de dula kar tumhein razi kar liya. Ab tum un ke samne bhi isi tarah apni razamandi zahir karna jaise ab tum ne mere samne ki hai taake un ka ranj bhi door ho jaye. Us ne kaha bohat acha. Chunancha jab woh sahaba ke majma mein aap ke paas aaya aap ne farmaya dekho yeh shakhs aaya tha is ne mujh se manga tha, main ne aise diya tha, phir is se poocha tha, to is ne aisa jawab diya tha jo tumhein nagawar guzra. Main ne ise phir apne ghar bulaya aur zyada diya to yeh khush ho gaya. Kyun bhai a'arabi yehi baat hai? Us ne kaha haan ya Rasoolallah, Allah Ta'ala aap ko hamare ahl-o-ayal aur qabeelay ki taraf se behtareen badla inayat farmaye. Aap ne mujh se bohat acha salook kiya. Jazakallah Us waqt aap ne farmaya meri aur is a'arabi ki misal suno! Jaise woh shakhs jis ki oontni bhag gayi log us ke pakadne ko daude woh un se badak kar aur bhagne lagi. Aakhir oontni wale ne kaha logo tum ek taraf hat jao mujhe aur meri oontni ko chhor do, is ki kho-khaslat se main waqif hoon aur yeh meri hi hai. Chunancha us ne narmi se usay bulana shuru kiya. Zameen se ghaas phoons tor kar apni muthi mein le kar usay dikhaya aur apni taraf bulaya, woh aa gayi. Us ne is ki nakeel tham li aur palan-o-kajawah daal diya. Suno! Is ke pehli dafa ke bigadne par agar main bhi tumhara sath deta to yeh jahannami ban jata. Ibrahim bin Hakam bin Aban ke zaf ki wajah se is ki sanad zaeef hai. Jaise farman hai ke اے نبی momino ke samne apna bazu past rakho. Log meri nafarmani karein to keh do ke main tumhare amaal se bari hoon. Tu hamesha apna bharosa Rabb-e-Azeez-o-Raheem par rakh. Munharifeen-e-shariat se aap be-niyaz ho jayen yahan bhi farmata hai agar yeh log teri shariat se munh pher lein to tu keh de ke mujhe Allah kafi hai. Is ke siva koi mabood nahi, mera tawakkal usi ki paak zaat par hai. Jaise farman hai mashriq-o-maghrib ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai is ke siva koi bhi layiq-e-ibadat nahi tu usi ko apna kar-saz thehra. Woh Rabb-e-Arsh-e-Azeem hai. Yani har cheez ka malik-o-khaliq wahi hai.

Arsh-e-Azeem tamam makhlooqat ki chhat hai. Aasman-o-zameen aur kul kainat ba-qudrat-e-Rab Arsh tale hai. Us Allah ka ilm har cheez par shamil hai aur har cheez ko apne ihate mein kiye hue hai. Us ki qudrat har cheez par haavi hai woh har ek ka karsaz hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab farmate hain sab se aakhri aayat Quran ki yahi hai. Marwi hai ke jab Khilafat-e-Siddiqi mein Quran ko jama kiya toh kaatibon ko Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab likhvate the, jab is se pehle ki (aayat la yafqahoon) tak pahunche toh kehne lage ke yahi aakhri aayat hai. Aap ne farmaya nahin is ke baad Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mujhe do aayatein aur parhwaai hain. Phir Aap ne un dono aayaton ki tilawat farmayi aur farmaya ke Quran ki aakhri aayatein yeh hain. Pas khatam bhi usi par hua jis par shuru hua tha yaani La ilaha illa Allah par. Yahi wahi tamam nabiyon par aati rahi hai ke mere siva koi pooja ke laayiq nahin. Tum sab meri hi ibaadat karo. Yeh riwayat bhi ghareeb hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Harith bin Khuzaimah ؓ in dono aayaton ko lekar aaye. Khud Rasool Allah ﷺ ne parhaai hain aur mujhe khoob achhi tarah hifz hain. Is par Hazrat Umar ؓ ne gawahi di ke maine bhi unhein Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai. Yeh gawahi sun kar Aap ne farmaya agar in ke saath teesri aayat bhi hoti toh main ise alag surat bana leta tum unhein Quran ki kisi surat ke saath likh lo. Chunancha Surah Bara'at ke aakhir mein yeh likh li gayi. Pehle yeh baat bhi bayaan ho chuki hai ke Hazrat Umar ؓ ne hi Quran ke jama karne ka mashwara Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique ؓ ko diya tha aur ba-hukm-e-khalifa Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit ؓ ne ise jama karna shuru kiya tha. Is jamaat mein Hazrat Umar ؓ bhi aamad-o-raft rakhte the. Sahih hadees mein hai Hazrat Zaid farmate hain. Surah Bara'at ka aakhri hissa maine Khuzaimah bin Sabit ya Abu Khuzaimah ke paas paaya. Yeh bhi hum likh aaye hain ke ek jamaat sahaba ne is ka mazakra Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ro-b-ru kiya jaise ke Hazrat Khuzaimah bin Sabit ne kaha tha. Jab ke un ke samne is ki ibtedaayi baat kahi thi. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Abu Darda ؓ se marwi hai ke jo shakhs subh-o-sham (aayat Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem) ko saat saat martaba parh le Allah Ta'ala ise is ki tamam pareshaniyon se nijat dega. Ek riwayat mein hai ke khwah sadaqat se parha ho ya na parha ho lekin yeh ziyadati ghareeb hai. Ek marfoo riwayat bhi isi qism ki hai lekin woh bahut munkar hai Wallahu A'lam.
